briefing.en: Find a way to decrypt the ANDRADA files.
briefing.zh: 设法解密 ANDRADA 文件。

briefing.en: Take the files to Gargoyle and convince the hacker to decrypt them.
briefing.zh: 把文件带给 Gargoyle，说服这名黑客将其解密。

briefing.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao.
Take the files to Rayan Arroyo. He'll know how to turn this situation toward his advantage.
briefing.zh: 将文件交给 Rayan Arroyo。他自然知道如何把这场乱局变成自己的进项。

briefing.en: Take the files to Faro Inesis to see if you can use Tri-Tachyon black-site resources to decrypt them.
briefing.zh: 将文件交给 Faro Inesis，看能否借助速子科技的黑色站点资源将其解密。

briefing.en: Take the files to Special Agent Finlay Siyavong of Fleet Intelligence to see if he can help.
briefing.zh: 将这些文件交给舰队情报部的特工 Finlay Siyavong，看看他是否愿意帮你解密。

briefing.en: Take the files to Horus Yaribay, on Kazeron.
briefing.zh: 将文件交给 Kazeron 上的 Horus Yaribay。

briefing.en: Take the files to Reynard Hannan, on Kazeron.
briefing.zh: 将文件交给 Kazeron 上的 Reynard Hannan。

briefing.en: You've decided to use your alpha-core AI administrator's abilities to decrypt the files.
briefing.zh: 你决定动用你的 Alpha 核心 AI 管理员的能力来解密这些文件。

briefing.en: Find the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada.
briefing.zh: 找到 Philip Andrada 的七名克隆子嗣。

texts.en: There are rumors that you're a double or triple-agent working for - or against? - Dolos Macario.
texts.zh: 有传言说你是 Dolos Macario 的双面特工，搞不好还是个要收拾他的三面特工。

texts.en:
"Captain," she says, unexpressive but with a carefully respectful tone. "Please stay clear of our operational volume."

And pause. "We have nothing further to discuss at this time.

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
"舰长，" 她面无表情，语气却刻意恭敬，"请与我们的行动区域保持距离。"

顿了一拍。"眼下我们没什么好谈的了。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

texts.en:
"Independent fleet," she says, not acknowledging your previous contact, "Hear me: stay clear of our operational volume and you will not be fired upon."

"Hyder out."

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.
texts.zh:
"独立舰队，\" 她开口道，对此前的照面只字不提，\"听好了：与我们的行动区域保持距离，就不会遭到攻击。"

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

texts.en:
"Commission-bearing fleet," she says, not acknowledging your previous contact, "Hear me: your are directed to stay clear of our operational volume as we perform official maneuvers."

"Hyder out."

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.
texts.zh:
"持委任状的舰队，\" 她开口道，对此前的照面只字不提，\"听好了：我方正在执行正式演习，请与我们的行动区域保持距离。"

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

options.en: Finlay Siyavong told me you could and would kill the Andrada heirs.
options.zh: Finlay Siyavong 告诉我，你既能、也愿意杀掉 Andrada 家的几个继承人。

texts.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic face of a commanding officer who is disappointed - but more than that, angry - with a subordinate who has risked the mission through not only ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"$TitleHeg. You mingled with a Persean League spy. And then come to me to pour his lies on my desk?"
texts.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情 —— 一名主官绷着的、不动声色的脸，失望是有的，可更深处是怒：恼的是手下办事不单因为无知，更因判断与品性都欠火候，险些把整桩任务搭进去。

"$TitleHeg。你跟一个英仙座联盟的探子搅在一处，回头还跑到我这儿，把他那套谎话倒在我桌上？"

texts.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic, blank face of a commanding officer who is truly angry with a subordinate who has risked the mission through more than ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"$TitlePL." His voice is controlled. "I extent great leeway by even accepting your comms request. Then you pour the lies of a League spy on my desk."
texts.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情——指挥官板起的一张不动声色的空面孔：下属把任务置于险地，靠的不只是无知，更是根本上的判断与品性出了岔子，他这才真动了怒。

"$TitlePL。\" 他把声音压得很稳。\"光是肯接下你的通讯请求，我已经是格外通融了。转头你却把一个联盟间谍的谎话倒到我桌上。"

texts.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic face of a commanding officer who is disappointed - but more than that, angry - with a civilian who has risked the mission through not only ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"Captain. You've mingled with a Persean League spy. Then come to me and you pour his lies onto my desk."
texts.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情——指挥官板着脸，失望，可更甚的是恼火：一个平民把任务置于险地，靠的不只是无知，更是根本上的判断与品性出了岔子。

"舰长。你跟一个英仙座联盟的间谍搅在了一起。转头还跑来我这儿，把他的谎话倒到我桌上。"

texts.en: He takes a slow breath, eyes fixed on your through the link.
texts.zh: 他缓缓吸了口气，隔着通讯链路一眼不眨地盯着你。

options.en: I'm only looking for the truth.
options.zh: 我只想查明真相。

options.en: I apologize. It was an innappropriate inquiry.
options.zh: 我道歉。这问题问得不合时宜。

options.en: So did you order the assassination of Andrada's clones?
options.zh: 这么说，是你下令刺杀 Andrada 的克隆体了？

options.en: I'm giving you a chance to deny the allegations.
options.zh: 我给你一个否认这些指控的机会。

texts.en: "That's a luxury we have not been able to afford for a long, long time, $titleHeg," he says, almost a growl.
texts.zh: "这份奢侈，我们早已很久很久消受不起了，$titleHeg，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

texts.en: "Then you'll be looking for a long time, $titlePL," he says, almost a growl.
texts.zh: "那你就慢慢找吧，有得找了，$titlePL，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

texts.en: "Keep looking, spacer," he says, almost a growl.
texts.zh: "接着找吧，太空人，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

texts.en:
"This conversation is over."

The link cuts.

* * *

It might be wise to wait a day or so before trying to contact Admiral Rao again."
texts.zh:
"谈话到此为止。"

链接被切断。

* * *

隔上一天左右再设法联系 Rao 上将，或许更稳妥些。"

texts.en: "Correct," he says, almost a growl.
texts.zh: "说得对，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

texts.en: "Your condescension is unwelcome, spacer," he says, almost a growl.
texts.zh: "少拿这种居高临下的口气跟我说话，太空人，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

texts.en:
The link opens with a surprisingly brief wait for an officer of Rao's rank. He appears with the hint of an amused smile.

"$PlayerName! I see you've carried out my orders to the letter. Great work," he says, seemingly earnest.

"Perhaps I should award you a medal for your service?"
texts.zh:
通讯链接以惊人的速度接通了 —— 对 Rao 这个级别的军官而言，等待时间称得上是极短。他出现在画面中，带着一丝玩味的笑意。

"$PlayerName！看来你严格执行了我的命令。干得漂亮，" 他说道，听来颇为诚恳。

"或许该为你颁发一枚勋章以示嘉奖？"

options.en: What in the worlds are you talking about?
options.zh: 你到底在说什么？

options.en: Yes, I think a medal would be in order.
options.zh: 是的，我想一枚勋章是应该的。

texts.en:
His eyes glitter frostily.

"I'm talking about a liar." His finger flicks to point at you.

"The one with the gall to open a comm link to my face after I received a most fascinating report from one of our fleet commanders about an encounter during an emergency intercept near Tse Franchise Station."
texts.zh:
他的眼睛冷冽地闪着寒光。

"我说的是个骗子。" 他手指一弹，指向你。

"一个在我收到某位舰队指挥官关于 Tse 特许经营空间站附近紧急拦截遭遇战的精彩报告后，竟敢当面与我通讯的家伙。"

options.en: Oh, I remember now.
options.zh: 噢，我现在想起来了。

options.en: That must have been a different $playerName.
options.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

texts.en:
"I'm glad to hear it, captain," he says. "Now we may speak plainly."

"From captain to... what have they made me, an $rank? My, it makes you wonder who's in charge, doesn't it."
texts.zh:
"很高兴听你这么说，舰长，" 他说道，"现在我们可以有话直说了。"

"从舰长到...他们给我安了个什么头衔，$rank？呵，这让人不禁想问到底是哪些家伙在掌权，不是吗。"

options.en: Let him get to his point, whatever it is
options.zh: 等他把话说完，不管他要说什么

options.en: That'd be the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud.
options.zh: 那应该是至高霸主，Baikal Daud。

texts.en:
"You played it well," he says.

"Outsmarted a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn more of each cycle. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."

He pauses a moment, studying you. "I had the thought..."
texts.zh:
"你演得很出色，" 他说道。

"骗过了 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

他停顿片刻，审视着你。"我有个想法..."

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 怎么了？

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain, that's true. But," he takes on an avuncular tone, "I don't think you've got enough experience to handle what I've got in mind."

"Put yourself out there, take on some jobs. We may speak again on this later."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"你确实很有潜力，舰长。但是，" 他的语气转为长辈式的教诲，"我认为你尚且缺乏足够经验，不足以处理我所构思的事情。"

"去历练吧，承接些任务。我们或许可以日后再议此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en: "You've got promise, captain." He pauses. "And I believe you have the experience to handle what I've got in mind."
texts.zh: "你很有潜力，舰长。" 他停顿片刻，"而且我相信，以你的经验足以胜任我心中的计划。"

texts.en:
"You've got promise, captain. You know how to slip out of a trap. You know how to use any means available to win."

He pauses. "It speaks well for what I have in mind.""
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你懂得如何挣脱陷阱，懂得如何不择手段地取得胜利。"

他停顿片刻，"这正契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. Especially if your captaining is anything like your swordplay. You spilled blood for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长，尤其是你那与自身剑术造诣相当益彰的指挥才能。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. You were brave enough to take up the sword with full knowledge of the art, fight... and lose. Your blood was spilled for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你足够勇敢，在通晓剑艺的情况下执剑应战...并败北。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You've found lucrative employment of a sort with the Tri-Tachyon corporation, however."

He leans back. "We could discuss this matter again if that situation were to change."
texts.zh:
"然而，你已经在 速子科技 找到某种利润丰厚的差事了。"

他向后靠去，"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

texts.en:
"Huh." He chews on his lip.

"Why not ask your boss, Dolos Macario, for a job? I'm sure he's got some dissidents to space."
texts.zh:
"呵。" 他咬着嘴唇说道。

"为什么不向你老板 Dolos Macario 讨个差事？我很确信他总有些异见分子需要处理。"

texts.en: "You're already signed up with the Hegemony. Good. That saves me a lot of bureaucratic nonsense."
texts.zh: "你已经登记加入 霸主 了，很好，这省去我不少官僚程序的麻烦。"

texts.en:
"As you bear the commission of the Persean League..." He makes a half-shrug. "I can't have you in a position of divided loyalty."

"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"既然你已经持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议了..." 他半耸着肩膀，"我不能让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug. "Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... well, we can't very well divide your loyalties."

"Besides," a fleeting smile appears. "I see you've fallen into Reynard Hannan's orbit. An ego of that size produces a gravity well which is very difficult to escape."
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅...但我们很难要求你分割忠诚。"

"况且，" 他的脸上浮现出一抹转瞬即逝的微笑，"我看你已经坠入 Reynard Hannan 的引力范围了。如此庞大的自我意识所产生的重力井，想必是极难挣脱的。"

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug.

"But perhaps," he looks aside. "We might have a mutual friend on Kazeron?"
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

他微微耸肩。

"不过或许，" 他侧目看去，"我们在 Kazeron 有共同的朋友？"

texts.en:
"Although the Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..."

He makes a half-shrug.

"You've chosen your path. I couldn't possibly distract you from your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"虽然 霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..."

他半耸着肩膀。

"但你已经选择了自己的道路，我哪敢打扰你那些烦人的信仰事务。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug.

"I suppose," he says slowly, "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸着肩膀。

"我想，" 他缓缓说道，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug, then pauses to look right at you.

"It's the guns you've given Standfast," his words are precise, "that convince me of your dedication."

He looks away, casual again. "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸肩膀。

"是你提供给 Standfast 的那些军火，" 他字句精准，"让我确信了你的诚意。"

他移开视线，恢复了随意的姿态，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: My membership in the Persean League is my business.
options.zh: 加入 英仙座联盟 是我的个人事务。

options.en: Reynard is insufferable, but I could not get a better deal.
options.zh: Reynard 令人难以忍受，但我找不到更优的选择了。

options.en: Reynard is a great man. I follow him gladly.
options.zh: Reynard 是个伟大的人，我十分乐意追随他。

options.en: I'm sure I couldn't say.
options.zh: 我恐怕无可奉告。

options.en: Horus Yaribay, you mean. And his desire for unification with the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你是指 Horus Yaribay，以及他渴望与 霸主 合并的意愿。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

texts.en:
"I'd like to offer you work. You don't have to salute me, and I'll make sure you're paid promptly."

He leans forward, his hands together. "What do you think? Could be fun. Play your cards right, and you'll be a legend."
texts.zh:
"我想给你提供工作。你不必向我敬礼，而我也会确保报酬能够及时支付。"

他倾身向前，双手交握，"你意下如何？这或许会很有趣。如果你打得一手好牌的话，就将会成为传奇。"

options.en: What sort of work do you need done?
options.zh: 你需要完成什么样的工作？

options.en: You show little respect for your fellow officers of the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你对 霸主 的同僚军官显得缺乏敬意。

options.en: What are these 'unique circumstances'? What is your goal?
options.zh: 这些 '特殊情况' 具体指什么？你的目标是什么？

options.en: Is this about taking down the Sindrian Diktat?
options.zh: 这是为了推翻 辛达强权 吗？

options.en: Why is it personal with Andrada?
options.zh: 你为什么和 Andrada 有私人恩怨？

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: I'm not so sure about this.
options.zh: 我不太确定。

texts.en:
"A proper officer of the Hegemony is taught to leap toward the enemy, blazing guns. Once the noise quiets down, they'll wait, slack-jawed, for the medals to be pinned to their uniforms."

"Such is the way of the Domain, which we must uphold."

He half-raises a finger, a quirk on his lips. "Officially," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"正统的 霸主 军官被教导要随着枪口的火光冲向敌阵。待硝烟散去，他们便张着嘴等待勋章别上军装。"

"此乃 人之领 之道，我等必须恪守。"

他微抬手指，嘴角轻扬，"官方说法如此，" 他总结道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Baikal was kind enough to find me a place where I could get important work done. I deal with... let us call them 'unique circumstances'. And for this I find it necessary to associate with energetic freelancers."

"I'll ensure you're paid promptly for a roster of small merc jobs."

"Then, perhaps something big will come up. When it does, I want to know I can count on you."
texts.zh:
"Baikal 好意为我寻得一处能处理重要事务的地方。我要处理的是...不妨让我们称之为 '特殊情况'。为此，我需要有活力的自由职业者。"

"我会确保你接手的小型雇佣任务都能及时获得报酬。"

"届时，或许会有重大机遇降临。当那一刻来临时，我希望能与你建立信任。"

texts.en:
"The truth makes few friends." Rao produces a wry smile.

"I never could stand a fool, especially when that fool is an honorable member of the Strategic Assembly. So," he holds his hand out to indicate his surroundings, Ragnar Complex.

"It's not so bad."
texts.zh:
"真相鲜少赢得朋友。" Rao 露出讥诮的微笑。

"我向来无法容忍蠢材，尤其当他们是战略指挥部的成员时。所以，" 他伸手示意周围的环境 —— Ragnar 综合设施。

"这里还不算太糟。"

texts.en:
"I'm offering you the chance to be the grit that throws history off its axis."

He lets his sly smile fade. "There are many bodies of power turning just now. Grinding away, warships and bombings and riots and resources."

"The Persean Sector needs change, or it will grind what's left of us to dust."
texts.zh:
"我正在给予你成为历史转折点的机会。"

他慢慢收起他那狡黠的微笑，"此刻正有许多权力机构正在运转。缓慢地碾磨着 —— 战舰、轰炸、暴动、资源。"

"英仙座星域需要变革，否则它将把我们仅存的一切碾作尘埃。"

texts.en:
A cold, quick expression passes over his face.

"Let us say that I'd be as satisfied as any Hegemony officer to cut down that pompous traitor. Setting aside even the matter of honor, I have a personal dislike of the man."
texts.zh:
一抹冰冷而迅疾的神色掠过他的脸庞。

"可以说，与任何 霸主 军官一样，能除掉那个自负的叛徒会令我深感快意。即便撇开荣誉问题不谈，我个人也极度厌恶此人。"

texts.en:
Rao lets out a slow breath. "That's talk for old comrades, over drink."

He leans back, not quite committing to a frown.

"Patience, captain."
texts.zh:
Rao 缓缓呼出一口气，"那是老战友间把酒言欢时的谈资。"

他向后靠去，眉间并未完全皱起。

"耐心些，舰长。"

texts.en: "Good," his approval comes with his sly smile. "Have your people set up secure comms. We'll show the Strategic Assembly how it's done."
texts.zh: "很好，" 他的赞许伴随着狡黠的笑容，"让你的人建立安全通讯，我们将向战略指挥部展示该如何行事。"

texts.en:
"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

texts.en:
"Of course."

He sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"当然。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

texts.en:
"Nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: "But you made the deal," Rao says impishly. "You didn't have to."
texts.zh: "但交易是你自己达成的，"Rao 狡黠地说道，"你本可拒绝。"

options.en: I don't need to explain myself to you.
options.zh: 我没必要向你解释。

options.en: I have a plan to get out of it. You'll see.
options.zh: 我有脱身的计划，你很快就会看到的。

options.en: Is the Hegemony offering its protection against the League?
options.zh: 霸主 这是要提供针对联盟的庇护吗？

texts.en:
"Then nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"那便无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Rao holds a finger to his cheek for a moment, thinking.

"It could be earned," he says. "But that's up to you."
texts.zh:
Rao 将手指轻抵脸颊片刻，一边陷入了沉思。

"或许可以争取，" 他说道，"但这取决于你。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What admirable loyalty! How Reynard earns it, I've never understood. I must study his leadership closely, for I obviously have much to learn." The sarcasm runs thick.

Rao sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"多么可敬的忠诚！我始终不明白 Reynard 是如何赢得这份忠诚的。我必须仔细研究他的领导艺术，显然我还有很多需要学习。" 话语中夹杂着明显的讽刺意味。

Rao 向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I understand. Keeping with his trust is more important than serving that goal." He leans back, "It's interesting."
texts.zh: "我理解。维护他的信任可比服务那个目标更重要。" 他向后靠去，"这很有趣。"

options.en: Speculate if you like, I have nothing to say.
options.zh: 你尽管猜测，而我就无可奉告了。

options.en: Hypothetically, I would require the consent of the third party before discussing anything.
options.zh: 在假设的情况下，我在讨论任何事情之前都需要获得第三方的同意。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前还不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

texts.en: Rao raises an eyebrow, his expression amused.
texts.zh: Rao 扬起一侧眉毛，神色玩味。

texts.en:
He smiles coyly, leaving your statement deliberately unanswered.

"It is possible our work together would serve certain common goals."
texts.zh:
他狡黠地微笑着，刻意不回应你的陈述。

"我们的合作或许能服务于某些共同的目标。"

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

texts.en:
"Ludd, I think, doesn't need self-appointed curates to shield the Faith from my little comments," he says, his eyes suddenly sharp. "Pray on the matter. I insist."

He leans back, and his face falls into shadow.
texts.zh:
"我认为卢德并不需要自封的祭司来替信仰挡下我的几句闲言碎语，" 他说道，眼神也突然锐利起来，"为此祈祷吧，我坚持如此。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Who is Dolos?
options.zh: Dolos 是谁？

options.en: Look, I just take Diktat money. I'm a merc. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: I take it that's a 'no', then.
options.zh: 那么，我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

options.en: I just take Diktat money. I'm a mercenary. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: You're a worm compared to the genius of Dolos Macario!
options.zh: 和 Dolos Macario 的才智相比，你不过是条蛆虫！

options.en: I take it that's a 'no'.
options.zh: 我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

texts.en:
"He calls himself the 'The Spider of Sindria', but that's not right," Rao says. "He's a self-satisfied little worm that's chewed his way into the rotten heart of the Sindrian Diktat. You should meet him."

Rao's smile is cold.

"Go. Meet him. Go on, now." He makes a shoo motion, then slaps the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"虽然他自称 '辛达瑞亚之蛛'，但其实这并不恰当，" Rao说道，"他不过就是条自鸣得意的蛆虫，啃噬着 辛达强权 那腐烂的心脏，你该去见见他。"

Rao 的笑容十分冰冷。

"去啊，去见他，现在就去。" 他做了个驱赶的手势，随即切断了通讯。

texts.en:
"You're not like me," he says. "I was a mercenary, yes. But that was not all I was. And it is not all I am."

"I am a Rao," his voice is full and strong. "I am an officer of the Hegemony Navy despite the best efforts of a few among us who love rules and uniforms more than they love the service and the cause."

He sits back down, a piercing and newly earnest look fixed on you.
texts.zh:
"你可和我不一样，" 他说道，"我确实曾是佣兵。但那并非是我的全部过去，也并非是我的全部现在。"

"我是 Rao 家族的一员，" 他的声音饱满有力，"尽管某些将规章与制服盖过效忠与事业的同僚百般阻挠，我仍是 霸主 海军的军官。"

他重新落座，用锐利而真挚的目光锁定着你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You are what you do, not the lies you tell yourself."

He reaches for an interface, pauses, then speaks.

"Now go away."
texts.zh:
"你的所作所为造就了你，而非自我欺骗的谎言。"

他伸手触向操作界面，在停顿片刻后，方才开口道。

"现在离开吧。"

texts.en:
"Correct," he says icily.

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"没错，" 他冷冰冰地说道。

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en:
"Hah," Orcus Rao says, rolling his eyes. "We got another one."

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"哈，" Orcus Rao 翻了个白眼，"又来了个这样的。"

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en:
"One should think," he says pointedly. "But never mind- what I mean to say is that you played the ruse well."

"Better than a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn each cycle would. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."
texts.zh:
"理应如此，" 他意味深长地说，"不过算了 —— 我想说的是你这场戏演得很漂亮。"

"比 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚强得多。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Rao laughs, though there's more of an edge...

You take a moment to try to form a judgement - if he really thinks this is funny, he can't be too angry, right? Or is he one of those officers that keeps others off guard with calculated shifts in mood? From what you know - mostly holodocs - Rao has a cunning streak and a bit of a mixed reputation among the more respectable segments of the Hegemony.

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
Rao 笑了，但笑意中带着几分锋芒...

你稍作停顿试图判断 —— 如果他真觉得这事好笑，那他应该没太生气吧？还是说他属于那种靠刻意转换情绪来让人防不胜防的军官？据你所知 —— 主要来自全息纪录片 —— Rao 心机深沉，在 霸主 的体面圈子里口碑有些两极分化。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"No." His amused tone grows a touch of frost.

He looks aside as he speaks. "I think not. They don't give medals for lying in the Hegemony..."

Then he holds a finger to his lips, thoughtfully. "No, that's not true. Not at all. They don't give medals for lying TO the Hegemony."

He smiles again, turning back to you.
texts.zh:
"不。" 他戏谑的语气里，此刻透出一丝寒意。

他侧目说道："我不这么认为。霸主 可不会为撒谎者颁发勋章..."

随后他若有所思地将手指按在唇上，"不，这不准确，完全不对。应该是他们不会为欺骗 霸主 者颁发勋章。"

他再次露出微笑，一边转回来面向你。

options.en: When did I ever lie to the Hegemony? (feign innocence)
options.zh: 我什么时候欺骗过 霸主？ (佯装无辜)

options.en: Is this about that fleet looking for Gargoyle after I left Tse Franchise Station?
options.zh: 是说我离开 Tse 特许经营空间站后，那支追捕 Gargoyle 的舰队的事吗？

texts.en:
He breaks out in a hearty laugh, taking a moment before he rubs his eyes.

"Yes, yes, very good." Rao lets his hands fall deliberately to his console.

"You lied when you encountered the absolute oaf in command of the fleet ordered to intercept you, transporting a hacker wanted by the Hegemony, away from Tse Franchise Station."
texts.zh:
他放声大笑，缓了片刻后才揉了揉眼睛。

"好，好，很好。" Rao 刻意将双手落在控制台上。

"当你遭遇那支奉命拦截你的舰队指挥官 —— 那个十足的蠢货时，你撒谎了，那时你正运送着 霸主 通缉的黑客离开 Tse 特许经营空间站。"

options.en: Oh, I remember now.
options.zh: 噢，我现在想起来了。

options.en: That must have been a different $playerName.
options.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

texts.en: "It is, yes," he says. "And the absolute oaf in command who believed your ruse."
texts.zh: "是的，没错，" 他说道，"还有那个相信你谎言的彻头彻尾的蠢材指挥官。"

options.en: Withhold comment
options.zh: 不作回应

options.en: Well. Sorry.
options.zh: 这个嘛。抱歉了。

options.en: Don't blame them too much, I can be pretty convincing when I want to be.
options.zh: 别太责怪他们，我想我说服别人时还是很有说服力的。

texts.en:
He waves the thought away, then takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
他挥手驱散了这个念头，随后深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Don't apologize for winning," he says. "It's unbecoming."

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
"别为胜利道歉，" 他说道，"这有失体面。"

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He snorts at that.

Rao takes a quiet moment then drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
他对此嗤之以鼻。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: A merc on the Askonia fringe told me to visit Ragnar. I assume that means you.
options.zh: 在 Askonia 星系边缘的一名佣兵叫我去趟 Ragnar。我猜测那人的意思是让我来见你。

texts.en:
"Is that so," he says, nonchalant.

"I wonder why they would have said that."
texts.zh: "是吗，" 他漫不经心地说道，"我倒好奇那个人为何要这么说。"

options.en: I think they were working for you. And under orders not to say so.
options.zh: 我认为那个人曾为你效力。且被命令不准向他人透露。

texts.en:
He raises an eyebrow, his affect casual.

"If I had hired this mercenary, I imagine I'd be pretty upset at how easily they gave up the identity of their employer. It's a good thing the Hegemony has an official policy forbidding the employ of mercs."
texts.zh:
他扬起一侧眉毛，神情依然随意。

"如果是我雇佣了这个佣兵，想必会就对方如此轻易就供出了雇主的身份而感到十分恼火。幸好 霸主 有禁止雇佣佣兵的官方政策。"

options.en: What? The Hegemony regularly employs mercenaries.
options.zh: 什么？霸主 明明经常雇佣佣兵。

options.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
options.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

options.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
options.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

options.en: Clearly you don't take this very seriously.
options.zh: 显然你并没有把这件事看得很重。

texts.en:
"Really?" Admiral Rao, leaning forward, puts on a look of concern.

He speaks officiously. "As a patriotic citizen, I'm sure you'll have reported all such lapses of policy so that official action may be taken."

The pose holds for a moment, then half a smile cracks through.
texts.zh:
"真的？" Rao 上将身体前倾，摆出关切的神色。

他用公事公办的语气说道："作为一位爱国公民，想必你已经上报了所有此类违规政策的行为，以便官方采取行动。"

他维持了这个姿态片刻，随即露出一丝笑意。

texts.en:
"Hmm." Rao looks you over. Is that twinkle in his eye - there are no other words for it - amusement?

"Why?"

He leaves the silence for you to fill.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Rao 打量着你，他眼中闪烁的是玩味吗？

"为什么？"

他留出沉默，等待你进行填补。

options.en: Because you'll pay me well, and on time. You were a freelancer, you know the life.
options.zh: 因为你报酬优渥，且会按时支付。你也当过自由佣兵，知道这行的生存法则。

options.en: They're mutineers. They undermine the restoration of the Domain, the Hegemony's purpose.
options.zh: 他们是叛乱分子。他们破坏了 人之领 的重建，而那是 霸主 的核心使命。

options.en: They're brutal oppressors, enemies of freedom and life. It's a just cause.
options.zh: 他们是残暴的压迫者，是自由与生命的敌人。这是一项正义的事业。

options.en: They're systematically killing the Faithful, they closed the Shrine of Volturn. My duty is to resist.
options.zh: 他们正系统性地屠杀信众，并关闭了 Volturn 圣地。抵抗他们正是我职责所在。

options.en: Because they're falling apart. They're going to lose and I like being on the winning side.
options.zh: 因为他们正在分崩离析。他们必败无疑，而我喜欢站在胜利的一方。

texts.en: He nods, eyes closed. "I will, I was, and I do." His eyes open, and he says "That's not all, though."
texts.zh: 他闭目点头。"我将会如此，我一直如此，而我也正在如此。" 他睁开眼说道，"但也不止于此。"

texts.en: He stares at you, a puzzled look on his face. "You're a believer, then. Huh." Rao rubs his chin.
texts.zh: 他凝视着你，面露困惑。"这么说你是个忠诚派。嗯。" Rao 摩挲着下巴。

texts.en: He nods, watching you. "Got the fire, I see. Good."
texts.zh: 他点点头，一边注视着你。"有血性，我看得出来。很好。"

texts.en: "Huh. Met Standfast, did you? I like her."
texts.zh: "呵。见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

texts.en:
"Huh," he looks aside. "Met Standfast, did you? I like her."

Rao makes a sly smile. "It's you who's been giving her some big guns, hasn't it."
texts.zh:
"呵，"他侧目望去，"见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

Rao 露出狡黠的笑容。"给她那些大家伙的人是你，对吧。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Is your loyalty so contingent? I suppose that is true for many, perhaps most- and almost all are loathe to admit it. How brave, then, to admit it." His tone is rhetorical, and rather more sardonic than earnest.

Rao looks to you again. "Nonetheless, I agree with your assessment of the enemy."
texts.zh:
"原来你的忠诚这么动摇吗？我想许多人 —— 或许大多数人 —— 都是如此，只是几乎无人愿承认。那么，敢于承认倒是勇气可嘉。" 他的语气带着反问的色彩，更多是讥讽而非诚恳。

Rao 再次看向你，"不过，我赞同你对敌人的评价。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: He shrugs, holding his ironic half-smile in place. Behind it his eyes are cold, very cold.
texts.zh: 他耸耸肩，保持着那抹讽刺的似笑非笑，而那笑容后是他冰冷的眼神，极为冰冷。

options.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
options.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

options.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
options.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

options.en: Right. I don't have time for this.
options.zh: 行吧，我没时间。

texts.en:
"Then I bid you a good day, captain."

Rao flicks the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"那么祝你今日愉快，舰长。"

Rao 轻点切断了通讯。

options.en: I think you might have work for me.
options.zh: 我认为你可能有任务交给我。

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"I don't have a reputation for being stickler for regulations, but I need you to hold a Hegemony commission before we have operational discussions concerning these matters."

He lets a hand drop on his desk.

"No exceptions."
texts.zh:
"我向来不以严守条令出名，但在我们就这些事展开作战层面的讨论之前，我需要你持有霸主委任状。"

他把一只手拍到桌上。

"没有例外。"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en: He consider for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

options.en: What should I do?
options.zh: 我该怎么做？

options.en: Isn't... Ragnar Station a bit of a backwater?
options.zh: Ragnar 空间站...不算是有点偏僻吗？

options.en: I found Hector. Irkalla was a trap. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Hector。Irkalla 是个陷阱。 (解释)

options.en: Achilles could be a problem. He's smart; navy-trained. And he keeps a cool head.
options.zh: Achilles 可能会是个麻烦。他聪明，受过海军训练，而且沉得住气。

options.en: Achilles could be a reformer. He'd be better for the Sector than Philip ever was.
options.zh: Achilles 说不定是个改革者。对这个星域来说，他会比 Philip 强得多。

options.en: Jason Andrada was on Qaras. He was dead when I arrived.
options.zh: Jason Andrada 在 Qaras 上。我赶到的时候他已经死了。

options.en: I found Pericles. Someone shot him.
options.zh: 我找到了 Pericles。有人开枪打死了他。

options.en: Let's talk about something else. (back)
options.zh: 我们谈点别的吧。 (返回)

texts.en:
"Find them," he says. "Didn't I say that already?"

"I don't think this is a pack of lies from Dolos Macario, not this time. But confirmation doesn't hurt. And I'd prefer it if someone with a little more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."
texts.zh:
"找出他们，\"他说，\"我不是已经说过了？"

"我不觉得这是 Dolos Macario 编的一整套谎话，这次不像。不过确认一下也没有坏处。而且我更希望派个比霸主一贯的'精锐'稍微懂点分寸的人去查，\"他拿起数据板，嫌恶地看了一眼，\"去查这一串穷乡僻壤。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
"You've done good work for the Hegemony," he says, and taps at his datapad. "For your trouble."

"And you're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主干得不错，\"他说着，在数据平板上敲了几下。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"而在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"You've served the Hegemony," he says, and taps the datapad. "For your trouble."

"You're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主效过力，\"他说着，敲了敲数据平板。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"Ragnar Complex," he corrects you. "I'm not posted here to enjoy myself, captain."

"This place," he gestures toward his surroundings, "has certain advantages. Foremost being that none of my former contingent from the Eventide class are particularly interested in taking this dishonorable post, nor are they asking to be invited for an official inspection of a fleet of mildly radioactive hulks."

He stares off into what you assume is a bulkhead, for a moment. Considering his alternatives, perhaps.

"Enough about me," he says finally.
texts.zh:
"是 Ragnar 综合设施，\"他纠正你，\"我被派到这儿可不是来享乐的，舰长。"

"这地方，\"他朝四周示意，\"有它的好处。最主要的是，我原先带的、从 Eventide 那个阶层出身的那批人，没谁特别想接这个不光彩的差事，也没谁主动要求被请来对一支轻度放射性的废船舰队做正式视察。"

他朝某个方向望了一会儿 —— 你猜那是一道舱壁。也许是在掂量自己还有别的什么出路。

"不说我了，"他最后说。

texts.en:
You explain about the automated defenses and the personalized, pre-recorded messages. Your name could have been subbed into his speeches by an algorithm, but you suspect this was meant for you.

Rao nods, listening.

"Think he's Macario's pick?"
texts.zh:
你讲了那些自动防御系统，以及那些针对个人预先录好的讯息。你的名字也许只是被算法替换进了他的演讲，但你怀疑那本是说给你听的。

Rao 点着头，听你说完。

"你觉得他是 Macario 选中的人？"

options.en: Probably. Hector seems to believe everything Macario told him.
options.zh: 多半是。Macario 说的每一句，Hector 似乎都信。

options.en: I'm not sure. Hector talks like a true believer in Andradism.
options.zh: 我不确定。Hector 说话的样子，像是个真心信仰 Andrada 主义的信徒。

options.en: I don't think so. Hector seems sheltered. How could he lead an empire?
options.zh: 我不这么认为。Hector 像是被养在温室里的人。他怎么可能领导一个帝国？

texts.en: "Just imagine," he says, then shakes his head.
texts.zh: "想想那会成什么样。"他说着，摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"If Macario had direct control over every aspect of his upbringing, and ensured that everything he knows is what Macario wishes for him to know... and never more than Macario himself."

Rao returns his speculative look to meet yours.

"This is good. We'll work with it."
texts.zh:
"如果 Macario 直接控制了他成长的每一个方面，确保他所知的一切都是 Macario 希望他知道的...而且绝不超过 Macario 本人所知的范围。"

Rao 收回审视的目光，与你对上视线。

"这很好。我们就按这个来做。"

options.en: How is this good?
options.zh: 这好在哪儿？

texts.en:
"Put some kid raised in an asteroid eating nothing but Andradaism in charge of an empire?"

He smiles. Like someone who's seen their opponent's force disposition - and has a plan.

"Good work, $titleHeg."
texts.zh:
"让一个在小行星上长大、从小只吃 Andrada 主义那一套的孩子去掌管一个帝国？"

他笑了。像是已经看清了对手的兵力部署 —— 而且心里有了主意。

"干得好，$titleHeg。"

texts.en: "Would that not serve?" His tone is rhetorical.
texts.zh: "那样岂不更好？"他的语气是反问。

texts.en: "With the help of Dolos Macario, I expect," he says.
texts.zh: "我猜，是在 Dolos Macario 的扶助之下。"他说。

texts.en:
Rao grunts acknowledgement.

"From the sounds of it they've had that one in their pocket for a great many cycles. Fortuna Kato might have had Fleet Intel help at the start, might have not... It's not the worst case we anticipated, but it's close."

He idly squeezes one hand into a fist.

"Remember, $titleHeg, we don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Rao 哼了一声，表示知道了。

"听这情形，他们把那东西攥在手里已经很多个星历年了。Fortuna Kato 一开始也许得到过舰队情报部的协助，也许没有...这还不是我们预料中最糟的情况，但也差不远了。"

他随手攥紧一只拳头。

"记住，$titleHeg，我们不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。

options.en: I understand and agree. (lie)
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。 (说谎)

options.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral...
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将...

texts.en: He gives you a quick look, then nods, satisfied.
texts.zh: 他飞快地看了你一眼，然后点头，颇为满意。

texts.en: He gives you a long look, then nods, unsatisfied somehow.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你，然后点头，却总像有些不满意。

texts.en:
"I'll leave this business of 'compromise' to the diplomats, $titleHeg." He says, emphasizing your presumed rank.

"This is not a matter open to discussion," he growls.
texts.zh:
"'妥协'这种事，我留给外交官去办，$titleHeg。"他说着，特意强调了你那个想当然的军衔。

"这件事没有商量的余地，"他低吼道。

texts.en:
Orcus gives you a baleful look. "I need not remind you of our position."

"We - the Hegemony - don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Orcus 阴冷地看了你一眼。"用不着我提醒你我们的处境。"

"我们 —— 霸主 —— 不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。

options.en: I understand and agree. (lie)
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。 (说谎)

options.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral.
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将。

texts.en: "Dead." Rao's expression doesn't change. "How?"
texts.zh: "死了。\"Rao 神色不变，\"怎么死的？"

options.en: Looks like an accidental shooting.
options.zh: 看起来像是走火。

texts.en: "Looks like?"
texts.zh: "看起来像？"

options.en: It does. But there were... others trying to track down Jason. (explain)
options.zh: 确实像。但还有...别的人也在追查 Jason。 (解释)

texts.en: You explain how someone paid to have you questioned, and perhaps killed, by a local goon. It did not go well for said goon.
texts.zh: 你说明有人出钱，让当地一个混混来审问你，或许还要你的命。那个混混的下场不太好。

texts.en: A Diktat agent, or what appears to be one, paid for the job. You found their apartment, and a comms log of them paying for documents that confirm Jason's death. The agent then fled the planet.
texts.zh: 一名辛达强权的特工 —— 至少看起来是 —— 付了这笔钱。你找到了他的住处，还有一份通讯记录，显示他出钱买了确认 Jason 死亡的文件。之后那名特工逃出了这颗行星。

texts.en: You managed to catch their shuttle, you explain. And you explain about the hidden poison capsule, and their Sindrian Diktat uniform.
texts.zh: 你说明自己截住了他们的穿梭机，又说到那枚暗藏的毒囊，还有他们身上辛达强权的制服。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "So who hired the hitman?"
texts.zh: "那杀手是谁雇的？"

texts.en:
"Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left is hiding."

Rao rubs his chin.

"At least he's off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
"也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

Rao 摩挲着下巴。

"至少他出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en:
"An inside job, huh." Rao smirks, rubbing his chin. "Or maybe an attempt at one. Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left was hiding."

"At least he's off the board."
texts.zh:
"内部人干的，嗯。\"Rao 咧嘴一笑，摩挲着下巴，\"或者只是有人想这么干。也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

"至少他出局了。"

options.en: I don't know.
options.zh: 我不知道。

texts.en:
He blinks, giving you a questioning look.

"I'd think you would want to know who was trying to kill you, $titleHeg." Rao shrugs. "And I'd be interested in why."

"At least the kid is off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，疑惑地看着你。

"我以为你会想知道是谁想杀你，$titleHeg。\"Rao 耸耸肩，\"而我也想知道为什么。"

"至少那小子出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en: "Someone," Rao says, not quite asking a question. "Did you find out who?"
texts.zh: "有人干的，\"Rao 说，语气不太像在提问，\"查出是谁了吗？"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "for some reason, you tried to shoot Maeus Moroz."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He is," his look shifts to you for a moment, "or was, useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"出于某种原因，你试图对 Maeus Moroz 开枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他是个，\"他的目光在你身上停了一瞬，\"或者说，曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you shot Maeus."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你对 Maeus 开了枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you destroyed the fleet of Maeus Moroz in space."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你在太空里摧毁了 Maeus Moroz 的舰队。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

options.en: No. His... adoptive father, Maeus Moroz, didn't either.
options.zh: 没有。他的...养父 Maeus Moroz 也没查出来。

texts.en: Rao nods, and glances at his datapad. Unconcerned.
texts.zh: Rao 点点头，瞥了一眼数据板。并不在意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Did you have Pericles killed?
options.zh: Pericles 是你杀的吗？

texts.en:
His look hardens into a warning.

"You're asking a dangerous question, $titleHeg. In this business I should think you would know better than that."
texts.zh:
他的眼神沉下来，成了警告。

"你在问一个危险的问题，$titleHeg。干我们这行，我以为你该比这更懂分寸。"

options.en: I understand.
options.zh: 我明白。

options.en: I just need to know what you're doing so I can do my job.
options.zh: 我只是需要知道你在做什么，好让我能办我的事。

options.en: I'm not here to act as your assassin, Orcus.
options.zh: 我不是来给你当刺客的，Orcus。

texts.en: "Good. We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh: "很好。这件事到此为止。"

texts.en:
"You 'need to know' enough to do your part, $titleHeg," he says. "And no more. This is the Hegemony and that is how this works here."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
texts.zh:
"你知道的'足够'让你做好你那份事就够了，$titleHeg，\"他说，\"不能更多。这里是霸主，这里的规矩就是这样。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Admiral Rao," he says, correcting you. "And no, I never asked that particular service of you."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
texts.zh:
"是 Rao 上将，\"他纠正你，\"另外，没有。我从来没让你干过那件事。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Yes," Rao says, unsurprised.

"Then you sat at the bar and had a drink with Maeus Moroz."

His eyes lock on to you. The question is all in his look.
texts.zh:
"是的，"Rao 说，并不意外。

"然后你坐在吧台边，跟 Maeus Moroz 喝了一杯。"

他盯住你。疑问全写在他的眼神里。

options.en: He blames Dolos Macario for the death of... his son.
options.zh: 他把...他儿子的死归咎于 Dolos Macario。

texts.en: "Good," says Rao.
texts.zh: "很好，"Rao 说。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Why is that good?
options.zh: 这有什么好的？

texts.en: "Because Dolos Macario is the enemy," he says. "And Maeus is not the forgiving type."
texts.zh: "因为 Dolos Macario 是敌人，\"他说，\"而 Maeus 可不是会原谅人的那种人。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: What should I do?
options.zh: 我该怎么做？

options.en: I've done some investigating. They're real.
options.zh: 我查过一些。他们是真的。

options.en: I've already confirmed all entries. They're real.
options.zh: 每一条我都核实过了。他们是真的。

texts.en:
"Find them," he says.

"I don't think this is the usual pack of lies from Dolos Macario. Not this time. But we need confirmation, and I'd prefer it be done with more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."

He looks you over with a lingering look of disapproval.

"We should make sure you're prepared."
texts.zh:
"找到他们。"他说。

"我不认为这又是 Dolos Macario 那套惯常的谎话。这次不像。但我们需要确证，而且我希望办得比霸主那些惯常的【精锐】更讲究些，\"他拿起数据平板，厌恶地看了一眼，\"别让他们在这串穷乡僻壤里到处乱戳。"

他上下打量你，目光里留着久久不散的不满。

"我们得确保你准备妥当。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "That's it. Find all those clones, sons, whatever they are."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"就这样。把那些克隆体、儿子，随他们是什么，全都找出来。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
He nods.

"Then we should make sure you're outfitted."
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"那我们就得确保你的装备齐备。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Good initiative, $titleHeg," he says, allowing himself to produce a surprised look. "Maybe I've grown to used to the Hegemony speed of doing things."

"Which, speaking of, brings me to the matter of some outfitting I had intended you receive to assist you in your investigation of the clones"
texts.zh:
"有主动精神，$titleHeg，\"他说，允许自己露出一点意外的神情。\"也许是我太习惯霸主办事的那个速度了。"

"说到这个，正好，我原本就打算给你一批装备补给，好协助你调查那些克隆体。"

options.en: Outfitting?
options.zh: 装备？

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "Now about the clones."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"那么，说说那些克隆体。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

options.en: Fortuna Kato told me to give you her compliments.
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 让我代她向你致意。

texts.en: "Did she," he says, not particularly pleased. "How nice. Be sure to return them if you can be bothered."
texts.zh: "是吗。\"他说，语气并不怎么愉快。\"那可真好。要是你乐意，记得把致意还回去。"

texts.en: "Did she," he says, not particularly pleased.
texts.zh: "是吗。"他说，语气并不怎么愉快。

options.en: Is that strange?
options.zh: 这很奇怪吗？

options.en: So you know her?
options.zh: 所以你认识她？

options.en: I can only assume she knows your role here.
options.zh: 我只能认为，她清楚你在这里的角色。

texts.en: "No. She's telling me she's watching me," he says. "Which she should be, of course."
texts.zh: "不。她是在告诉我，她在盯着我，\"他说。\"当然，她本来就该盯着。"

texts.en:
He grunts, dismissive.

"I'm sure she enjoys getting you to do her bidding. This changes nothing."
texts.zh:
他嗤了一声，不以为然。

"我肯定她很享受让你替她跑腿。这改变不了什么。"

texts.en: "We've met." He pauses, making it clear he does not intend to elaborate on this point.
texts.zh: "见过。"他顿了顿，摆明了不打算就这一点多说。

texts.en: "Of course," he says, "because she's not a fool, and Gens Kato has a relatively effective spy network."
texts.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"因为她不是傻子，而 Kato 氏族 的间谍网相当管用。"

options.en: I told Hercules Cyrino to use my Hegemony contacts to go into hiding.
options.zh: 我让 Hercules Cyrino 用我在霸主的门路去藏身。

texts.en: "Hercules Andrada? I haven't heard anything about that."
texts.zh: "Hercules Andrada？这事我一点风声都没听到。"

texts.en:
He picks up a datapad. "And if I did," he says, "I would be remiss to discuss a matter of strategic concern to the Persean Sector with clearance."

His tone suggests that the discussion is concluded.
texts.zh:
"就算真有此事，"他拿起一块数据板，"未经授权就谈论事关英仙座星域战略利益的问题，那才是失职。"

他的语气表明，这场谈话已经结束。

texts.en: "As far as we know," he picks up a datapad, "Hercules dropped off the map shortly after your visit."
texts.zh: "据我们所知，\"他拿起一块数据板，\"你那次拜访之后不久，Hercules 就从地图上消失了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: You're sure?
options.zh: 你确定？

texts.en:
"Yes." He gives you a look.

"End of discussion."
texts.zh:
"是。"他看了你一眼。

"到此为止。"

options.en: You're sure?
options.zh: 你确定？

options.en: You're sure?
options.zh: 你确定？

options.en: You're sure?
options.zh: 你确定？

options.en: Did you have him killed?
options.zh: 是你下的杀手？

texts.en:
"Yes." He gives you a look.

His look is the mask of command. Giving orders, and knowing that people will die. Graying spacers or pale kids fresh from the docks of Chicomoztoc. Saints, villains, and all between - bloody statistics will tell their fate. They might be one of the lucky ones, again and again, but their commander is always marked by death.

What is one more bright orphan from Nova Maxios?
A statistic.

"End of discussion," he growls, and slams the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"是。"他看了你一眼。

他的目光是那副指挥官的面具。下达命令，并且清楚会有人因此死去。头发花白的老船员，或者刚从 Chicomoztoc 的船坞里出来的苍白少年。圣徒、恶棍，以及介于两者之间的一切——他们的命运终将由血淋淋的数字来交代。他们或许会一次又一次地成为幸运的那些人，可他们的指挥官，永远被死亡打上印记。

再多一个来自 Nova Maxios 的聪明孤儿，又算得了什么？
一个数字罢了。

"到此为止。"他低吼道，狠狠按断了通讯。

texts.en:
Rao slowly puts down his datapad, folds his hands together, and looks at you.

His expression is perfectly blank in exactly the way a commanding officer shows their anger and disappointment in a subordinate.

"Was I unclear during our previous conversation?"
texts.zh:
Rao 缓缓放下数据板，双手交叠，看着你。

他脸上毫无表情——正是长官对下属表达愤怒与失望时的那种毫无表情。

"上次谈话时，我表述得不够清楚吗？"

options.en: I just want the truth.
options.zh: 我只想知道真相。

options.en: How can you have an innocent man killed?
options.zh: 你怎么能下令杀掉一个无辜的人？

options.en: I think you did the right thing.
options.zh: 我认为你做得对。

texts.en: "That's a luxury we have not been able to afford for a long, long time, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "这种奢侈，我们已经有太久太久负担不起了，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
"We're done here," he says, and slams the comms cut-off.

* * *

It might be wise to wait a day or so before trying to contact Admiral Rao again.
texts.zh:
"到此为止。"他说着，狠狠按断了通讯。

* * *

过一天左右再去联系 Rao 上将，或许更为妥当。

texts.en: "By giving the order. And you're lying to yourself if you don't think you've given that order before, over and over."
texts.zh: "下那道命令就是。如果你以为自己从未一次又一次地下过这种命令，那就是在骗自己。"

texts.en: "I don't."
texts.zh: "我不这么认为。"

options.en: I told Hercules Cyrino to contact you about going into hiding.
options.zh: 我告诉 Hercules Cyrino，让他联系你安排藏身。

options.en: I have Leonidas Andrada in cryosleep. Will you take him?
options.zh: 我手里有处在冷冻休眠中的 Leonidas Andrada。你们要接收他吗？

texts.en: "Cryosleep." Rao gives you a questioning look.
texts.zh: "冷冻休眠。"Rao 投来探询的目光。

options.en: He cannot function in his body. (explain)
options.zh: 他的身体已经无法运作了。(解释)

texts.en:
You explain that Leonidas has never left his life support cradle. He's lived over 20 cycles in a dream of Philip Andrada's life concocted by a pair of AI cores.

Rao's brow furrows as he listens.

"Yes, we will take him," he says, finally.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Leonidas 从未离开过他的生命维持舱。二十多个星历年里，他一直活在一场由一对 AI 核心编造出来的、Philip Andrada 一生的梦里。

Rao 听着，眉头渐渐皱起。

"好，我们接收他。"他终于开口。

options.en: Order Leonidas transferred to Ragnar Complex
options.zh: 下令把 Leonidas 转移到 Ragnar Complex

options.en: Will you keep him safe?
options.zh: 你们能保证他的安全吗？

options.en: Actually... I'm having second thoughts. Never mind.
options.zh: 其实...我再想想。算了。

texts.en:
The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit into the bowels of Ragnar Complex. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off as soon as it is wheeled through the first set of doors.
texts.zh:
安排妥当了。

一艘不留名号的穿梭机，把一台没有标识的冷冻休眠舱送进 Ragnar Complex 的深处。你在舱上装的那枚隐蔽追踪器，遥测信号在第一道闸门被推开的瞬间就断了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Call it a bounty," says Rao as the credits transfer comes through.

"For the weight of one more Andrada removed from the Persean Sector."
texts.zh:
"就当是赏金吧。"Rao 说，星币转账这时到账了。

"为一个 Andrada 从英仙座星域被抹去的分量。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: 'Removed?' Are you going to kill him?
options.zh: '抹去'？你们要杀了他？

texts.en:
"Do you want me to answer that question?"

His eyes are cold, and hard.
texts.zh:
"你希望我回答这个问题吗？"

他的眼神冰冷、坚硬。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 不必了。

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

texts.en: He closes his eyes, and nods.
texts.zh: 他闭上眼，点了点头。

texts.en: "The clone has to die," he says.
texts.zh: "这个克隆体必须死。"他说。

options.en: Why?
options.zh: 为什么？

options.en: Good.
options.zh: 很好。

options.en: I don't like it.
options.zh: 我不喜欢这个做法。

options.en: That's monstrous. He's helpless!
options.zh: 这太残忍了。他毫无反抗之力！

texts.en:
"Do you understand what it means for there to be an Andrada out there? He's a symbol, a rallying point, for Philip's so-called movement. That frozen body need never wake at all for this to be so."

No sly smile. Orcus looks older this way.

"The mutineers and their followers will kill for him. They will carry out bombings and assassinations. They will make civil war. You must understand that is what the blood of Andrada means to them."
texts.zh:
"你明白外面有一个 Andrada 意味着什么吗？他是 Philip 那套所谓运动的象征、旗帜。哪怕那具冻着的身体永远不醒，这也照样成立。"

没有那种油滑的笑。这样看，Orcus 老了许多。

"叛乱者及其追随者会为他杀人。会搞爆炸，搞暗杀。会打一场内战。你必须明白，对他们来说，Andrada 的血就意味着这些。"

texts.en: He closes his eyes, and nods.
texts.zh: 他闭上眼，点了点头。

texts.en: He closes his eyes, and nods.
texts.zh: 他闭上眼，点了点头。

texts.en:
"Most of those who die in war are helpless. And it is monstrous," he says, repeating your condemnations. "Cry for that injustice if it provides you with something, captain. But not on my comms."

"Enjoy the credits," he adds, then reaches for the comms cut-off.

His face freezes for a moment in the display, then flickers away.
texts.zh:
"死于战争的人，大多都毫无反抗之力。这也确实残忍。\"他说，把你刚才的谴责重复了一遍。\"如果为这种不义哭一场能让你好受些，那就哭吧，舰长。但别在我的通讯频道上哭。"

"好好花那笔星币吧。"他补了一句，伸手去按通讯切断键。

他的脸在显示屏上凝住了一瞬，随即闪灭消失。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Meaning?"

He shakes his head, not waiting for an answer.

"My primary concern is keeping the Persean Sector safe from yet another Andrada."
texts.zh:
"什么意思？"

他摇了摇头，并不等你回答。

"我最在意的，是不让英仙座星域再多出一个 Andrada。"

texts.en:
"Are you sure?" Rao says, voice dropping into his command pitch.

"Do you understand what it means to have another Andrada out there? A symbol, a rallying point, for Philip's so-called movement, his 'transcendent philosophy'? His thousand-cycle empire?"

No sly smile. Orcus looks older this way.

"They will kill for him without hesitation. They will carry out bombings, assassinations, black propaganda. They will make war. You must understand - that is what he is a symbol of, and what he will represent as long as he lives."
texts.zh:
"你确定？"Rao 说，声音沉了下去，变成了他下命令时的那种调子。

"你明白外面再多一个 Andrada 意味着什么吗？那是 Philip 那套所谓运动的象征、旗帜——他那套'超凡哲学'。他那个千年帝国？"

没有那种油滑的笑。这样看，Orcus 老了许多。

"他们会毫不犹豫地为他杀人。会搞爆炸，搞暗杀，搞黑色宣传。会发动战争。你必须明白——他象征的就是这些；只要他活着，他代表的就是这些。"

options.en: Order Leonidas transferred to Ragnar Complex
options.zh: 下令把 Leonidas 转移到 Ragnar Complex

options.en: I understand. Good-bye. (cut the comms)
options.zh: 我明白了。再见。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: Rao does not let an expression break across his face, but he does not look pleased.
texts.zh: Rao 脸上没有露出任何表情，但看上去并不愉快。

options.en: I'd like the discuss the encrypted files I brought to you.
options.zh: 我想谈谈我交给你的那批加密文件。

texts.en:
"Yes... yes, of course." He turns aside, makes a shoo motion, then returns his focus to you.

"As I understand it, a version of these so-called ANDRADA files was released to the Council of Demarchons. I am not, strictly speaking, supposed to have access to them..."
texts.zh:
"是... 是，当然。" 他侧过身，做了个赶人的手势，转回头来重新对着你。

"据我所知，这批所谓 ANDRADA 文件有个版本已发到统领议会。严格说起来，我本不该看得到它们..."

options.en: But you do?
options.zh: 可您还是弄到手了？

options.en: I will send you my full copy. (send the files)
options.zh: 我把完整的副本发给您。 (发送文件)

texts.en:
"As a gentleman," he speaks deliberately. "I would not besmirch the good name of the Coucil of Demarchons by implying the files were leaked by one of their esteemed class."

"Having said that, my understanding is that certain of the files were redacted per the privilege of the Prime Demarchon's office."

He glances away.

"Reynard moved more quickly than I expected. I had thought the files could be introduced without objection to the council during a quiet moment..."
texts.zh:
"身为绅士，\" 他字斟句酌，\"我可不愿玷污统领议会的清名，去暗示文件是他们里头某位体面人物漏出来的。"

"话虽如此，据我所知，其中有些文件是依着大统领办公厅的权责给删节过的。"

他把目光移开。

"Reynard 出手比我预想的快。我原打算趁个风平浪静的空当，把文件不声不响地递到议会上..."

options.en: I will send you my full copy. (send the files)
options.zh: 我把完整的副本发给您。 (发送文件)

options.en: I'm sure the Prime Demarchon has a good reason for restricting certain information.
options.zh: 大统领扣下某些消息，想来总有他的道理。

texts.en:
"You have my thanks, $titlePL."

He nods, not quite a bow.

"As a gentleman," he speaks deliberately. "I would not besmirch the good name of the Coucil of Demarchons by implying the files were leaked by one of their esteemed class."

"Having said that, my understanding is that certain of the files were redacted per the privilege of the Prime Demarchon's office."

He glances away.

"Reynard moved more quickly than I expected. I had thought the files could be introduced without objection to the council during a quiet moment..."
texts.zh:
"多谢了，$titlePL。"

他点了点头，算不上鞠躬。

"身为绅士，\" 他字斟句酌，\"我可不愿玷污统领议会的清名，去暗示文件是他们里头某位体面人物漏出来的。"

"话虽如此，据我所知，其中有些文件是依着大统领办公厅的权责给删节过的。"

他把目光移开。

"Reynard 出手比我预想的快。我原打算趁个风平浪静的空当，把文件不声不响地递到议会上..."

texts.en:
"You have my thanks, $titlePL."

He nods, not quite a bow.
texts.zh:
"多谢了，$titlePL。"

他点了点头，算不上鞠躬。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"It is essential the Council know the full truth, unbiased by the interests of... certain gens."

He coughs politely, then re-settles his posture.
texts.zh:
"议会必须知道全部真相，不能让... 某些氏族的私利搅浑了。"

他客气地咳了一声，重新端正了坐姿。

texts.en: "I trust you are coordinating with Special Agent Siyavong?"
texts.zh: "想来您已经在同特别特工 Siyavong 接洽着了吧？"

options.en: I am, yes.
options.zh: 是，已经在接洽了。

options.en: I will, yes.
options.zh: 是，我会的。

options.en: I have no intention of doing so.
options.zh: 我没这个打算。

texts.en:
He nods.

"You are most patriotic, $titlePL, I am sure. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work. We shall have much to discuss upon its completion, no doubt."
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 这番爱国心，我信。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。等事情办妥，咱们少不了一大堆要谈的。"

texts.en:
Horus produces a strained look.

"It is disappointing to hear you say that. If I could, I would persuade you otherwise - as a matter of patriotism toward the League, of course."
texts.zh:
Horus 脸上掠过一丝不自在。

"听您这么说，叫人失望。能劝的话我总要把您劝回来——自然是出于对联盟的一片忠心。"

options.en: I'll consider your words.
options.zh: 您的话，我会好好想想。

options.en: My answer stands.
options.zh: 我的答复不变。

texts.en:
He nods.

"You are most gracious, $titlePL. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work."
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 真是通情达理。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。"

texts.en:
He nods.

"I won't trouble you further upon the matter, then, $titlePL."

A pause.

"I believe that will be all?"
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"那这桩事我就不多打扰了，$titlePL。"

顿了一顿。

"想来没别的事了吧？"

texts.en: "Of course," he says. "I would never suggest you do otherwise."
texts.zh: "自然，\" 他说道，\"我哪会劝您反着来。"

options.en: Good. Let us discuss other matters, then.
options.zh: 好。那咱们聊点别的。

options.en: I'm just kidding. I'll send you my full copy. (send the files)
options.zh: 玩笑话。我把完整副本发给您。 (发送文件)

options.en: About the ANDRADA files...
options.zh: 关于 ANDRADA 档案...

texts.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."
texts.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with Fortuna Kato."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact Gens Kato myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和 Fortuna Kato 协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Kato 氏族。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with the Prime Demarchon."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact the office of the Reynard Hannan myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和大统领协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Reynard Hannan 的办公室。"

texts.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I shan't act prematurely. It is, you understand, a delicate situation and it would be a mistake to expose my Gens to some scandal or crisis."
texts.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我不会过早行动。你要明白，这是个微妙的局面，把我的氏族卷进什么丑闻或危机里，是犯不上的错。"

options.en: We must speak about Fortuna Kato... and her plan for Achilles Andrada.
options.zh: 我们得谈谈 Fortuna Kato...还有她对 Achilles Andrada 的那套计划。

texts.en: "Achilles Andrada?" Horus raises a well-groomed eyebrow. "The implications are many. Please, proceed."
texts.zh: "Achilles Andrada？\"Horus 挑起一道修得齐整的眉毛。\"这里头的意味可不少。请讲。"

options.en: Let me tell you what Fortuna is planning... (explain)
options.zh: 我把 Fortuna 的盘算告诉你... (解释)

texts.en:
You lay out Fortuna Kato's plan to back Achilles as the heir to the (presumably) dead or near-death Philip Andrada, win the ensuing civil war, then invite a reformed Sindrian Diktat into the Persean League in order to shift power away from Gens Hannan.

Horus is largely silent as you speak, only asking an occasional clarifying question or confirming a point of fact.

For all his aristocratic demeanor, he is no fool.
texts.zh:
你把 Fortuna Kato 的计划摊开来讲：扶 Achilles 上位，做那个 (想必已经死了、或者只剩一口气的) Philip Andrada 的继承人，赢下随后那场内战，再把一个改革后的辛达强权请进英仙座联盟，好把权力重心从 Hannan 氏族手里挪开。

你说的时候，Horus 大体上沉默不语，只是偶尔问一句以求厘清，或确认某个事实。

别看他一副贵族做派，他可不是傻子。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
And Horus frowns. More.

"Fortuna presents a difficult position," he says.

"This explains much of her recent activity - hiring mercenaries, weapons purchases, stockpiling fuel in Yesod, of all places. All through fronts, naturally, but the Gens always have informants upon one another."

He rubs his chin.

"Reynard is sure to react. He wouldn't simply let her achieve such a maneuver unopposed. No doubt Fortuna expects his reaction." He looks to you again, "You may be acting out her counter-plan."
texts.zh:
Horus 皱起了眉。皱得更深了。

"Fortuna 把我摆到了一个难办的位置上，"他说。

"这就解释了她最近许多动作——雇雇佣兵、买武器、把燃料囤在 Yesod 这种地方。当然，全是通过中间人办的，可各氏族向来都在彼此身边安着眼线。"

他搓着下巴。

"Reynard 一定会反应。他不会就这么让她从容走完这步棋。Fortuna 无疑也算准了他的反应。\"他又看向你，\"你说不定正在替她走那步反制。"

options.en: Me?
options.zh: 我？

texts.en: "She meant for you to speak to me," Horus says. "Did she not? It conveys a certain message in a certain way."
texts.zh: "她本就是要你来跟我谈，\"Horus 说，\"不是吗？这么做，本身就在以某种方式传达某种讯息。"

options.en: And what message is that?
options.zh: 那是什么讯息？

texts.en:
"Firstly it implies a diminishment. She could have simply contacted me herself as a sign of respect. But it may also serve as an affordance which concedes to me a greater range of response. Were I to deny her in a direct negotiation, it might close the door of possibility upon certain concessions due to a perceived loss of face. So in another sense, she is requesting terms. A counter-proposal."

He appears to consider the possibilities in a signalling-game perhaps too subtle for an outsider to the Gens system to quite appreciate.

Or he's overthinking it.
texts.zh:
"首先，这等于把我看低了一层。她本可以亲自联络我，以示尊重。但这同时也可能是一种姿态，等于主动给了我更大的回旋余地。倘若我在直接谈判中拒绝她，那么由于她自觉失了颜面，某些让步的大门也许就此关死。所以换个角度看，她是在开条件。是一份反提案。"

他似乎正在推演一场信号博弈里的种种可能——那微妙之处，氏族体系之外的人恐怕难以体会。

又或者，是他想多了。

texts.en:
"Firstly it implies a diminishment. She could have simply contacted me herself as a sign of respect. But it may also serve as an affordance which concedes to me a greater range of response. Were I to deny her in a direct negotiation, it might close the door of possibility upon certain concessions due to a perceived loss of face. So in another sense, she is requesting terms. A counter-proposal."

He is staring into space, considering the possibilities contained in a signalling-game perhaps too suble for an outsider to the Gens system to quite appreciate.

Or he's overthinking it.
texts.zh:
"首先，这等于把我看低了一层。她本可以亲自联络我，以示尊重。但这同时也可能是一种姿态，等于主动给了我更大的回旋余地。倘若我在直接谈判中拒绝她，那么由于她自觉失了颜面，某些让步的大门也许就此关死。所以换个角度看，她是在开条件。是一份反提案。"

他望着虚空出神，推敲着那场信号博弈里的种种可能——那微妙之处，氏族体系之外的人恐怕难以体会。

又或者，是他想多了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Of course," he says after a long pause, "this means Achilles will make a counter-declaration."

He looks at you through the link. "Very soon."
texts.zh:
"当然，\"他沉默良久才开口，\"这意味着 Achilles 也会发表一份针锋相对的声明。"

他隔着链路看着你。"很快。"

options.en: I should tell you about Fortuna Kato's plans for Achilles Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 我该告诉你 Fortuna Kato 对 Achilles Andrada 的打算。 (解释)

options.en: Have you decided which side Gens Yaribay will support in Askonia?
options.zh: 你想好了吗，Yaribay 氏族在 Askonia 会站哪一边？

options.en: Listen to yourself, Horus! You lead a great Gens, you must be decisive!
options.zh: 听听你自己在说什么，Horus！你执掌着一个大氏族，就得拿出决断来！

options.en: I suggest you back Fortuna's plan for Achilles.
options.zh: 我建议你支持 Fortuna 对 Achilles 的那套计划。

options.en: I suggest you back Reynard against Fortuna's crazy scheme.
options.zh: 我建议你站在 Reynard 一边，反对 Fortuna 这个疯狂的计划。

options.en: You need to choose yourself. By backing the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你得自己拿主意。就选支持霸主。

options.en: Yes, we should wait before taking action. (delay)
options.zh: 对，我们该再等等，先别动手。 (拖延)

texts.en:
"Sides, sides, hm," he rubs his chin. "There are many forces at work here, $titlePL. Many perspectives to consider."

"I'm, I'm-" Horus coughs and clears his throat, then is discouraged to find that the question has become no easier to answer.

"Perhaps I shall take a cautious approach," he concludes. "Wait and see in order to act at an appropriate time."
texts.zh:
"站边，站边，嗯，\"他搓着下巴，\"这里头有许多股力量在动，$titlePL。要考虑的立场太多了。"

"我，我——"Horus 咳了一声，清清嗓子，随即沮丧地发现这个问题并没有变得更好回答。

"也许我该走稳妥的路子，\"他最后说，\"先看着，等到合适的时机再动手。"

texts.en:
At once, his jaw tightens in anger, and he almost speaks.

But after a moment he releases a breath, appearing to accept the validity of your criticism.

"You are correct," hey says, eyes closed, "$titlePL. It is my burden and duty to lead."
texts.zh:
他的牙关一下子咬紧，怒意上涌，几乎就要开口。

可过了片刻，他吐出一口气，似乎接受了你的批评确有它的道理。

"你说得对，\"他闭着眼说，\"$titlePL。领导是我的重负，也是我的职责。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He takes a deep breath.

"This appears to be turning into a Second Askonia Crisis. And I fear it is an opportunity to work toward the goal I have elaborated previously - to take a step, perhaps, toward bringing the Persean Sector together."

"Reconciliation with the Hegemony," he says softly.

Horus looks through the link. "It is you that provided me with what I needed - a direct, secure line of communication with the High Hegemon. And now I am presented with the opportunity where concrete action can be taken. It feels like a cliff, but... to fly, you must believe."

"Thank you, $titlePL." He smiles, in a far-off way. "For clarity."
texts.zh:
他深吸一口气。

"这眼看着要变成第二次 Askonia 危机了。而我担心，这也正是个机会，让我能朝先前详细说过的那桩目标推进——也许，是朝着让英仙座星域重归一统，迈出一步。"

"与霸主和解，"他轻声说。

Horus 透过链路望着你。"是你给了我需要的东西——一条直通至高霸主的、安全可靠的联络线。而现在，一个能真正做点实事的机会就摆在面前。这感觉像是站在悬崖上，可...想要飞起来，你就得信。"

"谢谢你，$titlePL。\"他笑了笑，神思仿佛在别处。\"为这份清醒。"
effects: #AddTextSmall "Convinced Horus Yaribay to back the Hegemony" highlight

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I must speak with my envoys, reach out to certain contacts. There is much to arrange. We must speak again when the conflict breaks into the open."
texts.zh: "我得和我的使节们谈谈，联络一些人。要安排的事很多。等冲突摆到明面上，我们必须再谈一次。"

texts.en:
"We must..."

He pauses.

"Do I have your support in what I aim to accomplish? I would be remiss not to ask you explicitly. You are not my employee, nor am I your patron."
texts.zh:
"我们必须..."

他顿住了。

"我要做的这件事，能得到你的支持吗？不把这话明明白白问出口，就是我的失礼。你不是我的下属，我也不是你的东家。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Of course. I consider us partners in this endeavor.
options.zh: 当然。这件事上，我视我们为伙伴。

options.en: No, you chose your path. I must choose my own.
options.zh: 不。你选了你自己的路。我也得走我自己的。

texts.en:
"In truth, I've had my eyes on the Askonia situation for some time. The history of Opis, of... Andrada. It is at the center of the conflict between League and Hegemony."

He waves a hand, brushing the past away.

"There is a man, a contact, on Nortia. He is an organizer for the Askonia Charterist Alliance. The Hegemony favors his organization."

"So shall I. Give him supplies, fuel, credits - whatever he needs. My people will arrange a meeting."
texts.zh:
"说实话，Askonia 的局势我盯了有些时候了。Opis 的历史，还有...Andrada。这里正是联盟与霸主冲突的中心。"

他摆了摆手，把那些过往挥到一边。

"Nortia 上有个人，我的一个关系人。他是 Askonia 宪章派同盟的组织者。霸主那边是看好他这一伙的。"

"我也一样。给他补给、燃料、星币——他要什么就给什么。我的人会安排一次会面。"

options.en: Nortia. The ACA. Got it.
options.zh: Nortia。ACA。明白了。

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've spoken with him already, yes.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？我已经和他谈过了，是的。

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've already given him everything the ACA required.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？ACA 要的东西，我已经全给他了。

texts.en:
Horus sounds more confident somehow, a new sense of purpose driving him as he lays out plans.

"I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need. And credits."
texts.zh:
Horus 的声音不知不觉间多了几分底气；一种新的目标感驱使着他，把计划一条条铺开。

"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。还有星币。"

texts.en:
"I ask, also, that you assist the rebels however you might, even those who may be somewhat at cross-purpose with the ACA. Our cause is to correct where the Hegemony went so wrong - the Sindrian Diktat itself must be destroyed, no matter which clone of the arch-mutineer would lead it."

"Andrada made many enemies - most of all the Hegemony - and they will thank us for helping them."
texts.zh:
"另外，我还想请你不论用什么法子，都尽量帮一把那些叛军——哪怕其中有些人和 ACA 的宗旨不尽一致。我们要做的，是纠正霸主当年错得太离谱的地方——辛达强权本身必须被摧毁，不管坐上那位子的是那个老叛徒的哪一具克隆体。"

"Andrada 树敌无数——其中最恨他的就是霸主——我们帮他们一把，他们会感激我们的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Don't forget, $titlePL - speak with Finlay Siyavong. But remember above all that he cannot give you orders, only advice. You need not do as he says."

Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"
texts.zh:
"别忘了，$titlePL——去和 Finlay Siyavong 谈谈。但最要紧的是记住：他只能给你建议，不能给你下命令。你不必照他说的做。"

Horus 又拿起他的 TriPad，一边翻着通知一边满意地哼了一声。他抬起头。

"我想，就这些了？"

texts.en:
"Oh, that is most fortuitous! A most driven man, is he not?"

He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need."
texts.zh:
"哦，那可太巧了！那人干劲十足，不是吗？"

他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Horus furrows his brow as he taps at a datapad. Then looks up.

"That was you? Stars above... of course." He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "Nonetheless, I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron with fuel and supplies. I expect that you may have other contacts, or means, that might assist... our cause."
texts.zh:
Horus 皱着眉，在数据板上点了几下，然后抬起头。

"那是你做的？群星在上...当然。\"他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。\"不管怎样，我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，里头有燃料和补给。我想你也许还有别的关系，或者别的门路，能帮上...我们这桩事业。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I am glad to hear that." His smile is genuine.
texts.zh: "听你这么说，我很高兴。"他的笑容是真的。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
texts.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

texts.en: "You truly believe I ought? It would be undermining the Prime Demarchon... it may weaken the League. Fortuna and I agree on many things, and much to do with Reynard, but her vision is," he considers his words. "It is limited, and I think stubbornly small-minded in some respects. Take for instance her bigotry against the Luddics..."
texts.zh: "你真觉得我该这么做？那等于拆大统领的台...也许会削弱联盟。Fortuna 和我在许多事上看法一致，在关于 Reynard 的事上更是如此，可她的眼界，\"他斟酌着用词，\"是有限的，而且我认为在某些方面固执得有些小家子气。就拿她对卢德派的偏见来说..."

options.en: Nothing else will break Reynard's strangehold. You must support Fortuna.
options.zh: 除此之外，再也破不了 Reynard 的钳制。你必须支持 Fortuna。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

texts.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主的联络，我很领情，"他说，"更不必说你在 Menes 那件事上的...谨慎。这一次也一样。"

texts.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
texts.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall have to arrange a meeting with Fortuna Kato. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我就得安排一次与 Fortuna Kato 的会面了。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall meet Fortuna Kato as soon as possible. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会尽快去见 Fortuna Kato。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall make inquiries with the office of the Prime Demarchon to ascertain Reynard's policies concerning Gens Kato. Common orbit may yet be found."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会向大统领办公室探问一番，弄清 Reynard 对 Kato 氏族是什么政策。说不定还能找到共同的轨道。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall reach out to the office of the Prime Demarchon and offer my support against Fortuna's reckless plans."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会联络大统领办公室，表示我支持他们对付 Fortuna 这鲁莽的计划。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I have inquiries and envoys to send, if you do not mind."
texts.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我还有几处要探问，几个使节要派出去，希望你不介意。"

texts.en:
"You truly believe so?"

He looks strained. "I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. And to be second is no shameful thing. I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay...our future is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan given the present state of affairs."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always be more opportunities, in time..."
texts.zh:
"你真这么认为？"

他面色绷紧。"我想，如果 Fortuna 的计划失败，我的氏族能得的好处不少。屈居第二也并非什么丢人的事。我得首先顾全 Yaribay 氏族的安危...以眼下的局面，我们的前途和 Hannan 氏族已经死死绑在一起了。"

他顿了顿，若有所思："假以时日，机会总是会有的..."

options.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
options.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en:
"The Hegemony," he says.

"It's risky, very risky. They must destroy the Sindrian Diktat as a polity. There is sure to be much chaos in the aftermath..."
texts.zh:
"霸主，"他说。

"这很冒险，非常冒险。他们必须把辛达强权作为一个政权彻底打掉。事后必定是一片大乱..."

options.en: You must, though. This is your chance!
options.zh: 可你必须这么做。这是你的机会！

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
texts.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

texts.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
texts.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

texts.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.

options.en: Is there some way I can help you?
options.zh: 有什么我能帮上你的？

options.en: Is it possible you are overthinking this?
options.zh: 有没有可能，是你想得太多了？

options.en: The intricacy of Gens politics may be somewhat beyond a simple spacer like myself.
options.zh: 氏族政治这般千头万绪，像我这样单纯的太空船员，怕是有点跟不上。

options.en: I found Fortuna persuasive. I intend to support her and Achilles.
options.zh: 我觉得 Fortuna 说得有道理。我打算支持她和 Achilles。

options.en: I don't trust Fortuna, but I do intend to support Achilles.
options.zh: 我不信任 Fortuna，但我确实打算支持 Achilles。

options.en: I think I should just report this all to Reynard Hannan.
options.zh: 我想我该把这一切都报告给 Reynard Hannan。

options.en: I'll leave you to your thoughts, then. (don't involve yourself further)
options.zh: 那我就让你自己慢慢想。 (不再牵扯进去)

texts.en: He looks up, almost grateful. "Perhaps, $titlePL. Perhaps."
texts.zh: 他抬起头，几乎是带着感激。"也许吧，$titlePL。也许。"

texts.en:
"It is possible that Gens Yaribay's interests align with Kato's on this matter, but I shall need consult with my advisors and begin negotiations."

"Nonetheless, I appreciate that you have contacted me about this matter." He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Let us speak again when the situation develops further."

Horus looks up over his TriPad at you.

"For now, $titlePL, I shall bid you fare-well."
texts.zh:
"在这件事上，Yaribay 氏族的利益也许和 Kato 家一致，但我需要和顾问们商议，还要开始谈判。"

"尽管如此，我很感谢你就这件事联系我。\"他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"等局势再有发展，我们再谈。"

Horus 从 TriPad 上方抬头看你。

"眼下就先这样，$titlePL，祝你安好。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
This earns you a fleeting smile.

"Without a doubt," he admits. "But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
texts.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"毫无疑问，\"他承认道。\"但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

This earns you a fleeting smile.

"It is no failing or deficiency on your part, $titlePL," he concedes. "Possibly quite the opposite. But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
texts.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"这不是你的过失或欠缺，$titlePL，\"他让步道。\"也许恰恰相反。但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

"Fortuna." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution."

"Gens politics are never quite what they seem."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。"

"氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。"

texts.en:
"Achilles, then." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution. Gens politics are never quite what they seem. And when you become entangled with the League, the Gens are unavoidable."
texts.zh:
"那就 Achilles。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。而一旦你跟联盟牵扯上关系，氏族就避不开了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Reynard." That got his attention.

Horus looks at you, expression dim.

"Do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise. And it is possible that Reynard offers stability against Fortuna's... adventurism. On the other hand, Gens politics are never quite what they seem. I advise caution."

"Nonetheless, you have my thanks for what you have done for me 'til now."
texts.zh:
"Reynard。"这话让他抬起了头。

Horus 看着你，神情黯淡。

"你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求。也许 Reynard 能带来稳定，制衡 Fortuna 的...冒险主义。可另一方面，氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。我劝你谨慎。"

"不管怎样，我感谢你至今为我做的一切。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I shall need consult with my advisors and begin certain negotiations, much as Fortuna has done already."

He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Perhaps we shall soon speak again upon this; for now, I bid you fare-well."
texts.zh:
"我需要和我的顾问们商议，并着手一些谈判——Fortuna 已经先走了一步。"

他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。"或许我们很快会再谈这件事；眼下，我祝你安好。"
