options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Mm," he says, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "You have my thanks for the service you have done Gens Yaribay, $titlePL. I bid you fare-well."
texts.zh: "嗯，\"他说着，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"你为 Yaribay 氏族做的事，我记下了，$titlePL。祝你安好。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: I met with Fortuna Kato. She told me to give you her regards.
options.zh: 我见过 Fortuna Kato。她让我代她向你问好。

texts.en:
"Her regards?"

Horus closes his eyes and seems to slide back in his chair.

"Her regards... oh, it's worse than I thought then."
texts.zh:
"她问好？"

Horus 闭上眼，整个人似乎往椅背里陷了下去。

"她问好...唉，那比我原先想的还要糟。"

options.en: Well... (tell him what Fortuna is planning)
options.zh: 好吧... (把 Fortuna 的盘算告诉他)

options.en: About the ACA rebels...
options.zh: 关于 ACA 叛军...

texts.en: "Yes, of course - the matter of supplying their resistance movement."
texts.zh: "对，当然——就是给他们抵抗运动提供补给的事。"

texts.en:
"I am disappointed to have had no word from Arnaud Iscare on Nortia," Horus says with a concerned look.

"My, ah, trusted contacts quite insist that it would assist in securing a beneficial outcome in Askonia. So please, captain, see that it is done promptly."
texts.zh:
"Nortia 的 Arnaud Iscare 一直没有消息，我很失望，"Horus 面带忧虑地说。

"我那些，呃，可信的联系人坚持认为，这会有助于在 Askonia 争取一个有利的结果。所以，舰长，请务必尽快办妥。"

texts.en:
"I have had word from Arnaud Iscare that you've helped secure some material assistance for the ACA on Nortia," Horus says.

"Please see that he received everything he needs so that we may see, ah, a most beneficial settlement once this terrible crisis is over."
texts.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 来信了，说你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 弄到了一批物资援助，"Horus 说。

"请确保他拿到了所需的一切，好让这场可怕的危机结束后，我们能看到一个，呃，极为有利的结局。"

texts.en:
"Arnaud Iscare informed me that you've given the Nortia ACA everything they need," Horus says, allowing himself a hopeful smile. "My... trusted contacts would like to relay their thanks and appreciation."

"Allow me to provide you with credits to offset the risks you have taken and - well, we may consider it a reward, I suppose."
texts.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 告诉我，你已经把 Nortia 的 ACA 需要的一切都给了他们，\"Horus 说，难得露出一个带着希望的笑容。\"我那些...可信的联系人想转达他们的感谢与赞赏。"

"请允许我给你一些星币，补偿你承担的风险，还有——嗯，我们不妨就把它当成一笔报酬吧。"

options.en: A... contact told me to speak with you.
options.zh: “一个...联系人让我来找你谈。”

texts.en:
His eyes flicker.

"Yes, I see. I believe it was mentioned that you might have a very particular inquiry?"
texts.zh:
他眼珠闪了闪。

“是的，我明白了。有人提到过你可能会有一个非常特殊的疑问？”

options.en: Let's talk about Leonidas Andrada. You reviewed the files, right?
options.zh: 我们谈谈 Leonidas Andrada。那些文件你看过了，对吧？

texts.en:
"Yes..." His eyes twitch once, twice. "Leonidas."

"I'm not sure what I can tell you about that which you do not already know." He smiles, disarmingly. "Perhaps it is I who should be asked you about him."
texts.zh:
"看过...\"他的眼睛抽动了一下，又是一下。\"Leonidas。"

"我不确定关于这件事，我还能告诉你什么你不知道的。\"他笑了笑，那笑意很能卸人防备。\"也许该反过来说 —— 是我该向你打听他。"

options.en: Why didn't it work? The AI dream project. His body couldn't function.
options.zh: 为什么没成？那个 AI 梦境计划。他的身体撑不住。

texts.en:
"Why didn't it work?"

He smiles, putting a slightly puzzled look on his face.

"I'm not a neurocyberneticist, captain. And besides, I wasn't involved in any way."
texts.zh:
"为什么没成？"

他笑了笑，脸上摆出些许困惑的神情。

"我不是神经控制论专家，舰长。再说，这事我一点也没参与。"

options.en: But you knew about the arrangements. And you're highly modded yourself.
options.zh: 可那些安排你都知道。而且你自己身上装了那么多改造。

options.en: Of course. Never mind, then.
options.zh: 当然。那就当我没问。

texts.en:
"Captain," his mechanical smile doesn't reach his eyes.

"That's very forward of you to say."
texts.zh:
"舰长，"他那副机械的笑没有到眼睛里。

"这话说得可真够冒失的。"
effects: #SetTooltip inesis_leoAsk3 "He's far from subtle about his cybernetic implants."

options.en: Don't be coy. I know you don't care.
options.zh: 别装。我知道你根本不在乎。

options.en: I apologize. Let us speak of other things...
options.zh: 我道歉。我们说点别的...

texts.en:
"You can be quite insistent, can't you, when you really want to."

The smile is frozen on his face.

"Nonetheless, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation has no comment to your inquiry. Let's not waste any more time on it."
texts.zh:
"真想要什么的时候，你还真是死缠不放，是不是。"

那笑容僵在他脸上。

"尽管如此，速子科技公司对你的询问无可奉告。别再在这事上耗时间了。"

texts.en:
Something seems to give in his expression.

Maybe he likes you. Just a little.
texts.zh:
他脸上的什么东西似乎松了下来。

也许他有点喜欢你。就那么一点。

texts.en:
Something seems to give in his expression.

Maybe it's your Tri-Tachyon commission. He can trust you. Or perhaps it's that you're both implicitly implicated by your involvement in what, depending on one's perspective, could be called a crime.
texts.zh:
他脸上的什么东西似乎松了下来。

也许是因为你挂着速子科技的委任状。他可以信你。又或者，是因为你们两人都牵涉其中 —— 那件事换个角度看，完全可以叫犯罪。

texts.en:
The smile adjusts, rings true. It's not a smile of friendliness, but the joy of the hunt.

"You can be quite insistent, can't you, when you want to be, $PlayerName."

He leans back, looking ever so slightly more natural than usual, dropping the artificially pleasant demeanor.
texts.zh:
笑意微微收敛，变得真切起来。那不是友善的笑，而是猎物入手的快意。

"$PlayerName，你一旦较真起来，还真是寸步不让。"

他向后靠去，卸下那副刻意堆出来的和善神情，看起来比平时自然了许多。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"From what I know - which is far from comprehensive - it should have worked."

He speaks plainly, without the saccharine customer-facing affability.

"We've had great success with behavioral influence by means of simulated memories as well as cybernetic integration of induced cortex-motor function integration. There are centuries of studies; it's quite a mature field - and one in which Tri-Tachyon has always led, even before the Collapse."

"So, what could have possibly gone wrong?"
texts.zh:
"据我所知——当然远远谈不上全面——这套东西本该是成功的。"

他说话的口气很平实，没了面对客户时那种甜腻的殷勤。

"用模拟记忆施加行为影响，以及通过义体植入整合诱导性皮层-运动功能，我们都取得过极大成功。相关研究积累了几个世纪，是个相当成熟的领域——而在这一领域，速子科技一直遥遥领先，甚至在大崩塌之前就是如此。"

"那么，到底是哪里出了差错？"

options.en: I've brought you Leonidas Andrada. He's in cryosleep.
options.zh: 我把 Leonidas Andrada 带来了。他在低温休眠舱里。

texts.en:
A strange expression crosses his face.

"You brought me... why?"
texts.zh:
一丝古怪的神情掠过他脸上。

"你把他带来给我... 为什么？"

texts.en:
"Again." His pleasant, customer-facing smile drops.

"Captain, please. Why?"
texts.zh:
"又来了。" 他那副讨客户欢心的和善笑容垮了下来。

"舰长，拜托。为什么？"

texts.en:
His pleasant smile fades somewhat. "I hope we won't be throwing around any more inconsiderate words, captain.

"I simply don't see why you persist in this line of dealing."
texts.zh:
他脸上的和善笑容淡了几分。"我希望我们不必再甩出些不知轻重的话了，舰长。"

"我只是不明白，你为何非要在这件事上纠缠下去。"

options.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
options.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

options.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
options.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
options.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

options.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
options.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

options.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
options.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
options.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

options.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
options.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

options.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
options.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
options.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

texts.en: This is odd. Inesis is usually so cheerful when discussing business.
texts.zh: 这不太对劲。Inesis 谈起生意来，向来都是眉飞色舞的。

texts.en:
He closes his eyes. "The situation is not..."

He opens his eyes, and reforms his expression.

"I'm afraid I can't help you in this matter. The Company has no comment upon this individual or their alleged identity."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼。"情况并不是..."

他睁开眼，重新收拾好了表情。

"这件事恐怕我帮不了你。公司对此人，以及他所谓的身份，都没有任何评论。"

options.en: But it's your mess - and I'm helping you clean it up to avoid a scandal.
options.zh: 可这是你们的烂摊子——我是在帮你收拾，免得闹出丑闻。

texts.en:
"Our mess?" Inesis looks aside. "What scandal?"

"I've seen nothing on TriNews besmirching the good name of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Nor, I think, will you find any direct connection of your cryo-sleeper to the Tri-Tachyon brand."

A hint of his smile returns.

"-Aside from standard hardware and software products available to anyone with credits, of course."
texts.zh:
"我们的烂摊子？\" Inesis 把目光移向一旁，\"什么丑闻？"

"我在 TriNews 上没见过任何抹黑速子科技公司名声的东西。而且我想，你也找不出你那具低温休眠舱与速子科技这块招牌之间有任何直接关联。"

他的笑意又隐约回来了。

"——当然，只要出得起星币，谁都能买到的标准硬件与软件产品除外。"

options.en: So you reject my gift.
options.zh: 那么，你是拒绝我这份礼物了。

options.en: What if I sell Leonidas to Orcus Rao? Would that be preferable?
options.zh: 如果我把 Leonidas 卖给 Orcus Rao 呢？那样是不是更合你意？

options.en: We're done here.
options.zh: 我们没什么好谈的了。

texts.en:
"I am not in the business of 'gifts', captain," he says. "I am in the business of deals. When you want to make a deal, come to me."

An automatic smile.

"Until then? Both Tri-Tachyon and I hope you have a very profitable day."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"我做的是生意，不收'礼物'，舰长，\" 他说，\"我做的是交易。你想谈交易的时候，再来找我。"

一个自动浮现的笑容。

"在那之前？速子科技和我都祝你这一天财源广进。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"That's good, captain! Very good," he says, smile growing. "Now we're negotiating."

He taps his chin twice, as if thinking.

"I'll give you 50,000 credits for Leonidas. Take it or leave it."
texts.zh:
"这就对了，舰长！非常好，\" 他说，笑容越来越大，\"现在这才叫谈判。"

他在下巴上敲了两下，像是在盘算。

"Leonidas 我给你 50,000 星币。成不成，一句话。"

options.en: Deal.
options.zh: 成交。

options.en: I think one of the few remaining heirs to the Supreme Executor is worth more than 50k.
options.zh: 我觉得最高元首为数不多的继承人之一，可不止值五万。

options.en: You know what, never mind.
options.zh: 算了，就当我没说。

options.en: And will you help Leonidas? Or will you keep him on ice or dump him in space?
options.zh: 那你会帮 Leonidas 吗？还是把他冻在舱里，或者干脆丢进太空？

options.en: Deal.
options.zh: 成交。

options.en: You know what, never mind.
options.zh: 算了，就当我没说。

texts.en:
* * *

The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to Achaman Station. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off not long after the agents of Faro Inesis take possession. They're used to covertly moving unmarked goods without asking questions.

It's no longer your problem and you're 50,000 credits richer. As for Leonidas? You don't have to think about him at all ever again.
texts.zh:
* * *

安排妥当。

一艘匿名穿梭机把一具没有标识的低温休眠舱运往 Achaman Station。Faro Inesis 的手下接手这具休眠舱后不久，你安装在舱上的那枚隐蔽追踪器便断了遥测。这些人惯于悄悄地搬运无标识货物，从不问一句多余的话。

这不再是你的事了，你还多了 50,000 星币。至于 Leonidas？你再也不必想起他了。

texts.en:
"Maybe," he says. Then looks directly at you.

"But maybe the question he's an answer to has far more viable contenders, with far more influential backers."

"But I merely speculate. Who could say? It's a risk, which is why I lower my bid accordingly. 50,000 credits, then?"

He puts on his smile for you.
texts.zh:
"也许吧，" 他说，然后直视着你。

"但他所对应的那个问题，也许还有远比他更合适的候选人，背后的靠山也远比他有势力。"

"不过我也只是猜测。谁说得准呢？这是个风险，我自然要把价码压低。那就 50,000 星币？"

他为你挂上了笑容。

texts.en:
"Dump him in... captain!" Inesis is taken aback. "I'm no monster."

"I'd keep him on ice, of course. The expense is not so great, and if nothing else comes of it, I'm sure a collector would be interested... I seem to recall one of the Yaribays was putting out feelers."

"Ah," he holds up a finger and smiles, as if at your cleverness. "But I should say no more about my potential buyers."
texts.zh:
"丢进太空... 舰长！\" Inesis 被噎了一下，\"我可不是什么怪物。"

"当然是把他冻在舱里。这笔开销也不大，而且就算别无所获，我相信总有收藏家会感兴趣... 我好像记得 Yaribay 家的某一位正在四处试探风声。"

"啊，\" 他竖起一根手指笑了笑，像是在赞许你的机敏，\"不过关于我潜在的买家，我还是少说为妙。"

options.en: You'd sell him to a collector? You ARE a monster!
options.zh: 你要把他卖给收藏家？你就是个怪物！

options.en: Deal.
options.zh: 成交。

options.en: You know what, never mind.
options.zh: 算了，就当我没说。

texts.en:
"That's a very unkind thing to say, captain. I'm sorry this conversation has become such an emotional tax for you- I suggest we leave it here, and perhaps you'll be more considerate when next we meet."

He puts on a saintly look. "I'll hold no hard feelings over some ill-considered words. Good day, captain."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"这话说得可真不留情面，舰长。很抱歉这场谈话让你付出了这么重的情绪代价——我建议就到这里，下次见面时，希望你能多些体谅。"

他摆出一副圣徒般的表情。"几句没过脑子的话，我不会记在心上。再会，舰长。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: Inesis gives you a consternated look. It's odd on his face.
texts.zh: Inesis 一脸窘迫地看着你。这表情出现在他脸上格外别扭。

texts.en: "Help..." Inesis looks at you, confused. "Why would we do that?"
texts.zh: "帮...\" Inesis 困惑地看着你，\"我们为什么要那么做？"

options.en: Because it's your fault.
options.zh: 因为这是你们的错。

options.en: It's the right thing to do?
options.zh: 因为这是该做的事？

options.en: It's your mess and I'm helping clean it up.
options.zh: 这是你们的烂摊子，我是在帮忙收拾。

options.en: What if I brought Leonidas to Orcus Rao? Would that be preferable?
options.zh: 如果我把 Leonidas 交给 Orcus Rao 呢？那样是不是更合你意？

options.en: I'll pay you 50,000 credits if that's what it takes to do the right thing.
options.zh: 如果做该做的事就得花钱，那我付你 50,000 星币。

options.en: You know what? Never mind. You don't understand.
options.zh: 算了。就当我没说。你不明白。

texts.en:
He closes his eyes. "No, I don't think it is."

Now he looks at you patiently. "Where there's demand, there's a market. Tri-Tachyon cannot take responsibility for what buyers freely choose to do with our products."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼。"不，我不认为这是我们的错。"

然后他耐心地看着你。"有需求，就有市场。买家拿我们的产品去做什么，那是他们自由的选择，速子科技负不起这个责任。"

texts.en: "I'm not sure I understand."
texts.zh: "我不太明白你的意思。"

texts.en: "The Tri-Tachyon corporation doesn't see it that way, captain," he says blandly.
texts.zh: "速子科技公司不这么看，舰长，" 他语气平淡地说。

texts.en:
He raises an eyebrow.

"I'm interested in your credits, but I'm not sure what you're asking for. You'll have to explain- what is it you mean by doing 'the right thing'?"
texts.zh:
他挑起一侧眉毛。

"你的星币我很感兴趣，可我不太确定你在要求什么。你得解释一下——所谓'做该做的事'，具体指什么？"

options.en: Provide Leonidas the treatment he needs to sucessfully live in the real world.
options.zh: 给 Leonidas 提供他需要的治疗，让他能真正在现实世界里生活下去。

options.en: Never mind, I'm not sure this is a good idea.
options.zh: 算了，我不确定这是个好主意。

texts.en:
Inesis sighs, closes his eyes, and you can almost see the calculations flash across his eyelids.

His eyes snap open.

"I could, personally, make certain arrangements with a top-line cybernetics-medical consultant for 100,000 credits, no less. Including discretion. And although I see no purpose for such a sentimental waste, if this is how you desire to spend your hard-earned wealth, I would be a poorer man not to take the opportunity."

He smiles, helpfully.
texts.zh:
Inesis 叹了口气，闭上眼睛，你几乎能看见一串数字在他眼皮底下飞闪而过。

他猛地睁开眼。

"我本人可以出面，找一位顶尖的义体医疗顾问做些安排，价钱不少于 100,000 星币，含保密费。虽说我看不出这种多愁善感的挥霍有什么意义，但既然你就想这么花掉辛苦挣来的钱，我不趁机做这笔生意，那才是亏了。"

他露出一个乐于助人的笑容。

options.en: I accept. (make the arrangements)
options.zh: 我接受。 (着手安排)

options.en: The price is a bit much. Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 这价钱有点高了。改天再说吧。

options.en: Never mind, I'm not sure this is a good idea.
options.zh: 算了，我不确定这是个好主意。

texts.en:
* * *

The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to Achaman Station. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off not long after the agents of Faro Inesis take possession. They're used to covertly moving unmarked goods without asking questions.

Leonidas has a chance, at least. If Inesis' word is as good as his greed.
texts.zh:
* * *

安排妥当。

一艘匿名穿梭机把一具没有标识的低温休眠舱运往 Achaman Station。Faro Inesis 的手下接手这具休眠舱后不久，你安装在舱上的那枚隐蔽追踪器便断了遥测。这些人惯于悄悄地搬运无标识货物，从不问一句多余的话。

至少 Leonidas 还有一线机会——只要 Inesis 守信的成色比得上他贪财的成色。

texts.en: "Perhaps," he says, smile unwavering.
texts.zh: "也许吧，" 他说，笑容纹丝不动。

options.en: I want to talk about Leonidas Andrada.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 Leonidas Andrada。

options.en: I acquired potentially critical encrypted intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It may be valuable...
options.zh: 我拿到了一份加密情报，关于辛达强权，可能很要紧。说不定值不少钱...

texts.en:
"Take it to Faro Inesis. Achaman. Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"把它交给 Faro Inesis。Achaman，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Take it to my strategic analyst, name is Faro Inesis. Achaman Franchise Station, Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"交给我的战略分析师，叫 Faro Inesis。Achaman Franchise Station，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

They don't quite sigh as they put on a resigned air - what they're doing will be technically correct even if a superior officer is sure to be annoyed. Duty is duty.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

对方换上一副认命的神情，几乎要叹气 —— 他们要做的这件事在程序上无可挑剔，哪怕上级军官肯定会不高兴。职责就是职责。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
You watch $PersonRank $personLastName's face as $heOrShe skims the file headers of the report.

Seven names, seven Andradas. Seven blocks of heavily encrypted data. Skepticism is followed by concern.

$HeOrShe looks at you gravely. "Where did you get this?"
texts.zh:
你注视着 $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸，$heOrShe 正一条条扫过报告的卷首信息。

七个名字，七个 Andrada。七段重度加密的数据。怀疑过后，是忧虑。

$HeOrShe 神情凝重地看着你。"这东西你是从哪儿弄来的？"

Seven names, seven Andradas. Seven blocks of heavily encrypted data. Skepticism is followed by concern.

$HeOrShe looks at you gravely. "Where did you get this?"

你注视着 $personLastName 的脸，$heOrShe 正一条条扫过报告的卷首信息。

texts.en:
"Interesting. Perhaps even useful," he says, "unless Dolos was just getting bored and wants to stir up trouble."

He taps at his comms interface and a transfer link appears.

"$TitleHeg," he prompts.
texts.zh:
"有意思。也许还用得上，\"他说，\"除非这只是 Dolos 闲得发慌，想搅点乱子。"

他在通讯界面上点了几下，一条传输链接弹了出来。

"$TitleHeg。"他提示道。

options.zh: 因为这东西原本是送给 Dolos Macario 的。 (解释)

options.zh: 继续

options.zh: 上传 ANDRADA 文件的样本

options.zh: 以后再说。 (返回)

options.zh: 是，转吧。

options.zh: 不行。我必须和至高霸主本人谈！

options.zh: 不行。我必须和至高霸主本人谈！

options.zh: 这本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

texts.en: $HeOrShe taps at a TriPad. "I'm going to give you the comms ID for Special Agent Finlay Siyavong. He has an office on Kazeron. He'll know what to do."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点 TriPad，"我把特工 Finlay Siyavong 的通讯识别码给你。他在 Kazeron 有间办公室。他知道该怎么办。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe taps at a TriPad. "I'm going to give you the comms ID..."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点 TriPad，"我把通讯识别码给你..."

options.en: Is it for Special Agent Finlay Siyavong?
options.zh: 是给特工 Finlay Siyavong 的？

texts.en: "I- yes. Yes it is," $heOrShe says, looking surprised. "I guess you're better connected than I thought."
texts.zh: "我——对。是的，\"$heOrShe说道，神色有些意外，\"看来你的人脉比我以为的广。"

texts.en: "Well, good luck. Hope your find turns out to be something useful."
texts.zh: "那就祝你好运。希望你找到的东西真有点用处。"

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.
texts.zh:
"把文件送到舰队情报部去，\"他说，语调里带上了贵族式的命令口吻，\"特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上点了几下，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

texts.en:
You watch $personLastName's eyes as $heOrShe skims the file header.

"This won't be cheap," $heOrShe says. "If this is what it looks like."
texts.zh:
你看着$personLastName的眼睛 —— $heOrShe正扫过文件的头部信息。

"这可不便宜，\"$heOrShe说道，\"如果它真是看上去的那样。"

options.en: What would you say this looks like?
options.zh: 你说它看上去像什么？

options.en: Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 我们来谈谈星币吧。

texts.en: "It might be sensitive information of interest to... a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation," $heOrShe says with a slightly more strained smile.
texts.zh: "它可能是些敏感信息，或许会让...速子科技的一家商业伙伴感兴趣，"$heOrShe说道，笑容略微发僵。

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is a partner of Tri-Tachyon?
options.zh: 辛达强权是速子科技的伙伴？

options.en: Then we'll be careful. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 那我们就谨慎些。谈谈星币吧。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

options.en: How inspiring. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 真叫人振奋。我们来谈谈星币吧。

texts.en: "As we discussed, for a 20,000 credit finders-fee I can forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，20,000 星币的介绍费，我就把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 16,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"16,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 12,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"12,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

options.en: 20,000 credits. I accept.
16,000 credits. I accept.
12,000 credits. I accept.
Absurd! How about 10,000 credits?
options.zh: 荒唐！10,000 星币怎么样？

options.en: I could just take this to Gargoyle. You know, the hacker?
options.zh: 我大可以拿去找 Gargoyle。你知道的，那个黑客？

options.en: I could probably just sell these files to another faction and make quite a profit.
options.zh: 我大概也能把这些文件卖给别的势力，赚上一笔。

options.en: I'll find someone else. (decline)
options.zh: 我另找别人。 (拒绝)

texts.en: $PersonName glances at a TriPad. "Payment received. Thank you, captain."
texts.zh: $PersonName瞥了眼 TriPad。"款已收到。谢谢你，舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 20,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 20,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 16,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 16,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 12,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 12,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: "Faro Inesis is your man. I'll forward you his contact information..."
texts.zh: "Faro Inesis 就是你要找的人。我把他的联系方式转给你..."

options.en: Thank you. I think.
options.zh: 谢谢。大概吧。

options.en: I've already met Faro Inesis! What'd I pay you for?
options.zh: 我已经见过 Faro Inesis 了！我这钱花在哪儿了？

options.en: Thank you. I think.
options.zh: 谢谢。大概吧。

texts.en:
"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says.

"Now I ought to open a comms to my investment agent to talk about volatiles futures..."
texts.zh:
"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，"$heOrShe说道。

"现在我得联络我的投资代理人，谈谈挥发物期货..."

texts.en:
"I'd call it a successful consultation to enhance efficiency in underutilized partner connections."

This line is delivered in complete earnestness.

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says with a wink. "Now I've got some volatiles futures to look into..."
texts.zh:
"我会称之为一次成功的咨询，提升了利用不足的伙伴关系的效率。"

这句话说得一本正经。

"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，\"$heOrShe眨了眨眼，\"现在我得去看看几笔挥发物期货了..."

texts.en: "16,000 credits," $heOrShe shoots back.
texts.zh: "16,000 星币，"$heOrShe回敬道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Take it or leave it."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"要就要，不要拉倒。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"Then see what you can get out of that anarchist," $heOrShe says. "You'll probably end up with a virus in your flagship for the trouble."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"那就去看看能从那个无政府主义者身上榨出什么，\"$heOrShe说道，\"到头来你的旗舰多半会中个病毒，算是这趟的报酬。"

texts.en: "You think you're the first spacer," $heOrShe says, "with a datacore full of noise claiming to have essential intel for sale?"
texts.zh: "你以为你是头一个，\"$heOrShe说道，\"抱着个塞满杂音的数据核心，声称手里有关键情报待售的太空人？"

texts.en: "But because I admire your spirit, I'll do 16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: "不过看在你这份胆气的份上，16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en: "Only because I admire your assertive negotiation, I'll do it for 12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Are you in or out?"
texts.zh: "纯粹是欣赏你这股强硬的谈法，12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"做还是不做？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Go on, try it. It'll be a waste of time, and time is credits."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe抱起$hisOrHer双臂。"去啊，试试看。白费时间，而时间就是星币。"

texts.en: "You'll be back," $heOrShe says, projecting confidence.
texts.zh: "你会回来的，"$heOrShe说道，刻意显出十足的信心。

texts.en:
"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam。请稍候。"

通讯画面一阵抖动，换成了霸主的徽记。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。记住了。

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.
options.zh: 删除已见证。

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 上传 ANDRADA 文件

options.en: The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.
options.zh: 你派去拦截 Macario 信使的那个佣兵？就是那个信使。

options.en: They were intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

options.en: I prefer not to reveal that information at this time.
options.zh: 这个来源，我暂时不想透露。

options.en: You hired the merc that made that debris field.
options.zh: 那片残骸区，就是你雇的佣兵做出来的。

options.en: So can you decrypt the files?
options.zh: 那么，这些文件你能解开吗？

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?
options.zh: 这个信使是哪来的？

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

texts.en:
The image of Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears. He is not even looking at the comms-feed.

"Independent fleet: maintain distance and you will not be fired upon. Hear and obey," Caden declares, taking a breath.

"Final victory to the Supreme Executor!" he shouts.
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 的形象出现了。他甚至脸都没有朝着通讯器。

"独立舰队，保持距离以防被我方攻击。倾听并服从！" Caden 宣告道，一边深吸了一口气。

"胜利终归最高元首！"他怒吼道。

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat, captain!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see another proud follower of the Supreme Executor's vision upholding the Great Cause."

He blinks, perhaps realizing that he doesn't actually have anything to say to you. "Stay strong and stay vigilant just as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前。

"荣耀归于辛达强权，舰长！" 他热情洪亮地喊道，"又见到一位拥护最高元首伟大愿景、共举伟业的忠实追随者，真叫人心里发热。"

他眨了眨眼，大概是发觉自己其实没话跟你说。"保持坚强，保持警惕，正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于辛达强权！"

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a loyal follower of the Supreme Executor's vision, and," he leans in, "One who will stand with me when the time comes, when strength and loyalty will be required to secure the future of the Persean Sector."

He leans back, satisfied. "Stay strong and vigilant - as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前的画面里。"啊，$playerName 舰长。荣耀归于 辛达强权！" 他热情地夸赞道："能看到另一位最高元首愿景的忠实追随者，真的令人感到振奋。而且..." 他凑近了些，"当需要力量和忠诚来护卫英仙座星域的未来之时，他将与我并肩作战。"

他向后靠了靠，表示满意。"保持坚强和谨慎 —— 正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于 辛达强权！"

不等你的回答，通讯链接就被切断了。

texts.en:
Dolos Macario, the Spider of Sindria, appears before you. He looks bored.

"Captain, o captain," he greets you, his tone bored. "Not yet." He winks and hits the shut-off.

The crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry slowly turns.
texts.zh:
Dolos Macario，辛达瑞亚之蛛，出现在你面前。他看起来很无聊。

"舰长啊，舰长。" 他和你打了个招呼，语调透露着无聊，"还不到时候。" 他眨了眨眼，然后按下了切断键。

辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标慢慢地旋转着。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: You sold Jason's info to a Diktat agent.
options.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个特工。

texts.en:
"So you caught up with the tiger cub?" He looks as pleased with himself as ever. "Well done, captain."

"If I may?" Jove holds up a finger. "I anticipate a certain indignation based on your phrasing and tone."

"It's true, more detailed data was discovered upon further inquiry made by myself and my organization following our own conversation. Jason Korin is, after all, a much more interesting person than I could ever have imagined."

He blinks innocently.

"I meant 'was', of course."
texts.zh:
"这么说，你追上那只小老虎了？\"他看上去一如既往地自得。\"干得好，船长。"

"容我插一句？\" Jove 竖起一根手指。\"从你的措辞和语气里，我预感到一阵怒气。"

"确实如此。我们那番谈话之后，我与我的人又做了一番追查，发现了更详细的数据。毕竟，Jason Korin 这个人比我所能想象的要有趣得多。"

他无辜地眨了眨眼。

"当然，我的意思是——【曾经是】。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You, in fact, held back certain essential facts from me. Well, one particularly crucial fact about Jason... Andrada's heritage."

He leans back, looking satisfied.
texts.zh:
"事实上，你对我瞒下了一些关键事实。嗯，一个格外要紧的事实：Jason...Andrada 的血脉。"

他向后一靠，一脸满意。

texts.en:
"Pardon me. Jason Andrada, I mean."

"There's profit to be found in the wake of important people, you see. Besides, we had no exclusive arrangement," he gives a little wave. "You have no basis for complaint."
texts.zh:
"恕我失言。我是说，Jason Andrada。"

"要紧人物走过之后，留下的尾流里是有钱可赚的，你瞧。再说，我们之间并没有排他约定。\"他轻轻一摆手。\"你没有理由抱怨。"

options.en: So you figured it out.
options.zh: 所以，你自己想明白了。

options.en: Pedantry won't make you any friends.
options.zh: 抠字眼可交不到朋友。

options.en: I'm not confirming your speculation.
options.zh: 我不证实你的猜测。

options.en: I would appreciate a little discretion.
options.zh: 希望你能稍稍谨慎一些。

options.en: You assisted the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
options.zh: 你帮了辛达强权。这就是我的不满。

options.en: You betrayed secrets of the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
options.zh: 你泄露了辛达强权的机密。这就是我的不满。

options.en: I've heard enough.
options.zh: 我听够了。

texts.en: "No. I inferred it." His tone is crisp.
texts.zh: "不。我是推断出来的。"他的语气干脆。

texts.en:
"I don't want or need 'friends'," he almost hisses the word.

"I want competent associates. Collaborators, clients, partners; whatever. I want them clear-eyed, because I tire of simpleminded brutes and self-deluded fanatics. They're sloppy. They're fools."

He takes a deep breath. "Still making up my mind about you, captain."
texts.zh:
"我不想要，也不需要【朋友】。"这个词几乎是从他齿间嘶出来的。

"我要的是能办事的同伙。合作者、客户、伙伴，随便叫什么。我要他们眼睛清楚，因为我受够了头脑简单的莽夫和自欺欺人的狂信徒。他们做事毛糙。他们都是蠢货。"

他深吸一口气。"至于你，船长，我还在下判断。"

texts.en: "You don't need to," he waves airily. "That gormless Diktat agent was confirmation enough."
texts.zh: "不必了。\"他漫不经心地一挥手。\"强权那个蠢头蠢脑的探子已经足够作证。"

texts.en:
"Then I graciously accept your appreciation, captain," he smiles broadly and insincerely. "I revealed nothing of you or of any agreement made between us to anyone else."

"What you, yes, must understand is that this information - the ripples made by the life and death of Jason Andrada - was already loose in the world when you stepped into that bar on Qaras. You can't stop it, and couldn't."

He rests his chin on both his hands.

"The question is, and this I eagerly await to witness, is what you do next."
texts.zh:
"那我就恭敬地领受你的谢意了，船长。\"他笑得开朗，却毫无诚意。\"关于你，关于我们之间的任何约定，我一个字都没向旁人透露。"

"你必须明白的是——没错，你必须明白——这些消息，Jason Andrada 的生死所激起的涟漪，在你踏进 Qaras 那间酒吧时就已经在这世上散开了。你阻止不了，也从来阻止不了。"

他把下巴搁在双手上。

"问题在于——这一点我正热切地等着看——你接下来会做什么。"

texts.en:
"I would not be so confident that what I did was assistance," Jove says, stroking his chin.

"It was, however, profitable to me."
texts.zh:
"我做过的事算不算帮忙，你最好别那么有把握。"Jove 摩挲着下巴说。

"不过，那对我很有赚头。"

texts.en:
"To whom?" He looks less amused now. "To an agent of the one-and-same Sindrian Diktat? A patrol commander of the Sindrian Diktat with a fake uniform?"

"If that is the house to which you pledge your loyalty, captain, then I am afraid the betrayal is not on my part."
texts.zh:
"背叛了谁？\"他此刻不那么觉得好笑了。\"背叛了同一个辛达强权的探子？还是辛达强权某个穿着假制服、冒充巡逻指挥官的家伙？"

"如果你效忠的是那样一个门庭，船长，那我恐怕要说，背叛的人不是我。"

texts.en: Jove nods, eyes closed, looking quite calm.
texts.zh: Jove 闭着眼点了点头，神情相当平静。

options.en: You sold Jason's info to a Sindrian Diktat double-agent.
options.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个双面间谍。

options.en: I need to run a little operation on Qaras. I'd like to keep it quiet.
options.zh: 我要在 Qaras 上做个小行动。希望动静别太大。

texts.en:
"This is about the goon who shoved a gun in your face outside the bar." He places his hands together. "Yes, I heard about it. No, he wasn't mine."

"Now tell me a story about why I ought to help you navigate our tangled little web of protection agreements."
texts.zh:
"是为了那个在酒吧外把枪顶到你脸上的打手。\"他把双手并在一起。\"是的，我听说了。不，他不是我的人。"

"现在，讲个故事给我听，说说我为什么该帮你在这张乱成一团的小小保护协议网里找条路。"

texts.en:
"Oh, fine. Yes, I'll back you. No charge." Jove gives you an indulgent look. "We can't just allow goons to shove guns in the face of a 'fellow corsair', especially not after a meeting with myself."

"Yes, of course I heard about it. No, the goon wasn't mine. And yes, I assume you got everything you needed from a bit of interrogation."

"Anyway, the worst part of all of this," he examines a fingernail, "it sullies the integrity of my hospitality."
texts.zh:
"哦，好吧。行，我支持你。不收钱。\"Jove 宽容地看了你一眼。\"总不能让打手把枪顶到一位'同道私掠船长'脸上，尤其还是刚跟我见过面之后。"

"是的，我当然听说了。不，那打手不是我的人。还有，我猜你从那点审讯里该问的都问到了。"

"总之，这一切里最糟的一点，\"他端详着一片指甲，\"是它脏了我待客之道的名声。"

texts.en:
"Oh... fine. Yes, I'll back you - no charge." Jove gives you an indulgent look. "We can't just allow goons to shove guns in people's faces, especially not after a meeting with myself."

"Yes, of course I heard about it. No, the goon wasn't mine. And yes, I assume you got everything you needed from a bit of interrogation."

"Anyway, the worst part of all of this," he examines a fingernail, "it sullies the integrity of my hospitality."
texts.zh:
"哦...好吧。行，我支持你——不收钱。\"Jove 宽容地看了你一眼。\"总不能让打手把枪顶到别人脸上，尤其还是刚跟我见过面之后。"

"是的，我当然听说了。不，那打手不是我的人。还有，我猜你从那点审讯里该问的都问到了。"

"总之，这一切里最糟的一点，\"他端详着一片指甲，\"是它脏了我待客之道的名声。"

options.en: Threatening me with a gun was the worst part, I'd say.
options.zh: 要我说，最糟的是有人拿枪指着我。

options.en: Threatening me with a gun was the worst part, I'd say.
options.zh: 要我说，最糟的是有人拿枪指着我。

texts.en:
"Sure, sure. Matter of perspective," he says. "Anyway, I'll make sure no one interferes with your revenge plot."

$HeOrShe gives an ironic little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"当然，当然。看从谁的角度说，\"他说。\"总之，我会保证没人来搅你的复仇。"

$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的小礼。"玩得开心。"

options.en: Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
options.zh: 10,000 星币，能买你的支持吗？

options.en: Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
options.zh: 10,000 星币，能买你的支持吗？

options.en: How about 15,000 credits.
How about 15,000 credits.
You already have an answer. You just want me to say it.
options.zh: 你心里早有答案。你只是想让我说出口。

options.en: Maybe later... (back)
options.zh: 也许以后再说... (返回)

texts.en: "You already know it'll be 15,000," he says, seemingly disinterested.
texts.zh: "你早知道是 15,000，"他说得像是毫无兴致。

texts.en: "Boring," he says. "It'll be 15,000. And no, I won't budget on the price, so don't bother with the 'meeting you halfway' with 12,500. I'm not interested."
texts.zh: "没意思。\"他说。\"就是 15,000。也别想我在这价上让步，省了那套 12,500'各让一步'的说辞。我没兴趣。"

texts.en:
He holds his wrist to his ear, theatrical, and nods when it gives a soft chime.

"No one will interfere with your little revenge plot." $HeOrShe gives an ironic salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
他装模作样地把手腕举到耳边，听见一声轻响，便点了点头。

"没人会来搅你那点复仇的小算盘。"$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks genuinely intrigued.

"Prove yourself. What is it?"
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他看上去真被勾起了兴趣。

"那就拿出点东西来。是什么？"

options.en: In truth, it's several points which reinforce one another.
options.zh: 实话说，是几点理由，彼此互相支撑。

texts.en: He makes a rolling hand motion - get on with it.
texts.zh: 他抬起手做了个催促的手势——往下说。

options.en: You're an information broker. You must have integrity.
options.zh: 你是情报贩子。信誉总得有。

texts.en:
To sell information at a top price, you explain, his clients must believe that he is trustworthy. And not only that - they must believe that his judgement is solid. Jove himself must know who to trust in order to separate good information from bad. Or he must know precisely how little to trust the untrustworthy to turn bad information into good.

He nods, evidently enjoying your explanation.

You continue: a client attacked in public immediately after meeting with him does not project the image of a trustworthy enterprise. It raises uncomfortable, unprofitable questions. And if the attack was not carried out on his order, it's only worse, because that means a third party sees him as weak. An opportunity to exploit. This would mean that K-O Jove does not have the judgement necessary to handle his own affairs.
texts.zh:
你解释说，要把情报卖出最高价，他的客户就必须相信他可靠。而不止于此——他们还得相信他的判断是稳的。Jove 自己就得知道谁可信，才能从坏情报里挑出好的。又或者，他得非常清楚该少信那些不可信的人几分，才好把坏情报变成好情报。

他点头，显然颇享受你这一番解释。

你接着说：一个刚跟他见过面、就在公开场合被袭击的客户，传达不出任何可靠生意的形象。它会引出些令人不适、也赚不到钱的问题。而如果这场袭击不是他下的令，那就更糟——因为那意味着有第三方视他为软弱。是个可以下手的机会。而这也就意味着，K-O Jove 不具备处理自己事务所需的判断力。

options.en: You see, my problem is your problem.
options.zh: 你看，我的麻烦就是你的麻烦。

texts.en:
"I suppose." Jove watches you carefully.

"What you ask is not trivial. Favors must be called, bribes paid. Qaras is built on relationships and not all are so... trusting... as that between you and I."
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"Jove 仔细看着你。

"你求的不是小事。人情要动用，贿赂要打点。Qaras 是立在一层层关系上的，而这些关系并不都像你我之间这么...信得过..."

options.en: Exactly. When you are indebted to another, your problems become theirs...
options.zh: 正是如此。你欠了别人的时候，你的麻烦也就成了他们的...

texts.en:
You elaborate: if K-O Jove owes some other gang, syndicate, cell, boss, or clade, it ties their interests into alignment. None profits from annihilation of the other. Indeed, when Jove owes a debt of credits or favor, it will profit his creditor when he thrives.

Jove closes his eyes, not shaking his head, no; his subtle smile remains.

"Enough, captain. Enough. If I listen to more of this I'll be a poor man indeed, despite my many interested friends."
texts.zh:
你进一步说：若 K-O Jove 欠着别的帮派、辛迪加、小队、头目或宗族的债，那便把双方的利益捆到了一处。哪一方被彻底铲掉，另一方都无利可图。事实上，当 Jove 欠着一笔星币或人情的债时，他越兴旺，债主就越得利。

Jove 闭上眼睛，没有摇头，没有；那抹浅笑还挂着。

"够了，舰长。够了。再听下去，我就要变成一个穷光蛋了——尽管我有那么多愿意关照我的朋友。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I'll make sure no one interferes with your revenge plot. One supposes all of Qaras will be better for it, somehow - I'll hold you to that."

$HeOrShe gives an ironic little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"我会保证没人来搅你的复仇。想来这么一折腾，Qaras 上下多少会更好些——这话我可记在你账上。"

$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的小礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en: He gives you a look of patience which is anything but.
texts.zh: 他给了你一个耐心的眼神——只是完全不是那个意思。

options.en: Could Siyavong decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Siyavong 能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
texts.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

texts.en:
Your mind wanders from the open comms channel, to what you did - and what you found - brewing, rotting, in the Askonia System.

You think of Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria. The proud conqueror - the fading villain of the Hegemony's pride, and soon, perhaps, a wasting corpse.

You think to yourself...
texts.zh:
你的思绪从仍然开着的通讯频道飘开，飘向你在 Askonia 星系做过的事、找到的东西——那些正在发酵、正在腐烂的东西。

你想起了 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮。那个骄傲的征服者——霸主自尊心里那个正在褪色的恶人，也许很快就是一具枯朽的尸体。

你暗自思忖...

options.en: Who, or what, are the seven Andradas on Macario's list?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，究竟是谁，又或者是什么？

options.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list truly Philip's heirs?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，真是 Philip 的继承人吗？

options.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list... Andrada?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada... 都是 Andrada 本人吗？

options.en: What game is Macario playing by revealing the list to me?
options.zh: Macario 把这份名单透露给我，究竟在下什么棋？

options.en: Andrada's dictatorship could be felled with one push... in the right place
options.zh: Andrada 的独裁政权一推就倒... 只要推对地方

options.en: Philip Andrada's grand experiment might be felled with one push... in the wrong place
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的宏大实验或许一推就倒... 只要推错地方

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat must be protected from Macario's scheming
options.zh: 必须护住辛达强权，不让 Macario 的阴谋得逞

options.en: I don't have time for this right now
options.zh: 我现在没时间处理这个

texts.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased perhaps? Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. And Andrada's, perhaps.

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
texts.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了？总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。或许，也逃出了 Andrada 的。

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

texts.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased, perhaps. Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. What was Supreme Executor Philip Andrada's plan for these files, these names?

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了。总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。最高元首 Philip Andrada 对这些文件、这些名字，原本是打的什么算盘？

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

options.en: I need to find out what's in the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 我得弄清楚 ANDRADA 档案里到底写了什么

texts.en: You can visualize the list without checking your TriPad. Seven names lead by the surname of the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor.
texts.zh: 不用翻 TriPad，那份名单就在你眼前浮着。七个名字，打头的是辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首的姓氏。

options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The best hackers or perhaps the least AI core - or a team made of the two working together - could crack the files, given time.

Any major faction's intelligence service must have this capacity.

Except the Luddic Church. (Nor the Path, for that matter... unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock. You set aside that disturbing thought.)
texts.zh:
最好的黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——只要给足时间，都能破开这些文件。

任何一个大势力的情报机构，都必然具备这种能力。

银河救赎教会除外。(卢德左径其实也一样... 除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群。你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。)

options.en: Return to the practical question
options.zh: 回到那个实际问题

texts.en: You return to your initial thought: could Orcus Rao decrypt the files?
texts.zh: 你回到最初那个念头：Orcus Rao 能解密这些文件吗？

texts.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
texts.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

texts.en: It would take some kind of super-hacker. If only you knew one...
texts.zh: 这得是何等厉害的黑客才行。可惜你不认识这样的人...

texts.en: If you had your own colonial infrastructure with an alpha-level AI core at its head, it might be possible to keep the job entirely internal.
texts.zh: 如果你有自己的殖民地设施，再有一颗 Alpha 级 AI 核心坐镇，或许整件事都能在内部消化。

options.en: Gargoyle could do it
options.zh: Gargoyle 或许能做到

options.en: You could use the alpha-level core installed as administrator of $sd7s_aiColonyName
options.zh: 你可以动用那颗装在 $sd7s_aiColonyName、担任管理者的 Alpha 级核心

options.en: Surely someone in the Sindrian Diktat is loyal to Andrada?
options.zh: 辛达强权里总该有人忠于 Andrada 吧？

options.en: The Hegemony could, if it so chose
options.zh: 霸主若愿意下场，也能做到

options.en: If the Persean League could be persuaded of its utility...
options.zh: 若能说服英仙座联盟相信此事的用处...

options.en: Tri-Tachyon expertise could crack it... for a price
options.zh: 速子科技的技术能破开它... 只要出得起价

options.en: Perhaps you need more time to develop allies and contacts
options.zh: 也许你还需要更多时间去经营盟友与人脉

texts.en:
The hacker is mercurial, but Gargoyle's curiosity can be counted on - to say nothing of the opportunity to disgrace and annoy one or more powerful factions by revealing their secrets.

It is clear, then, that you must take the ANDRADA files to Gargoyle.
texts.zh:
这名黑客性情无常，但 Gargoyle 的好奇心绝对可靠——更别提揭开秘密能让一两个强大势力丢脸恼火。

那么路只有一条：你只能把 ANDRADA 文件带去给 Gargoyle。

texts.en: "Glad that's resolved," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something?"
texts.zh: "总算解决了，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才想说什么？"

texts.en: "I'm glad that's been resolved," $heOrShe says pleasantly. "You were about to say something?"
texts.zh: "很高兴这事解决了，\" $heOrShe 语气愉快，\"你刚才想说什么？"

texts.en: "Okay," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something?"
texts.zh: "行了，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才想说什么？"

texts.en: "I see," $heOrShe says with more than a tinge of skepticism. "You were about to say... ?"
texts.zh: "原来如此，\" $heOrShe 的语气里带着不止一点怀疑，\"你刚才是要说... ？"

texts.en: "Acknowledged," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something. Speak."
texts.zh: "收到，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才要说什么。讲。"

texts.en:
Your colony of $sd7s_aiColonyName, in the $sd7s_aiColonySystemName, has an Alpha Core safely and securely optimizing many key functions.

The 'executive consultant team' that oversees interfacing between the core and colonial operations could insert the task of analyzing the ANDRADA files into the AI's usual work queue.

Perhaps it would even 'enjoy' solving this unique problem.
texts.zh:
你在 $sd7s_aiColonySystemName 的殖民地 $sd7s_aiColonyName，有一枚 Alpha 核心正稳妥无虞地优化着许多关键机能。

负责衔接核心与殖民地运作的【执行顾问团队】，可以把分析 ANDRADA 文件的任务塞进这台 AI 的日常作业队列。

说不定它甚至会【享受】解开这个独一无二的问题。

texts.en:
You bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat and are pledged to uphold the vision of Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor from which all legitimate authority flows!

But, clearly, not all is well in the Sindrian Diktat.

Dolos Macario schemes, Hyder scrapes for supplies, Caden rants and parades his fleet in circles. Underlings plot treason, loyal officers are purged without reason.
texts.zh:
你持有辛达强权的委任状，宣誓维护 Philip Andrada 的愿景——辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首，一切合法权力皆从他那里流出！

但显然，辛达强权里并非一切都好。

Dolos Macario 在背后算计，Hyder 四处搜刮补给，Caden 只会咆哮着把舰队拉出去绕圈游行。底下的人谋划叛变，忠诚的军官被毫无理由地清洗。

options.en: I must find an outsider to decrypt the files
options.zh: 我必须找个外人来解密这些文件

texts.en:
So it must be.

The corruption and confusion runs deep, and only an outsider can help you - yourself an outsider - save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
看来只能如此。

腐败与混乱已经渗得太深。只有外人能帮你——而你自己就是个外人——救下辛达强权。

texts.en: The Hegemony is touchy about the subject of AI cores due to the living memory of the AI Wars as well as the need to secure support from the Faithful of the Luddic Church.
texts.zh: 霸主对 AI 核心这个话题格外敏感：一来 AI 战争的记忆还活着，二来他们需要稳住银河救赎教会的信众。

texts.en: You bear a commission with the Hegemony and would expect to be taken seriously if you were to bring in intel of such supreme importance concerning the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: 你持有霸主的委任状。若你带着关乎辛达强权、如此重要的情报上门，应当会被认真对待。

texts.en: You do not bear a commission with the Hegemony. Considering the sensitive nature of the intel, and what would be required to decrypt it, you will need an advocate inside their organization.
texts.zh: 你不持霸主的委任状。考虑到这份情报的敏感程度，以及解密它需要付出的代价，你得在他们内部找个替你说话的人。

texts.en:
In any event, you bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat and are considered an adherent to Philip Andrada, reviled as arch-traitor in the Hegemony's telling of history.
They would never help you.
texts.zh:
况且，你持有辛达强权的委任状，被视为 Philip Andrada 的追随者——而在霸主的史书里，那人是头号叛徒。
他们绝不会帮你。

texts.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
texts.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

texts.en: You've heard that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if you can help out.
texts.zh: 你听说 Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看能不能帮上忙。

texts.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations and a burning desire to strike at the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框，也一心要对辛达强权动手。

texts.en: You've personally met the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud. He is a practical man, though you have no way of knowing if he trusts you - or could ever trust someone in your position.
texts.zh: 你曾亲自见过至高霸主 Baikal Daud。他是个务实的人，不过你无从知道他是否信得过你——或者他是否可能信任一个处在你这位置上的人。

options.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao
options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 把文件交给 Baikal Daud

options.zh: 把文件交给你的霸主联系人

options.en: Take the files to a high-level Hegemony officer
options.zh: 把文件交给一位霸主高层军官

options.en: Consider your other options
options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: If this intel is legitimate and as important as Dolos Macario acts like it is, it should prove to be an invaluable weapon to Admiral Rao.
texts.zh: 若这份情报确属真货，又真如 Dolos Macario 表现出的那般要紧，那它对 Rao 上将就是一件无价利器。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: High Hegemon Daud must recognize the value of what you'll bring him. Key intel from the heart of the Sindrian Diktat can only help his position.
texts.zh: 至高霸主 Daud 一定看得出你送去的东西值多少。来自辛达强权心脏的关键情报，只会让他的位置更稳。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A high-level officer or administrator will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 一位高层军官或行政官知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
texts.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

texts.en: You are a demarchon of the Persean League in good standing. You have the right to bring matters essential to League security directly to the top executive and you can expect to be taken seriously. Reynard Hannan may be arrogant, but he did not get to his position by being stupid.
texts.zh: 你是英仙座联盟一名声誉无亏的民选统领。你有权把关乎联盟安全要务的事项直接呈给最高行政官，而且可以指望被认真对待。Reynard Hannan 也许傲慢，但能爬到那个位置，绝不是靠愚蠢。

texts.en:
You bear a commission for the Persean League. Despite your dedication, some will consider you little more than an opportunistic mercenary. The only possible way you can be taken - and treated - seriously is through the influence of a leader of one of the Kazeronian gens.

...Or a trusted contact who could, presumably, leverage such a relationship.
texts.zh:
你持有英仙座联盟的委任状。可无论你多尽心，总有人只当你是个见风使舵的雇佣兵。唯一可能被当回事、被认真对待的门路，是借 Kazeron 某个氏族领袖的影响力。

...或者一个信得过的联系人，他能替你把这条关系用起来。

texts.en: You are not a member of the Persean League, nor do you bear their commission. The only way you would be treated seriously is through the influence of an important contact... or the leader of a major Gens. Even then, you will not be trusted with such sensitive information without proving yourself.
texts.zh: 你既不是英仙座联盟的成员，也不持他们的委任状。想被认真对待，只能靠某位要员的引荐... 或者某个大氏族领袖的影响力。可即便到了那一步，不先证明自己，他们也不会把这么敏感的情报交到你手上。

texts.en: You are a Demarchon of the Persean League and can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan. He must have the resources required to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 你是英仙座联盟的民选统领，可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见。他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案所需的资源。

texts.en: As a Demarchon of the League with an expensive 'arrangement', you can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan to discuss what you've found. And he must have the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 作为联盟的民选统领，又付着一笔昂贵的"安排"，你可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见，与他谈谈你的发现。而他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

texts.en: You have earned the trust of Horus Yaribay. Surely he has access to the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 你已经赢得了 Horus Yaribay 的信任。他总该有门路弄到破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

texts.en: You do have a contact in the League that could provide a means to engage with Fleet Intelligence.
texts.zh: 你在联盟里确实有个联系人，能替你搭上舰队情报部的门路。

options.en: Take the files to Reynard Hannan
options.zh: 把文件交给 Reynard Hannan

options.en: Take the files to Horus Yaribay
options.zh: 把文件交给 Horus Yaribay

options.en: Take the files to Finlay Siyavong
options.zh: 把文件交给 Finlay Siyavong

options.en: Take the files to your contact
options.zh: 把文件交给你的联系人

options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: You will place your trust in the ambitions of Reynard Hannan. If he knows what's good for him he'll recognize your value.
texts.zh: 你决定把信任押在 Reynard Hannan 的野心之上。他若识得利害，就该认出你的价值。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: You will take these files to Horus Yaribay and place your trust in him as he placed his trust in you.
texts.zh: 你决定把这些文件交给 Horus Yaribay，并像他曾信任你那样信任他。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: You will take these files to Finlay Siyavong and place your trust in him to do the best thing for the Persean League.
texts.zh: 你决定把这些文件交给 Finlay Siyavong，相信他会为英仙座联盟做出最有利的选择。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Is there anyone in Tri-Tachyon you could trust? They're almost certain to use the information for their own game. Perhaps it is worth the risk.
texts.zh: 速子科技里有你信得过的人吗？他们几乎肯定会拿这份情报去做自己的局。也许，这风险值得一冒。

texts.en: You bear a commission of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. This should provide an 'in' to corporate officers of influence, perhaps with access to unique black-site resources.
texts.zh: 你持有速子科技公司的委任状。这应该能替你敲开有分量的公司高管的门——他们或许能动用某些独特的机密设施资源。

texts.en: You do not bear a commission with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, though this is no great barrier - credits and loyalty are generally considered fungible to Tri-Tachyon executives. You would need to leverage a relationship with a well-connected contact on the 'inside' to have any hope of gaining access to the Company's black-site capabilities.
texts.zh: 你并未在速子科技持有委任状，不过这也算不上什么大障碍——在速子科技的高管眼里，星币与忠诚向来可以互换。你得靠着公司【内部】一位人脉通达的关系人，才有望触及这家企业的黑站能力。

texts.en: You have a contact in The Company who may be able to help. Anyone with ambition in Tri-Tachyon - and that ought to be everyone - will leap at an opportunity to get an edge on the competition, whether inside the company or out.
texts.zh: 你在公司里有位联系人，或许能帮上忙。速子科技中但凡有点野心的人——而那本该是所有人——都会扑向任何一个压过对手的机会，不论对手在公司内外。

texts.en: This matter could be of interest to Director Zunya Glamor-Rotanev. She has credits to throw around, after all, and this might be an opportunity to earn a few more.
texts.zh: 这件事也许能让 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 总监感兴趣。毕竟她有大把星币可撒，而这或许也是个多赚几笔的机会。

texts.en: Faro Inesis is a consummate spymaster. He might be just the man for a job involving decryption and exploitation.
texts.zh: Faro Inesis 是位炉火纯青的谍报头子。解密与利用情报这类活儿，他也许正是合适的人选。

texts.en: Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded of the financial benefits of decrypting key intel concerning what appears to be an increasing unstable Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Rayan Arroyo 或许能被说动——解出一批关键情报能换来实打实的收益，而情报关乎一个看上去正愈发不稳的辛达强权。

options.en: Take the files to your Tri-Tachyon contact
options.zh: 把文件交给你的速子科技联系人

options.en: Take the files to a senior Tri-Tachyon executive
options.zh: 把文件交给一位速子科技高层主管

options.en: Take the files to Director Glamor-Rotanev
options.zh: 把文件交给 Glamor-Rotanev 总监

options.en: Take the files to Faro Inesis
options.zh: 把文件交给 Faro Inesis

options.en: Take the files to Rayan Arroyo
options.zh: 把文件交给 Rayan Arroyo

options.en: Consider your other options
options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A high-level executive or administrator will know how to access the resources required to decrypt such important intel.
texts.zh: 一位高层主管或行政官，自然知道该去哪里调取解密这种重要情报所需的资源。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Director Glamor-Rotanev seems to have set her sights higher than factional politics, but perhaps the opportunity to exploit knowledge about Macario's scheming could pique her interest.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 总监的目光似乎早已越过派系政治，但能拿 Macario 的算计做文章，这个由头也许仍能勾起她的兴趣。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Besides, Inesis' operations must be very well-funded by Director Glamor-Rotanev - and well-protected from the Company itself. If anyone can do this, Inesis can.
texts.zh: 再说，Inesis 的行动必有 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的雄厚资助，也必然防着公司本身。这事若有人办得成，那就是 Inesis。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Rayan Arroyo would know how to exploit an intelligence breakthrough concerning the Sindrian Diktat. Shorting volatiles futures, stockpiling fuel; one way or another he'll take his cut without getting caught up in any mess.

The trick will be convincing him to pull the strings necessary to access Tri-Tachyon's AI assets. They must exist, though the Company keeps them very, very quiet in the aftermath of the two AI Wars.
texts.zh:
Rayan Arroyo 懂得怎么把一份关于辛达强权的情报突破变成钱。做空挥发物期货，囤积燃料；无论走哪条路，他都会捞到自己那一份，还不会沾上一身麻烦。

难处在于说服他去动用那些关系，才够得着速子科技的 AI 资产。这些东西一定存在——只是两场 AI 战争之后，公司把它们藏得极深。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You tag a new workspace in your TriPad and fill it with the relevant files and notes.

When you feel prepared you can open it to review your options.
texts.zh:
你在 TriPad 里标出一个新的工作区，把相关文件和笔记都放了进去。

等你觉得准备妥当了，可以打开它，重新梳理自己的选择。

texts.en: When you feel prepared you can simply open the workspace to review your options.
texts.zh: 等你觉得准备妥当了，直接打开这个工作区，就能梳理自己的选择。

options.zh: 关闭工作区

texts.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
texts.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

texts.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations - and you know if his desire to strike at the heart of the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框——而你也清楚，他有多想直插辛达强权的心脏。

texts.en: Besides, you bear a commission of the Hegemony. It is only correct that you take intel of strategic importance to an appropriate senior officer, and Orcus Rao is ideally placed to put such intel to appropriate use.
texts.zh: 再说，你持有霸主的委任状。把具有战略价值的情报交给一位合适的高级军官，本就天经地义；而 Orcus Rao 的位置，最便于让这份情报派上该有的用场。

options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

texts.en:
It appears to be too important a piece of intel to simply allow into your hands - and more dangerously, your databanks. Macario of all people should know that post-Collapse encryption is not a sure science.

The best hackers, perhaps the least AI core, or a team made up of the two working together for any given major intelligence service might be able to crack it, given time. Any are capable of it but the Luddic Church (and Path, for that matter, unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock.)

You set aside that disturbing thought.

What is clear is you need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
texts.zh:
这份情报太重要了，不可能就这么落进你手里——更危险的是，落进你的数据库。别人或许不懂，Macario 总该知道，大崩塌之后的加密术从来不是什么稳妥的科学。

顶尖黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——任何一家大情报机构，只要给足时间，或许都能把它破开。除了银河救赎教会，谁都有这个能力 (卢德左径其实也一样，除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群)。

你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。

清楚的是：你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

texts.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. It will be his opportunity to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor - bound by a puppet-master's strings. That will be your chance.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。那是他把 Caden 推上最高元首之位的机会——用提线拴住的傀儡。那也是你的机会。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

texts.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. Does he mean to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor while bound by a puppet-master's strings?

Is this the bold future that Philip Andrada decreed? It is difficult to imagine it is so.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。他是打算把 Caden 推上最高元首之位，再用提线拴住他吗？

这就是 Philip Andrada 所钦定的那幅壮阔未来吗？很难想象会是如此。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

texts.en:
Philip Andrada carved a stellar empire from the heart of the Persean Sector and then, it seems, his body - though not his immortal will - faltered, allowing parasites and traitors to bring corruption and ruin to his vision.

Foremost among them: Dolos Macario.

You don't know exactly what these files represent but they can't be the product of Macario. He builds nothing of his own, only manipulating what others created. He is nothing like Philip Andrada, who conceived a perfect polity from force and will alone.

It may be that only you can save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
Philip Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国；而后，垮下去的似乎是他的身体——而非他不朽的意志，寄生虫与叛徒这才得以把他的愿景拖进腐败与毁灭。

其中最要紧的一个：Dolos Macario。

你说不准这些文件究竟意味着什么，但它们不可能是 Macario 的产物。他从不自己建造什么，只会摆弄别人造出来的东西。他与 Philip Andrada 全然不同——那个人仅凭武力与意志，就构想出一个完美的政体。

也许只有你，才救得下辛达强权。

options.en: Inesis is Tri-Tachyon - could he decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Inesis 是速子科技的人 —— 他能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
texts.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

options.en: Could Orcus Rao decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Orcus Rao 能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. Certainly Orcus Rao seems dedicated to the destruction of Philip Andrada, and if Macario's files are the opening he needs...
texts.zh: 也许他能。Orcus Rao 显然一心要毁掉 Philip Andrada，如果 Macario 的这些文件正是他等的那个缺口...

options.en: Contact the 'executive consultant team' overseeing the Alpha Core administrator
options.zh: 联系监管 Alpha 核心管理程序的【执行顾问团队】

texts.en:
The executive consultant team - a group of AI security experts and analysts - have already been briefed on the plan.

* * *

"We're ready when you are," the team leader reports. Their enthusiasm for the task is obvious but respectably suppressed.

The link is open.
texts.zh:
执行顾问团队——一群 AI 安全专家与分析员——早已听过计划简报。

* * *

"你准备好，我们就开始，"团队负责人报告。他们对这活儿的热切显而易见，却压得足够体面。

链路已通。

options.en: Transfer the files
options.zh: 传输文件

texts.en:
"Received, $playerSirOrMadam. We'll input this into the analysis queue now. This should take about-"

The team leader trails off with a worried look on their face, then taps rapidly at an input device, eyes flickering from an implant-interface.

"Um. $PlayerSirOrMadam. It's done. We just need to check the output for excursion attempts. This... will take some time."
texts.zh:
"$playerSirOrMadam，已接收。这就送进分析队列。大概要花——"

团队负责人的话断在半截，脸上掠过一丝忧色，随即在输入设备上飞快敲击，目光在植入体界面间来回跳动。

"呃。$PlayerSirOrMadam。做完了。我们只需检查输出里有没有越界尝试。这... 要花些时间。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

It's not difficult to pass a shift or two. You have no shortage of small decisions to review concerning the colonial operations of $name.

It is tedious work, however. The AI has anticipated and improved upon every minor directive you might have thought to propose. It's somewhere between humbling and irritating, like reviewing a better version of your own command logs.

The ping of an incoming comms link is a relief.
texts.zh:
* * *

打发一两个班次并不难。关于 $name 的殖民地运作，你有的是琐碎决定要过目。

可这活儿真枯燥。你能想到的每一条小指令，那台 AI 都早已料到，而且办得更漂亮。既让人服气，又让人窝火，像在翻看自己指挥日志的升级版。

通讯链路接入的提示音，听着像种解脱。

options.en: Open the comms
options.zh: 接通通讯

texts.en:
"Looks clean, $playerSirOrMadam," the team leader reports. "All yours."

Their tone is that of mild, well-compensated professional enthusiasm tempered by an undercurrent of anxiety.

"Per your orders we anonymized the data and quarantined the review process. Even I couldn't tell you what's in those files, but I assure you it ought to be human-readable. Good luck with, um, whatever it is."

They sign off the comms-link.
texts.zh:
"看着干净，$playerSirOrMadam，\"团队负责人报告，\"全归你了。"

那语气是报酬优渥的专业人士式的客气热忱，底下压着一股不安。

"按你的命令，数据已匿名化，审查流程也已隔离。连我也说不出那些文件里有什么，但我保证它应该是人能读的。祝你... 呃，不管那是什么，祝你好运。"

对方切断了通讯链路。

options.en: Access the files
options.zh: 打开文件

texts.en: You open the updated ANDRADA workspace.
texts.zh: 你打开更新后的 ANDRADA 工作区。

texts.en:
You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.

The data has been processed and analyzed by an intelligence team, possibly over many cycles. You are able to rapidly glean essential details from the prepared summaries.

This archive is stored in your TriPad in a secure workspace and remains accessible through your mission intel entry.
texts.zh:
你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

这些数据已经过一个情报小组的处理与分析，也许花了许多个星历年。你得以从整理好的摘要里迅速拣出要点。

这份档案存放在你 TriPad 上的加密工作区里，仍可从任务情报条目中访问。

texts.en: You now have a list of places of interest, mostly small planets, a couple minor asteroids, and the Galatia Academy station. All within the core worlds.
texts.zh: 你手上现在有了一份地点清单：多数是小型行星，另有一两处小行星，还有 Galatia 学院空间站 —— 全都在核心世界之内。

Perseus "Saturnian".

Nomios, Arcadia system. Medical reports green. Biochemistry reports. Electrostim muscular and neurological development regimen, equipment and technician fees.

Cheerful progress reports; costly procurement receipt - inventory referred to by codewords. Doctor Cydonia "proceeding with operation". Updates suddenly cease at $sd7s_cydoniaDate.

Alarmed finger-pointing reports. Cydonia gone dark, then reported present at Kanta's Den. Case referred to the Ministry of Internal Security, something called EXCISION-RED.

Perseus，代号 "Saturnian"。

Nomios，Arcadia 星系。医学报告全部正常。生化检测报告。电刺激肌肉与神经发育方案，设备与技术员费用。

进度报告笔调轻快；昂贵的采购收据 —— 清单上的物件只用代号指称。Cydonia 医生【手术进行中】。所有更新在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate 骤然中断。

随后是惊慌的相互推责报告。Cydonia 失联，之后有报告称其出现在 Kanta's Den。案子转交内部安全部，落到一个叫 EXCISION-RED 的名目下。

Anonymous donation to Nova Maxios orphanage, records altered. Excellent creche scores. Conflict with peers. Multiple MuniSec reports as adolescent.

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

你深吸一口气，等着看接下来会发生什么。

texts.en:
"Mm." Gargoyle looks distractedly off somewhere while making a complex motion with one hand, using some kind of implanted interface.

But there - a quick little glance, an unmistakeably piercing look for just a moment.

You can tell the hacker is already intrigued, but doesn't want to show it.
texts.zh:
"嗯。"Gargoyle 心不在焉地望着别处，一只手做出复杂的手势，操作着某种植入体界面。

但就在那儿——极快地一瞥，只有一瞬，却锐利得毫不含糊。

你看得出这名黑客已经起了兴致，只是不想露出来。
