texts.en:
"Got 'em," the hacker says, turning away.

A cloud of glowing glyphs grows alarmingly at their odd hand and eye movements.

The link crackles with visual static, then suddenly terminates.
texts.zh:
"拿到了，"黑客说着转过身去。

随着那双怪异的手与眼睛的动作，一团发光的字符令人心惊地增殖开来。

链路爆出一片视觉噪点，随即骤然中断。

texts.en:
"Oh," the hacker's brow furrows for just an instant.

"But I'm sooo bored with this." A flick and half of the hovering displays fade away.

Gargoyle turns and props their head on their hands, looking at you. "You might as well tell me about it."
texts.zh:
"哦。"黑客的眉头一皱，只有一瞬。

"可我已经被这东西烦透了。"一个弹指，悬浮的显示面板淡去一半。

Gargoyle 转过身，双手托腮看着你。"你还是跟我说说吧。"

options.en: Are you sure? I wouldn't want to waste your time.
options.zh: 你确定？我可不想浪费你的时间。

options.en: Seriously. Never mind.
options.zh: 认真的。当我没说。

texts.en:
A smile develops. "You're so thoughtful, captain. That's why I like you."

A quick twirl and twitch - then an eager datalink awaits your upload.

"I'm ever so curious," Gargoyle says, fingers twitching. Looking hungry.
texts.zh:
一个笑容慢慢浮起来。"你真是体贴，舰长。所以我才喜欢你。"

一个急转，几下抽动——随即一条急不可耐的数据链等你上传。

"我可太好奇了，"Gargoyle 说着，手指抽动，眼里透着饿意。

options.en: Transfer the files
options.zh: 传输文件

options.en: No. For real. I'm cutting the comms. Bye.
options.zh: 不。说真的。我断通讯了。再见。

texts.en:
"Too late." A smile develops. "I'm piqued. So let's have it, here's a linky-link. You know what to do."

A twirl and a twitch and then an eager datalink awaits your upload.

Gargoyle puts on an uncharistaristically gracious expression.
texts.zh:
"太晚了。\"一个笑容浮起。\"我被勾住了。那就拿来吧，这是链接。你知道该怎么做。"

一个转手、一下抽动，一条急不可耐的数据链就在等你上传。

Gargoyle 摆出一副与平日全然不符的宽和神情。

options.en: Transfer the files
options.zh: 传输文件

options.en: No. For real. I'm cutting the comms now. Bye.
options.zh: 不。说真的。我现在就断通讯。再见。

texts.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil.

Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises might come through the link.

The link did terminate abruptly and unexpectedly.

You wonder if even Gargoyle could deal with a surprise digital attack of the sort Macario's contacts might cook up to punish untoward curiousity.
texts.zh:
你输入通讯 ID，手悬在一枚发光的【确认】符印上。

你的通讯官点头，随时准备应对链路上冒出来的任何意外。

那条链路确实断得突然，也出人意料。

你不禁想：倘若 Macario 的关系人为了惩治不该有的好奇心，炮制一场突然的数字攻击，Gargoyle 是否应付得了。

options.en: Confirm comms request
options.zh: 确认通讯请求

texts.en:
You execute the command.

Gargoyle appears.

"Oh, there you are," the hacker says with a smirk. "I thought you'd lost interest in your fascinating little archive."
texts.zh:
你执行了指令。

Gargoyle 出现在画面上。

"哦，你在啊，\"黑客得意地一笑。\"我还以为你对那份迷人的小档案失去兴趣了。"

options.en: What did you find?
options.zh: 你查到了什么？

options.en: I thought you got hacked!
options.zh: 我还以为你被黑了！

options.en: You gave no indication of voluntarily ending the comm-link.
options.zh: 你没有任何主动断开链路的迹象。

texts.en: "This is a hot one! Spicy with rads, yum yum. Names, locations, records... Seven Andradas now? Well, eight. Well. Maybe six or so. Actually, you'll want to confirm that..."
texts.zh: "这一份够劲！辐射味的辣，好吃好吃。名字、地点、记录... 现在有七位 Andrada 了？哦，八位。哦。大概六位上下。其实这个你得自己去核实..."

options.en: Would you please transfer the decrypted files to me?
options.zh: 能不能把解好的文件传给我？

texts.en:
"Oh, right." The hacker looks up.

"I think I'm going to have to make a new friend at the Academy," Gargoyle says with an impudent grin.

"You'd best read it all for yourself, cappy," they say, attention drifting back to the virtual display swarm.
texts.zh:
"哦，对了。"黑客抬起头。

"看来我得在学院里交个新朋友了，"Gargoyle 露出放肆的笑。

"你最好自己从头读一遍，船长，"对方说着，注意力又飘回那一片虚拟显示里。

options.en: Close the comms then open the files
options.zh: 关掉通讯，再打开文件

texts.en: You transfer the files to a secure workspace accessible via your TriPad.
texts.zh: 你把文件转进一个能通过 TriPad 访问的安全工作区。

texts.en: "Me?" An eyeroll. "Don't be ridiculous."
texts.zh: "我？\"一个白眼。\"别逗了。"

texts.en:
"Anyway, this is a hot one! Spicy with rads, yum yum. Names, locations, records... Seven Andradas now? Well, eight. Well. Maybe six or so. Actually, you'll want to confirm that..."

Blocks of text appear as if in thin air. Images. Reports.
texts.zh:
"总之，这一份够劲！辐射味的辣，好吃好吃。名字、地点、记录... 现在有七位 Andrada 了？哦，八位。哦。大概六位上下。其实这个你得自己去核实..."

成块成块的文字凭空浮现。图像。报告。

options.en: Would you please transfer the decrypted files to me?
options.zh: 能不能把解好的文件传给我？

texts.en: Gargoyle shrugs. "We were done talking."
texts.zh: Gargoyle 耸耸肩。"我们话已经说完了。"

options.en: I need your help decrypting a set of secret intel files.
options.zh: 我需要你帮忙解一批机密情报文件。

texts.en:
"Intel files," he repeats your words with more than a dash of skepticism.

"Whose?"
texts.zh:
"情报文件，"他把你的话重复了一遍，怀疑不止一点点。

"谁的？"

options.en: I think they belong to Dolos Macario. You've heard of him?
options.zh: 我想它们属于 Dolos Macario。你听说过他吗？

options.en: They concern the Sindrian Diktat. Philip Andrada, actually, in particular.
options.zh: 它们事关辛达强权。确切地说，尤其是 Philip Andrada。

options.en: It's probably best if I don't tell you.
options.zh: 这事我最好还是别告诉你。

texts.en: "Yes." He rubs his temples. "I've heard of him."
texts.zh: "是啊。\"他揉了揉太阳穴，\"我听说过他。"

texts.en: "You know what I'm going to say, right?"
texts.zh: "你知道我要说什么，对吧？"

options.en: 'No'?
'Talk to Gargoyle'.
options.zh: '去找 Gargoyle'。

options.en: 'I'd love to help.'?
options.zh: '我很乐意帮忙'？

options.en: 'I'm going to explain to you how we're going to short volatiles futures.'
options.zh: '我来给你讲讲，我们怎么去做空挥发物期货。'

texts.en:
"Correct," he says. "Then I say that this is probably the sort of stupid scheme Gargoyle would love."

Arroyo cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"没错，\"他说，\"然后我会说，这多半正是 Gargoyle 会喜欢的那种蠢主意。"

Arroyo 切断了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Well done," he says.

Arroyo cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"说得对，"他说道。

Arroyo 切断了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"No," he says. "The answer was 'no'. Then I say that this is probably the sort of stupid scheme Gargoyle would love."

Arroyo cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"不对，\"他说，\"答案就是'不'。然后我会说，这多半正是 Gargoyle 会喜欢的那种蠢主意。"

Arroyo 切断了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
This catches him off-guard.

"Maybe you're not as hopeless as I thought," he says. "I still don't want to be involved. Take this to Gargoyle, it sounds like the sort of stupid scheme they'd love."

"Now get out of here," he turns away. "I need to comms my volatiles guy."

Arroyo cuts the feed.
texts.zh:
这话让他一时没接上。

"也许你没我想的那么没救，\"他说，\"但我还是不想掺和。拿去找 Gargoyle 吧，听起来正对他们那种爱干蠢事的胃口。"

"现在滚吧，\"他转过身去，\"我得联络一下我那个做挥发物的经纪人。"

Arroyo 切断了画面。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Yes." He rubs his temples. "They would, wouldn't they."
texts.zh: "是啊。\"他揉了揉太阳穴，\"他们干得出来，不是吗。"

texts.en: "Yes." He rubs his temples. "It probably is."
texts.zh: "是啊。\"他揉了揉太阳穴，\"多半就是这样。"

options.en: I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

options.en: I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

options.en: I have possibly critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有一些可能至关重要的情报，关于辛达强权。不过它是加密的。

options.en: I have what may be critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有一些也许至关重要的情报，关于辛达强权。不过它是加密的。

options.en: I need to access some very sensitive, heavily encrypted files.
options.zh: 我需要读取一些高度敏感、层层加密的文件。

options.en: I need to access some very sensitive, heavily encrypted files.
options.zh: 我需要读取一些高度敏感、层层加密的文件。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny.
options.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。

options.en: I have critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有关于辛达强权的关键情报。不过它是加密的。

options.en: I have possibly critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有一些可能至关重要的情报，关于辛达强权。不过它是加密的。

options.en: Siyavong won't decrypt the files unless I have a Persean League commission...
options.zh: 除非我拿到英仙座联盟的委任状，不然 Siyavong 不会解密这些文件...

texts.en:
"Hmm," Horus rubs his chin. "A wise and necessary precaution, no doubt."

"I suppose you'll have to earn a commission with the League, granted by a senior official with that power," he continues. "I can help you find reputable work but it is up to you to prove yourself sufficient to that honor."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"Horus 搓着下巴，\"毫无疑问，这是明智而必要的防范。"

"那么你恐怕得从联盟那里挣一份委任状 —— 得由有权授予的高级官员签发，\"他接着说，\"我可以帮你找些正经活计，但要配得上那份荣衔，得靠你自己去证明。"

options.en: I have an intel report concerning the Sindrian Mutiny.
options.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的情报。

texts.en: "And don't worry, $titleHeg," he says. "My... people are still working on that Sindrian intel."
texts.zh: "别担心，$titleHeg，\"他说。\"我手下那些人...还在啃那份辛达情报。"

texts.en:
After a short wait spent watching propaganda blurbs scroll past the crest of the Hegemony navy, the comm-link connects you with the office of Admiral Rao.

"$TitleHeg," he says. "We have some intel to discuss."
texts.zh:
你等了一小会儿，看着宣传短片在霸主海军徽记旁一条条滚过，通讯链路终于接通了 Rao 上将的办公室。

"$TitleHeg。\"他说。\"有些情报要谈。"

options.en: The ANDRADA files.
options.zh: ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"Yes." A slow smile appears.

"I would like you to confirm these reports. Personally."

"The Hegemony is a blunt instrument, intelligence services included. If we started an official investigation, everyone will soon know why."
texts.zh:
"没错。"一个缓慢的笑容浮了上来。

"我希望由你去核实这些报告。亲自去。"

"霸主是件钝器，情报部门也一样。我们要是正式立案调查，所有人很快就会明白是为了什么。"

texts.en: "It'd be convenient if you held a Hegemony commission, and may soon become necessary. Makes it easier to pay you, too. Consider it. I'll even help with the paperwork."
texts.zh: "你手上要是有份霸主委任状，事情会方便得多，而且恐怕很快非有不可。付你钱也名正言顺些。考虑一下。文书我可以帮你办。"

texts.en:
"Before I get ahead of myself," he says, "you should review the reports."

He taps an interface and your comms pings a file transfer.
texts.zh:
"我别把话扯太远，\"他说。\"你该先看看这些报告。"

他在界面上点了一下，你的通讯器响起文件传输的提示音。

options.en: Close the comms then open the files
options.zh: 关掉通讯，再打开文件

texts.en: You transfer the files to a secure workspace accessible via your TriPad.
texts.zh: 你把文件转进一个能通过 TriPad 访问的安全工作区。

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says. "We have some fascinating topics to discuss. But first," he taps at a datapad.
texts.zh:
通讯链路先在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚素净的徽记上停留了片刻，才接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说，"我们有些很有意思的话题要谈。不过首先，"他敲了敲数据板。

options.en: Receive the decrypted files
options.zh: 接收解密后的文件

texts.en:
He nods as his datapad chimes confirmation.

"You've given us much to consider."

If it's not your imagination, you'd swear his habitual smirk is a little strained.
texts.zh:
数据板响了一声，确认完成，他点点头。

"你给了我们很多要考虑的东西。"

如果不是你的错觉，你几乎敢说他那惯常的冷笑有些僵硬。

options.en: What did you find?
options.zh: 你查到了什么？

texts.en: Siyavong's eyes go distant. He takes a deep breath before he returns them to you.
texts.zh: Siyavong 的目光飘向远处。他深吸一口气，才重新看向你。

texts.en: "You should read the files for yourself, demarchon. There is much which concerns the Persean League."
texts.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，统领。里面有不少内容牵涉到英仙座联盟。"

texts.en: "You should read the files for yourself, captain. There is much which concerns the Persean League, of which you bear commission, of course."
texts.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，舰长。里面有不少内容牵涉到英仙座联盟 —— 你毕竟还挂着它的委任状。"

texts.en: "You should read the files for yourself, captain."
texts.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，舰长。"

texts.en:
He looks away.

"And much which concerns... the gens. I have a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
他移开了目光。

"还有不少内容牵涉到...各氏族。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

texts.en:
He looks away and clears his throat.

"And much which will concern Gens Yaribay, I suspect," he says pointedly. "I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
他移开目光，清了清嗓子。

"而且据我揣测，还有不少内容会牵涉到 Yaribay 氏族，\"他意味深长地说。\"我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

texts.en:
He looks away.

"And much which concerns Gens Hannan - or shall I say, the Prime Demarchon. I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
他移开了目光。

"还有不少内容牵涉到 Hannan 氏族 —— 或者我该说，牵涉到大统领。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

options.en: Close the comms and open the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 切断通讯，打开 ANDRADA 文件

options.en: Close the comms and open the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 切断通讯，打开 ANDRADA 文件

options.en: Close the comms and open the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 切断通讯，打开 ANDRADA 文件

texts.en: You close the comms then place the files in a secure workspace accessible via your TriPad.
texts.zh: 你切断通讯，把文件放进 TriPad 上一个加密工作区。

options.en: I'm told you can help me crack some encrypted files.
options.zh: 我听说你能帮我破解一些加密文件。

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"恐怕我没法跟一个既不是英仙座联盟成员、也没有在联盟名下领过委任状的人，谈论任何涉及势力安全的事。"

他双手交叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"For me to begin an official investigation with FIS resources these files would have to contain information of great concern to the interfactional security interests of the Persean League."

You'd swear his half-smile has intensified somehow, despite looking exactly the same.
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"要我动用舰队情报部的资源启动正式调查，这些文件里就得装着关乎英仙座联盟势力间安全利益的重大情报。"

你几乎可以肯定他那半笑更浓了些，尽管看上去毫无变化。

options.en: They concern the Sindrian Diktat. Dolos Macario... misplaced them. (explain)
options.zh: 它们与辛达强权有关。Dolos Macario...把它们放丢了。 (解释)

texts.en:
You explain the situation; your recovery of the data, the file headers, the dates.

He blinks, not allowing any look of surprise to cross his face.
texts.zh:
你说明了情况：你如何找回这些数据、文件头、日期。

他眨了下眼，没让一丝惊讶浮上脸。

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of Horus Yaribay told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，Horus Yaribay 的办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of the Prime Demarchon told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，大统领办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "If what you say is true, then I expect these files fulfill the conditions I've laid out."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"如果你说的是真的，那我想这些文件已经满足了我提出的条件。"

texts.en:
He taps something, and an upload prompt appears in your comms interface.

"If you please."
texts.zh:
他点了下什么，你的通讯界面上弹出一个上传提示。

"请吧。"

options.en: The files are heavily encrypted. Do you have access to AI cores?
options.zh: 这些文件加密得很严。你能接触到 AI 核心吗？

options.en: If I provide these to you, I will require a decrypted copy.
options.zh: 如果我把这些交给你，我要一份解密后的副本。

options.en: And how does Fleet Intelligence view covert League support for the Sindrian Diktat?
options.zh: 那么舰队情报部怎么看联盟对辛达强权的暗中支持？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files to Siyavong
options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件上传给 Siyavong

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"I wouldn't worry about about that if I were you, captain."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑起一边眉毛。

"换作是我，就不会为这个操心，舰长。"

texts.en:
"You'll have it."

He puts his hands together. A pledge.

"It is the least we can do to ensure you don't imagine you would need to take a copy of these elsewhere, you see."
texts.zh:
"你会拿到的。"

他双手合拢。一个承诺。

"我们至少得做到这一步：让你不至于以为还得另找地方再复制一份，你明白吧。"

texts.en:
"An interesting question, captain," he says, pleasantly evasive.

"However it is not my place, nor that of Fleet Intelligence, to dictate policy. We serve by the direction given us by the League Council, headed by the Prime Demarchon, and in doing so fulfill our mission to protect the constituents of the Persean League from outside threats."

His half-smile is re-asserted.

"It would not be my place to openly contradict policy."
texts.zh:
"是个有意思的问题，舰长，"他说，语气讨喜地回避着。

"不过这既不是我的位置，也不是舰队情报部的位置，去决定政策。我们依照联盟议会 —— 由大统领领导 —— 给出的指示行事，以此完成我们的使命：保护英仙座联盟的成员不受外来威胁。"

他那半笑又回来了。

"公开顶撞政策，不是我的位置该做的事。"

options.en: If these files are what they appear to be, what do you want me to do?
options.zh: 如果这些文件当真如表象所示，你希望我怎么做？

options.en: If I seek to undermine the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
options.zh: 如果我要拆辛达强权的台，你会设法拦我吗？

options.en: If I support the authority of the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
options.zh: 如果我要支持辛达强权的权威，你会设法拦我吗？

texts.en: He considers this for a moment.
texts.zh: 他思量了片刻。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence will be in contact if your cooperation is needed in light of... shifting outcome scenarios."

The half-smile reappears.

"We appreciate your patriotism in this matter, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"如果...形势走向有变、需要你配合，舰队情报部会联系你。"

那半笑又浮上来。

"这件事上，我们很感念你的爱国之心，$titlePL。"

texts.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
texts.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

texts.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
texts.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

texts.en:
Siyavong nods acknowledgement, then taps away at his datapad for a minute.

Finally, he says "Hm." Then looks up at you. "This will take some time. Perhaps four days, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 点头致意，然后在数据板上敲了足足一分钟。

最后他"嗯"了一声，抬头看你。"这得花些时间。大概四天吧，$titlePL？"

options.en: I'll return then, Special Agent.
options.zh: 那我到时候再来，特别探员。

options.en: Why four days?
options.zh: 为什么要四天？

texts.en: "I'll see you soon, I'm sure," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: "我们很快会再见的，我确定，"他说，然后伸手去切断通讯。

texts.en:
"I'll see you soon," he says.

"You're always in the center of something interesting, aren't you."

With that, Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"我们很快会再见的，"他说。

"你总是站在有意思的事情正中央，不是吗。"

说完，Siyavong 伸手切断通讯。

texts.en: "My usual office is on Kazeron. Meet me there," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: "我平时的办公室在 Kazeron。去那儿找我，"他说，然后伸手去切断通讯。

texts.en:
"My usual office is on Kazeron. Meet me there," he says, then pauses. "You're always in the center of something interesting, aren't you."

With that, Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"我平时的办公室在 Kazeron。去那儿找我，\"他说，然后顿了一下，\"你总是站在有意思的事情正中央，不是吗。"

说完，Siyavong 伸手切断通讯。

options.en: I believe you can help me crack some encrypted files.
options.zh: 我相信你能帮我破解一些加密文件。

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He gives you a meaningful look, then folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"恕我直言，凡不属英仙座联盟成员、也未以联盟之名领受委任的人，我连谈一谈势力安全事务的门都无从谈起。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼，双手交叠。

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 什么事？

texts.en:
"My organization... would like to ensure that you are able to investigate these files." He pauses, picking up a datapad. "As a free agent, naturally, under no particular orders from Fleet Intelligence."

"To those ends, I must inform you that we have discovered a storage bay - under your name - which contains supplies and fuel."

He sets the datapad down and puts his hands together, the very image of professionalism.
texts.zh:
"我所在的机构...希望确保你有条件去查清这些文件。\"他顿了顿，拿起一块数据板。\"当然是以自由行动者的身份，不受舰队情报部的任何具体指令。"

"为此，我必须告知你：我们发现了一个登记在你名下的储藏舱，里面备有补给与燃料。"

他放下数据板，双手交叠，一副十足的职业做派。

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 什么事？

options.en: You say there'll be war? With who?
options.zh: 你说会有一场战争？和谁打？

options.en: You implied that you met with Horus Yaribay after you decrypted the files...
options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Horus Yaribay...

options.en: You implied that you met with Reynard Hannan after you decrypted the files...
options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Reynard Hannan...

options.en: I reviewed the files. What should I do?
options.zh: 我看过那些文件了。我该怎么做？

options.en: Achilles Andrada. Or 'Kalian'. It says he's a Persean League officer.
options.zh: Achilles Andrada。或者叫 'Kalian'。文件里说他是英仙座联盟的军官。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I wish to discuss the matter of Andrada clones being targeted.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 Andrada 克隆体遭人追杀这件事。

options.en: We need to talk about Achilles and Gens Kato.
options.zh: 我们得谈谈 Achilles 和 Kato 氏族。

options.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

options.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
options.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 咱们换个话题吧。

texts.en:
"Hector and..." He pauses, and makes a small gesture with one hand.

"And whoever will stand against him. Askonia will suffer, again. One hopes it will not spread."
texts.zh:
"Hector 还有..."他顿了顿，一只手做了个不大的手势。

"还有所有会站出来对抗他的人。Askonia 又要遭难了。但愿这场祸事不会蔓延。"

options.en: Are you doing something to stop it?
options.zh: 你们在做些什么来阻止它吗？

options.en: Can it be stopped?
options.zh: 这能阻止得了吗？

options.en: If there's a war, I intend to win it.
options.zh: 若真有战争，我要赢下它。

texts.en:
His half-smile dims.

"At this point I believe that stopping it is beyond the range of scenarios we shall see play out. But trust that all my efforts shall be to the security and safety of the Persean League - and, indeed, the entire Sector."

"Whether you believe that," his expression is ironic, "depends on many things, of course. But I must content myself with saying so."
texts.zh:
他的半笑淡了下去。

"到了这一步，我认为阻止它已不在我们所能看到的那些可能之内。但请相信，我所做的一切都是为了英仙座联盟的安全 —— 也是为了整个星域。"

"你信不信这话，\"他神情带着讥诮，\"自然取决于许多东西。但我只能把话说到这里。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow, his amused half-smile firmly in place.

"A spirited assertion, but that may not be up to you. War is a sort of negotiation, $titlePL, and direct force is but one aspect."

He gives you an indulgent look. "But you don't need me to tell you that. You are successful and... potent."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉，那副带着玩味的半笑稳稳挂着。

"说得有气势，可这恐怕不由你说了算。战争是一种谈判，$titlePL，直接动武只是其中一个方面。"

他宽容地看了你一眼。"不过这话不必我来告诉你。你的事业有成，而且...手段了得。"

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力。"

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow fractionally.
texts.zh: 他微微挑起一侧眉毛。

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League - and the Prime Demarchon is the foremost executive servant of the League, and it is to him I report concerning certain... critical matters."

"It is my duty," he concludes, somewhat crisply.
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力 —— 而大统领是联盟最高层的行政长官，某些...关键事务，我正是向他汇报。"

"这是我的职责，"他收尾时语气颇为干脆。

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en:
"Officially," he says, "I shall make no recommendation regarding your involvement into the alleged contents of these files in accordance with present Persean League policy of non-intervention in matters regarding... certain trade partners, as guided by our executive leadership."

He puts his hands together, clearing his throat, and pauses for a moment. Then looks up at you.
texts.zh:
"就官方而言，\"他说，\"对你是否介入这些文件所称的内容，我不作任何建议。按英仙座联盟现行政策，凡涉及...某些贸易伙伴之事，一律不予干预 —— 此为我们的行政领导层所定。"

他双手交叠，清了清嗓子，停了一停，然后抬眼看你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You have made a career of taking independent initiative. With provocative results. I will follow your actions with great interest and assist in defending the stability and security of the Persean League now and in the future."

The holo flickers for a moment, but you'd swear he winked.
texts.zh:
"你这一路走来，靠的就是自行其是。结果也足够惹眼。我会密切关注你的行动，并为捍卫英仙座联盟眼下与将来的稳定和安全提供协助。"

全息影像闪了一下，但你敢发誓，他眨了下眼。

options.en: I think I understand.
options.zh: 我想我明白了。

texts.en:
"That is alleged."

Siyavong's expression tightens.
texts.zh:
"那只是指控。"

Siyavong 的神情绷紧了。

options.en: It says you - your organization - knows about him. And intervened.
options.zh: 文件里说，你 —— 你的机构 —— 知道他的事，而且插了手。

texts.en:
"How interesting," he says as if he isn't interested at all.

"I will only comment that, in general terms, it is my duty to protect citizens of the Persean League." A pause. "Whatever their alleged genetic source."
texts.zh:
"有意思，"他说这话时仿佛一点也不觉得有意思。

"我只说一点，泛泛而论：保护英仙座联盟的公民是我的职责。\"一顿。\"无论他们所称的基因来源是什么。"

options.en: I'm going to find him and speak with him.
options.zh: 我会找到他，和他谈谈。

options.en: So he's safe?
options.zh: 那他是安全的？

options.en: I'll ask no more about him. For now.
options.zh: 关于他的事我不再多问。至少现在不问。

texts.en: "I will not stand in the way of the free association of citizens of the Persean League," he says.
texts.zh: "我不会妨碍英仙座联盟公民之间的自由交往，"他说。

texts.en: Saying nothing, he nods very slowly.
texts.zh: 他什么也没说，只是极缓地点了点头。

texts.en: "Good."
texts.zh: "很好。"

texts.en:
"I suspect you are correct, captain," Siyavong says. He is not overtly worried about the notion, by all appearances.

"And even if we did not see evidence, it is the first reaction I would anticipate from... many interested parties."
texts.zh:
"我猜你说得对，舰长，"Siyavong 说。从表面上看，他并不为这个念头担忧。

"就算我们看不到证据，这也是我能想到的...许多有关各方的第一反应。"

texts.en: "If that satisfaction might quell your insistence, then I suppose we must," he says, looking unimpressed.
texts.zh: "如果这点满足能让你不再坚持，那我想我们也只能如此，"他说，看起来并不买账。

texts.en:
He coughs, falsely. "Now this was an illuminating aside," Siyavong says with a distinct undercurrent of annoyance.

"Let's move toward a less gruesome topic, shall we?"
texts.zh:
他假咳了一声。"这一岔话倒真是让人长了见识，"Siyavong 说，底下明显压着一层恼意。

"我们换个不那么血腥的话题，好吗？"

options.en: Do you know who is doing it?
options.zh: 你知道是谁干的吗？

options.en: Do you want me to confront Admiral Rao?
options.zh: 你要我去当面质问 Rao 上将？

options.en: Is League Fleet Intelligence targeting Andradas?
options.zh: 是联盟舰队情报部在针对 Andrada 家的人？

options.en: Would you like me to take out the Andradas?
options.zh: 要不要我把 Andrada 家的人一个个除掉？

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 咱们换个话题吧。

texts.en:
"Specifically? In some cases. There are many assassins and mere murderers-for-hire in the Persean Sector."

"Who sees that they are paid, and by whom, and who allows it? Those are more difficult questions with more complex answers."

He raises a palm at you.

"Allow me to draw a hypothetical."
texts.zh:
"具体而言？有些是。英仙座星域里从来不缺刺客，也不缺只图钱的杀手。"

"谁负责付钱、付给谁、谁又默许这一切？这些问题更难，答案也更复杂。"

他朝你抬起一只手。

"让我假设一种情形。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The Hegemony considers the Sindrian Diktat as fundamentally criminal in the highest degree - Philip Andrada is mutiny embodied. Agents of the Hegemony - and those who gives orders to said agents, say one Orcus Rao who is busier by far than an admiral assigned to a holding-before-retirement posting ought to be - will seek to undermine Andradism by any means available."

"Ideally they'd put Andrada on trial, have a full show of 'legitimacy' of the laws of the Human Domain and so forth."

"Not so easily arranged, as you may imagine. And now Andrada has produced clones to inherit his mutinous polity?" Siyavong shakes his head in mock-sympathy. "A clone is not guilty of the father's crimes. And yet..."
texts.zh:
"在霸主看来，辛达强权从根子上就是最高等级的犯罪 —— Philip Andrada 本身就是叛乱的化身。霸主的特工，以及给这些特工下命令的人 —— 比如那位 Orcus Rao，他忙得远超过一个被安排到退休前闲置职位上的上将该有的程度 —— 会想尽一切手段挖空 Andrada 主义。"

"最理想的做法是把 Andrada 送上法庭，把人之领律法的【合法性】好好演上一场，诸如此类。"

"当然，这事没那么容易办成，你大概也想得到。况且如今 Andrada 还造出了克隆体，要继承他那个叛逆的政体？\"Siyavong 装出一副同情的样子摇了摇头。\"克隆体并没有犯下父亲的罪。可话又说回来..."

options.en: You're suggesting that Orcus Rao has ordered illegal assassinations?
options.zh: 你是在说 Orcus Rao 下令进行非法暗杀？

texts.en:
"Clearly he has," Siyavong says, matter-of-fact, "ever."

"Of our Andrada clones, however? I could not provide you with hard evidence of it."

"Could he? Would he? Yes and yes. Did he?"

His knowing smile reforms.
texts.zh:
"显然有，\"Siyavong 说，语气平淡，\"从来都有。"

"不过说到我们这些 Andrada 克隆体？我拿不出确凿的证据。"

"他做得到吗？他会做吗？两个问题的答案都是肯定的。那他做了吗？"

他那副心知肚明的笑容又挂了起来。

texts.en:
His brow furrows.

"Would you not, please? It is... unnecessary."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。

"能不能请你别去？这...没有必要。"

options.en: I understand.
options.zh: 我明白。

options.en: If you insist, then I won't confront Orcus Rao. (lie)
options.zh: 既然你坚持，那我就不去质问 Orcus Rao 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: He gives you a look meant to hide a vast skepticism.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，那眼神是要掩住满腹的怀疑。

texts.en: He gives you a concerned look.
texts.zh: 他有些担忧地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence? No."

He gives you a warning look.

"And it would be impolitic for me to participate in speculation about certain other parties within the Persean League. Whatever you may choose to believe, I am bound by certain legal strictures as concerns citizens of the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"舰队情报部？不是。"

他给了你一个警告的眼神。

"再者，参与对英仙座联盟内某些其他势力的揣测，对我而言并不明智。不管你愿意相信什么，凡涉及英仙座联盟公民，我都要受某些法律条文的约束。"

options.en: But the Gens are not?
options.zh: 可各氏族就不受约束？

texts.en:
He drops his hint of a smile.

"I said no such thing and I would thank you not to share irresponsible 'deductions' of this sort."

"Perhaps another topic interests you, captain?"
texts.zh:
他连那点笑意也收了起来。

"我没说过这种话。这类不负责任的【推断】，还请你别到处去讲。"

"也许你更想聊点别的，舰长？"

texts.en:
"No, thank you," he says, uncomfortably. "I don't believe that would be helpful at this juncture."

He produces a strained smile.

"It was thoughtful of you to ask before... anything."
texts.zh:
"不了，谢谢，\"他说，有些不自在。\"我不认为在目前这个节骨眼上，那样做会有什么好处。"

他挤出一个勉强的笑。

"你能在做任何事之前先来问一声... 想得很周到。"

texts.en: "Please," he says.
texts.zh: "拜托了，"他说。

texts.en:
"We don't," Siyavong says. "The word you'll find for the situation is 'fraught' due, as per our previous conversation, various factors."

He gives you a cool look.

"Have patience."
texts.zh:
"我们不知道，\"Siyavong 说。\"你会用来形容这局面的词是【棘手】—— 原因嘛，如我们上次所谈，种种因素叠加。"

他冷冷地看了你一眼。

"耐心些。"

options.en: Patience for what?
options.zh: 耐心等什么？

options.en: For Achilles to make his move?
options.zh: 等 Achilles 出手？

texts.en:
"You'll know."

He re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
"到时候你就知道。"

他重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

Then re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
他什么也没说。

然后重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
You elaborate about the palatial asteroid, Hector's words, and the trap he left for you.

"So Hector is his pick." He nods to himself. "And how long has it been so, I wonder, with all the recent... stirrings."

He puts his hands together, polite and collected. "I do not imagine Macario's influence has improved Hector's character. There'll be a war before this is over, that much is clear."
texts.zh:
你把那座宫殿般的岩质小行星、Hector 的话，还有他给你设下的那个圈套，都讲了一遍。

"所以 Hector 才是他的选择。\"他自顾自地点了点头。\"我倒想知道，最近这些...骚动之下，这种局面已经持续多久了。"

他把双手叠在一起，礼貌而镇定。"我不觉得 Macario 的插手会让 Hector 的品性变好。这事了结之前必有一战，这一点很清楚。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says. "Perhaps more than you."

"You understand there was an attack? Several assassins. Armed."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，\"他说。\"也许比你知道得还多。"

"你该明白，那是一次袭击。好几名刺客，全副武装。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says.

"It could have gone rather worse, don't you think? Poor timing, nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，"他说。

"本来可能会糟得多，你不觉得吗？话虽如此，这时机实在不巧。"

texts.en:
"We know," he says. "It could not have gone much worse, I would say. Very poor timing on your part."

Siyavong watches you.

"At least you survived the attack."
texts.zh:
"我们知道，\"他说。\"依我看，事情糟得不能再糟了。你挑的时机实在不巧。"

Siyavong 看着你。

"至少你在那场袭击里活了下来。"

options.en: Um. Is he alright?
options.zh: 他...他还好吗？

options.en: At least that.
options.zh: 至少还有这一点。

options.en: Are you implying I was involved?
options.zh: 你是在暗示这事跟我有关？

options.en: That's one less Andrada clone to menace the Sector.
options.zh: 星域里少了一个祸害人的 Andrada 克隆体。

texts.en:
He says nothing for a couple seconds. Then looks away.

"No. He is not." His eyes meet yours. "The details are considered classified. But you may assume that he is not relevant to the crisis growing in Askonia."
texts.zh:
他沉默了几秒，然后把目光移开。

"不。他不好。\"他直视你的眼睛。\"细节属于机密。不过你可以认为，他已与 Askonia 日益扩大的危机无关了。"

texts.en:
"Indeed. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"的确。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"More than that, $playerSirOrMadam. Because of course you were involved - you were right beside Hercules as he was killed."

Then he lets it go.

"But no, we understand the situation. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"不止如此，$playerSirOrMadam。因为你当然牵涉其中 —— Hercules 被杀的时候，你就在他旁边。"

然后他松了口。

"不过算了，我们了解情况。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"That is one way of looking at it," he says with frictionless self-control. "I was relieved, of course, to hear you were entirely unharmed."

"I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming about the details of the situation, particularly given the Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy..."

He puts his hands together neatly. "In any case, Provost Baird appreciates that interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."
texts.zh:
"也可以这么说，\"他说，克制得滴水不漏。\"听说你毫发无伤，我当然松了口气。"

"我不能说安全主管把事情的细节讲得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的人在场..."

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。"无论如何，Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

options.en: I told him to trust Provost Baird.
options.zh: 我让他去信 Baird 院长。

options.en: I let Provost Baird take care of him.
options.zh: 我把他交给 Baird 院长照看。

options.en: I told Hercules the Persean League would protect him. Did he contact you?
options.zh: 我告诉 Hercules，英仙座联盟会保护他。他联系过你们吗？

options.en: I told him to talk to the hacker, Gargoyle, to help him escape.
options.zh: 我让他去找那个黑客 Gargoyle，想办法脱身。

options.en: I offered him asylum on my own colony.
options.zh: 我提出可以让他在我自己的殖民地上避难。

options.en: I gave him credits to help him escape.
options.zh: 我给了他一笔星币，帮他逃走。

options.en: Well. Hope he's doing okay...
options.zh: 好吧。希望他一切还好...

texts.en:
Siyavong does something halfway between taking a deep breath and a sigh.

"Interesting," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
Siyavong 做了个介于深吸气与叹气之间的动作。

"有意思，"他过了一会才说。

options.en: Why is that interesting?
options.zh: 这有什么值得在意的？

texts.en: "I don't know, captain," he says with exacting neutrality. "I'm sure we'll find out before long. Perhaps."
texts.zh: "我不知道，舰长，\"他说，语气中立得一丝不苟。\"我想不用多久就会知道了。也许吧。"

texts.en:
Siyavong's half-smile fades somewhat.

"No. He's disappeared."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 脸上那点半笑淡了下去。

"不。他不见了。"

options.en: Disappeared as in dead, or...
options.zh: 不见了是指死了，还是...

texts.en: He looks at you for a long moment. You can see the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你。你能看见他眼角的皱纹。

texts.en: "I couldn't say."
texts.zh: "我说不好。"

texts.en:
Something small breaks. Finlay's smile drops.

"Hercules is dead, captain. Targeted killing. He made it as far as Ancyra. Same organization as the first attempt - behind the proverbial trigger, that is. The identity of the client is less certain."
texts.zh:
某样很小的东西碎了。Finlay 的笑容落了下去。

"Hercules 死了，舰长。是定点清除。他一路逃到了 Ancyra。还是同一个组织，和第一次动手的那批人一样 —— 扣下扳机的那些。至于委托人是谁，就不那么确定了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He rubs one of his eyes.

"I liked him. Hercules. He seemed like a thoughtful young man."
texts.zh:
他揉了揉一只眼睛。

"我挺喜欢他。Hercules。看着像个有想法的年轻人。"

options.en: Why are you telling me this?
options.zh: 你为什么告诉我这些？

options.en: He was an Andrada.
options.zh: 他是 Andrada 家的人。

options.en: I liked him too.
options.zh: 我也喜欢他。

texts.en:
Siyavong taps something on his console, then adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"I don't believe I said anything. Now, where we were?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 在控制台上点了点什么，然后调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我想我什么也没说过。那么，我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
"Indeed."

Siyavong adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"Where were we?"
texts.zh:
"的确。"

Siyavong 调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
He nods, looking down.

"So. Where were we."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，垂着眼。

"那么。我们刚才说到哪儿了。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting? Why?
options.zh: 有意思？为什么？

texts.en:
"It explains why we can't find Hercules."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么我们找不到 Hercules。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting why?
options.zh: 为什么有意思？

texts.en:
"It explains why he booked transport to where he did."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么他订了去那个地方的船票。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en: "Ah." Siyavong's eyes light up. "That explains it."
texts.zh: "啊。\"Siyavong 的眼睛亮了起来。\"这就说得通了。"

options.en: That explains what?
options.zh: 说得通什么？

texts.en:
"Yes," Siyavong says with no particular emphasis.

He watches you closely.
texts.zh:
"是，"Siyavong 说，语气听不出任何强调。

他紧紧地看着你。

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

options.en: I have Leonidas Andrada in cryosleep. Will you take him?
options.zh: 我手里有处在冷冻休眠中的 Leonidas Andrada。你们要接收他吗？

texts.en:
Siyavong's expression remains neutral.

"He is... damaged, is he not?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 神情不变。

"他...受了损伤，是不是？"

options.en: He cannot... physically function. His mind may be intact. (explain)
options.zh: 他的身体...已经不能运转了。头脑也许还完好。 (解释)

texts.en:
You explain that he was raised in a dream-life concocted by a pair of AI cores, never leaving his life support cradle.

After a long moment taking this in, Siyavong speaks. "Given his condition, Leonidas does not seem to present a threat to the stability of the Sector. Not now, anyway. But he remains a potent symbol which could one day return."

He looks up, at nothing, for a moment. Not meeting your eye.

"And you would give him over to Fleet Intelligence?" he asks.
texts.zh:
你解释说，他是在一对 AI 核心编造的梦境人生里长大的，从未离开过生命维持舱。

过了好一会儿，Siyavong 才把这些消化完，开口道："以他现在的状况，Leonidas 似乎不构成对星域稳定的威胁。至少眼下不构成。但他仍是一个有力的象征，有朝一日可能卷土重来。"

他抬起眼，望着一片虚空，片刻没有看你。

"而你要把他交给舰队情报部？"他问。

options.en: For protection. You could protect him, right?
options.zh: 为了让他得到保护。你们能护住他，对吧？

options.en: I trust you to do the right thing. Not for Gens Hannan. For the Persean League. The Persean Sector.
options.zh: 我信你会做正确的事。不为 Hannan 氏族，为英仙座联盟，为英仙座星域。

options.en: And I trust you to use him to advance the cause of of the Persean League.
options.zh: 我也信你会用他来推进英仙座联盟的事业。

options.en: And I want you to make sure Reynard Hannan knows who gave him an Andrada.
options.zh: 我还要你确保 Reynard Hannan 知道，是谁把一个 Andrada 交到了他手里。

texts.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before speaking.

"Not if Fleet Intelligence decided his existence was a threat to the Persean League."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"除非舰队情报部认定他的存在威胁到了英仙座联盟——那样就护不住了。"

options.en: Are you saying that Leonidas will be killed if I hand him over to you?
options.zh: 你是说，如果我把 Leonidas 交给你们，他就会被杀掉？

options.en: I'll give you Leonidas. (give the order)
options.zh: 我把 Leonidas 交给你们。 (下达命令)

options.en: I cannot give you Leonidas.
options.zh: 我不能把 Leonidas 交给你们。

options.en: Perhaps we should talk about something else. (back)
options.zh: 也许我们该谈点别的。 (返回)

texts.en:
"I am not. But it is also a thing I could not say."

His expression is pained, now, the lingering smile quite gone.

"I hope you understand me."
texts.zh:
"我不是这个意思。可这同样是我说不出口的事。"

他的神情此刻有些痛苦，那点残留的笑已经不见了。

"我希望你能明白我的意思。"

options.en: I understand.
options.zh: 我明白。

options.en: Why the word games? Just speak plainly for once!
options.zh: 为什么要玩这些文字游戏？就不能有一次直说吗！

texts.en: He nods.
texts.zh: 他点了点头。

texts.en:
"I cannot," he says. "And I cannot tell you what the FIS will do. I do not know myself."

"You are not new and naive to the worlds, $titlePL. You know that these factions of the Persean Sector will do small, terrible things - if they must, if they like, and perhaps even for no reason at all but a sort of inertia."

"That's the answer I must live with. And if you can, too? Then give me Leonidas."

He seems to realize that his hands were clenched together, and he releases them, stretching his fingers, before resettling his posture politely at his desk.
texts.zh:
"我不能。"他说，"我也不能告诉你舰队情报部会怎么做。我自己也不知道。"

"你在这世上不是新来的毛孩子，$titlePL。你知道英仙座星域这些势力会做出一些不大不小的恶事——若是不得不做，若是乐意去做，甚至也许毫无理由，只是出于一种惯性。"

"这个答案，我得带着它活下去。如果你也能接受，那就把 Leonidas 交给我。"

他似乎这才发觉自己双手一直紧握着，于是松开，活动了一下手指，随后又礼貌地在桌前坐正。

texts.en:
The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to a strictly short-term rental spacedock to be passed into the custody of Persean League Fleet Intelligence. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off as soon as your $shipOrFleet's shuttle begins its return flight.
texts.zh:
安排妥当了。

一艘不留名号的穿梭机，把一台没有标识的冷冻休眠舱送到一座严格意义上只是短期租用的太空港，交由英仙座联盟舰队情报局看管。你在舱上装的那枚隐蔽追踪器，遥测信号在你的$shipOrFleet的穿梭机开始返航的那一刻就断了。

texts.en:
Siyavong nods.

He appears, if anything, to have had a weight lifted from his shoulders.
texts.zh:
Siyavong 点了点头。

他看上去倒像是肩上卸下了一副重担。

texts.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment.

"Your... high opinion weighs heavy, captain. And I must remind you that Fleet Intelligence trusts me to uphold my vow of service to that organization, and to the Persean League."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你。

"你的...高看，分量很重，舰长。而我也必须提醒你：舰队情报部信任我，是因为我宣誓效忠那个机构，也效忠英仙座联盟。"

texts.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before he speaks.

"Yes, Fleet Intelligence would see to that."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"是的，舰队情报部会照看好的。"

texts.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before he speaks.

"I suppose I must remind you, captain, that I do not work for Reynard Hannan." A quick albeit hollow smile. "Fleet Intelligence, however, does serve by the directives of the Prime Demarchon."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"我想我必须提醒你，舰长：我不为 Reynard Hannan 做事。\"他很快地笑了一下，那笑是空的。\"不过，舰队情报部确实按大统领的指令行事。"

options.en: I need to talk to you about Fortuna Kato's plans with Achilles.
options.zh: 我得跟你谈谈 Fortuna Kato 围绕 Achilles 的打算。

texts.en:
"With respect for my position and duty, $titlePL, I would prefer not to discuss the situation from a perspective which could be misconstrued as favoring one or another of the Gens."

Siyavong doesn't change his expression.

"Perhaps we might speak again when the situation becomes... more clearly applicable to the security of the Persean League." He pauses. "And, perhaps, to one of its citizens, commission-bearers, or even a demarchon."
texts.zh:
"出于对我职位与职责的尊重，$titlePL，我不愿从某个可能被误解为偏袒某一氏族的立场来谈这件事。"

Siyavong 面色不改。

"也许等局势...更明确地涉及英仙座联盟的安全时，我们可以再谈。\"他顿了顿。\"或者，涉及它的某位公民、某位持委任状者，甚至某位统领时。"

texts.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says.
texts.zh:
通讯链路在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停留了片刻，随后接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说。

texts.en:
He proceeds immediately into a rant.

"It was a fool who provided a planet-killer to the Sindrian Diktat," Siyavong says forcefully. "Not a monster, I think. Merely a credits-hungry fool. Or worse, a believer."

He looks away. There is more anger in his voice than you've ever heard before - something well beyond the uptight annoyance you might expect, what with his educated Kazeronian accent.

"I would hate to think it was a believer."

An awkward silence extends.
texts.zh:
他立刻发作起来。

"把行星杀手交给辛达强权的，是个蠢货，\"Siyavong 语气强硬地说。\"我想不是恶棍。只是个见钱眼开的蠢货。或者更糟——一个信徒。"

他移开视线。他声音里的怒气，比你以往听过的都要重——远不止他那口受过良好教育的 Kazeron 腔调本该带来的那种拘谨的烦躁。

"我真不愿去想那是个信徒。"

尴尬的沉默漫延开来。

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat."

Siyavong taps his desk. And you see his half-smile appear.

"Victories which are too great can turn into dangerous things, you know. Sometimes it is best if success is... moderate."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以辛达强权统领的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。你看到他那抹半笑浮了上来。

"你要知道，太大的胜利是会变成危险东西的。有时候，成功...适度一些反而最好。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor."

"And he's slipped from... Gens influence, shall we say. But at least it was not, as many are also now saying, a 'great' victory."

Siyavong taps his desk.

"Great victories can be a dangerous thing, you know. Sometimes it is best for most of us to avoid too many of them. Accounting for context, of course."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以最高元首的身份掌权。"

"而且他已经摆脱了...氏族的操控，姑且这么说吧。但至少，那并不是如今许多人也在说的那种'伟大'胜利。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。

"你要知道，伟大的胜利可能是危险的东西。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利少一些反而最好。当然，这要视情况而定。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor after a great victory."

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for the rest of us if there are not too many of them."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 在一场伟大胜利之后以最高元首的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们其余人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。"

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. He's tapping his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for most of us if there are not too many of them. The results, you see; well..."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。他敲着书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。你看那些后果；唉..."

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough.

"But it was not, as many are now saying, a great victory." He emphasizes that word, 'great'. Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。

"但那并不是——如今许多人正这么说——一场伟大的胜利。"他把'伟大'这个词咬得很重。Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

texts.en:
"The end of the Sindrian Diktat," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. "It was no great victory for anyone. Though perhaps the Hegemony is pleased to make example of 'their' mutiny?"

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of a smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权的终结，\"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。\"那对谁都不是什么伟大的胜利。不过也许霸主倒乐意拿'他们的'那场叛乱来做个榜样？"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

options.en: *clear your throat*
options.zh: *清了清嗓子*

options.en: So what is to become of Leonidas?
options.zh: 那么 Leonidas 会怎么样？

options.en: Achilles won. Isn't that what you wanted?
options.zh: Achilles 赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

options.en: I pledged my support and Achilles won. Is this not what you wanted?
options.zh: 我承诺了支持，Achilles 也赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

options.en: Achilles won. Isn't that what you wanted?
options.zh: Achilles 赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

options.en: I pledged my support and Achilles won. Is this not what you wanted?
options.zh: 我承诺了支持，Achilles 也赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

options.en: You got what you wanted, then, didn't you.
options.zh: 那么，你得到了你想要的，不是吗。

options.en: We got what we wanted, then, didn't we.
options.zh: 那么，我们得到了我们想要的，不是吗。

options.en: We got what you wanted, then, didn't we.
options.zh: 那么，我们得到了你想要的，不是吗。

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is done for. Isn't that success?
options.zh: 辛达强权完了。这还不算成功吗？

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is finished, Askonia liberated. This can only be a good thing.
options.zh: 辛达强权覆灭了，Askonia 解放了。这只能是件好事。

options.en: Are you going to do something about Hector?
options.zh: 你打算对 Hector 采取行动吗？

options.en: So what's next?
options.zh: 那么接下来呢？

texts.en:
He frowns. Not a subject he wished to revisit, apparently.

"He cannot become anything more than he was." Siyavong raises a finger at you. "I suggest that you not read too much into this absence of information. You recall his condition - which is almost certainly irreversible barring the provision of a miracle which, as a humble servant of the Fleet Intelligence Service, is not amongst the privileges I may draw upon to perform my duties."

"The matter is effectively closed."

He is still frowning.
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。看来这不是他想再谈的话题。

"他不可能比从前更有起色。\"Siyavong 朝你竖起一根手指。\"我建议你别从这份信息缺失里读出太多东西。你记得他的状况——那几乎肯定是不可逆的，除非出现奇迹；而作为舰队情报部一名卑微的雇员，动用奇迹并不在我履行职责所能享有的特权之列。"

"这件事实际上已经了结了。"

他仍然皱着眉。

texts.en:
"Yes, well." A grimace. "Not quite like this."

He pauses. Watching you.

"What I want is what is best for the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"是啊，好吧。\"他嘴角一抽，\"可不是这样收场的。"

他顿了顿，目光打量着你。

"我所求的，是对英仙座联盟的安全与安稳最有利的结果，$titlePL。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"I thank you, $titlePL. For your help."
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我谢谢你，$titlePL。谢谢你的帮助。"

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"We must all contend with how events played out. You in your way, me in mine. It is, after all, my duty."

Siyavong folds his hands together and re-affirms his ironic half-smile like the lowering of a blast-shield.
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我们都得面对事情最终的走向。你以你的方式，我以我的。毕竟，这是我的职责。"

Siyavong 十指交叠，重新挂上那抹带着讥诮的半笑，仿佛降下一道防爆闸门。

texts.en:
"What I want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
texts.zh:
"我所求的，"Siyavong 说。

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

texts.en:
"What we want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
texts.zh:
"我们所求的，"Siyavong 说。

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Undeniably. But power abhors a vacuum."

Siyavong looks away with a sigh.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
texts.zh:
"无可否认。但权力厌恶真空。"

Siyavong 叹了口气，移开目光。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Do something about Hector?" Siyavong says, as if taken aback. He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
texts.zh:
"对 Hector 做点什么？"Siyavong 说，像是被问了个措手不及。他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Siyavong looks away with a sigh.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 叹了口气，移开目光。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"
