texts.en:
Tactical gives swift acknowledgement and a ray flits across the tactical display to blink out on the target, leaving the expanding, fading virtual cone of a debris cloud.

Comms speaks, "It's gone quiet, $playerSirOrMadam."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." Your tactical officer speaks up. "Should presume a warning signal got out and potential hostiles will be incoming. A few shifts, a matter of days... if this is Tri-Tachyon, they'll send someone."
texts.zh:
战术官迅速应命，一道射线掠过战术显示屏，在目标处灭去，只留下一个不断扩张、渐次淡去的碎屑云虚拟锥。

通讯官开口："安静下来了，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"你的战术官出声道，\"应当假定警告信号已经发出，敌方援军会来。几个班次，也就几天之内...如果这里真是速子科技，他们一定会派人来。"

options.en: We'd better get this over with quickly, then.
options.zh: 那我们最好赶紧把这事了结。

texts.en:
Even from afar, it is clear that Irkalla has been not merely erased but purged. The expensively-fitted base facilities, the hidden redundant comms units and sensors, the drone bays and camouflaged primary airlock have been reduced to ragged holes.

This was not a clean job. A great deal of explosives were employed.

The work looks almost spiteful.
texts.zh:
即便隔着这么远也能看清，Irkalla 不止是被抹去，而是被清洗过。造价高昂的基地设施、隐藏的备用通讯单元与传感器、无人机舱库、伪装的主气闸，全都只剩参差的破口。

这活干得并不干净。用了大量炸药。

看上去几乎带着恨意。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: You $shipOrFleet matches orbit with the asteroid $name.
texts.zh: 你的 $shipOrFleet 与小行星 $name 同步进入轨道。

options.en: I'm looking for a man named Jason Korin.
options.zh: 我在找一个叫 Jason Korin 的人。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe doesn't even blink. "Do I look like a comm directory?"

"Got work to do, cappy. That all?"
OR
$HeOrShe thinks for a moment. "Don't know one of those."
OR
"Never heard of 'em," $heOrShe says without hesitation.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 连眼都不眨。"我看起来像通讯名录吗？"

"我还有活要干，船长。就这些？"
OR
$HeOrShe 想了一会儿。"没听说过这号人。"
OR
"没听过这号人。" $heOrShe 毫不迟疑地说。

texts.en:
"Below my paygrade." $HeOrShe doesn't even blink.

"Unless you've got some business to chew, kindly burn off."
texts.zh:
"这不在我的档次里。" $HeOrShe 连眼都不眨。

"除非你有买卖要谈，不然就劳驾滚远点。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe makes a thinking-face.

"Nope, don't know 'em," $heOrShe says after a moment.
OR
$HeOrShe considers for a moment. "I don't recognize the name, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 摆出一副思索的表情。

"不认识这号人。" $heOrShe 过了片刻才说。
OR
$HeOrShe 斟酌片刻。"这个名字我没听过，$playerSirOrMadam。"

texts.en: "Never heard of 'em," $heOrShe says without hesitation.
texts.zh: "没听过这号人。" $heOrShe 毫不迟疑地说。

options.en: Maybe 10,000 credits would change your mind?
options.zh: 也许 10,000 星币能让你改主意？

texts.en:
"Look now, you won't like if I took your credits for nothing. I've a policy to don't make blood with anyone who owns their own $shipOrFleet unless there's real good reason."
OR
$HeOrShe shrugs. "Would love to take the credits, cap, but you'd still get nothing."
texts.zh:
"你听好，我要是白拿了你的星币，你也不会高兴。我的规矩是：除非真有十足的理由，不跟任何名下有 $shipOrFleet 的人结血仇。"
OR
$HeOrShe 耸了耸肩。"我巴不得收下这笔星币，船长，可你还是什么都问不出来。"

texts.en:
"I don't have that intel," $heOrShe says. "Credits won't change that."

$HeOrShe pauses, then says, "You might recon the spacer bars off the portside concourse."
OR
"Negative," $heOrShe says. "Might be I could lie, but I don't need more enemies."

The pirate almost smiles. "Got a full deck of 'em already, thank you and over."
texts.zh:
"我没有那份情报。\" $heOrShe 说。\"星币也改不了这一点。"

$HeOrShe 顿了顿，然后说："你可以去左舷走廊外那几家太空人酒吧探探。"
OR
"不行。\" $heOrShe 说。\"我大可以骗你，可我不需要再多几个敌人。"

那海盗几乎笑了一下。"我手里敌人的牌早就满手了，谢了，通话结束。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe sighs. "I'd love to take your money, captain, but I'd have to give you the same answer - I don't know any whatever-his-name-is."

"Then you'd be angry that I took your money. And I make it a policy not to make enemies who have their own $shipOrFleet."

$HeOrShe leans forward, "Don't take that the wrong way - this is Qaras, we don't bow to outsiders here, ships or no. But I've got ongoing concerns that aren't you and I'm content to keep it that way."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 叹了口气。"我很想收下你的钱，船长，可我还是那句话——我并不认识什么这个那个名字的人。"

"那样你会为我白收了你的钱而恼火。而我的原则是不跟名下有 $shipOrFleet 的人结仇。"

$HeOrShe 俯身向前。"别往歪处想——这里是 Qaras，我们不对着外人低头，有没有舰船都一样。不过我眼下的麻烦不是你，我也乐意让它保持这样。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Don't take it wrong," $heOrShe says almost apologetically.

"We're Qaras. Qaras don't bow in the dirt to outsiders, warships or no, and that ain't changing. But I've got concerns that ain't you and I'm content to keep 'em that way."
OR
"That being said, there's those around that make their business snooping. Might ask one of 'em. They'd be good to ping a runner."

$HeOrShe looks you over. "That's what this is about, right?"
texts.zh:
"别往歪处想。" $heOrShe 说，几乎带着歉意。

"我们是 Qaras 人。Qaras 人不对外人低头伏地，管你有没有战舰，这一点不会变。不过我手头的麻烦不是你，我也乐得让它一直不是你。"
OR
"话虽这么说，这附近有些人专做打探的买卖。你可以去问问他们中的一个。要找人跑腿传话，他们很在行。"

$HeOrShe 上下打量你。"你要的就是这个，对吧？"

texts.en:
As you step out of the bar, you find yourself shoved roughly against the corridor wall. The augmented brute holds an ugly little palm-cannon in your face.

"What's yer interest in Jason Korin, spacey?"

His breath is foul.

"Start spillin' or your head'll return to orbit minus yer hull."
texts.zh:
你刚走出酒吧，就被人粗暴地按在走廊墙上。那个改造过的壮汉把一具丑陋的小手炮顶在你脸上。

"你打听 Jason Korin 干什么，太空佬？"

他的口气臭得刺鼻。

"开始吐实话，不然你的脑袋就得脱离舰体、独自回轨道去。"

options.en: Let your bodyguards do their work
options.zh: 让保镖动手

options.en: You cannot begin to comprehend the depths of your error, friend.
options.zh: 朋友，你根本想象不到自己错得有多深。

options.en: I'd like to talk to him. Do you know where I can find him?
options.zh: 我想跟他谈谈。你知道上哪儿能找到他？

texts.en: "Well?" Another shove, for emphasis. "You'd b-"
texts.zh: "怎么着？\"又是一推，算是强调。\"你最好给——"

texts.en:
The goon's eyes roll up as the stun-pulse hits him. The shock crumples his powerful body like the foil of a cheap stellar shade struck by an asteroid.

The proximity of the effect leaves your teeth itching. Two of your bodyguards cover firing angles as the third bags the goon for interrogation.
texts.zh:
晕眩脉冲击中那打手时，他两眼上翻。电流的冲击把他壮硕的身躯折成一团，像被小行星砸中的廉价星帆薄片。

距离太近，那股余效让你牙根发酸。两名保镖封住射界，第三名把打手捆起来拖走，准备审问。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Someone watching the exchange made a break for it, your guards report in clipped tactical jargon. Ducked around a corner, unclear if involved.

It wouldn't do to start assaulting bystanders, so you must let them go. But It's good odds that someone smarter than this unconscious brute knows he failed.
texts.zh:
有人在旁看着这一切，趁机跑了——保镖用简短的战术行话回报。那人拐过墙角，是否有关尚不清楚。

当街殴打路人不成体统，你只能放他走。不过，比这昏过去的莽汉更聪明的某个家伙，多半已经知道他失手了。

options.en: Return to your shuttle
options.zh: 返回穿梭机

texts.en:
You flip a fractional credit to the underboss watching the port concourse as your guards haul the goon into your shuttle.

They give a nod, and pointedly turn their back and make a casual remark to their underlings. The semiofficial brutes get the message: nothing to see here.
texts.zh:
保镖把打手拖进穿梭机时，你朝那个盯着港口大厅的副头目弹了一枚零头星币。

他点了点头，刻意转过身去，随口对手下说了句什么。那些半官方的打手们都懂了：这里什么都没发生。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

The goon cracks instantly. He may not be smart, but he's smart enough to realize he's eyes-deep in a plot well above his paygrade.

For all the good it does. He's just a heavy in a dirt-side gang who received orders for a job from his boss. The boss, in turns, was hired by 'some fancy off-worlder'.

A spacer?

No. Different world, different system. Some 'Askie' - an Askonian - by the accent.
texts.zh:
* * *

打手立刻就招了。他或许不聪明，但也明白自己卷进的这摊事，远不是他这种层级该碰的。

可招了也没用。他不过是地面帮派里的一个打手，从老大那儿领了活。老大则是被'某个讲究的外星来客'雇的。

是个太空船员？

不。另一个星球，另一个星系。听口音，是个'Askie'——Askonia 人。

options.en: So who's his boss?
options.zh: 那他老大是谁？

texts.en:
You get the name of his boss, a location - the gang's compound - and plenty of irrelevant detail.

It might be informative to visit this gang boss down on Qaras with a half-dozen marines. It might also be polite to get permission from what passes for the local authorities so this can be done quietly, and without causing such offense as would start a firefight between, well, everyone.

You've still got the goon in custody, though.
texts.zh:
你问出了他老大的名字、一个地点——帮派的老巢——还有一大堆无关紧要的细节。

带半打陆战队下到 Qaras，去拜访这位帮派头目，或许能问出些东西。先向当地那套勉强算得上官方的东西讨个许可，也算讲礼数——这样事情能办得安静，不至于闹出那种让所有人跟所有人打起来的场面。

不过，那打手还扣在你手里。

options.en: Have him dumped on the Qaras concourse
options.zh: 把他扔到 Qaras 的大厅里去

options.en: Offer him a job as crew
options.zh: 给他一份船员的活

options.en: Throw him out the airlock
options.zh: 把他扔出气闸

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: You have enough marines to carry out an assertive 'visit' to a local gang leader.
texts.zh: 你手上的陆战队足够对本地一个帮派头目进行一次强硬的'拜访'。

texts.en: You don't have enough marines to carry out an assertive 'visit' to a local gang leader. But there are always unemployed mercs hanging around worlds like Qaras. A dozen or so should do it.
texts.zh: 你手上的陆战队不够对本地一个帮派头目来一次强硬的'拜访'。但像 Qaras 这样的地方，总有无业雇佣兵在晃荡。十来个就够用了。

texts.en: You finally have a moment to consider your next move.
texts.zh: 你终于有片刻工夫考虑下一步。

texts.en:
You're considering your next move when your comms officer interrupts.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Comms request from Qaras. I..." They hesitate for a moment. "With apologies, I think you'll want to hear this one."
texts.zh:
你正琢磨下一步，通讯官打断了你。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。Qaras 发来通讯请求。我...\"他顿了顿。\"恕我直言，这一通您大概会想听。"

texts.en:
You're considering your next move when your comms officer interrupts.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Comms request from Qaras. I..." They hesitate for a moment. "With apologies, I think you'll want to hear this one."
texts.zh:
你正琢磨下一步，通讯官打断了你。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。Qaras 发来通讯请求。我...\"他顿了顿。\"恕我直言，这一通您大概会想听。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Pull up the comms link
options.zh: 接通通讯

options.en: Pull up the comms link
options.zh: 接通通讯

texts.en:
Jason Korin - Jason Andrada - is dead. You could simply be done with Qaras. Let this go, just walk away.

On the other hand, someone else is on the same trail. The intel must have got out somehow. Or Macario is making a play. Or both.

You consider your options.
texts.zh:
Jason Korin——Jason Andrada——死了。你本可以就此了结 Qaras 的事。放下，转身离开。

但另一方面，还有别人也追着同一条线索。情报必定以某种方式泄了出去。要么就是 Macario 在动手。也可能两者皆是。

你权衡着手中的选择。

texts.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Intriguing," he says quietly, examining you like he is contemplating a purchase.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
texts.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"有意思。"他轻声说，打量你的样子像在盘算一桩买卖。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

texts.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Perhaps in light of recent events," K-O Jove says quietly, "You'll reconsider my offer."
texts.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"也许鉴于最近这些事，\"K-O Jove 轻声说，\"你会重新考虑我的提议。"

options.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
options.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

options.en: Was it you in the bar who sent silver-eyes?
options.zh: 酒吧里那个银眼女人，是你派来的？

options.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

options.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
options.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

options.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

texts.en: "That botch-job?," he answers with a look of mild disgust. "No. Not my style."
texts.zh: "那桩烂活？\"他答道，脸上带着几分嫌恶。\"不是我。那不合我的风格。"

texts.en:
"It was. And you disappointed me," an edge enters $hisOrHer voice. "And found a rougher example of local hospitality, I'm afraid."

He leans back, casual as a predator.

"You need to learn to accept a friendly offer, captain. You need someone to watch your back. Or just as well," a wave, "Your front."
texts.zh:
"是我。而你让我失望了。\"$hisOrHer声音里添了几分锋利。\"恐怕你也领教了本地待客之道里更粗野的那一面。"

他向后靠去，随意得像一头掠食者。

"舰长，你得学学接受一份好意的提议。你需要有人替你看住背后。或者，也一样，\"他一挥手，\"看住正面。"

options.en: We've got off to a poor start. Let call this a new orbit.
options.zh: 我们开头开得不好。就当这是换了一条新轨道吧。

options.en: My guards handled it. Why are you calling?
options.zh: 我的保镖已经处理了。你打来干什么？

options.en: And the goon? Was he your doing?
options.zh: 那打手呢？是你安排的？

texts.en:
"I admire a constructive attitude, captain."

The quirk of his lip, loitering like a dumbfire munition drone, grows into something toothy and smile-like for a moment.

"Perhaps we can make the best of an awkward situation."
texts.zh:
"我欣赏有建设性的态度，舰长。"

他嘴角那一撇，先前像一架盘桓不去的无制导战机，此刻咧开，有一瞬成了带牙的笑。

"也许我们能把这尴尬局面变成点好事。"

texts.en:
A pause.

"The fool with the gun wasn't mine, I'll have you know. That was..." the pirate rubs $hisOrHer fingers together in one hand, "artless."
texts.zh:
一段停顿。

"拿枪那个蠢货不是我的人，这你可得听清楚。那手法...\"这个海盗把$hisOrHer的手指并在一起搓了搓，\"毫无章法。"

options.en: And how are we going to do that?
options.zh: 那我们要怎么做？

options.en: So what is this? What are you selling?
options.zh: 那这算什么？你在卖什么？

texts.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I have a proposal: tell me why he's important to you and I'll tell you where he is."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "No fibbing." A wink. "I'll know."
texts.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我提个条件：告诉我他为什么对你重要，我就告诉你他在哪儿。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"不许编。"他眨了下眼。"我听得出来。"

texts.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I want to help you, and I will. And I have a request: I'd like to know why he's important to you."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "I'll respect your wishes if you don't want to tell. It will leave me ever so curious, so hungry, but," he winks. "I'm sure I'll discover the truth soon enough."
texts.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我想帮你，也会帮。我只有一个请求：我想知道他为什么对你重要。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"你若不愿说，我尊重你的意思。那会让我好奇得要命、馋得发慌，不过，"他眨了眨眼。"我确信，用不了多久我自己就能查出真相。"

options.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada. He fled from... his minders.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他从...他的看护者手里逃了出来。

options.en: I don't wish to reveal that information.
options.zh: 我不想透露这个。

options.en: I've already got a lead. You're negotiating from weakness.
options.zh: 我已经有线索了。你这是在弱势谈条件。

options.en: I'll pay you 10,000 credits to just tell me.
options.zh: 我付你 10,000 星币，你直接告诉我。

options.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
options.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

options.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
options.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

options.en: I don't make deals with criminals.
options.zh: 我不跟罪犯做交易。

options.en: I don't deal with criminals. Nor can I trust them.
options.zh: 我不跟罪犯打交道，也没法信他们。

options.en: As a fellow corsair, haven't I earned a bit of goodwill?
options.zh: 同为私掠船长，我总该挣得几分情面吧？

options.en: No thanks. (cut the comms)
options.zh: 不用了。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
Jove is at a loss for words. Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe looks unsettled, despite $hisOrHer affect. "I see it now. Fascinating."

"For an Andrada, that death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind; I'm a realist." He raises $hisOrHer eyebrows. "You heard correctly: Jason is dead. Allow me to elaborate."
texts.zh:
Jove 一时说不出话。当然，也就那么一瞬。

"Andrada。\"$HeOrShe神色有些不安，尽管$hisOrHer仍端着那副姿态。\"现在我看清了。真有意思。"

"对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死算是慈悲了。别误会，我说这话不是出于私怨；我是个现实主义者。\"$hisOrHer挑起眉毛。\"你没听错：Jason 死了。让我细说。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: He claps his hands together softly. Then speaks, either from memory or reading off a subtle implant.
texts.zh: 他轻轻合掌一拍，然后开口——不知是在凭记忆背诵，还是在读某个植入体的显示。

texts.en:
"Our Jason was a fractious specimen. In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. He was in the wrong place at the wrong time with the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."
texts.zh:
"我们这位 Jason 是个难缠的样本。在 Qaras 这段时间，他跟底层分销商起过冲突，接触过跃跃欲试的革命分子，还搞砸过一次——请注意，是比喻意义上的——一段可能的'风月'，最后还得让一个片区执法员提醒他什么叫做'本地习俗'。"

"然而，从这些摩擦里，我看不出哪一件埋下了杀意的种子。他只是在错误的时间、错误的地点，跟错了帮派。所以他挨了一发流弹。环境造成的意外，命运的怪癖。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe shrugs. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe耸耸肩。"说到底，他不过是损耗。一个数字。"

options.en: You're telling me he was the victim of a random shooting?
options.zh: 你是说，他死于一场随机的枪击？

texts.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied with my information? I assure you, my people were thorough." Jove examines you through the link. "You know something I do not, of course. I can only help you as much as you let me."
texts.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你对我的情报不满意？我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。\"Jove 隔着通讯打量你。\"当然，你知道一些我不知道的事。你能让我帮到多少，全看你自己。"

texts.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied?" Jove puts on a look of concern. "I assure you, my people were thorough. I must concede, however, the feeling that such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - ought to have meant more to the world."
texts.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位宝贝 Andrada 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你不满意？\"Jove 摆出一副关切的样子。\"我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。不过我得承认，我总觉得这么一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——本该在世上留下更大的回响。"

options.en: I'm satisfied. Accidents happen all the time.
options.zh: 我满意。意外总在发生。

options.en: I'm satisfied. And I have pressing business to deal with.
options.zh: 我满意。而且我还有急事要办。

options.en: He was a clone of Philip Andrada. He was on the run.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他当时在逃亡。

options.en: Accidents happen all the time.
options.zh: 意外总在发生。

options.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

options.en: Don't get too comfortable. There are more of them.
options.zh: 别太放心。他们还有更多。

texts.en: "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe watches you very carefully. "You accept this very easily."
texts.zh: "人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe极仔细地打量着你。\"而你接受得太轻巧了。"

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."
texts.zh:
"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

texts.en:
"Now," he smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," $heOrShe gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"他勾起嘴角。\"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"$heOrShe 摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

texts.en:
"Burn bright, as they say."

Jove turns away. "But not too bright," he adds quietly.
texts.zh:
"照他们说的，烧得亮些。"

Jove 转过身去。"但也别太亮。"他轻声补了一句。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: You stare at the blackness of the blank comms interface. Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the pirate is to be believed.
texts.zh: 你盯着通讯界面熄灭后的一片漆黑。Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。若那海盗的话可信，这不过是暴力世界上一场毫无意义的死。

options.en: Shut down the comm interface
options.zh: 关闭通讯界面

texts.en:
He smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," he gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
texts.zh:
他勾起嘴角。"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"他摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

texts.en:
He nods slowly, eyes on you. Not quite a bow.

"I appreciate your candor, captain. Those are not cheap words from me."

Thoughts appear to race across Jove's face. "Such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - here on Qaras. Such a person is not made without many knowing of it. And such a person is not killed without many searching for his killer."

He looks back at you.

"A quick death - a merciful fate for a clone of Andrada. I speak not out of hatred, I'm simply a realist. Few will accept this, of course. Things are going to get interesting around here."
texts.zh:
他缓缓点头，目光没有离开你。算不上鞠躬。

"舰长，我欣赏你的坦率。这话从我嘴里说出来，可不便宜。"

种种念头似乎在 Jove 脸上飞快掠过。"这样一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——就发生在 Qaras。造出这样一个人，不可能瞒过多少人的耳目。而这样一个人被杀，也不可能没有许多人去找凶手。"

他重新看向你。

"死得快——对 Andrada 的克隆体来说，这算是慈悲的结局。我说这话不是出于憎恨，我只是个现实主义者。当然，肯接受这说法的人不会多。这一带要变得有意思了。"

options.en: Good luck. Now I've got a pressing matter to attend to.
options.zh: 祝你好运。现在我还有件急事要办。

options.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

options.en: Don't get comfortable. There are more clones. Or were.
options.zh: 别以为可以松口气。克隆体不止一个。或者曾经不止一个。

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."

"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

texts.en:
"More..."

His expression freezes in a half-amused mask, a shield of detachment not quite fully raised.

Jove looks away, eyes moving rapidly. "Stars and blood, but of course - Andrada would be a fool not to. What does a clone cost to the Supreme Executor? This-"

He looks back at you, evidently deciding not to share his further thoughts on the subject.

"Your generosity is much appreciated," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
"不止一个..."

他的表情僵在一副半带笑意的面具上，那层疏离的盾牌还没能完全举起来。

Jove 移开视线，眼睛飞快地转动。"星与血啊，可这当然了——换成 Andrada，不这么做才是蠢货。对最高元首来说，一个克隆体值几个钱？这——"

他重新看向你，显然决定不再把这个话题往下说。

"你的慷慨，我很领情。"他顿了顿才说。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Jove gives you a sad look, and lets out a breath. "I respect your decision."
texts.zh: Jove 带着惋惜看了你一眼，吐出一口气。"我尊重你的决定。"

texts.en:
"You think that corridor-gang knew what they were asking?" $HeOrShe leans close, a feral look growing. "They're rubes. Muscle for bullying civilians. Meat for the slaughter."

"I offer you a glittering gift. Don't reject me again."
texts.zh:
"你觉得那帮混走廊的知道自己在问什么吗？\"$HeOrShe凑近了些，眼里的野性一点点涨起来。\"他们是些乡巴佬。给人当打手、欺负平民。就是待宰的肉。"

"我给你的是一份闪光的礼物。别再拒绝我。"

texts.en: "Boring. But I do have my duty to turn a profit." $HeOrShe sighs. "Let's make it 15,000."
texts.zh: "无趣。不过赚钱是我的本分。\"$HeOrShe叹了口气。\"那就 15,000。"

options.en: Transfer 15,000 credits
options.zh: 转账 15,000 星币

options.en: Let's split the difference. 12,500 credits.
options.zh: 各让一步。12,500 星币。

options.en: Let's discuss alternatives.
options.zh: 我们谈谈别的方案。

texts.en: Jove nods with a tiny smile that seems a little more satisfied than proper based on his apparent disdain for your credits.
texts.zh: Jove 点了点头，微微笑了笑。他那副看不上你这些星币的样子，跟这个笑里的满足感颇不相称。

texts.en: "No." He crosses his arms.
texts.zh: "不行。"他抱起双臂。

texts.en: His eyes go up as he gives a little shrug.
texts.zh: 他眼睛一抬，轻轻耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
He tilts his head. "How can I be a criminal if there is no law?"

"Come now, captain. Don't hide behind abstractions."
texts.zh:
他偏了偏头。"没有法律，我又怎么会是罪犯？"

"得了，舰长。别躲在抽象概念后头。"

texts.en: "What a delicious notion," he says.
texts.zh: "这念头真叫人受用。"他说。

texts.en:
"Pity I find in you such a sad morsel."

He turns away, as if in disgust. "A 'fellow corsair'. You bore me. Good-bye, captain."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"可惜，我在你身上只摸到一点可怜的碎渣。"

他别过脸去，仿佛在犯恶心。"一个【同行海盗】。你真让我乏味。再见，舰长。"

通讯断了。

texts.en:
"I suppose. For a," he raises a skeptical eyebrow, "fellow corsair."

A finger is held up. "I'll allow your use of this esteemed badge of dishonor only provisionally, mind."
texts.zh:
"我想想。作为一个，\"他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，\"【同行海盗】。"

他竖起一根手指。"事先说清楚，这枚光荣的耻辱徽章，我只是暂时准许你借用。"

texts.en:
"I should say no... I mean," $heOrShe gives a delicate wave, "-look at you. But."

A sigh, then, "What Kanta wants, Kanta gets. And you," he looks at you significantly, "get special treatment."
texts.zh:
"我本该说不...我是说，\"$heOrShe 优雅地一挥手，\"——看看你这副样子。可是。"

一声叹息，接着是："Kanta 想要的东西，Kanta 总能拿到。而你，"他意味深长地看你一眼，"能拿到特别优待。"

texts.en:
"Right." His hands come together softly.

"I'll have my people have a little look for you. We keep an eye on everything exciting around here - it's as I said. This won't take terribly long."
texts.zh:
"好。"他双手轻轻一合。

"我让我的人替你打听打听。这地方但凡是有点意思的事，我们都盯着——就像我说的。不会花太久。"

options.en: Hold on, you don't even know who Jason Korin is?
options.zh: 等等，你连 Jason Korin 是谁都不知道？

options.en: I'll wait, then.
options.zh: 那我就等着。

texts.en:
"Why should I?" $heOrShe says with a laugh. "Do you have any idea how many people step off their transport into the dark heart of Qaras each day looking for something, running from something, hiding, using?"

"It's only your interest that's convinced me there's something interesting here, if not amusing. If your 'Jason' matters, my people will find him."
texts.zh:
"我凭什么？"$heOrShe 笑了一声。"你知道每天有多少人从运输船上下来，一头扎进 Qaras 这颗黑暗的心脏？找东西的、躲事的、藏身的、用药的？"

"只凭你这份兴趣，我就信了这里头有点意思——至少不无聊。要是你那位 Jason 真要紧，我的人会找到他。"

options.en: Well you're in for quite a surprise.
options.zh: 那你可要大吃一惊了。

Well before the turn of an hour, he reappears, affecting his self-satisfied wisp of smile.

你被独自留下——倒也清净——正好把 Jove 的账继续往上堆，顺带补看高级军官们的状态报告。

一个钟头还没过完，他就回来了，脸上又挂起那缕自得的浅笑。

texts.en:
Jove watches you for a moment, holding a TriPad. He doesn't look at it.

"He's dead."

He releases the TriPad so it drops with a clatter.
texts.zh:
Jove 手里拿着一块 TriPad，看了你一会儿，却始终没看它。

"他死了。"

他松开手，TriPad 啪嗒一声落在地上。

texts.en: "A common enough problem, isn't it?"
texts.zh: "这毛病可太常见了，不是吗？"

texts.en:
"And I'm forced to admit this comes as something of a relief. More Andradas causing trouble?"

$HeOrShe frowns. "You must understand, there is a scale of imagination - no, let us call it 'ambition' - which produces inconvenient outcomes for... innovators and free-thinkers."
texts.zh:
"而我不得不承认，这消息多少让我松了口气。又有一位 Andrada 出来惹麻烦了？"

$HeOrShe 皱起眉。"你得明白，想象力是有量级的——不，还是叫它【野心】吧——到了某个量级，就会给...创新者和自由思想者带来些不便的后果。"

texts.en: "It does not appear as such." Jove produces a brief, coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不像。"Jove 露出一个短促的、意味深长的笑。

texts.en: "Apparently not. Assuming you're not lying to me, of course." $HeOrShe produces a coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不是。当然，前提是你没在骗我。"$HeOrShe 露出一个意味深长的笑。

texts.en:
"See, it's funny. Your Jason was a fractious specimen." $HeOrShe eyes the TriPad but does not yet retrieve it.

"In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer..."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. Perhaps he encountered the wrong place, the wrong time, the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."

$HeOrShe shrugs mildly. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
texts.zh:
"你看，有意思的地方就在这儿。你那个 Jason 是个不安分的样本。"$HeOrShe 瞥了眼地上的 TriPad，却没有去捡。

"他在 Qaras 这段时间，跟底层分销商动过手，接触过几个想闹革命的年轻人，还——比喻意义上——炸掉了一场本该成的姻缘，最后得靠片区执法员提醒他什么叫本地规矩..."

"可这些磕磕碰碰里，我看不出哪一件埋着杀机的种子。也许他只是撞上了错的地方、错的时间、错的帮派。于是一发流弹找上了他。时势的意外，命运的捉弄。"

$HeOrShe 无所谓地耸了耸肩。"说到底，他只是损耗。一个数字。"

options.en: You're saying he was shot?
options.zh: 你是说他是被枪打死的？

options.en: Are you incapable of giving a straight answer?"
options.zh: 你就不能给个痛快的回答？

texts.en:
"It so appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当的活，只是办砸了——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位 Andrada 宝贝毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

texts.en:
"So it appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled, attack - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts; the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当却办砸了的袭击——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

options.en: Someone that important to so many doesn't just die.
options.zh: 对这么多人来说这么要紧的一个人，不会就这么死了。

options.en: Jason Korin is a clone of Philip Andrada. His death can't be an accident.
options.zh: Jason Korin 是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他的死不可能是意外。

options.en: I believe you. Accidents happen all the time.
options.zh: 我信你。意外天天都有。

options.en: I believe you. Accidents happen all the time. (lie)
options.zh: 我信你。意外天天都有。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

His tone darkens. "And for an Andrada? That death was a mercy." Jove leans back, as if bored.

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then the loss is on you. Now I believe we're finished here." The smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

他的语气沉了下来。"而放在一位 Andrada 身上？那样的死是种仁慈。"Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那损失算你的。现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
"That's another funny thing. Your Jason doesn't seem important at all."

$HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes. "I believe you're holding back, captain."

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then that disappointment is on you."

Jove leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
"还有件有意思的事。你那个 Jason，看着一点也不重要。"

$HeOrShe 眯起 $hisOrHer 的双眼。"我觉得你有所保留，舰长。"

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那这份失望得你自己兜着。"

Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en: Silver-eyes appears, apparently unbidden.
texts.zh: 银眼女人现身了，仿佛不请自来。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
You step from the hidden lounge into the echelon of dark curtains, a velvety black like deep space. The air is close and warm, like a vacsuit with a bad atmo regulator.

Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh:
你从隐秘的休息室走出来，穿过层层叠叠的黑色帘幕——那黑如天鹅绒，像深空本身。空气闷热，像一件大气调节器坏掉的太空服。

Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Return to the bar
options.zh: 回到酒吧

texts.en: Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh: Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

texts.en:
You turn to make a casual scan of the bar to find your view blocked by a heavily augmented woman in a dark coat. Her eyes are silver.

"'Pologies, $playerSirOrMadam." She clears her throat. "The boss... wishes for me to do the favor of extending to you an invitation to partake in the back room and share a word on your, uh, pressing query."

She hides a look of relief at making it through what are clearly someone else's words.
texts.zh:
你转身随意扫了一眼酒吧，视线却被一个身穿深色外套、改造痕迹极重的女人挡住。她的眼睛是银色的。

"抱歉，$playerSirOrMadam。\"她清了清嗓子。\"老板...想让我帮忙给您带个话，请您到后面那间屋里坐坐，聊聊您那桩，呃，要紧的事。"

话说完，她藏起一丝如释重负的神色——那显然不是她自己的措辞。

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Sounds shady, no thanks.
options.zh: 听着不太干净，谢了。

texts.en:
She nods, then turns to lead you into the shadows at the back of the bar.

Behind a clever echelon of black curtains is a door, and behind that door a small, luxurious lounge slouches moodily.
texts.zh:
她点点头，转身领你走进酒吧后方的阴影里。

层层巧妙错落的黑色帘幕之后是一扇门，门后是一间小巧而奢华的休息室，懒散地沉在暗处。

options.en: Enter
options.zh: 进入

texts.en:
"Interesting," the $post says, watching you with a wisp of smile. As if assessing you like a prize. "Intriguing, even."

The goon, silver-eyes, disappears.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
texts.zh:
"有意思。\"$post 说，唇角挂着一丝笑，打量着你，像在估一件奖品。\"甚至可以说，耐人寻味。"

那个银眼睛的打手不见了。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

options.en: You're in charge around here?
options.zh: 这地方归你管？

options.en: I suppose you might know where I can find Jason Korin?
options.zh: 我想，你也许知道哪儿能找到 Jason Korin？

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, captain. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，船长。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:

"Is that what I said? Have care, $titleHeg. I am mindful of my claims."

texts.en:
"You're $playerName." He speaks past your question.

A strange expression comes over $hisOrHer face. "You did a very naughty thing, a cruel thing, to Kanta's pet clone."

$HisOrHer eyes dart to meet yours. "It was a beautiful execution. She's not so invincible, is she, Queen Jorien."
texts.zh:
"你是 $playerName。"他没接你的问题。

一种古怪的神情掠过 $hisOrHer 的脸。"你对 Kanta 养的那只克隆体做了件很坏、很残忍的事。"

$HisOrHer 的目光一挑，对上你的眼睛。"那是一场漂亮的处决。她也没那么不可战胜，对吧，Jorien 女王。"

texts.en: "I may," he says, savoring the words.
texts.zh: "也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in this spacer bar.
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把这间太空人酒吧尽数算了进去。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in the celestial sphere upon which you stand, and its orbits.

"Practically anyone of importance you can bother, it seems. Hardly discreet."
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把你脚下这颗天球连同它的轨道一并算了进去。

"看来凡是有点分量的人，你能烦的都烦了一遍。这可不怎么谨慎。"

options.en: I do what I must to survive.
options.zh: 为了活下去，我只能这么做。

options.en: It was a mistake made in a moment of crisis.
options.zh: 那是危机时刻犯下的错误。

options.en: It's nice to meet a fan of my work.
options.zh: 能遇到欣赏我作品的人，真好。

options.en: The clone was an unholy abomination.
options.zh: 那克隆体是亵渎的孽物。

options.en: So are you going to tell me?
options.zh: 那你打算告诉我吗？

options.en: Would 10,000 credits hurry this along?
options.zh: 10,000 星币能让这事快点吗？

options.en: So are you going to tell me about Jason?
options.zh: 那你打算跟我讲 Jason 的事吗？

texts.en: "Don't be so bashful," $heOrShe scolds. "It was an inspired act."
texts.zh: "别这么害臊。\" $heOrShe 责备道。\"那是一记神来之举。"

texts.en: He closes his eyes for a moment. "But that's not why you're here."
texts.zh: 他闭了闭眼。"但你来这儿不是为了这个。"

options.en: We were speaking of Jason Korin. Do you know where I can find him?
options.zh: 我们刚才在说 Jason Korin。你知道哪儿能找到他吗？

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Don't play-act weakness to me," his voice suddenly acid. "It was an inspired act. Possess it, and accept my highest praise."

He closes his eyes, taking a deep breath, then resettles his composure.
texts.zh:
"别在我面前装软弱。\"他的声音骤然转酸。\"那是一记神来之举。认下它，接受我最高的赞誉。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，重新整好仪态。

texts.en: He puts his hands together and appears to nod respectfully toward you. It's an uncomfortable but seemingly heartfelt concession.
texts.zh: 他双手合拢，像是郑重地朝你点头致意。这份让步叫人不太舒服，却看上去出自真心。

texts.en:
"Oh." He seems taken a little aback. "I see."

"I give praise to your inspired act." He puts his hands together in an impression of piety and appears to nod respectfully toward you.
texts.zh:
"哦。\"他似乎有些意外。\"我明白了。"

"我为你的神来之举献上赞誉。"他双手合拢，做出一副虔诚的样子，像是郑重地朝你点头。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles, slowly.

"I could be persuaded."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 慢慢笑了。

"我也许能被说动。"

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"I will help you. Because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"我帮你。出于我对你那桩大胆作为的钦佩。"

options.en: Consider me... a fellow corsair, in need of a favor.
options.zh: 就当我是...一个同道的私掠船长，需要你帮个忙。

options.en: Would 10,000 credits hurry this along?
options.zh: 10,000 星币能让这事快点吗？

options.en: Would 10,000 credits hurry this along?
options.zh: 10,000 星币能让这事快点吗？

options.en: Let's compromise. How about 12,500?
options.zh: 各让一步。12,500 怎么样？

options.en: Let's compromise. How about 12,500?
options.zh: 各让一步。12,500 怎么样？

options.en: Pay 15,000 credits.
options.zh: 支付 15,000 星币

options.en: Pay 15,000 credits.
options.zh: 支付 15,000 星币

options.en: This is tedious. Just tell me or don't.
options.zh: 真烦。要么说，要么别说。

options.en: This is tiresome. I'm leaving.
options.zh: 够了。我走了。

options.en: This is tiresome. Cutting the link now. (cut comms)
options.zh: 够了。现在就切断通讯。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"No credits. I will help you because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"不必付钱。我帮你，是因为我钦佩你那桩大胆的作为。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Hegemony can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信霸主出得起。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Persean League can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信英仙座联盟出得起。"

texts.en: "Let's not," he says, an edge in his voice.
texts.zh: "别这样。"他说，声音里带了刃。

texts.en: Jove nods, touching a hand to a data interface device, something on his wrist, without looking.
texts.zh: Jove 点了点头，一只手抚上腕上的数据接口，眼睛都没抬。

texts.en:
The smile hardens.

"You need to learn to take pleasure in this business, captain. You'll find precious little happiness in the dead of space."

He pauses.

"Make it worth my time to give you the man you seek."
texts.zh:
笑意凝住了。

"你得学会从这门生意里尝出点滋味，舰长。在深空里，你能找到的快乐少得可怜。"

他顿了顿。

"想让我交出你要找的人，就拿出点东西来，让我觉得这时间花得值。"

texts.en:
The pirate drops $hisOrHer attention from you as if you were a piece of furniture and returns $hisOrHer attention to a quiet holo of what looks to be some sort of bloodsport.

The augmented goon emerges from the shadows to escort you back to the bar.
texts.zh:
那海盗把 $hisOrHer 的注意力从你身上挪开，仿佛你只是件家具，转而回到 $hisOrHer 面前那幅安静的全息影像上——看上去像某种血腥格斗。

那个改造过的打手从阴影里走出来，送你回酒吧。

texts.en: Jove gives you a look somewhere between disappointed and bored.
texts.zh: Jove 瞥了你一眼，那神情介于失望与无聊之间。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You move to step away, and she steps into your path. From the corner of your eye you see a couple of your bodyguards tense up, ready to act.

"Please," she says, expressionless. "That's my ask. Boss don't like to hear no. Gets in a mood."
texts.zh:
你想侧身走开，她却横跨一步挡在前面。你眼角瞥见两名保镖绷紧了身子，随时准备动手。

"拜托。\"她面无表情。\"这是我要办的事。老板不爱听不行。会闹脾气。"

options.en: Fine. Lead on.
options.zh: 行。带路。

options.en: Still no. Good luck with your boss.
options.zh: 还是不行。祝你老板那儿好运。

options.en: You got an answer. Now clear off.
options.zh: 你已经得到答复了。现在让开。

texts.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
texts.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his affect. "Fascinating."

"I daresay, for an Andrada such a quick death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Just a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished here." That smile again. "For now."

当然，不会太久。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
