texts.en:
A server appears by your side, a glass of what looks exactly like your favorite drink on a silver tray.

"Compliments of the house."
texts.zh:
一位服务员出现在你面前，手中的银盘上正是你最爱的饮品。

"本店的一点心意。"

options.en: Um. Thank you.
options.zh: 呃，谢谢。

options.en: Take the drink
options.zh: 接过饮料

options.en: Don't I own 'the house'?
options.zh: '本店'？这不应该是我本人的店吗？

options.en: No thanks. I'm, uh, not thirsty.
options.zh: 不用了，谢谢，我，呃，不渴。

texts.en: The server nods and politely disappears. A sip reveals that it is perfectly to your taste.
texts.zh: 服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。轻抿一口，确实完美符合你的口味。

texts.en: You take the drink and the server politely disappears. A sip reveals that it is perfectly to your taste.
texts.zh: 你接过饮料，服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。轻抿一口，确实完美符合你的口味。

texts.en: "Technically yes, $playerSirOrMadam, though your organization leases to the proprietor. Who, by the way, extends their compliments."
texts.zh: "理论上是的，$playerSirOrMadam，不过是您的组织把店租给业主的，另外，那位业主向您致以问候。"

options.en: Thank you.
options.zh: 谢谢。

options.en: Take the drink
options.zh: 接过饮料

options.en: I wish to pay like any other customer. I insist.
options.zh: 我希望和其他顾客一样付钱。我坚持这一点。

options.en: No thanks. I'm, uh, not thirsty.
options.zh: 不用了，谢谢，我，呃，不渴。

texts.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam. I'll see that the price of the drink is subtracted from the facility fees."

With that, the server politely disappears. You examine the drink you just bought, then take a sip. It is, in a word, perfect.
texts.zh:
"当然可以，$playerSirOrMadam。我会将饮料的费用从物业费里扣除。"

说完，服务员礼貌地离开了。你审视了一下刚买的饮料，轻抿一口。一个字，好。

options.en: Return to the bar
options.zh: 回到酒吧

texts.en: The server nods and politely disappears.
texts.zh: 服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。

options.en: Look around the bar
options.zh: 在酒吧里四处看看

texts.en:
The clatter of drinkware, the eruptions of boasting and harsh laughter, are interrupted by a commotion.

"$PlayerName!"

A skinny crewman in torn jumpsuit shouts your name and leaps on a table, kicking aside glasses and earning himself curses. His eyes are wide, his face sweaty with stims.
texts.zh:
杯盏碰撞的叮当声、此起彼伏的吹嘘与粗野大笑，被一阵骚动打断了。

"$PlayerName!"

一个穿着破烂连体服的瘦削船员喊着你的名字，纵身跳上一张桌子，踢翻了一片酒杯，招来一片骂声。他双眼圆睁，一张脸被兴奋剂浸得满是汗水。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Warlord Kanta sends her hate!"

The ugly autopistol in his hand vomits a burst of low-power rounds before it jerks with an off-pitch snap - then, in in the relative quiet following the fusillade, you hear a piece of metal hit a ceiling-vent with a distinct metallic ping.
texts.zh:
"军阀 Kanta 给你们送仇恨来了！"

他手里那把丑陋的自动手枪喷出一串低威力弹丸，接着便伴着一声走了调的脆响卡了壳——随后，在那一轮乱射之后相对的寂静里，你听见一块金属撞上天花板通风口，发出清脆的一声叮。

options.en: Get down
options.zh: 趴下

texts.en:
The would-be assassin stares alarmed at his smoking hack-fab gun, giving it a shake before resqueezing the trigger. A fruitless effort.

Taking a moment to perform damage assessment, you discover that you are entirely unharmed.

A couple pirates behind you were hit by the makeshift autopistol's slugs, but they are enraged rather than wounded - their armored vacsuits served them well.
texts.zh:
那个没得手的刺客惊惶地盯着自己冒烟的土制手枪，晃了晃，又去扣扳机。徒劳无功。

你花了一瞬检视自身伤势，发现自己毫发无伤。

你身后有两名海盗被那把拼装手枪的弹丸击中，但他们只是被激怒，并未受伤——他们那身装甲真空服救了他们。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Patrons of the bar quickly draw weapons of their own to return the promise of violence, much magnified and of far more reliable make.

Crackling gunfire erupts, and the clap and flash of DEW discharge drowns out shouts and screams.

The lighting flickers and strobes, the atmo quickly filling with smoke and the shredded forgecloth which had been affixed to ceilings and walls to damp ambient sound.
texts.zh:
酒吧里的客人纷纷拔出自己的武器，把这份暴力的许诺加倍奉还——火力更猛，做工也可靠得多。

噼啪的枪声骤然炸响，定向能量武器放电的爆响与闪光淹没了喊叫与尖叫。

灯光忽明忽暗地频闪，空气里很快灌满了烟雾，还有被撕碎的吸音布——那本是贴在天花板和墙壁上用来吸音的。

options.en: Slip out of the bar
options.zh: 溜出酒吧

texts.en:
Your bodyguards extract you from the growing chaos, out a side-door.

Assembling outside you see what passes for local MuniSec: a few semi-official armed gangs, stationing themselves threateningly at corridor-intersections to stare down interlopers. They give your party of accompanying bodyguards a respectful glance, and look on - you didn't start the trouble, so you may go.

Display of arms is no crime. The crime is the unauthorized and unprovoked (in the immediate sense) attempt on your life, for this disrespects the local ward-boss who should have been informed of the assassination ahead of time. Hungry airlocks will be fed after this incident if any collaborators (or scape-goats) can be connected to the act.
texts.zh:
你的保镖把你从越来越乱的场面里带出来，从一扇侧门溜了出去。

在外头聚齐后，你看到了这地方所谓的 MuniSec：几支半官方的武装帮派，气势汹汹地守在走廊交叉口，瞪着外来者。他们朝你这队随行保镖投来一个还算尊重的眼神，便继续观望——乱子不是你挑起的，所以你可以走了。

亮出武器不算罪。罪在这桩未经许可、也无端 (就眼下而言) 的取你性命的勾当——它冒犯了本地管区的头目，行刺之前本应先知会他一声。此事过后，只要能攀扯出任何同谋 (或替罪羊)，饥饿的气闸就有东西可喂了。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
The clink of teacups is suddenly overcome by a shout and a crash.

"Demon! Servant of Moloch, follower of Mammon!" A disheveled figure with a scraggly beard leaps on a table, leveling a pistol toward you, "I walk the Path! I strike at you with the Hammer of-"
texts.zh:
茶杯的叮当声突然被一阵碰撞和一声大喊所覆盖。

"恶魔！摩洛克的仆人，玛门的追随者！" 一个头发凌乱、胡子拉碴的人跳到桌子上举起手枪对着你，"我行走于卢德之径！我将以卢德之锤将你 ——"

options.en: Get down
options.zh: 趴下

texts.en:
A series of dull cracks signals your guards' suppressed low-penetration fire and the assassin falls like a ragdoll.

The samovar behind him, indented by a through-shot, leaks a steady patter of hot water into a growing pool of blood on the table.
texts.zh:
一串沉闷的枪响表明你的警卫们进行了消声低穿透力射击，刺客就像一个破布娃娃一样应声倒下。

他身后的茶炊被流弹打凹了下去，茶水潺潺而出，漏到了桌子上逐渐绽开的血泊里。

options.en: Get back up
options.zh: 站起来。

texts.en:
Local MuniSec holds you, your guards, and a few witnesses until a mid-rank Knight of Ludd can make a ruling on the situation. The case for self-defense is clear-cut - witnesses swear holy oaths to this - and the licensing of your protective weapons is accepted.

"A child, led astray," the Knight says gruffly as the would-be assassin is wrapped in a simple shroud and taken away. Their eyes turn to you, "Your pride sows wrath, and it bears this bloody fruit."

After a pointed silence, they say, "You and yours; go now. What's here is done."

"...So I pray," the Knight mutters as you turn away.
texts.zh:
地方安全部控制住了你和你的警卫，以及几位目击者，直到一位中阶卢德骑士终于对情况做出裁定。正当防卫的事实显而易见，目击者对其所见所闻宣以圣誓，并且你的自卫武器许可也都真实有效。

"一位被引入歧途的孩子。" 当这名刺杀未遂的刺客被朴实无华的裹尸布裹起带走之后，骑士哀叹道。人们的目光随之转向了你，"你的傲慢播下了愤怒，最终收获了这血腥的结果。"

在一段突兀的沉默后他们说："你和你的人；现在走吧。这里发生的事已经了结了。"

"...我祈祷如此，" 在你转身离开时，骑士低声说道。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: You begin to scan the clientele, searching for the distinct face of Achilles Andrada. Failing that, Fleet uniforms with their backs turned - one looks over his shoulder and meets your eyes for a moment.
texts.zh: 你开始扫视店里的客人，找 Achilles Andrada 那张辨识度极高的脸。找不到的话，就找背对着你的舰队制服——其中一人回头瞥了一眼，与你目光相接了一瞬。

texts.en: It's a suspicious look. Not Achilles.
texts.zh: 那是个狐疑的眼神。不是 Achilles。

texts.en: A frown and a glare is all you get. It's not Achilles.
texts.zh: 你只换来一记皱眉和瞪视。不是 Achilles。

texts.en: You get a smile, a raised glass, and an open look - another round, captain? You acknowledge the gesture, but keep searching for Achilles.
texts.zh: 你换来一个微笑、一只举起的酒杯，还有一副坦荡的神情——再来一轮吗，舰长？你点头回礼，但继续找 Achilles。

options.en: Keep looking
options.zh: 继续找

options.en: Ping your bodyguards and keep looking
options.zh: 给你的保镖发个信号，继续找

texts.en:
A hush falls, and heads turn.

You follow them toward the figure who has appeared at the bar's entrance: a silhouette of glittering shadow. A squad of attendants calmly file around her like invading infantry.

Her costume is ostentatious, like a monarch of old Earth.
texts.zh:
一片静默落下，众人纷纷转头。

你随众人的目光看向酒吧门口出现的那个人影：一道闪着光的暗影。一队随从从容地绕着她散开，像入侵的步兵。

她的衣着张扬夺目，像旧地球的君主。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I'll have the room." Her voice is raised with a resonant confidence quite comfortable delivering outrageous demands.

Those who understand the implications of her presence take quick last sips and leave. Those who don't are quietly, even forcefully, escorted out by aides - guards? Their uniforms are gilt with touches of Gens Kato fancy, but you can tell by their movement that there are panels of flex-armor and subtle weapons beneath.

The Matriarch of Gens Kato turns her gaze upon you as the bar empties. Two chairs are pulled up, a table given a wipe-down.

She sits, regal.
texts.zh:
"这间屋子我包了。"她提高了声音，那声音浑厚而自信，说这种荒唐的要求说得十分从容。

明白她出现意味着什么的人，赶紧喝完最后一口就走。不明白的，则由随从——还是护卫？——安静地、甚至强硬地请了出去。他们的制服上有 Kato 氏族那种讲究的金线装饰，但从走路的姿态看得出来，底下衬着柔性装甲板，还藏着不张扬的武器。

酒吧空下来时，Kato 氏族的女族长把目光转向你。两把椅子被拉了过来，一张桌子被擦了一遍。

她坐了下来，仪态威严。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName," she says.

"I should have met with you sooner."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerName 舰长，"她说。

"我该早点见你的。"

options.en: Where's Achilles?
options.zh: Achilles 在哪儿？

options.en: A pleasure to meet you, ma'am. Where's Achilles?
options.zh: 幸会，女士。Achilles 在哪儿？

options.en: Yes, you should have. This bait-and-switch is beneath both of us.
options.zh: 是啊，你本该如此。这种引我上钩又掉包的把戏，配不上你，也配不上我。

texts.en: "Safe," she says.
texts.zh: "他很安全，"她说。

texts.en:
She traces a hand on the table. "An attempt on Achilles' life was made on this very spot. It was blind luck that the first shot missed."

Her eyes rise.
texts.zh:
她一只手在桌面上划过。"就在这个位置，有人对 Achilles 下过手。第一枪打偏，纯属运气。"

她抬起眼。

texts.en:
"Then you appear."

"An independent spacer. A warlord, some say."
texts.zh:
"然后你出现了。"

"一个独立的太空佬。也有人说，是个军阀。"

texts.en:
"Then you appear. Bearing a commission of the Hegemony."

"Meddling."
texts.zh:
"然后你出现了。手里还捧着霸主的委任状。"

"来插手的。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. A servant of the cult of Ludd?" She looks skeptical.
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。卢德教派的仆从？"她看上去颇为怀疑。

texts.en: "Then you appear. A commissioned contractor for the Tri-Tachyon corporation."
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。拿着速子科技公司委任的合同承包者。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. Bearing a commission of the League. Loyal, ostensibly, to our noble project."
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。捧着联盟的委任状。表面上，是忠于我们这项高尚事业的。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. A member of the League in full, but moreover, a creature of Reynard Hannan."
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。一位十足的联盟成员，但更像是 Reynard Hannan 的走狗。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. A full member of the League due, in part, to the largesse of Reynard Hannan."
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。能成为正式的联盟成员，多少得归功于 Reynard Hannan 的慷慨。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. A special 'friend' of Horus Yaribay, are you? I haven't quite pinned down what you're receiving in return for your support."
texts.zh: "然后你出现了。Horus Yaribay 的'特殊朋友'，是吗？我还没弄清楚，你这份支持换回来的是什么。"

texts.en: "Then you appear. Are you another automaton sworn to Philip Andrada's little experiment in ideology?"
texts.zh: "你也是那种向 Philip Andrada 那场意识形态小实验宣誓效忠的人偶吗？"

options.en: I am no 'creature' of Reynard!
options.zh: 我可不是 Reynard 的'走狗'！

options.en: Does Horus Yaribay know about what you're doing here?
options.zh: Horus Yaribay 知道你在这儿做的事吗？

options.en: So is this a play against Gens Hannan?
options.zh: 所以这是一场针对 Hannan 氏族的棋局？

options.en: I told Reynard I would vote him out at the first opportunity. Will you help me?
options.zh: 我跟 Reynard 说过，一有机会就把他投下台。你愿意帮我吗？

options.en: Reynard Hannan blackmailed me. I'm not his 'creature'.
options.zh: Reynard Hannan 勒索过我。我不是他的'走狗'。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon's commission allows me to take initiative. As you have with Achilles.
options.zh: 速子科技的委任状允许我自行决断。就像你对 Achilles 做的那样。

options.en: Andrada's genius is transcendent. As is his blood!
options.zh: Andrada 的天才是超凡的。他的血脉也是！

options.en: I am no 'automaton'. My commission is held with my own self-interest in mind.
options.zh: 我不是什么'人偶'。我接这份委任，考虑的是我自己的利益。

options.en: I am no automaton. I seek only to bring order to the growing chaos.
options.zh: 我不是人偶。我只想给这愈演愈烈的混乱带来秩序。

options.en: If I'm meddling, then what is this? You've taken Achilles for your tool.
options.zh: 如果我这叫插手，那你又算什么？你把 Achilles 当成了自己的工具。

options.en: Are you working with Finlay Siyavong, from Fleet Intelligence?
options.zh: 你在跟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 合作吗？

options.en: I serve the Persean League. Who is served by making Achilles your tool?
options.zh: 我为英仙座联盟效力。把 Achilles 变成你的工具，又是为谁效力？

options.en: What is your scheme with Achilles?
options.zh: 你跟 Achilles 打的什么算盘？

options.en: Why Achilles? Why not another?
options.zh: 为什么是 Achilles？为什么不是别人？

options.en: So how will you ensure Achilles becomes Supreme Executor?
options.zh: 那你要怎么保证 Achilles 当上最高元首？

options.en: Andrada must be destroyed. His hateful polity, his clones. All of it.
options.zh: Andrada 必须被摧毁。他那个可憎的政权，他的克隆体。全部。

options.en: It appears that we disagree about what is to be done.
options.zh: 看来我们对于该做什么，意见不合。

options.en: I spoke to Imoinu. Your granddaughter, I believe?
options.zh: 我跟 Imoinu 谈过。我想她是你孙女？

options.en: I met Dardan. Your grandson, if I am not mistaken?
options.zh: 我见过 Dardan。没弄错的话，他是你孙子？

texts.en:
"As you wish," she says, conceding absolutely nothing.

"I shall speak as if he shall hear every word, of course."
texts.zh:
"如你所愿，"她说，却一步也没让。

"当然，我说话时会当作他每个字都听得见。"

texts.en:
She shrugs. Then she looks up at you.

"You mean to align yourself with Horus Yaribay," she says, looking you over.

"$TitlePL. You know he is too hesitant, too cautious. You and I know why the Hegemony can't simply be invited to 'clean up' their errors and crimes in Askonia. The situation has evolved - this is an opportunity to unseat Reynard Hannan from what he believes is his personal throne in the office of Prime Demarchon by shifting the center of power of the Persean League and, indeed, the Sector."

"Horus will understand that it was necessary to do it my way, in the end."
texts.zh:
她耸了耸肩，然后抬头看向你。

"你想跟 Horus Yaribay 站到一边，"她打量着你，说。

"$TitlePL。你知道他太犹豫，太谨慎。你我都清楚，为什么不能干脆请霸主来'清理'他们在 Askonia 犯下的错误和罪行。局势已经变了——这是个机会：把英仙座联盟、乃至整个星域的权力中心挪一挪，让 Reynard Hannan 从他自以为属于他的那张大统领宝座上滚下来。"

"到头来，Horus 会明白，按我的方式做是必要的。"

options.en: How will supporting some renewed Diktat lead to the peace Horus desires?
options.zh: 扶持一个重生的强权，怎么可能带来 Horus 想要的那种和平？

options.en: Won't this set off the Hegemony? Don't you risk a greater conflict?
options.zh: 这不会激怒霸主吗？你就不怕引出一场更大的冲突？

options.en: If you support Achilles, it means there will be civil war in Askonia.
options.zh: 你要是支持 Achilles，就意味着 Askonia 会打内战。

options.en: Let us set aside Horus for the moment...
options.zh: 先把 Horus 放一边...

texts.en:
"Would you propose allowing Dolos Macario to dictate the constitution of a renewed Sindrian Diktat?"

She pauses, then answers herself, "There's little that'd be worse."
texts.zh:
"你难道主张让 Dolos Macario 来定一个重生的辛达强权的宪法？"

她顿了顿，随即自答："没什么比那更糟了。"

texts.en:
"Every act entails risk," she says steadily. "The question is if you seize the opportunity to direct events or cede it to another."

"Anyway, the High Hegemon is no fool." Fortuna speaks confidently, "He will do everything to minimize the spread of conflict. To minimize further fallout which embarasses the project of the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
"任何行动都有风险，"她语气平稳。"问题在于，你是抓住机会去主导局势，还是把它让给别人。"

"再说，至高霸主不是蠢人。\"Fortuna 说得很笃定，\"他会尽一切努力把冲突压到最小，把进一步让霸主的事业蒙羞的余波压到最小。"

texts.en:
"Yes!" Her hand makes a small fist.

"And if I don't, who stands to stop a new consolidation of power within the Sindrian Diktat? For cycles now the polity has been as paralyzed as the drooling corpse of Philip Andrada."

"Imagine Dolos Macario behind Caden, or some clone he's managed to indoctrinate, with the full, unified power of the Sindrian Diktat! It would be disaster."
texts.zh:
"对！"她的手轻轻握成拳。

"如果我不做，还有谁能拦住辛达强权内部新一轮的权力整合？这么多星历年，这个政权就跟 Philip Andrada 那具流着口水的尸体一样瘫痪。"

"想想看，Dolos Macario 躲在 Caden 背后，或者躲在他成功洗脑的某个克隆体背后，握着辛达强权完整而统一的权力！那会是场灾难。"

texts.en: "Let's," she agrees.
texts.zh: "那就先放一放。"她表示同意。

texts.en:
"With Reynard," she begins, "The world is of two camps: those for and those against Gens Hannan."

"A Sindrian Diktat simmering at near-war against the Hegemony? This serves Gens Hannan."

"Askonia at peace, however, and a member of the League?" Her expression is open.
texts.zh:
"在 Reynard 看来，\"她开口道，\"这世上只分两派：支持 Hannan 氏族的，和反对 Hannan 氏族的。"

"一个跟霸主僵持在战争边缘的辛达强权？这正合 Hannan 氏族的意。"

"可要是 Askonia 太平无事，还成了联盟的一员呢？"她的神情坦荡。

options.en: It would dilute his influence. And yours.
options.zh: 那会稀释他的影响力。还有你的。

options.en: It would dilute his influence.
options.zh: 那会稀释他的影响力。

texts.en: "Yes," she admits. "But this gens of secondary influence has already adapted to such conditions."
texts.zh: "没错，\"她承认，\"可这个影响力居次的氏族，早就适应这种局面了。"

texts.en:
"Imagine what the population and industry of Askonia - not so great as once they were, admittedly - and a majority stake in Sector fuel production would mean. The barycenter of League power would no longer fall solely within the orbit of Kazeron."

"The Kazeron dominated by Reynard Hannan."
texts.zh:
"想象一下：Askonia 的人口与工业——得承认，已不复当年——再加上星域燃料生产的多数份额，那意味着什么。联盟权力的重心，将不再只落在 Kazeron 的轨道里。"

"那个由 Reynard Hannan 把持的 Kazeron。"

texts.en: "Temper your enthusiasm, captain," she says calmly. "I have a plan for Reynard."
texts.zh: "收一收你的热情，舰长，\"她平静地说，\"我对 Reynard 有安排。"

texts.en:
"I know of what happened," she says. "And you are his until you're freed."

She holds up a hand, delicately. "We may yet speak of that. Patience."
texts.zh:
"我知道发生了什么，\"她说，\"在你脱身之前，你就是他的人。"

她优雅地抬起一只手。"这事我们以后或许会谈。耐心点。"

texts.en:
"I see you understand me," she says with a smirk.

"It may be that I am simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"看来你懂我的意思，"她带着一丝冷笑说。

"也许我不过是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: I'm sure your goodwill comes with reasonable conditions.
options.zh: 我相信你的善意，附带着合理的条件。

options.en: A sound proposal; I applaud your initiative.
options.zh: 很好的提议，我欣赏你的主动性。

options.en: So he's to be a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato?
options.zh: 所以他要成为你为 Kato 氏族铺路的工具？

options.en: There is nothing 'natural' about Achilles, or his position you would exploit.
options.zh: Achilles 身上没有一点'天然'可言，你想利用的那个位置也一样。

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my own interests," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with a capable, dutiful, and... ambitious young man."

"There's much to gain: lasting peace as a united bloc stays Hegemony aggression. Trade agreements, knowledge-sharing, a shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan and toward the League itself."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益做事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个能干、尽责、而且...有野心的年轻人结成同盟，是有价值的。"

"能得到的很多：一个统一的集团就能挡住霸主的进犯，换来长久和平。贸易协定、知识共享，权力重心从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron，转向联盟本身。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association."

"Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and an implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly, her look skeptical.

"As you wilI have it. I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去，神情带着怀疑。

"随你怎么说。我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with... a capable, dutiful, and ambitious young man."

"Trust me," she says, showing perfect teeth. "If he thought he was to be a mere tool, he would not have agreed to my terms. He's an Andrada."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个...能干、尽责、而且有野心的年轻人结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"相信我，\"她说着，露出一口完美的牙齿，\"如果他以为自己只是个工具，就不会答应我的条件。他可是 Andrada 家的人。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly.

"He is what he is believed to be. And I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"他就是人们所认定的那个人。我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
"So you're a believer," she says, gently.

A distance, a coolness enters her voice.

"Know that Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"原来你是个信徒，"她温和地说。

她的声音里多了一层疏远和冷意。

"要知道，Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: If this course is his choice... then I cannot oppose it.
options.zh: 如果这条路是他自己的选择...那我不能反对。

options.en: I'm sure your 'goodwill' does not come without conditions.
options.zh: 我确信你的'善意'不会没有条件。

options.en: I won't see the heir of Andrada be made a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato!
options.zh: 我不会看着 Andrada 的继承人变成你为 Kato 氏族谋算的工具！

texts.en:
She leans back slightly, her look skeptical of your tone.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去，神情分明是不认同你的语气。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en: "As you would have it," she says. "I shall not whisper even a hint of your faithlessness to the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh: "随你，\"她说，\"你对辛达强权的二心，我一个字都不会往外递。"

options.en: Then we understand one another.
options.zh: 那咱们就算说通了。

options.en: Is that a threat?
options.zh: 这是威胁吗？

texts.en: She nods.
texts.zh: 她点了点头。

texts.en: "I speak in jest, captain," she says evenly. "If I threaten you, you will know it."
texts.zh: "我在说笑，舰长，\"她语气平缓，\"我要是威胁你，你会知道的。"

texts.en:
"Then perhaps, in that, we can find common orbit," she says. A coolness enters her voice, like armor.

"Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"那么在这一点上，我们或许能进入同一条轨道，"她说。一层冷意像装甲一样覆上她的声音。

"Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en: "My 'tool'?" She smirks. "I'm simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh: "我的'工具'？\"她嘴角一挑。\"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interests, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Some junior, some senior; it as natural as fortunes rise and wane by the vagaries of time."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。有晚辈，也有长辈；就像时运随光阴的无常而起落一样自然。"

texts.en:
"You've met Reynard Hannan. Would you rather Achilles fell into his orbit?"

She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Be they junior or senior; it as natural as fortunes wax and wane."
texts.zh:
"你见过 Reynard Hannan。你宁可让 Achilles 落进他的轨道？"

她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。不论辈分高低；就像时运有盛有衰一样自然。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Now I ask you - not accuse - what is your interest in Achilles? What is the Hegemony's interest in Achilles?"

She smiles, coyly. "Did Daud... no, it would have been Orcus Rao, wouldn't it. Did Orcus put you up to this?"
texts.zh:
"现在我问你——不是指控你——你对 Achilles 有什么图谋？霸主对 Achilles 又有什么图谋？"

她勾了勾嘴角，笑得有几分做作。"是 Daud 让你...不，应该是 Orcus Rao，对吧。是 Orcus 教你这么干的？"

options.en: He is involved.
options.zh: 他确实参与其中。

options.en: I'll not confirm or deny Hegemony involvement.
options.zh: 霸主是否介入，我不承认，也不否认。

options.en: He knows nothing of this. (lie)
options.zh: 此事他一无所知。(说谎)

options.en: He knows nothing of this. As far as I know.
options.zh: 此事他一无所知。据我所知是如此。

options.en: I'm acting under my own initiative, ma'am.
options.zh: 我是自作主张，女士。

texts.en: "Of course he is," she says, satisfied.
texts.zh: "他当然参与其中，"她心满意足地说。

texts.en: "Please give Orcus my compliments when next you meet with him on that dismal station of his," she concludes.
texts.zh: "下次去他那座阴惨惨的空间站上见他，代我向他致意，"她最后说。

texts.en: "How loyal," she says. "Maybe he'll give you a medal... when the dust settles."
texts.zh: "真忠诚，\"她说，\"也许他会给你发一枚勋章...等尘埃落定之后。"

texts.en:
"No," she says. "Either you're lying or you've been woefully uninformed."

"Which is worrying," she adds, with a look of concern.
texts.zh:
"不对，\"她说，\"要么你在撒谎，要么你被瞒得彻底。"

"这可叫人担心，"她补了一句，脸上现出忧色。

texts.en:
She examines you for a moment.

"Trust me, then," she says, "when I tell you that he knows quite a lot of this."
texts.zh:
她打量了你片刻。

"那么，就相信我吧，\"她说，\"我说他对这事知道得相当多。"

texts.en: "Perhaps you even believe that," she says.
texts.zh: "也许你自己都信了这话，"她说。

texts.en:
Her eyes shift at his name.

"Fleet Intelligence serves the Persean League. And so do I, in my way. That is all that need be said."
texts.zh:
听到这个名字，她的眼神一动。

"舰队情报部效忠英仙座联盟。我也是，以我的方式。该说的就这些。"

"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en:
"He is trained, competent, dutiful. And humbler by far than his clone-father. As well I know."

She does not elaborate.

"So." She stares into you. "Tell me what you know of another."
texts.zh:
"他受过训练，有能力，也尽责。而且远比他那位克隆父亲谦逊。这一点我很清楚。"

她没有再往下说。

"那么，\"她直视着你，\"告诉我，关于另一个人的事，你知道多少。"

options.en: It stands to reason there are others. I speak hypothetically, of course. (lie)
options.zh: 按理说还有别人。当然，我只是假设。(说谎)

options.en: Seven others. I have a report intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 还有七个。我手上有份报告，本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: Leonidas. Although he... cannot function.
options.zh: Leonidas。不过他...不能正常运作。

options.en: Hercules. An academician. A man of peace, I think.
options.zh: Hercules。一位院士。我想他是个爱和平的人。

options.en: Hercules. An academician. He'd be easier to control.
options.zh: Hercules。一位院士。他更容易控制。

options.en: Could Hercules be your second choice?
options.zh: Hercules 能不能当你的第二人选？

options.en: Hector... who appears to be backed by Macario.
options.zh: Hector...他似乎有 Macario 撑腰。

options.en: Hector, though misguided, is truly passionate for his birthright.
options.zh: Hector 虽然走错了路，可他对自己那份与生俱来的权利是真有热忱。

options.en: You've made your decision.
options.zh: 你已经做出了决定。

texts.en:
"Hypothetically," she repeats, watching you closely.

"If there is one clone of Philip Andrada, it stands to reason there are others."

"And none other is so conveniently present." She spreads her hands, showing the lack of clones, or perhaps inviting them to appear.
texts.zh:
"只是假设，"她重复道，紧盯着你。

"既然 Philip Andrada 有一个克隆体，按理说就该有别的。"

"而且没有哪个像他这样方便在场。"她摊开双手，像是在展示这里并没有别的克隆体，又像是在邀他们现身。

texts.en:
"A pity Dolos allowed it to fall into your hands," she says. "Sloppy work for the 'Spider of Sindria', I think."

"If I wanted to instigate a crisis, force another contender to make their move prematurely, what could do it?"

She looks expectantly at you, having answered her own question.
texts.zh:
"Dolos 竟让这东西落到你手里，真是可惜，\"她说，\"对'辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛'来说，这活干得太糙了。"

"如果我想挑起一场危机，逼另一个竞争者提前出手，什么办法能办到？"

她带着期待看着你，显然自己已经答了这个问题。

options.en: You think Macario leaked this intentionally?
options.zh: 你觉得是 Macario 故意放出来的？

options.en: I don't think it was intentional. But I think he'll work with it.
options.zh: 我觉得不是故意的。但我认为他会顺势利用。

options.en: He screwed up. And he'll never admit it.
options.zh: 他搞砸了。而且他绝不会承认。

texts.en:
"I'd be a fool not to treat it as though he did," she says.

"So would he."
texts.zh:
"要是不把它当成他有意为之，我就是个傻子，"她说。

"换了他，也会这么处理。"

texts.en: "Then little is changed. My course is set."
texts.zh: "那么，变化不大。我的航向已定。"

texts.en: "Then it changes little. My course is set."
texts.zh: "那么，也差不了多少。我的航向已定。"

texts.en: "Meaning?"
texts.zh: "什么意思？"

options.en: He's lived a dream for his entire life. He can't really move, or speak.
options.zh: 他一辈子都活在一场梦里。他动不了，也说不出话。

texts.en: "That would make seizing the office of Supreme Executor difficult," she says.
texts.zh: "那要夺取最高元首之位，可就难了。"她说。

texts.en:
"The one who was shot at the Galatia Academy?" she asks, though it is more of a statement.

"I don't think we need to concern ourselves with him."
texts.zh:
"就是在 Galatia 学院挨枪的那个？"她问，不过更像是在陈述。

"我看不必为他费心。"

texts.en:
"A man of study and quiet, you mean," she says.

"How would he fare in battle? Could he alight fire in the heart of a crowd through his speech alone?"

She seems satisfied with her answers.
texts.zh:
"你是说，一个埋头学问、安安静静的人。"她说。

"他在战场上能行吗？只凭一张嘴，就能点燃人群心里的火？"

她似乎对自己的答案很满意。

texts.en:
"I need remind you that I am searching for a legitimate partner, albeit a junior one? Not a puppet whose every move I must choose and master."

"How would he fare in battle? Could he alight fire in the heart of a crowd through his speech alone?"

She looks at you as if she's already satisfied with her own answers.
texts.zh:
"需要我提醒你吗，我要找的是一个名正言顺的伙伴——哪怕资历浅些？不是一个每一步都得由我挑选、由我摆布的傀儡。"

"他在战场上能行吗？只凭一张嘴，就能点燃人群心里的火？"

她看着你，仿佛早已对自己的答案满意了。

texts.en:
"If it came to it." She smirks.

"Regardless," she says airily, "I've made my decision and it is Achilles."
texts.zh:
"真到了那一步，也无妨。"她嘴角一挑。

"无论如何，\"她轻描淡写地说，\"我已经定了，就是 Achilles。"

texts.en:
"Backed by Macario," she repeats, watching you closely. "Inconvenient, but not unexpected."

"Whatever this Hector is, and if he's Macario's creature then he must be something quite unloveable. Achilles is the better option - for me, for the League, for the Persean Sector. Of each of those I am certain."
texts.zh:
"有 Macario 撑腰，\"她重复道，目光紧盯不放。\"麻烦，但不意外。"

"不管这个 Hector 是什么来路——若他是 Macario 的人，那必定是个相当讨人嫌的东西。Achilles 是更好的选择：对我，对联盟，对英仙座星域。这三点我都确信。"

texts.en:
"That would not be quite the sort of passion I seek to foster in an heir to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her head tilts slightly. "You do understand why that is, don't you?"
texts.zh:
"这可不是我想在辛达强权继承人身上养出来的那种热忱。"

她微微偏头。"你明白这是为什么，对吧？"

texts.en:
"Correct."

She politely places her hands together, settled.
texts.zh:
"没错。"

她礼貌地把双手交叠，安然而坐。

texts.en:
"Broadly speaking," she says, "He will claim legitimacy. He will have backing. Allies, credits, warships."

A pause. "Insiders."

"And he will take Sindria. And with Sindria, Askonia. And Askonia will join the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"大略说来，"她说，"他会宣称自己名正言顺。他会有靠山。盟友、星币、战舰。"

一顿。"还有内应。"

"然后他会拿下 Sindria。拿下 Sindria，也就拿下了 Askonia。而 Askonia 会加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: The Hegemony would never allow it.
options.zh: 霸主绝不会容许。

options.en: But Andrada's ideology is incompatible with the Persean League's... diversity.
options.zh: 可 Andrada 的意识形态，与英仙座联盟的...多元，水火不容。

options.en: But Andrada's transcendent ideology is incompatible with the League's 'diversity'.
options.zh: 可 Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，与联盟的'多元'水火不容。

options.en: Bold of you to tell me the plan. What stops me from revealing it?
options.zh: 把计划讲给我听，胆子不小。我凭什么不把它捅出去？

options.en: I will make no agreement without speaking to Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 不先跟 Horus Yaribay 谈，我不会达成任何协议。

options.en: A bold plan, and I've heard no better. Can I help?
options.zh: 计划够大胆，我也没听过更好的。我能帮上忙吗？

options.en: If you've got the credits, then I'll back you. And Achilles, if you want.
options.zh: 只要星币到位，我就支持你。还有 Achilles，如果你要。

options.en: You're going to have one big problem - me.
options.zh: 你会有个大麻烦——就是我。

options.en: Andrada still must be destroyed. Everything he built, torn down.
options.zh: Andrada 还是得被毁掉。他建起来的一切，都得推倒。

options.en: I am not comfortable with the power you may have over Achilles.
options.zh: 你可能对 Achilles 拥有的那种支配力，让我很不舒服。

options.en: I won't help or hinder you. I've got my own business to see to.
options.zh: 我不帮你，也不拦你。我自己还有事要办。

texts.en: "That's why I didn't ask the Hegemony for permission."
texts.zh: "所以我才没去求霸主批准。"

texts.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The appeal is all aesthetics."

"Achilles looks good in uniform. He'll co-opt the legacy of his clone-father with ease."
texts.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它的吸引力全在审美上。"

"Achilles 穿军装好看。他要接手他那克隆父亲的遗产，轻而易举。"

texts.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The popular appeal is all aesthetics."

Fortuna holds a moment, then gives you a look.

"No offense intended, of course," she says. "Achilles looks good in a uniform. It's all he needs."
texts.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它能收拢人心，靠的也全是审美。"

Fortuna 顿了顿，然后看了你一眼。

"当然，无意冒犯。\"她说，\"Achilles 穿军装好看。这就够了。"

texts.en:
"Nothing. And soon it won't matter, because it is already in motion."

"Understand that my telling you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement."

"Accept my good regard," she says, positively dripping noblesse oblige.
texts.zh:
"什么也拦不住。而且很快就无所谓了，因为它已经在运转。"

"你要明白，我把这些告诉你，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。"

"收下我的敬意。"她说，那口吻里满是居高临下的施恩意味。

texts.en:
She nods, keeping her eyes on you.

"I understand. My plans are already in motion and shall provide the best of any alternative. Horus will see that when you speak to him, as I assume you shall."

"Understand that my openness in speaking with you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement. And for that of Gens Yaribay, even if we do not agree on... every detail."
texts.zh:
她点头，目光始终没有离开你。

"我明白。我的计划已在运转，它会胜过任何替代方案。你去跟 Horus 谈，他会看明白的——我想你总会去谈。"

"你要明白，我这样坦率地同你说话，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。对 Yaribay 氏族 那一族也是如此，哪怕我们并非在...每个细节上都一致。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Accept my good regard," she says, her tone making it clear that her statement is equal to natural law to her mind.

She stands.

"Now I have much to see done. Give Horus my regards."
texts.zh:
"收下我的敬意。"她说，那语气分明表明，在她看来这话等同于自然律。

她站起身。

"眼下我还有太多事要办。替我向 Horus 问好。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She leaves, gilded silhouette followed by ranks of attendants.

The bartender lets out a sigh. Business this shift is ruined... but the next will be filled with gawkers and rumor-mongers.

You take your leave, followed by your bodyguards.
texts.zh:
她离开了，镀金般的身影后跟着一列随从。

酒保叹了口气。这一班的生意算是毁了...不过下一班会挤满看热闹的和传闲话的。

你带着保镖离开。

texts.en:
She smiles.

"Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long, I am sure."
texts.zh:
她微微一笑。

"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈，我确信。"

texts.en:
She smiles. "Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long."

"Perhaps we can get you out from under Reynard's thumb. Contingent on Achilles' success, of course."
texts.zh:
她微微一笑。"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈。"

"也许我们能把你从 Reynard 的掌心里弄出来。当然，得看 Achilles 成不成事。"

texts.en:
She stands.

"Thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. Together we will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
texts.zh:
她站起身。

"谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会一起建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She smiles coldly. "Your mercenary reputation prevails."

Fortuna takes a moment to whisper into her cuff. You, in turn, receive the ping of a credits transfer.

"For your consideration," she says. "You shall receive additional payments as you follow my instructions to ensure the ascension of Achilles to his birthright."
texts.zh:
她冷冷一笑。"你这雇佣兵的名声，果然名不虚传。"

Fortuna 低头对着袖口低语了几句。随即，你的通讯器响起一声星币转账的提示音。

"一点心意。\"她说，\"只要你按我的吩咐行事，确保 Achilles 登上他生来就该有的位置，后续还会另有酬劳。"

texts.en:
She smiles coldly.

"No. You can't be trusted to uphold a deal. Everyone knows that."
texts.zh:
她冷冷一笑。

"不必。你守不住协议，这谁都知道。"

options.en: You had me at '100,000 credits'.
options.zh: 你说出'十万星币'的时候，我就已经答应了。

texts.en:
"When the time is right we must speak again," she says.

Fortuna stands.

"I thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. We will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
texts.zh:
"时机成熟时，我们得再谈一次。"她说。

Fortuna 站起身。

"我谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You?"

Her face twitches and settles into cool disappointment rather than bursting into laughter, but you suspect she might have.
texts.zh:
"你？"

她脸上抽动了一下，随后没有爆出笑声，而是沉成一片冷淡的失望——但你怀疑她差点就笑出来了。

texts.en:
"I don't expect you or your masters in the Hegemony Strategic Council to understand why my way is best."

"I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
texts.zh:
"我不指望你，也不指望你那些在霸主战略委员会里的主子，能明白我的路为何最好。"

"我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

texts.en: "Remember that you are part of the Persean League, captain," she says. "Our strength is together. Do not place yourself in the way of progress."
texts.zh: "记住你是英仙座联盟的一分子，舰长。\"她说，\"我们的力量在于同心。别挡在进步的路上。"

texts.en: "I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
texts.zh: "我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You deal in absolutes. Ideals with no regard for the world."

She sighs. "You speak like Imoinu."
texts.zh:
"你只讲绝对。只讲理想，不管这世界如何。"

她叹了口气。"你说话像 Imoinu。"

options.en: And you compromise away a legacy of treason, mass killings, and planet-murder.
options.zh: 而你，把叛国、屠杀和屠星换来的那份遗产，拿去做妥协交易。

texts.en: "It is clear we do not see eye to eye." She stands.
texts.zh: "显然我们谈不到一处。"她站起身。

texts.en:
"Uncomfortable," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Achilles is a man grown and can see to his own comfort and compromise, captain. See to it that you mind your own."
texts.zh:
"不舒服，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"Achilles 已经成年，他的安逸和他的妥协，他自己会照看，舰长。你管好你自己的事。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I too shall mind to my own. See to it that you do not interfere."
texts.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我也只管我自己的。你务必别来插手。"

texts.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your bosses at Tri-Tachyon, mind yours."
texts.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你在速子科技的那些上头，管好你们的。"

texts.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your spymaster Orcus, mind yours."
texts.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你那间谍头子 Orcus，管好你们的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Temper your rage, captain," she says.

"Whatever you think of Andrada, my way is easier. Achilles can soften the excesses of the Sindrian Diktat, promote openness and transparency, and foster the new trade relationships which peace is built upon."
texts.zh:
"收一收你的怒火，舰长，"她说。

"不管你怎么看 Andrada，我的路更省事。Achilles 能收敛辛达强权的过度之处，推动开放与透明，培育和平所依托的新贸易关系。"

options.en: I shall hold my tongue. For now.
options.zh: 我会闭嘴。暂时。

options.en: The Andrada mutiny must be brought to justice - by the Hegemony.
options.zh: Andrada 的叛变必须受到审判——由霸主来审。

options.en: You would call Andrada's conquest legitimate? What of Opis and its dead?
options.zh: 你会说 Andrada 的征服是合法的？那 Opis 和它死掉的人呢？

options.en: You would accept Diktat legitimacy! You'd deny what your own granddaughter fights for?
options.zh: 你要承认强权的合法性！你要否掉你亲孙女为之奋斗的东西？

options.en: You would find it less 'easy' if you valued the lives of the Faithful sent to Cruor.
options.zh: 要是你在乎那些被送去 Cruor 的卢德信徒的性命，就不会觉得这事有多'省事'。

options.en: You misunderstand. I intend to take the Sindrian Diktat for myself.
options.zh: 你误会了。我打算自己拿下辛达强权。

texts.en: "I appreciate your respect for civil discussion," she says, "despite our differing perspectives."
texts.zh: "我欣赏你对文明讨论的尊重，\"她说，\"尽管我们看法不同。"

texts.en: "The Hegemony had its chance, captain. Auxiliary captain," she says the words quite deliberately. "For more than 20 cycles, you had your chance."
texts.zh: "霸主有过机会，舰长。辅助军的舰长，\"她把这几个字说得格外刻意，\"二十多个星历年，你们都有过机会。"

texts.en:
She moves as if to wipe some imagined dirt from her extravagant costume, but catches herself, and folds her hands neatly.

"Perhaps there is a more salient point we might build upon."
texts.zh:
她像是要抹掉那身华服上并不存在的灰尘，手抬到一半又收住，端端正正地把双手交握在身前。

"或许我们可以从一个更切题的要点谈起。"

texts.en:
"I remember the horror of Opis, captain," she says. "I remember watching as that world was torn apart and millions died. You need never remind me."

She lets that be for a moment.

"But I cannot change the past. And with respect to your idealism, my ability to bend the present is limited, however great."
texts.zh:
"我记得 Opis 的惨状，舰长，\"她说，\"我记得看着那个世界被撕碎，几百万人死去。你用不着提醒我。"

她让这句话悬在那儿，过了一会儿。

"可我改不了过去。至于你的理想主义——不管它多宏大，我能扭转当下的力量都是有限的。"

texts.en:
"That fight was lost before it began!" Her voice raises.

"I will use what power I have to bend the present toward the best future I can see. I shall not hold my hand to await your judgment on that matter, or any other!"
texts.zh:
"那场仗在开打之前就已经输了！"她的声音扬了起来。

"我会用我手上的权力，把当下推向我看得见的最好的未来。我不会停手等着你来评判这件事，或者别的什么事！"

texts.en:
"I will make no time for your dim sermonizing," she spits. Then, suppressing her anger, takes a deep breath.

"I have Achilles' assurance that he will stop the persecution. Is that not enough?"
texts.zh:
"我没空听你那些昏话布道。"她咬着牙说，随后压住怒气，深吸一口气。

"Achilles 向我保证过，他会停止迫害。这还不够吗？"

options.en: I suppose it'll have to be.
options.zh: 看来也只能这样了。

options.en: And you trust him?
options.zh: 你信他？

options.en: It'll have to be. For now.
options.zh: 只能这样。暂时。

options.en: And let the crimes against humanity go unpunished? It is not enough.
options.zh: 就让反人类的罪行不受惩罚？这不够。

texts.en: She nods, slowly.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头。

texts.en: "I must," she says.
texts.zh: "我必须这么做，"她说。

texts.en: She nods, slowly.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头。

texts.en: She lets out a breath, slowly. Eyes hard.
texts.zh: 她缓缓吐出一口气，眼神变硬。

texts.en:
This response baffles her.

"You?" She makes a strange expression; it'd be unseemly to laugh in your face.

"I am at a loss, $playerSirOrMadam. What you propose is... unreasonable."
texts.zh:
这个回答让她一时不知所措。

"你？"她露出一个古怪的表情；当着你的面笑出声来，终究有失体面。

"我不知道该说什么了，$playerSirOrMadam。你的提议...不合情理。"

options.en: We'll see.
options.zh: 走着瞧。

options.en: Keep up. I've made a habit of accomplishing the impossible.
options.zh: 跟上。把不可能的事办成，我已经习惯了。

texts.en: "I suppose we shall," she says doubtfully.
texts.zh: "那就走着瞧吧，"她将信将疑地说。

texts.en: "So you say," she says.
texts.zh: "随你怎么说，"她说。

texts.en: "So it does." She stands.
texts.zh: "确实如此。"她站起身。

texts.en:
Her expression closes slightly.

"I see. Of course." She sighs.

"Headstrong, is she not? I fear I was too liberal with Eunomia concerning her upbringing. Hadwin, my consort, always said so. Perhaps he was right."
texts.zh:
她的神情微微收紧。

"我明白了。当然。"她叹了口气。

"性子太拗，是不是？我怕是对 Eunomia 的管教太松了。Hadwin，我的伴侣，一直这么说。也许他是对的。"

options.en: It's understandable. She's young.
options.zh: 可以理解。她还年轻。

options.en: She's going to get herself killed.
options.zh: 她这是要把自己送进死路。

options.en: She is fighting for what she believes.
options.zh: 她在为自己相信的东西而战。

options.en: She is fighting for a righteous cause.
options.zh: 她在为一项正义的事业而战。

texts.en: "Indeed. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh: "确实。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
She shakes her head.

"The sooner the question of the Sindrian Diktat is resolved, the sooner she'll come home, where she belongs."
texts.zh:
她摇了摇头。

"辛达强权的问题了结得越早，她就能越早回家，回到她该在的地方。"

texts.en: "I sincerely hope not. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh: "我真心希望不至于。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
"'What she believes'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh:
"'她相信的东西'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
"'A righteous cause'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh:
"'一项正义的事业'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
"Oh, Dardan." She looks off and away. "Stubborn boy."

"Perhaps we were too strict in directing his upbringing - I left that to Hadwin, you know. It is as though he fears to have any imagination. It makes his... situation difficult."
texts.zh:
"唉，Dardan。"她的目光移向别处。"倔孩子。"

"也许我们在管教他时太严了——你知道，那摊事我交给了 Hadwin。他像是连一点想象力都怕有。这让他的...处境很难办。"

options.en: Maybe planetary administration isn't Dardan's calling.
options.zh: 也许行星行政本来就不是 Dardan 该走的路。

options.en: It appears he's learned a hatred for the Luddic Faithful.
options.zh: 看样子他学会了憎恨卢德信徒。

options.en: He lacks the conviction to take the steps necessary to quell the Pather uprisings.
options.zh: 他缺那份决心，下不了镇压左径暴动该下的手。

texts.en:
She gives you a look.

"He will learn. It is his duty to the gens. And I gave him it not because I thought it would be easy, but because the challenge would teach him what he needs to lead the gens."
texts.zh:
她看了你一眼。

"他会学会的。这是他对氏族的责任。我把这差事交给他，不是以为它轻松，而是因为这挑战能教会他领导氏族所需要的东西。"

texts.en:
"It is not 'hatred' if it is a rational fear. Look upon Mairaath, captain! See there the destruction wrought by blind faith, the millions dead. For what?"

"It is an irrational cult. No greater force holds us back from rebuilding human civilization - one of freedom and plenty rather than the tyranny and war of the Domain."

She takes a deep breath, centering regal calm upon herself once again.

"Freedom and plenty. To return to the point, Achilles offers us a chance for this and more, captain."
texts.zh:
"如果那是理性的恐惧，就不叫'憎恨'。看看 Mairaath，舰长！看看盲信造出的毁灭，看看那几百万条人命。图什么？"

"那是个不理性的教派。没有哪股力量比它更妨碍我们重建人类文明——一个自由而富足、而非人之领那种暴政与战争的文明。"

她深吸一口气，重新把那份君临般的镇定收拢回来。

"自由与富足。回到正题：Achilles 给了我们一个机会，能换来这些，甚至更多，舰长。"

texts.en:
She gives you a look of some consternation.

"I have no love for the Luddics and their irrational mythology. They hold the entire Sector back, in an age of darkness. But consider well such bold and bloodthirsty proclamations - see how such 'conviction' has served Philip Andrada on Volturn."

"Andrada was as blind the Luddics he slaughtered," she hisses. Then takes a deep breath, re-centering herself in a sense of regal calm.

"And for all purposes he is as good as dead. Which brings us back to Achilles."
texts.zh:
她看着你，神情有些不安。

"我对卢德派和他们那套不理性的神话毫无好感。在这黑暗的时代，是他们拖住了整个星域。可你好好掂量掂量这种大胆又嗜血的说辞——看看这种'决心'让 Philip Andrada 在 Volturn 落了个什么下场。"

"Andrada 跟他屠杀的那些卢德派一样瞎，"她嘶声道。随后深吸一口气，重新沉回那份君临般的镇定里。

"而说到底，他早跟死了没两样。这就又说回 Achilles 了。"

texts.en: She interrupts, holding a hand aloft, a finger raised to summon the bartender, who appears almost instantly.
texts.zh: 她打断你，一只手抬起，竖起一根手指唤来酒保；那酒保几乎立刻就到了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I find myself in the mood for a glass of the Aguila-Samek '45."

She projects her voice to the room.

"I apologize, ma'am," the bartender says, scurrying up to the table, "but we don't h-"

"Of course you don't," she says over him. "I brought some that you may pour for me."
texts.zh:
"我忽然想喝一杯 Aguila-Samek '45。"

她把声音送向整个房间。

"抱歉，女士，\"酒保快步凑到桌边，\"可我们没——"

"你们当然没有，\"她打断他，\"我自己带了，你只管给我斟上。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She snaps her fingers, and an attendant approaches.

A case appears and from it an amber bottle webbed in silver tracery, a stream of cool mist flowing down the sides. It opens with a crisp pop.

The bartender fills Fortuna's glass, then hesitates, the spout frozen above the glass set in front of you.

She gives a tiny nod, and the bartender pours for you.
texts.zh:
她打了个响指，一名随从走上前来。

一只箱子送上桌，从里面取出一只琥珀色酒瓶，瓶身覆着银丝般的纹路，冷雾顺着瓶壁流下。瓶盖弹开，发出清脆的一声。

酒保为 Fortuna 斟满一杯，随后迟疑起来，壶嘴悬在你面前那只杯子的上方不动了。

她轻轻一点头，酒保便为你斟上。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She raises her glass.

"I desire stability. It is a necessary precursor to general prosperity and good living. I offer Achilles all of this, and more - the opportunity to fulfill his duty and ambition as a 'great man' of history." She pauses. "Or, at least, the echo of one."

"I do not demand his humiliation for my own self-regard, nor his life or pain for the crimes of his clone-father."

"And to you I offer an honest accounting of my goals and motives." She looks to you with haughty expectation.
texts.zh:
她举起酒杯。

"我要的是稳定。那是普遍繁荣与优裕生活必要的前提。这些我全都给 Achilles，还有更多——一个成为历史上'伟人'、尽到责任并实现抱负的机会。\"她顿了顿。\"至少，做一个伟人的回声。"

"我并不为了自己的体面要求他受辱，也不为他克隆父亲的罪行索取他的性命或痛苦。"

"而对你，我愿意如实交代我的目标与动机。"她带着傲然的期待看向你。

options.en: You forget that Achilles is the blood of Andrada, from which all authority flows.
options.zh: 你忘了，Achilles 身上流着 Andrada 的血，而一切权威皆由此而来。

options.en: I'll drink to that.
options.zh: 为这话，我干一杯。

options.en: I'll drink to that, provisionally.
options.zh: 为这话，我先干一杯——有条件地。

options.en: You forget MY ambitions. Which have been earned, not inherited.
options.zh: 你忘了我的野心。那是我挣来的，不是继承来的。

options.en: You forget that Achilles is a symbol. So long as he lives, so does Andrada.
options.zh: 你忘了 Achilles 是个象征。只要他活着，Andrada 就还活着。

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then, with a sigh, she sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your words.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

随后叹了口气，抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你说的话。

texts.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.
texts.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

texts.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.

"Provisionally."
texts.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

"有条件地。"

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, timing her action to allow herself to ignore your gaffe.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，借着这个动作，正好不去理会你的失言。

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your impasse.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你们之间的僵局。

texts.en: "Safe," she says, with a nod acknowledging your polite words in a strained situation.
texts.zh: "安全，"她说着点了点头，算是对你在这种紧绷场合里说的客套话表示认可。

texts.en: Her look cools slightly.
texts.zh: 她的神色冷了几分。

texts.en:
You have bodyguards both overt and incognito - dressed as spacers on shore-leave, a technician just off-shift. Their heads scan the room's firing lines, and an EW specialist taps at their datapad as if checking for messages.

You can imagine the subtle sensors tagging the various low-powered hand weapons carried by the clientele. They would appear in the optics, cybernetic or simple hardware, of your guards. A dense cluster of pistols would show in the pack of League Fleet junior officers in one corner.
texts.zh:
你的保镖有明有暗——有的扮成上岸休假的太空佬，有的像个刚下班的技工。他们扫视着屋里各条可能的射击线路，一名电子战专家敲着数据平板，像是在查消息。

你能想象那些精细的传感器，正把客人们随身带的各色低功率手武器一一标出来。它们会出现在你保镖的目镜里——义体也好，普通硬件也罢。角落里那堆联盟舰队下级军官身上，会亮起一团密集的手枪光点。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The hum and clatter of the bar fades as the main holo-projector's image grows and transitions through a blurry leap in scale, then focuses back to sharpness, as the bartender fiddles with the controls.
texts.zh: 酒吧里的嗡鸣与杯盘碰撞声渐渐低下去。酒保拨弄着控制钮，主全息投影的画面随之放大，经过一次模糊的尺度跃变，重新聚焦、恢复清晰。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The audio is silent for a moment, a holo-caster's lips moving to no effect.

BREAKING NEWS, the holo-cast proclaims in bold letters.

"From the Askonia System-"

The caster's voice hits like a too-loud slap before pulling back to merely overwhelming.

You begin to turn away. Yet another declaration of a final crackdown on the next victim from a carousel of scapegoats.
texts.zh:
声音先空了一瞬，全息播报员的嘴唇动着，却没有半点声响。

突发新闻。全息播报以粗体大字宣告。

"来自 Askonia 星系——"

播报员的声音猛地砸下来，像一记过重的耳光，随后才收敛到仅仅是压人的音量。

你正要转身走开。又是一则宣告：要对下一个牺牲品动手，进行最终的清洗——替罪羊一个接一个，轮着来。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Then you glimpse your own face, bright and distorted.

SPACER MURDER RAMPAGE - POLITICALLY MOTIVATED?
texts.zh:
接着，你瞥见了自己的脸，明亮而扭曲。

太空船员连环凶杀案——出于政治动机？

options.en: Turn to watch
options.zh: 转身看下去

texts.en: There's you, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy, flanked by bodyguards. There's an ominous tone.
texts.zh: 画面里是你，穿过 Galatia 学院的入口休息厅，两侧是护卫。配乐透着一股不祥的味道。

texts.en: There's you, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy, flanked by bodyguards. There's an ominous tone. This must be about Hercules. Who you never met, in fact. You recall a discussion with Provost Baird, and-
texts.zh: 画面里是你，穿过 Galatia 学院的入口休息厅，两侧是护卫。配乐透着一股不祥的味道。这一定和 Hercules 有关。可你其实从没见过他。你想起与 Baird 院长的那次谈话，还有——

texts.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT?

Images of Hercules' destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens.

A bland, out-of-context statement from Chief of Security Marcellus Lott.
texts.zh:
院士遇刺未遂？

Hercules 那间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。

安全主管 Marcellus Lott 一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

texts.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION COVERUP?

An image of Hercules' destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens. Erdene Benoit, in tears, led away by guards in mirrored masks.

A bland, out-of-context statement from Chief of Security Marcellus Lott.
texts.zh:
院士遇刺，遭人掩盖？

Hercules 那间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。Erdene Benoit 泪流满面，被戴镜面面具的守卫带走。

安全主管 Marcellus Lott 一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

texts.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION COVERUP?

An image of a destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens. A young woman, in tears, led away by guards in mirrored masks.

A bland, out-of-context statement from the Galatia Academy's chief of security.
texts.zh:
院士遇刺，遭人掩盖？

一间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。一名年轻女子泪流满面，被戴镜面面具的守卫带走。

Galatia 学院安全主管一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

options.en: Someone tried to shoot him?
options.zh: 有人想枪杀他？

texts.en:
A view over the shoulder of a cowering civilian, grainy footage from a cheap buzz-drone.

DEATH SQUAD INVADES QARAS

Your boot crushes a discarded food container as you stride down the municipal corridor flanked by fearsome-looking marines. Your eye catches on the camera and it freezes, zooms. Your menacing face in stark chiaroscuro.

Grainy recording from a handheld sensor. Broken-down doors, a trashed meeting room.

Cut to Jason Korin's bloodless corpse on a slab, eyes staring blank accusations. Hard to tell he's a young Andrada with the tattoo-work.

A hangdog curate mumbles something of no consequence to an unseen interviewer.
texts.zh:
镜头越过一名瑟缩平民的肩头，影像是廉价蜂鸣无人机拍下的粗颗粒画面。

死亡小队入侵 QARAS

你踏着一只被丢弃的食品盒走过去，靴底把它碾扁，两侧面目凶悍的陆战队簇拥着你，你大步穿过市政走廊。你的目光扫到镜头，画面骤然定格、推近。你那张脸在强烈的明暗对比下显得狰狞。

手持传感器拍下的粗颗粒影像。被撞烂的门，一片狼藉的会议室。

镜头切到 Jason Korin 了无血色的尸体，躺在停尸台上，双眼空洞地瞪着，像无声的控诉。一身刺青让人几乎认不出这是个年轻的 Andrada。

一个垂头丧气的教士对着镜头外的采访者嘟囔了几句无关紧要的话。

options.en: Just watch
options.zh: 看着就好

options.en: That's not how it happened!
options.zh: 事情根本不是那样发生的！

texts.en: Next: Maeus Moroz leaving the MuniSec facility, his face red with tears, looking lost and enraged. For someone to explain, someone to target...
texts.zh: 下一段：Maeus Moroz 走出 MuniSec 设施，满脸泪痕、涨得通红，神情茫然又暴怒。像是在等谁来解释，或者等一个可以迁怒的目标...

texts.en:
ORTHRUS DOUBLE MURDER: FATHER AND SON

Then the moment you pulled a gun in the bar and fired. The clip ends with the flash, then repeats. Repeats again, slower. Maeus's body jerks and freezes.
texts.zh:
ORTHRUS 双命凶案：父与子

接着是你在酒吧里拔枪开火的那一刻。片段在枪口火光中结束，然后重播。又重播一遍，更慢。Maeus 的身体猛地一颤，随即定格。

texts.en:
ORTHRUS DOUBLE MURDER: FATHER AND SON

Then the moment you pulled a gun in the bar and failed to fire. The clip scales and zoom toward you holding the pistol, ready to fire, the bartender's face contorted in horror. It repeats the loop. Repeats again, slower, as if Maeus never saw the shot coming, the shot you never fired.
texts.zh:
ORTHRUS 双命凶案：父与子

接着是你在酒吧里拔枪、却没能开火的那一刻。画面推近、再推近，定格在举枪待发的你身上，酒保的脸因恐惧而扭曲。片段循环播放。又重播一遍，更慢，仿佛 Maeus 始终没看见那一枪袭来——那一枪你从未开出。

texts.en:
ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON

Then an older holo, one you never saw. The fuzzy edge of a security drone's pickup: a young man of familiar build walks, nearly colliding with a spacer just off-ship, a raised hand, a small flash, and the young man falls to the ground.

So quick, so subtle - it takes several seconds for the bystander coming to the young man's aid to notice the blood pooling on the ground. The small crowd recoils to an unheard cry.
texts.zh:
ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子

接着是一段更早的全息影像，你从没见过。画面边缘是安保无人机模糊的取景：一个身形熟悉的年轻人走过，几乎与一名刚下船的太空人撞上，一只手抬起，一点微光，年轻人便倒在地上。

太快了，也太轻了——好几秒之后，那个上前搀扶年轻人的旁观者才注意到地上正漫开的血。小小的人群猛地一缩，应和着一声你听不见的惊叫。

texts.en:
58966 Elysium.

Marble walls and columns invaded by hostile shadows in black armor. Doors breached, atmo venting in clouds. A shot from low, looking up - their leader, you, marching through desecrated halls. Giving an order.

Quick cut: a body in a pool of fresh blood, slashed dead.

ROGUE SPACER TRANSFORMS PARADISE INTO SLAUGHTERHOUSE
texts.zh:
画面：58966 Elysium。

大理石的墙壁与立柱间，闯入一片片黑色装甲的敌意暗影。门被撞开，大气成团地往外泄。一个自下而上的仰拍镜头——他们的首领，也就是你，正穿过被亵渎的厅堂。你在下令。

快切：一具被砍死的尸体，躺在新鲜的血泊里。

狂徒太空人把乐园变成屠场

texts.en:
A narrator, voice insistently dull, has been speaking the whole time, "-accompanied by this statement from the Chief High Inspector-General..."

A quick cut to a face you know all too well.
texts.zh:
一个解说员的画外音始终没停，语调刻意平板："——并附上首席总监察长的这份声明..."

快切到一张你熟悉得不能再熟悉的脸。

texts.en:
A Hegemony MIS narrator, voice insistently dull, has been speaking the whole time, "-accompanied by this statement from the Sindrian Mutiny's chief spy..."

A quick cut to a face you know all too well.
texts.zh:
霸主 MIS 的解说员一直在说，语调刻意平板："——并附上辛达叛乱当局头号间谍的这份声明..."

快切到一张你熟悉得不能再熟悉的脸。

texts.en:
Dolos Macario displays sadness, concern, and just the right touch of righteous anger.

"My fellow, loyal, citizens of the Sindrian Diktat. I address not only you but all right-thinking people of the Persean Sector. All who uphold law and order in troubled times."
texts.zh:
Dolos Macario 脸上显出悲伤、忧虑，以及恰到好处的一丝义愤。

"辛达强权忠诚的同胞们。我不只是在向你们说话，也是在向英仙座星域所有明事理的人说话。向所有在乱世中维护法律与秩序的人说话。"

texts.en:
Dolos Macario displays sadness, deep concern, and a careful touch of righteous anger.

"My fellow, loyal, citizens of the Sindrian Diktat. I address not only you but all right-thinking people of the Persean Sector. All who uphold law and order in troubled times."

(Some off-duty Hegemony officers at the end of the bar boo and jeer. Several spacers join in.)
texts.zh:
Dolos Macario 脸上显出悲伤、深切的忧虑，以及一丝拿捏得当的义愤。

"辛达强权忠诚的同胞们。我不只是在向你们说话，也是在向英仙座星域所有明事理的人说话。向所有在乱世中维护法律与秩序的人说话。"

(酒吧尽头几名休班的霸主军官发出嘘声与嘲骂。几个太空人也跟着起哄。)

texts.en:
"I have provided evidence of a disturbing conspiracy which threatens everything we hold dear." He holds for a moment.

"Until now our dear leader, Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, has kept his progeny secret - entrusted to caretakers for protection and to provide a traditional upbringing far from the corrupting influence of celebrity and wealth. Given an honest start to life, as any father would wish for his sons, for these many past cycles."

"Until recently," his voice finally cracks, "they were safe."

He closes his eyes and takes a shuddering breath, appearing to suppress a sob.
texts.zh:
"我已提交证据，证明一场令人不安的阴谋正在威胁我们所珍视的一切。"他停顿了一瞬。

"直到今天，我们敬爱的领袖、最高元首 Philip Andrada 一直将自己的子嗣藏在暗处——托付给看护人抚养，既为保护他们，也为了让他们在远离名声与财富腐蚀的地方接受传统的教养。让他们有一个诚实的起点，正如任何一位父亲对自己儿子的期望，这么多星历年都是如此。"

"直到不久之前，\"他的声音终于裂了，\"他们都是安全的。"

他闭上眼，吸了一口气，肩膀发颤，像是在压住一声呜咽。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer has made it $playerHisOrHer personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!"

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor of this murderous rampage into protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
texts.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了 $playerHisOrHer 毕生的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将这场屠杀中唯一的幸存者纳入保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

texts.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer somehow lied $playerHisOrHer way into a commission with the Sindrian Diktat. $PlayerHeOrShe made it a personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!" His voice goes soft for a moment. "It is the foulest treachery one can imagine."

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor into our protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
texts.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，靠着 $playerHisOrHer 的谎言，骗到了一份辛达强权的委任。$PlayerHeOrShe 把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了自己的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！\"他的声音软了一瞬，\"这是能想象到的最卑劣的背叛。"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将唯一的幸存者纳入我们的保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

texts.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, one senseless terrorist, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
texts.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手、一个毫无理智的恐怖分子打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

texts.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, a radical terrorist employed by the Cult of Ludd, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
texts.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手——一个受卢德教派雇用的激进恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the coward! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL have justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
texts.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个懦夫！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将讨回正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

texts.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the traitor! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You are stripped of your commission. You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL uphold justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
texts.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个叛徒！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你的委任状已被剥夺。你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将维护正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

texts.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。

texts.en: You notice the spacer at the next table turn to re-examine your face. And another, two down.
texts.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。再过去两桌，又有一个。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
texts.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

接着，隔了两张桌子的又一个人转过头来。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
texts.zh: ...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地说出她...或他的名字，但请放心，报应会来得又快又准。还会有...

options.en: It appears to be time to leave
options.zh: 看来该走了

options.zh: 够了，关掉它！

texts.en: Your bodyguards throw a disposable poncho over you as they hustle you out a side-door; you could pass as any civilian girded against the drip of poorly-tuned life support conduits.
texts.zh: 护卫们把一件一次性斗篷披到你身上，簇拥着你从侧门匆匆离开；此刻你看起来就像任何一个寻常平民，裹着斗篷抵挡调校不良的生命维持导管滴下的冷凝水。

texts.en:
Macario's attack on your reputation, even if rejected as Sindrian black propaganda, nonetheless makes you an inconvenient friend.

And a target for bounty hunters and assassins, no doubt.

It's unthinkable to simply sit back and allow this to be done to you. You carefully consider how you should react.
texts.zh:
Macario 对你名声的攻击，即便被当作辛达的黑宣传而不被采信，也足以让你成为一个令人为难的朋友。

而且毫无疑问，会让你成为赏金猎人与刺客的目标。

坐视这一切落到自己头上，是无法想象的。你仔细思量自己该如何应对。

options.en: This is personal. I'm going to make Macario regret ever speaking to me.
options.zh: 这是私人恩怨。我要让 Macario 后悔曾经对我说过话。

options.en: He's a monster. For the sake of the Sector, Macario's scheming must be stopped.
options.zh: 他是个怪物。为了星域，必须制止 Macario 的阴谋。

options.en: Macario must be stopped - for the sake of the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 必须制止 Macario——为了辛达强权！

options.en: Macario must be stopped before he tears the Sindrian Diktat apart.
options.zh: 必须在 Macario 把辛达强权撕碎之前制止他。

options.en: He's made a mistake. I must convince Macario that he needs me!
options.zh: 他走错了一步。我得让 Macario 相信他需要我！

options.en: I don't want to get involved, it's not my fight.
options.zh: 我不想卷进去，这不是我的仗。

texts.en:
You'll tear apart the Spider's web and crush him like a bug.

He made it personal and you're going to show him the only way this can be allowed to end.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要撕碎他这张蜘蛛网，像碾死一只虫子那样碾碎他。

他把这事变成了私人恩怨，而你要让他看清，这件事唯一被允许的结局是什么。

首先就有一个大问题。

options.en: He's sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 他安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

options.en: He took my Sindrian Diktat commission.
options.zh: 他夺走了我的辛达强权委任状。

texts.en: If you could smash through those fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized. The polity would be vulnerable to intervention from the Hegemony, or perhaps even Achilles Andrada with Persean League backing.
texts.zh: 如果你能击穿那些舰队、擒住 Macario，辛达强权引以为傲的军力将四散溃败、士气尽失。这个政权就会脆弱到任人介入——霸主会来，甚至可能有英仙座联盟撑腰的 Achilles Andrada。

texts.en:
Smashing through Diktat fleets to capture Macario has an appealing directness. But he'll scurry away by one escape route or another as soon as you entered orbit.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options. And allies. Whoever you speak to first may send signals about your loyalties and priorities...
texts.zh:
击穿强权舰队、擒下 Macario，这种直截了当的做法颇有吸引力。可你一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走。

你得做得更隐蔽。你权衡着选项，还有盟友。你先去找谁，或许就会透露出你的忠诚与轻重缓急...

texts.en: Orcus Rao would doubtless be interested in the downfall his counterpart in the 'Sindrian Mutiny'.
texts.zh: Orcus Rao 无疑会有兴趣看到他那位同侪在'辛达叛乱'中倒台。

texts.en: Though you don't hold a Hegemony commission, Orcus Rao is a contact - and certainly interested in arranging the downfall of his counterpart in the 'Sindrian Mutiny'.
texts.zh: 你虽然不持有霸主的委任状，但 Orcus Rao 算得上是旧识——而且他必定有兴趣安排'辛达叛乱'中那位同侪的倒台。

texts.en: Reynard Hannan is the most powerful man in the Persean League. He can help you, if you prove yourself to him by helping him respond to this Second Askonia Crisis.
texts.zh: Reynard Hannan 是英仙座联盟最有势力的人。只要你能帮他应对这场第二次 Askonia 危机，向他证明自己的价值，他就会帮你。

texts.en: You told Fortuna Kato you would help her back Achilles' claim. You're both enemies of Macario so your interests are aligned.
texts.zh: 你答应过 Fortuna Kato，会帮她支持 Achilles 的继承主张。你们两人都是 Macario 的敌人，利益自然一致。

texts.en: You told Fortuna Kato you would help her back Achilles' claim - for credits. You're both enemies of Macario so your interests are aligned.
texts.zh: 你答应过 Fortuna Kato，会帮她支持 Achilles 的继承主张——为了星币。你们两人都是 Macario 的敌人，利益自然一致。

texts.en: Finlay Siyavong might lend the assistance of the FIS, provided it somehow benefitted the Persean League.
texts.zh: Finlay Siyavong 或许能让舰队情报部出手相助——前提是这件事多少对英仙座联盟有利。

texts.en: Faro Inesis might be convinced to use his intelligence network and contacts to support your efforts... if he could profit without risking his position in Tri-Tachyon.
texts.zh: 也许能说服 Faro Inesis，动用他的情报网络与人脉来支持你的行动...前提是他能从中获利，又不至于危及自己在速子科技的地位。

texts.en: Although averse to your schemes as a rule, Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded to help by the promise of safe profits.
texts.zh: Rayan Arroyo 素来讨厌你那些算计，但若能许他一笔稳妥的利润，也许能说服他帮忙。

texts.en: Oxana Hyder seems to trust you. And you know how much she hates Macario.
texts.zh: Oxana Hyder 似乎信得过你。而你也知道她有多恨 Macario。

texts.en: Oxana Hyder may not entirely trust you, but you know how much she hates Macario.
texts.zh: Oxana Hyder 未必完全信得过你，可你也知道她有多恨 Macario。

texts.en: You've sown a seed of distrust between Horacio Caden and Macario. Perhaps it's time to see if it will bear bloody fruit.
texts.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 与 Macario 之间埋下了猜忌的种子。也许该看看它会不会结出见血的果实了。

texts.en: You've sown a seed of trust with Horacio Caden. With your shared loyalty to Philip Andrada's vision, surely you can find a way to save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 心中埋下了信任的种子。既然你们都忠于 Philip Andrada 的构想，总能找到一条拯救辛达强权的路。

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With Rao's help, with the assets of the Hegemony behind you, you'll find your opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Rao 相助，有霸主的资源在背后支撑，你会找到突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:
You take a deep breath.

And open your eyes.
texts.zh:
你深吸一口气。

然后睁开了眼睛。

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With Reynard Hannan's help, with the office of the Prime Demarchon and power of the Persean League, you'll find an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Fortuna Kato 相助，有 Kato 氏族的资源、甚至可能有英仙座联盟的力量在背后支撑，你会找到突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

With Siyavongs's help, with the assets of the Persean League, you'll find your opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
