options.zh: 我不需要任何人的帮助

texts.en: He, at least, can be counted on to support the Persean League rather than the interests of one Gens over another.
texts.zh: 至少他指望得上——他会支持英仙座联盟，而不是让某一个氏族的利益压过别家。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: You connect to the local comm directory and browse the public and otherwise known listings.
texts.zh: 你与本地通讯目录建立连接，并浏览公共列表和其他已知列表。

texts.en: For all her pride, at least Fortuna Kato will make an agreement without demanding you submit as if to a king.
texts.zh: 尽管她骄横自负，至少 Fortuna Kato 愿意谈条件，不会要求你像对君王那样俯首称臣。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: Despite his distance from true power, despite his self-doubt, at least Horus does not seek to make himself your master.
texts.zh: 尽管他与真正的权力相隔甚远，尽管他心存自我怀疑，至少 Horus 没打算做你的主子。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: If Reynard Hannan cannot accept your independence, then you'll simply have to take it for yourself and act accordingly.
texts.zh: 既然 Reynard Hannan 容不下你的独立，那你就自己去挣，然后照自己的意思行事。

options.en: Close the comms interface
options.zh: 关闭通讯界面

texts.en:
"Then you resign yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt.

"I have nothing more to say to you."
texts.zh:
"那你就是认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑。

"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

options.en: Achilles Kalian appears to be known to Fleet Intelligence already. Were you aware?
options.zh: 看来舰队情报部早就知道 Achilles Kalian 这个人。你知道这事吗？

options.en: Fortuna Kato is plotting to use Achilles Andrada to upset your position in the League.
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 正谋划利用 Achilles Andrada，动摇你在联盟中的地位。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: Do you... want the clones dead?
options.zh: 你...希望那些克隆体死吗？

options.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

options.en: I found Hector. He won't be a problem. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Hector。他不会成为问题。 (解释)

options.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
options.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 咱们换个话题吧。

texts.en:
"It is presumptive to question me, $titlePL." He narrows his eyes. "But I am in a forgiving mood."

He flicks with his hand, discarding his own indignation.

"Of course I knew of Kalian. He's the product of a minor and long-standing arrangement with our 'friends' from Askonia. A little insurance for Philip, a little hostage for us."
texts.zh:
"质疑我，是越界，$titlePL。\"他眯起眼睛。\"不过我眼下心情宽厚。"

他随手一挥，连自己的不悦也一并挥开了。

"Kalian 的事我当然知道。那是我们与 Askonia 那些'朋友'之间一项不起眼却由来已久的安排。对 Philip 是一份小小的保险，对我们则是一个小小的人质。"

options.en: Wait, you're working with Macario?
options.zh: 等等，你在和 Macario 合作？

texts.en:
"Mind your tone, $titlePL," Reynard says, though casually.

"Our Diktat representative has not been entirely forthright about Macario's personal attention to the matter, nor about the scope of Philip's... ambitions. Your files," he extends a charitable hand. "Prove their misdirection."

"Not that I blame them, of course. I wouldn't trust me either."

"I suppose I have you to thank." Reynard almost rolls his eyes. "A rare concession, do enjoy it."
texts.zh:
"注意你的口气，$titlePL，"Reynard 说，语气倒还随意。

"我们那位辛达强权代表，并没有完全坦白 Macario 对这件事的亲自关注，也没有说清 Philip 那些...野心的范围。而你的档案，\"他伸出手，姿态宽宏，\"证明了他们的误导。"

"当然，我不怪他们。换了我，我也不会信我自己。"

"看来我该谢你。\"Reynard 几乎翻了个白眼。\"难得的让步，好好享用吧。"

texts.en:
"Mm. Clearly."

Reynard doesn't seem terribly concerned.
texts.zh:
"唔。看来确实如此。"

Reynard 看上去并不怎么在意。

options.en: You don't seem terribly concerned.
options.zh: 你似乎并不怎么担心。

options.en: You have a plan, don't you.
options.zh: 你有对策，是不是。

options.en: I wish to offer my assistance with your... response.
options.zh: 我想为你的...回应出一份力。

texts.en: "Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." He grins toothily. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh: "不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."
texts.zh:
他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

texts.en:
He produces a concessionary smile, as if from an approving teacher to a clever student.

"Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." His grin becomes toothier. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh:
他挤出一个带点让步意味的笑，像是老师在夸奖一个机灵的学生。

"不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他的笑容咧得更开，牙齿都露了出来。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
"It pleases me to hear you say this. I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."

He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening. Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner."

He produces a toothy grin.
texts.zh:
"听你这么说，我很高兴。等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。"

他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。

texts.en:
"Good," he says.

"And before you succumb to the impulse by making a gauche inquiry, this has not been done at my order. Why dirty my own hands with such frivolity when there are so many others who are more than willing?"

He leans back comfortably, quite content with the situation.
texts.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"还有——趁你还没忍不住提出那种失礼的问题：这事不是我下令做的。既然有那么多人心甘情愿代劳，我何必用自己的手去沾这种无聊的事？"

他舒坦地向后一靠，对这局面相当满意。

texts.en:
Reynard looks at you for a moment, a gleam in his eye. His smirk is not entirely unfriendly.

"Your offer is appreciated, but no. It amuses me to watch the drama unfold," he says, looking off-link somewhere. Perhaps at a gorgeous landscape.

"I've a notion that this may be worked to my advantage," he lifts a finger at you, looking smug. "But it shan't do to tell too early. Watch closely. You may learn something, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
Reynard 看了你片刻，眼里有光。他的笑不算全然不友善。

"你的提议我很领情，但不必。看着这出戏演下去，我挺开心，"他说，目光飘向通讯之外某处。也许是某片华美的风景。

"我有个想法，这件事或许能为我所用，\"他朝你竖起一根手指，一脸得色，\"不过说太早可不行。看仔细了。你或许能学到点什么，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He drums his fingers on his luxurious desk.

"This 'Hector' will announce that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he's been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

"We'll deal with it in due time."
texts.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用手指在奢华的书桌上敲了敲。

"这个'Hector'会宣布：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

"到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He taps manicured fingers on his luxurious desk. They stop. His eyes turns to you.

"And how sure are you that he was in that asteroid when you blew it up?" He doesn't wait for an answer. "Not sure enough, I think."
texts.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用修整齐整的手指在奢华的书桌上轻叩几下。停住。目光转向你。

"你炸掉那颗小行星的时候，有多确定他就在里面？\"他不等你回答。\"我看，还不够确定。"

options.en: Human remains were detected...
options.zh: 检测到了人类遗骸...

texts.en:
He snaps his fingers, interrupting your explanation.

"The intention is that we are surprised when this 'Hector' announces that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he has been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

Pausing to giving you a patient look, he says, "I do not plan to be surprised. We'll deal with it in due time."
texts.zh:
他打了个响指，打断你的解释。

"他们的用意，就是让我们在这个'Hector'宣布时措手不及：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

他顿了顿，用一种近乎耐心的目光看着你，说："我没打算措手不及。到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "Yes, I'm familiar with the situation. Philip Andrada transformed into a weak-necked academician. It's the punchline of a sophomoric joke."

Reynard doesn't manage a smile, but he sits up, and anger enters his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"是，这局面我清楚。Philip Andrada 变成了一个缩着脖子的院士。这像个幼稚笑话的包袱。"

Reynard 没能挤出笑容，但他坐直了，声音里多了怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "And he was killed, I know. Boo-hoo."

Reynard sits up, anger entering his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"而且他死了，我知道。真惨。"

Reynard 坐直身子，声音里透出怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I've sent a representative to express my displeasure; many of my Gens' offspring, and of my clients besides, attend the Galatia Academy and I won't hold with assassination."

He scoffs, annoyed, then brushes the issue away. His anger, at least, is directed elsewhere.

"We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh:
"我已派了一名代表去表达不满；我氏族里许多子弟，还有不少附庸的子弟，都在 Galatia 学院就读。我容不下暗杀这种事。"

他恼火地哼了一声，随即把这事拂开。至少，他的怒气是冲着别处去的。

"此事不必再提。"

texts.en:
"I've sent a representative to express my displeasure. Many of my Gens' offspring, and of my clients besides, attend the Galatia Academy and I won't hold with assassinations."

He scoffs, annoyed, then brushes the issue away. His anger, at least, is directed elsewhere.

"We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh:
"我已派了一名代表去表达不满。我氏族里许多子弟，还有不少附庸的子弟，都在 Galatia 学院就读。我容不下暗杀。"

他恼火地哼了一声，随即把这事拂开。至少，他的怒气是冲着别处去的。

"此事不必再提。"

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

texts.en:
"So?"

His hands are upturned, empty - to show what you've given.

"IF Fleet Intelligence determines your 'critical intel' is of any use, then I'll be impressed. Don't waste my time groveling."
texts.zh:
"所以？"

他摊开双手，掌心空空——这就是你交上来的东西。

"如果舰队情报部认定你这份'关键情报'有点用处，我才会对你刮目相看。别浪费时间在我面前摇尾乞怜。"

options.en: I'd like your advice concerning a... development in the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我想听听你的意见，关于辛达强权那边的一桩...新动向。

texts.en:
"This is about those files, isn't it."

He gives you an accusing look.

"You decrypted them. And now... what?"
texts.zh:
"这是为了那些文件，是吧。"

他用责备的目光看着你。

"你把它们解开了。然后呢...你想怎么样？"

texts.en:
He looks suspicious.

"Production problems in the fuel industry, disruption of the supply chain? Hmm," he taps at a TriPad. "I've got capital to work with on the fuel angle..."

Arroyo looks up from reviewing his charts and portfolios. "Or is this more. It is, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他面露怀疑。

"燃料产业的生产出了问题，供应链断了？嗯，\"他敲了敲 TriPad，\"燃料这块我手上有资金可以动..."

Arroyo 从他那堆图表和投资组合上抬起头。"还是说，这事比那更大。是的，更大，对吧。"

options.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

options.en: Is this going to stress you out? Should I stop?
options.zh: 这事会让你压力太大吗？要不要我不说了？

options.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

options.en: Never mind, I don't want to stress you out.
options.zh: 算了，我不想给你添压力。

texts.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems.

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
texts.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那些似乎是 Andrada 克隆儿子的人——七个，分散在七个星系。

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

texts.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed a few, and each seems to have been raised in unique circumstances...

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
texts.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那似乎是七个散布在七个星系里的 Andrada 克隆儿子。你已确认了其中几个，而每一个似乎都是在各自独特的环境里养大的...

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

texts.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed most of the files' content, finding clones of Andrada raised in various unique circumstances... and there may be a conspiracy targeting them.

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
texts.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那似乎是七个散布在七个星系里的 Andrada 克隆儿子。文件的内容你已核实了大半：这些 Andrada 的克隆体成长于各不相同、各自独特的环境...而且，似乎有一场阴谋正冲着他们而去。

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

options.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
options.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

options.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
options.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

options.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
options.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

texts.en:
He takes a deep breath, then slowly lets it out.

"I see," he says finally. "So what?"
texts.zh:
他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出来。

"我明白了，\"他终于开口，\"所以呢？"

texts.en: "I think we're done with that." He picks up a TriPad. "Anything else?"
texts.zh: "我看这事就到此为止吧。\"他拿起 TriPad，\"还有别的事？"

options.en: This is important. What's your read on the situation?
options.zh: 这事很重要。你怎么看眼下的局面？

options.en: Don't you think this is important?
options.zh: 你不觉得这事很重要吗？

options.en: Why aren't you surprised by the clones?
options.zh: 你为什么对克隆体一点也不意外？

options.en: Can you profit from this?
options.zh: 你能从中获利吗？

options.en: So what should I do?
options.zh: 那我该怎么做？

options.en: I think we're done with this subject.
options.zh: 这个话题就到此为止吧。

texts.en:
"Never said it wasn't," he says. "If you detect a certain exasperation in my manner credit it to your recklessness."

He takes a steady, calming breath.

"And I can't say I'm the least bit surprised Andrada had this scheme cooking for... since the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. Makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh:
"我可没说过它不重要，\"他说，\"你要是在我身上瞧出一股不耐烦，那得记在你自己的鲁莽账上。"

他稳稳吸了一口气，把心气压下去。

"而且我一点也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅计划...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候就在炖了。以他的基本面，这很说得通。"

texts.en: "Sure," he says. "And I'm not surprised Andrada had something like this cooking... from the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. It makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"我也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅东西...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候起就在炖了。以他的基本面来看，这很合理。"

texts.en:
"Imagine you're an egotistical maniac," he gives you a look. "Not merely egotistical a normal, justified amount, like me. Imagine a real loose fitting."

"If you really needed a backup, you could create children. Clones are a step better, though. More control. A more perfect vessel because you can count on them looking like you, more or less. Appeals to the ego, right?"

"Setting that aside, your first option would be life-extension, of course. But what if you're a paranoid dictator under tech restrictions and constant threat of hostile covert ops? Hard to find life-extension care you can trust."
texts.zh:
"想象你是个自大狂，\"他瞥了你一眼，\"不是像我这样，只自大到正常、合理的分量。想象一个彻底脱了缰的。"

"如果你真需要一个备份，你可以生孩子。克隆体要更进一步：更好控制。也更像一件完美的容器——你差不多能指望他们长得像你。这对自大狂很有吸引力，对吧？"

"撇开这个不谈，你的首选当然是延寿手段。可要是你是个偏执的独裁者，受着技术管制，还时刻面临敌对秘密行动的威胁呢？你很难找到信得过的延寿医疗。"

options.en: Why?
options.zh: 为什么？

texts.en:
He rubs his fingers through his beard, thoughtful.

"They're delicate operations, potentially long recovery time. Need to stay awake to make sure no one gets any ideas. So do it quick and sophisticated. Domain-era tech like that has a limited pool of practitioners, and they're closely watched."

"Imagine if even one technician was compromised. Could do it subtle, switch a few codes in a custom protein-nanite top-up... built-in delay, make whatever went wrong look natural. Or like the fault of someone else."

Arroyo puts his hands behind his head, and leans back in his luxurious chair.

"Glad I'm not him."
texts.zh:
他手指捋过胡须，若有所思。

"那些手术都很精细，恢复期可能很长。你得保持清醒，好确保没人动歪心思。所以要做得又快又精。那种人之领时代的技术，能上手的人本来就没几个，而且都被盯得很紧。"

"想想看，只要有一个技师被人拿住了。动手可以很隐蔽：在定制的蛋白纳米补剂里换掉几个编码...设好延迟，让出问题的地方看起来是自然发生，或者像是别人的过失。"

Arroyo 双手枕到脑后，往他那张奢华的椅子里一靠。

"幸好我不是他。"

options.en: Are you saying Philip Andrada was murdered by a life extension treatment?
options.zh: 你是说 Philip Andrada 是被人用延寿治疗害死的？

texts.en:
"Does it matter what got him?"

He manages the suggestion of a shrug; not easy in his pose.

"I'm saying it could be done. And if I wanted to live a long, happy life - and I do - then I wouldn't go around making major powers of the Persean Sector my enemy."
texts.zh:
"他是怎么倒下的，有区别吗？"

他勉强做出一个耸肩的样子——以他这个姿势，可不容易。

"我是说，这种事办得到。而我要想长命百岁、过得舒坦——我确实想——那我就不会到处把英仙座星域的大势力都树成敌人。"

texts.en:
"Oh yes," he says confidently.

"And I'll consider my advice to you in this conversation to be sufficient payment for the tip-off. So don't try angling for a cut. You've got to do the work yourself."

He smirks.
texts.zh:
"哦，那当然，"他答得很笃定。

"至于这次谈话里给你的这些建议，我就当作够付你那份情报的钱了。所以别想着再从我这儿分一杯。活儿得你自己去干。"

他嘴角一撇，笑了。

texts.en:
"If I were you," he says, "I'd forget about all of it, sell my fleet, and invest in something stable so I could live a long, comfortable life."

He glares at you pre-emptively. "And if you don't like that advice, you shouldn't have asked in the first place."
texts.zh:
"要是我是你，\"他说，\"我就把这一切都忘掉，把舰队卖掉，投点稳当的产业，好让自己长长久久、安安稳稳地过完这辈子。"

他抢先瞪了你一眼。"你要是不爱听这建议，当初就不该来问。"

texts.en:
"Good. Me too." He picks up a TriPad.

"Anything else going on? Maybe something nice? Something that won't get poison slipped in my dinner or get me arrested by a covert-ops snatch-squad?"
texts.zh:
"很好。我也一样。"他拿起 TriPad。

"还有别的事吗？来点好消息？那种不会有人往我晚饭里下毒、也不会害我被秘密行动组的抓人小队逮走的事？"

texts.en:
"No. I'm already stressed out because you brought this up, whatever 'this' is."

He leans back. "Besides, I have good chems for this sort of thing."

"Now, explain."
texts.zh:
"不。你一提这事我就已经有压力了，管它'这事'是什么。"

他往后一靠。"再说，这种事我有上好的药剂。"

"现在，说吧。"

options.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

texts.en:
"I'm already stressed out imagining what insane scheme you've tied yourself up in this time."

"Now, explain."
texts.zh:
"光是想象你这次又把自己缠进了什么疯癫的勾当，我就够有压力的了。"

"现在，说吧。"

options.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

options.en: I bring a gift. (give him Leonidas Andrada)
options.zh: 我带来了一件礼物。 （把 Leonidas Andrada 交给他）

texts.en:
You order Leonidas' cryopod prepared. A drone-carrier is prepped for the transfer, its cargo cradled gently by an octet of clamp-arms.

Hector is intrigued, waving off what can only be objections on the receiving end from his attendants and bridge officers. Warnings not to accept indeterminate packages from dubious spacers.

"Tell me, captain, what is this gift?"
texts.zh:
你下令准备好 Leonidas 的冷冻舱。一架无人运输机为转运做好了准备，八条钳臂轻轻托住舱体。

Hector 来了兴致，挥手挡开了通讯那头侍从与舰桥军官的反对——无非是在警告他别收下来历不明的太空佬递上的不明包裹。

"告诉我，舰长，这是什么礼物？"

options.en: Your clone-brother, Leonidas Andrada. In cryosleep.
options.zh: 你的克隆兄弟，Leonidas Andrada。在冷冻休眠中。

texts.en:
An alarmed look. "But Dolos-"

Hector shuts his mouth, giving you a wary look.

"My clone-brother." He nods, slowly. Remembering to appear ruthless and in control at all times.

"A most unique and fitting gift, spacer. You shall have to tell me... your version of events. Someday. Perhaps my brother will... become useful one day."

By Hector's look, you don't think he has rehabilitation in mind; they are one flesh, after all.
texts.zh:
他神色一惊。"可 Dolos——"

Hector 把话咽了回去，警惕地看着你。

"我的克隆兄弟。"他缓缓点头，没忘记要时刻显得冷酷、尽在掌握。

"一份绝无仅有、恰到好处的礼物，太空佬。你总得跟我讲讲...你那个版本的说法。改天吧。也许我这位兄弟有朝一日...会变得有用。"

看 Hector 的神情，你不觉得他打的是让人康复的主意；毕竟，他们本是一体。

texts.en:
"Sometimes I ponder what my life would be in the Domain - an uncollapsed Domain, that is," $heOrShe says, contemplative. "A glittering sea of living worlds, each filled with history."

"Though I suspect someone who went needling around asking uncomfortable questions might get into a spot of trouble, eh?" $HeOrShe gives an unacademic snort. "I've managed to produce enough of that - trouble, I mean - for myself in the here-and-now. If you don't anger the institutions you're not doing good work, I think."
texts.zh:
"有时我会想，如果我生活在 人之领 里 —— 一个未崩溃的 人之领 里 —— 我会过得怎样。" $heOrShe沉思着说，"那是一片由无数鲜活世界所构成的光辉之海，每一个世界都充满了历史。"

"虽然我怀疑，在那里到处问些令人不快的问题的人，可能会惹上一点麻烦，嗯？" $HeOrShe发出一声不那么学者的哼笑。"我在现实世界中已经给自己惹了足够的 —— 我是说，麻烦。我认为，如果你没有激怒那些机构，那么你的工作就做得不够好。"

texts.en:
"Oh 'Infernium', yes yes. It's a bit of Luddic vernacular, refers to antimatter starship fuel. Though what they really mean," and here $heOrShe stresses the word, "is rather more."

"In certain texts the term encompasses all AM applications, or even all high-energy processes. 'The get of Mammon and Belial', one creative firebrand called it. I like that one; I've always enjoyed the dramatic rhetoric of Luddic folk-preaching tradition."
texts.zh:
"哦，'地狱火'，就是这个。这个有点卢德风格的俚语，指的是反物质星舰燃料。尽管地狱火这个词，" $heOrShe着重强调了这个单词，"实际上还有更多含义。"

"在某些文档中，这个词涵盖了所有反物质相关应用，乃至于所有高能过程。一位有创意的激进分子将其称为 '恶魔玛门与恶魔彼列之孽出'。我喜欢这个说法；我一直很喜欢卢德民间布道时常用的那种戏剧性修辞方式。"

texts.en:
"Now I may be old, but there are older by far. If the records are to be believed - and I do believe, the Hegemony keeps very good records - then the pirate Warlord Kanta was born well before the Collapse. Or shall we call her ex-Domain Armada officer Jorien Kanta?" $HeOrShe looses a wheezing laugh.

"Oh yes, she had a name like anyone else, once upon a time. One wonders if it's expensive biomods or periodic cryosleep that keeps her going. I'd love to find out..."
texts.zh:
"现在我可能老了，但是比我老的多的可海了去了。如果这些记录可靠的话 —— 我当然相信它们是可靠的，毕竟 霸主 的记录一向保存得相当完备 —— 那么海盗军阀 Kanta 出生于大崩塌发生的很久之前。或者我们应该称她为前 人之领 舰队军官 Jorien Kanta？" $HeOrShe发出一阵喘息般的笑声。

"是的，她曾经和其他人一样有名有姓。真令人好奇，究竟是昂贵的生物改造，还是定期的低温休眠，才让她得以续命至今。我倒是很想弄明白呢..."

texts.en:
"Hmm, history is not all the study of 'great leaders', but one can't help but admire a narrative of glorious victory, hubris, and ignominious end. Philip Andrada, for instance."

$HisOrHer gaze drifts into the past as $heOrShe speaks, "I remember like it was yesterday. He embodied all that was proud and good in the Hegemony. Practically deified on every holo following his defeat of the Warlord Loke. Oh, how we celebrated at that news! It was the vanquishing of chaos itself, the dawn of a new golden age. So it felt, once."

"His turn wounded us," $heOrShe says softly. "It wounded the Hegemony itself, very deeply." $HeOrShe nods to $himOrHerself, drifting back into some old memory.
texts.zh:
"嗯，历史并非仅仅是对 '伟大领袖' 的研究，但那些关于辉煌胜利、傲慢骄纵，最终身败名裂的故事，总是令人不禁心驰神往。比如 Philip Andrada。"

$heOrShe一边说着，目光一边飘向了遥远的过去，"我至今记忆犹新，清晰地仿佛就发生在昨天。他曾是 霸主 的骄傲与一切良善品质的化身。在击败军阀 Loke 之后，几乎所有的全息影像都将他奉若神明。哦，当初我们听到这个消息时，是何等地欢欣鼓舞！那仿佛代表我们已经彻底战胜混乱，迎来了一个崭新黄金时代的曙光。至少当时我们是这样的感觉。"

"他的背叛刺痛了我们，" $heOrShe轻声说道，"也深深地刺痛了 霸主。" $HeOrShe若有所思地点了点头，又陷入了某些旧日的回忆之中。

texts.en:
"I've considered cryosleep. Pay the fee, jump ahead a hundred cycles to see how everything turns out. As a historian, by the stars, it's quite an appeal! On the other hand - yes, yes - I know the statistics. The failure rates are low nowadays... if you find a good vault. But it still scares me. You could just go to sleep and never wake up."

$HeOrShe laughs darkly, "Though that's every single day, isn't it? Ah, I have too much work to do, anyway..."
texts.zh:
"我考虑过低温休眠。支付费用，一跃跳过一百个星历年，去看看一切最终会走向何方。作为历史学家，天哪，这诱惑着实不小！但话又说回来 —— 对，对 —— 我很清楚那些统计数据。如今失败率确实很低了... 前提是，你能找到一个靠谱的休眠舱。这依然令我心惊胆战，你可能会就这样睡着，然后永远也醒不过来了。"

$HeOrShe阴郁地笑了笑，"不过，那不就是每天的常态吗？唉，不管怎么说，我还有太多的工作要做..."

texts.en:
"Aliens! Hah. No, there's nothing well documented enough to be considered," $heOrShe stresses the words, "Legitimate History."

"Yes yes, if you want to experience xenolife, visit Jangala and take your pills and quarantine shower."

"But that's simply not what is meant, is it. We want there to be someone else out there like us, someone to talk to, someone to tell us we're not alone, someone to give us answers. Someone who cares. Perhaps we're looking in the wrong place? Or thinking in the wrong way?" $HeOrShe dismisses the thought with the shake of $hisOrHer head. "Eh, but this grows into speculation. Not my trade!"
texts.zh:
"外星人！哈哈。不，从来没有文件证明能那玩意儿存在，" $HeOrShe加重了语气，"至少没有任何正史。"

"对，对，如果你想见识下异种生命，就去 Jangala，别忘了吃药片，再洗个隔离澡。"

"但这根本不是我们所指的那种，对吧。我们渴望着宇宙中存在其他像我们一样的存在，一个可以交谈的对象，一个能表示出我们并不孤单的存在，一个能给予我们答案的存在。一个会在乎我们的存在。或许，是我们找错了地方？或者，是我们思考的方式出了问题？" $heOrShe摇了摇头，打消了这个念头。"唉，但这已经上升到推测的范畴了。那可不是我的专长！"

texts.en:
"We've all heard the stories about the Onslaught battleship, the final weapon that stood against an alien threat." $HeOrShe scoffs, waving a dismissive hand, "As if we live in some milfic holo about brave heroes and vile aliens."

"Grand historical context-breaking contact doesn't work that way, at least in our body of knowledge. It's more confusing; messy and chaotic. It undermines the entire cognitive-ideological basis of society, which is then forced to reform around a great wounding of its very epistemological basis. And always, so many must die to learn these lessons."

$HeOrShe gets a distant look for a moment, then breaks into a sardonic smile. "Not unlike the Collapse eh? Must be aliens." $HeOrShe winks. "For sure."
texts.zh:
"我们都听过 攻势-级 战列舰的故事，据说那是用来对抗外星威胁的最终武器。" $HeOrShe对此嗤之以鼻，一边不屑地挥了挥手，"说得好像我们活在某个关于英勇英雄与邪恶外星人的军事科幻全息影像剧里似的。"

"至少在我们所知的范畴内，那种足以颠覆历史背景的重大接触事件并非如此运作。它往往更加令人困惑，混乱且无序。它会动摇整个社会的认知-意识形态基础，使社会围绕其自身认识论基础所遭受的重创而进行重塑。而且，为了吸取这些教训，往往必须付出无数生命作为代价。"

$HeOrShe的目光一时缥缈起来，随后脸上绽开一丝讥讽的笑容。"就和大崩塌没什么两样，嗯？那也一定是外星人干的。" $HeOrShe眨了眨眼。"肯定是的。"

texts.en:
"Old Earth, mother Terra. From whence we came, long gone. The Luddics aren't completely wrong in their stories. Though, hm, they possess few qualms about 'improving' details to appeal to their quotidian moral framing."

"The historical record is far more complex than that telling, and far more difficult. Far more relatable in the end as well, I believe. Every day we survive by powerful technologies which any one of us barely understands, and which may unleash truly apocalyptic destruction. Mistakes are made, tragedy results; it's only a question of scale."

$HeOrShe considers this for a moment, then begins mumbling a critical response to $hisOrHer own thoughts, "But scale can indeed fundamentally change the quality of phenomena and hence the contextualization of the moral dimension, hmm, quite entirely! Hmm..."
texts.zh:
"古地球，母星泰拉。吾等从此而来，而其早已不在。卢德教会的故事并非一无是处。尽管，嗯，他们在 '润色' 细节以迎合他们的道德框架时颇为肆无忌惮。"

"实际的历史记录远比那些叙述复杂得多，也更让人难以下咽。但我也认为它最终更能引起人们的共鸣。我们完全依赖着我们几乎无法理解的高科技生存，而这些科技甚至可能带来真正的末日浩劫。我们早已犯错。错误在所难免，悲剧由此而生；这仅是规模大小的问题罢了。"

$HeOrShe思考了一会儿，然后开始喃喃自语，对$hisOrHer自己的想法提出了批判，"但规模确实可以从根本上改变现象的性质，从而，嗯，完全重塑其在道德维度的背景！嗯..."

texts.en:
"Though much of the Persean Sector has been effectively freed from the Domain's technology restrictions - without dismissing the Hegemony's best bloody-minded efforts, of course," $heOrShe gives a half shrug to their efficacy, "-this age has not seen any especially great leaps of technological development. Why not? For the Persean League, or Tri-Tachyon among others, the ban is lifted!"

"Perhaps it is that development of highly complex, advanced technologies requires a stable foundation: a large population base with excess theoretical and engineering capacity, a willingness to devote resources to pursuits beyond mere survival. Or war. And yes, war drives innovation - of a sort. But imagine the possibilities if those billions of credits had not been vaporized alongside so many foolish youths... like those I once knew."

$HeOrShe goes very quiet for a moment. "Those old production chips and nanoforges offer a ladder with the middle rungs missing. We fight to reach toward the top, doomed to fall as the step falters..."
texts.zh:
"尽管英仙座星域基本已经有效地摆脱了 人之领 的技术限制 —— 当然，这并不是说 霸主 那些顽固的努力毫无用处，" $heOrShe对他们的成果半耸了耸肩，"但这个时代并未见证什么特别巨大的技术飞跃。为什么呢？对 英仙座联盟 或者是 速子科技 这样的势力而言，早就不存在什么禁令了！"

"也许，这些复杂、先进的高新技术发展需要一个稳定的基础：比如庞大的人口基数，发达的理论和充裕的工业水平，并且要有将资源投入生存与战争之外，追求更高目标的意愿。当然，战争确实在某种程度上能推动创新。但请设想，若是数以十亿计的星币没有伴随着众多鲁莽的年轻人 —— 如同我曾相识的那些 —— 一同在战火中灰飞烟灭，世间本该有多少未竟的可能啊..."

$HeOrShe沉默了一会儿。"那些老旧的生产芯片和纳米锻炉就好比一架阶梯，虽能登高，却已失却其中关键的数级。不论我们如何努力向上攀爬，都注定会因为中间梯级的缺失而跌落..."

texts.en:
"The Human Domain split key industries into separate worlds, although yes, with redundancies - set well apart from one another. If one world which produces hyperdrives tried to leverage their specialization against the Domain, well, what good are they without raw materials? Or AM fuel? Or, indeed, the basic necessities of life and access to markets?"

"How can one rebel when the Domain need only control the local Gate to lay a complete siege? Which one world could possibly stand against the entire Domain?" $HeOrShe gives a grim smirk. "Now we're stuck here, besieged by the Domain. There's no one to accept our surrender but some dead Gates."
texts.zh:
"人之领 刻意把关键产业都分散到了不同的世界上，在保证冗余的大前提下，让各产业彼此相隔甚远。假若其中某个生产超光速驱动器的世界妄图凭借自己的专长来违抗 人之领 的话，那么，一旦失去原材料、反物质燃料、乃至基本生活必需品与市场准入，它又能有何作为呢？"

"人之领 只需掌控本地的星门便能够彻底围困整个地区，区区一个世界又能如何反抗？敢问哪个世界能和整个 人之领 抗衡呢？" $HeOrShe露出了一个阴冷的微笑，"我们现在全都被 人之领 围困在了这里。除了那些早已沉寂的星门外，想投降都找不到其他东西。"

texts.en:
"The Galatia Academy? Oh yes, yes, I once attended. And taught there too, if you'll believe it. For quite a few cycles. They figured me as a troublemaker soon enough, but I was slippery. I played the game. Me! Hah, would you believe that?"

$HeOrShe laughs at some old memory. "Made a few enemies too, I did."

"Did you hear who they put in charge of the Academy? Anahita Baird! Can you believe it? The wolf is tending the sheep now, and that's the truth. The Hegemony has no idea what they've done." $HeOrShe cackles, "No idea!"
texts.zh:
"Galatia 学院？哦对，不管你信不信，我曾经就读于那里，还教了几年的书。他们虽然很快就发现了我这个人是有点滑头，不过那会我早就溜了。不管怎么样我也算懂得那套游戏规则。我！哈，信不信由你？

$HeOrShe回想起什么往事，笑了起来。"我也树了不少敌，确实不少。"

"你知道他们让谁来管理学院了吗？Anahita Baird！简直难以置信！现在是狼在看管羊群了，这可是大实话。霸主 根本不知道自己干了什么 '好事'。" $HeOrShe幸灾乐祸地笑着，"他们一无所知！"

texts.en:
"With Baikal Daud in the office of High Hegemon, I can't help but wonder at what mark his administration will make on the 'Phoenix of the Persean Sector'. The old guard still dominate the navy - that's the Eventide contingent. Those families go back to the arrival of the 14th, of course. It's not an old aristocracy by any historical standard, but the pattern is established quickly enough given agreeable conditions. Where was I- yes, Daud. Man of the people. Ruffles feathers. Like when he intervened personally in the Sphinx ensigns scandal. Hegemons simply don't do that! But he's a born leader, none can deny it."

"That's what is really going to get him in trouble," $heOrShe says, then goes quiet, lost in thought.
texts.zh:
"Baikal Daud 就任至高霸主之后，我不禁好奇他的执政会给这 '英仙座星域的不死鸟' 带来怎样的影响。旧势力依然掌控着海军 —— 也就是 Eventide 的势力。当然，那些家族可以追溯到第十四战斗群的到来。以任何历史标准衡量，这都算不上什么历史悠久的贵族阶层，但只要有适宜的条件，类似的模式很快就会建立起来。我说到哪儿了 —— 哦对，Daud。他是人民的领袖。羽庇一方。就像他亲自介入 Sphinx 少尉丑闻时一样。历任至高霸主们可通常不会那么做！但他是天生的领袖，这一点毋庸置疑。"

"这才是真正会让他惹上麻烦的地方，" $heOrShe说道，然后陷入了沉思，不再言语。

texts.en:
"In my circles- that's historians, mind you, not just old folks hanging around the bar," $heOrShe chuckles at $himOrHerself. "We've made a rule not to argue about Artemisia Sun unless legitimate new information appears. And it never does!" $HeOrShe pauses for a moment, tapping $hisOrHer book. "But you're not a historian, so the rule doesn't apply. Wonderful, you get to hear me out!"

"So: Why was she voted off the board just in time for the crucial military disaster of the Second AI War, then able to sweep back into her office with the credibility of all who opposed her absolutely annihilated? Was it merely a ruthless recovery, or was this a calculated sacrifice of Tri-Tachyon assets in order to consolidate her personal power from the start?" $HeOrShe smiles. "Maybe we can hash this theory all the way through one of these days."
texts.zh:
"在我的圈子里 —— 我是说那些实打实的历史学家，不是在酒吧里无所事事的老头。" $heOrShe自嘲地笑了笑，"我们定了个规矩，除非有新的确凿消息出现，否则不讨论 Artemisia Sun。而直到现在从来都没有出现过确凿消息！" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，敲了敲手里的书，"但你不是历史学家，所以这个规矩对你不适用。太好了，你得听我讲完！"

"所以，为什么她会恰巧在第二次 AI 战争爆发关键性的军事溃败之前，被投票罢免了董事职务？而她又是如何以所有反对派全都名誉彻底扫地的形式卷土重来，重掌大权？这仅仅是一次冷酷无情的东山再起？抑或是一场处心积虑的阴谋 —— 从一开始便计划牺牲 速子科技 的资产，以巩固她个人的权力根基？" $HeOrShe微笑着说，"或许有朝一日，我们可以将这个理论的来龙去脉彻底梳理一番。"

texts.en:
"How we long for some incidental recording of even one of Ludd's supposed speeches or acts. Incredible, is it not, how all evidence of a prophet seems to have disappeared? This, hrm, 'miracle' is of course a point of faith among followers of the Church of Galactic Redemption."

$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow at you. "It is also, officially, a point of policy for the Hegemony to cooperate with this nonsense in order to appease those Faithful." $HeOrShe furrows $hisOrHer brow in frustration, "As a historian, of course, this vexes me to no end. History as experienced by the common person may be a story society tells itself, and distorted as such. Even still! It must be grounded in fact."

"Of course if I did discover a holovid of Ludd's Trial, some fanatic would try to murder me soon enough for distributing it. Not that I could help myself." $HeOrShe smiles impishly, then considers. "If you do ever find something like that in some old derelict, you'd give me a copy, wouldn't you?"
texts.zh:
"我们是多么渴望能找到哪怕一段偶然录下的，据传为卢德所发表的演说，抑或是其所行之事的记录啊。所有关于这位先知的证据似乎都消失了，这不是很不可思议吗？这个，哼，所谓的 '奇迹'，自然是 银河救赎教会 信徒们坚守的信条。"

$HeOrShe对你挑了挑眉。"当然，从官方角度来看，霸主 为了安抚那些信徒，竟也将配合此等荒谬之说定为一项政策。" $HeOrShe沮丧地皱起了自己的眉头，"作为历史学家，我当然对此感到无比烦恼。普通人所经历的历史，或许只是社会为了自圆其说而编织的故事，并因此难免失真。即便如此！历史终究须以事实为根基。"

"当然，如果我发现了卢德受审过程的全息视频，一些狂热分子肯定会因为我传播此物而谋杀我。不过我也无法克制自己不去公布。" $HeOrShe顽皮地笑了笑，随即陷入沉思，"如果你在某艘古老的遗弃船上发现了类似的东西，肯定会匀一份副本给我的，对吧？"

texts.en:
"You wouldn't believe how much of my work is built upon cargo manifests. I have a former student working on Agreus; they send me copies lifted off scrapped memory cores. The real secrets are wiped, of course, but the story is all there, in the lines of onloaded and offloaded cargo compared against the hull mass calculations used by navigation to say nothing of the hyperdrive. History is written in logistics!"

"Take for instance the sheer quantity of food and supplies that 'disappear' on trade routes skimming the edge of the Core Worlds. Statistical sampling suggests that a significant percent of all economic activity in the Persean Sector is 'off the books', and a significant portion of that goes straight toward those who are called 'pirates' as well as the so-called 'decivilized' populations... to say nothing of undocumented populations within the Core itself."

The historian leans close, "The official population census of the Persean Sector could be off by as much as an order of magnitude. It's simply astounding." $HeOrShe smiles, and shaking $hisOrHer head.
texts.zh:
"你恐怕难以置信，我的研究工作在很大程度上是建立在货物清单之上的。我有一个学生在 Agreus 工作，他给我发了一些从废弃的内存核心中提取的副本。当然，真正的机密信息都被删除了，但故事的全貌就隐藏在那里，通过对比装卸货物的记录条目与导航使用的船体质量计算数据 —— 甚至都用不上超空间引擎的相关数据，就已经能看出端倪。历史是用物流写就的！"

"举个例子，在略过核心世界边缘的贸易路线上，那些 '消失' 的食物和补给数量惊人。统计抽样表明，英仙座星域的所有经济活动中，有相当一部分是 '未登记的'，而这些未记录的经济活动中，又有很大一部分直接流向了那些被称为 '海盗' 的人以及所谓的 '蛮荒人' 人口... 更不用说核心世界内部那些未登记的人口了。"

这位历史学家凑近了些，"英仙座星域的官方人口普查数据与事实可能相差一个数量级。这简直太惊人了。" $HeOrShe微笑着摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"Ah, like I was just telling those young folks over there," the historian waves $hisOrHer hand toward a small group which seems to be avoiding eye contact, "- after the trials of the Cold Passage, the 14th Battlegroup limped across the Persean frontier to discover a sector dominated by the Warlord Leonis. The joint command of the 14th struck down that cruel reign and were hailed as liberators, laying the groundwork for Admiral Kali Molina to make a declaration of Hegemony over the Domain colonies of the Persean Sector with the Eventide Diktat of cycle 49."

"The untarnished Hegemony of that time was too overshadowed by memories of the Domain to truly appreciate the political capital at the High Hegemon's command. Short-term thinking prevailed in anticipation of Gate reactivation. Indeed," $heOrShe puts on a look of sad understanding, "How could they have known that discontinuity would persist for so long, perhaps forever?"
texts.zh:
"啊，就像我刚才跟那边那些年轻人说的，" 历史学家朝着一群尽量避免眼神接触的人挥了挥$hisOrHer的手，"在经历了 '冷寂远航' 的艰难试炼后，第十四战斗群艰难跋涉，勉强穿越了英仙座星域边界，发现整个星域都处于军阀 Leonis 的统治之下。第十四战斗群的指挥官们推翻了那残酷的统治，被人们誉为解放者，此后海军上将 Kali Molina 在星历 49 年的 Eventide 敕令中宣示对英仙座星域所有 人之领 殖民地拥有主权一事，也是凭此奠定了基础。"

"当时未受玷污的 霸主 充斥着 人之领 时代的痕迹，没有真正认识到至高霸主所掌握的政治资本。在期待星门重启的预期下，短期思维占据了上风。确实，" $heOrShe露出了一种悲伤而理解的表情，"他们怎么可能知道星门的失效会持续这么久，甚至可能永远持续下去呢？"

texts.en:
"Whoever Ludd was, they were not a mere uneducated rabble-rouser. Besides," $heOrShe lowers $hisOrHer voice, "I subscribe to the theory - held by more than a few secular scholars, though quietly, quietly indeed - that Ludd was not one, but many. I would argue that the present format of the Holy Ecumene Council of Archcurates is a reflection of the early Luddic leadership network passed down through history, institutionalized in the early years post-Collapse."

"Heresy, of course. But the truth generally is," $heOrShe says with a smirk.
texts.zh:
"无论卢德是什么人，都绝非是一个无知的煽动者。而且，" $heOrShe压低了声音，"不在少数的世俗学者持有这样一个观点，尽管他们从不声张，守口如瓶，但我认同这个理论 —— 卢德并非一个人，而是许多人。我认为，当前圣枢机议廷的构成形式，正是源自历史的上卢德领导网络，在大崩塌后的早期被制度化了。"

"这当然是离经叛道的观点。但真相往往如此，" $heOrShe带着一丝冷笑说道。

texts.en:
"The contemporary form of the Church of Galactic Redemption has proven remarkably stable in spite of, or perhaps because of, the chaotic political arrangement of the Persean Sector immediately post-Collapse."

The historian cradles $hisOrHer hands, unconsciously repeating the old motions of lecturing.

"The Holy Ecumene Council of Archcurates rule on matters of canon, authorize and delegate executive functions, and perform certain exclusive sacraments. However they may be censured and even laicized by a supermajority of the Curates-popular! The members holding those more common positions are ratified by local congregations but must be ordained by an Archcurate in good standing."

$HeOrShe sips some tea, then frowns and looks at $hisOrHer cup as if the tea had gone unexpectedly cold. "Of course, it's rather more complicated than just that in practice..."
texts.zh:
"银河救赎教会 的组织形式展现出非凡的稳定性，尽管英仙座星域在大崩塌后初期经历了混乱的政治格局 —— 但或许，正是这种混乱反而成就了它的稳定。"

历史学家将$hisOrHer的双手交叠，无意识地重复着过去讲课时的习惯性动作。

"圣枢机议廷负责对教规教义问题做出裁决，授权并委派行政管理职能，以及举行某些专属的圣礼。然而，他们也可能受到绝大多数 '大众神职人员' 的谴责，甚至被解除圣职！担任那些较低层级职位的人员虽由地方教会批准，但圣职必须由一位资格完备的枢机主教授予。"

$HeOrShe啜了一口茶，随即皱起眉头，看向$hisOrHer的茶杯，仿佛意外地发现茶水已经变凉了。"当然，在实践中，情况远比这要复杂得多..."

texts.en:
"There are those among the Church of Galactic Redemption - the Luddics, in popular parlance - who hold that the Knights of Ludd are an aberration at odds with the original Luddic vision of the Church. Doubtless true," the historian raises $hisOrHer eyebrows at this small heresy. "An examination of what are agreed by scholars to be among the more authentic passages of the Book of Ludd suggest that themes of militancy and 'a knighthood of the faith' are likely intended as abstract references to a sort of semi-sacral militant volunteerism which would range in practice from a civic protest movement all the way to, arguably, insurrectionism."

"The practical benefit of a standing militant order during the Post-Collapse chaos and following wars must be admitted, however," $heOrShe leans back in $hisOrHer seat, contemplative. "And the most vocal objectors within the Church proper argue that the Knights err by degree rather than in whole. The less vocal objectors? Well, we may not know their thoughts for many, many cycles indeed. The Knights see to that."
texts.zh:
"银河救赎教会的各教众 —— 简单点说，就是那群卢德教徒们 —— 竟然拥有卢德骑士团，简直背离了教会最初的教旨。这一看法无疑属实，" 历史学家在提到这一小小的异端思想时挑了挑眉，"学者们公认卢德之书中较为可信的段落表明，武装斗争性和 '信仰骑士团' 的主题可能是对一种半神圣武装志愿主义的抽象指涉，其现实形态本应涵盖从公民抗议运动到 —— 甚至于可以是 —— 叛乱活动。"

"但必须承认，在大崩塌后的混乱以及随后的战争中，一个常备的军事组织具有现实意义的实用价值，" $heOrShe靠回自己的座位上，陷入了沉思，"就连教会内部最直言不讳的反对者也只敢指责骑士团的存在只是路线的些许偏差，而非本质性错误。至于那些沉默的异议者？嗯，我们可能在许多、许多个星历年内都没办法知道他们的想法。骑士团自会把事情料理周全。"

texts.en:
"It is speculated that Admiral Andrada, the self-anointed Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat - or 'Sindrian Mutiny' per the Hegemony viewpoint - is facing a dictator's all-too-common problem of succession. Until now, behind the unified facade of the Diktat, it appears that he has played his major supporters off one another to maintain political stability. Declaring a clear successor would have disrupted this internal balance."

"And now," the historian speaks slowly, rubbing $hisOrHer chin, "with the cycles' inevitable turn and Andrada in rumored poor health, will he make a surprise announcement to designate an heir? There would be a wave of arrests and, dare I say, executions as those loyal and disloyal to the Executor-apparent are... sorted."

"Or perhaps Andrada has a secret family, or a mind-simulation, or a clone, or some wilder scheme?" $HeOrShe barks a laugh. "Speculation on this point seems to say as much about the speculator as about anything Andrada is thinking. I should ask you for some insight!" $HeOrShe laughs again.
texts.zh:
"据推测，海军上将 Andrada ，即 辛达强权 —— 从 霸主 视角应该称之为 '辛达乱军' 的自封 最高元首，正面临着独裁者普遍面临的继承问题。迄今为止，他始终在辛达统一的外表之下挑动主要支持者相互制衡来维持政局稳定。明确指定继承人必将打破这种微妙平衡。"

"而现在，" 历史学家摩挲着$hisOrHer的下巴，缓缓说道，"随着岁月的无情流逝，加上 Andrada 据传身体状况不佳，他会突然指定一个继承人吗？届时应该会爆发一波抓捕事件，我敢肯定，那些人将根据对元首的忠诚与否而...归类，以此决定是否处决。"

"又或者 Andrada 还藏着秘密家族、思维模拟体、克隆人，再或者其他什么更疯狂的方案？" $HeOrShe大笑一声，"对此事的猜测往往更多反映出揣测者自身的立场，而非 Andrada 的真实想法。真该问问你有什么看法！" $HeOrShe又笑了起来。

texts.en:
"If Philip Andrada, the self-anointed Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, were the strategic mastermind he was claimed to be - first by Hegemony propaganda and then his own - then why then did he not simply sweep the Persean Sector in a conquest to rival his greatest vanquished foe, the Warlord Loke?"

"Well!" The historian raises a finger like an orator, then, thinking better of it, lets $hisOrHer hand drop to the table. "Matters abound! Andrada took a portion - but only a portion - of the Hegemony navy in the course of his mutiny. He took possession of the Askonia system and was immediately faced with the catastrophic consequences of the Opis incident, ongoing rebellion, complete lack of logistics, and the pressing need to maintain a credible military force against a vengeful Hegemony. And, indeed, all of this while fulfilling the expectations of key supporters!"

"The true testament to Andrada's genius may well lie in his scheme not immediately collapsing in upon itself!"
texts.zh:
"如果 Philip Andrada，这位自封的 辛达强权 最高元首，真的如 霸主 宣传和他自己所声称的那般算无遗策，那么他为何没有直接横扫英仙座星域，成就堪比其最强手下败将军阀 Loke 那般的征服伟业？"

"问的好！" 历史学家像演说家一样举起一根手指，但转念一想，又把$hisOrHer的手放回了桌子上。"原因当然很多！Andrada 在叛乱过程中仅裹挟了 霸主 海军的部分力量。他虽然占据了 Askonia，却必须立刻面对 Opis 事件的灾难性余波、此起彼伏的叛乱、彻底崩坏的补给体系，同时还迫切需要继续维持一支可靠的军事力量，用以对抗复仇心切的 霸主 —— 当然，在做好这一切的同时，他还要满足关键支持者们的期望！"

"如此说来，反倒是 辛达强权 这套国家架构没有迅速崩溃，才真的说明 Andrada 是个天才！"

texts.en:
"The culture of transient interstellar starship crew and infrastructure workers - "spacers", if you like - has become particularized in the era post-Collapse. Rather than existing in vast diffusion across the Human Domain as a mere statistical category, impossibly detached and undistinguished, they've been localized to the Persean Sector and now form a critical mass of intra-cultural contact out of which distinct commonalities arise."

$HeOrShe takes a moment to catch $hisOrHer breath before proceeding. "Indeed, the majority of interstellar logistics have shifted from Gate to hyperspace journeys. Spacers bear everyday witness now to the ruins of the Collapse and AI Wars. These journeys are haunted," $heOrShe takes on a jovially grim tone. "Haunted, one might say, by history. Indeed, one might suggest that Spacer culture has become quite superstitious in the last two hundred cycles."

$HeOrShe trails off, letting a breath go, looking upward toward unseen stars. "The great dark filled with death and mystery as never before," $heOrShe says, quoting something.
texts.zh:
"在大崩塌后的时代，星舰船员和相关基础设施从业者 —— 如果你愿意的话，可以称之为 '宇宙民' —— 的文化已经变得独具特色。他们不再仅仅作为 人之领 中一个庞大而分散、难以捉摸且毫无特色的统计学概念而存在，而是扎根于英仙座星域，现在已经形成了一个关键的文化内部交流群体，从中涌现出了独特的共性。"

$HeOrShe稍微停顿了一下，调整了下自己的呼吸，然后继续说道："事实上，星际物流的主要存在形式已经从星门改为了超空间航道。这些太空佬现在每天都在目睹大崩塌和 AI 战争的废墟。这些航程，" $heOrShe用一种既愉快又阴郁的语气说道，"可以说，是被历史的幽灵纠缠着。事实上，有人可能会认为，在过去的两百年里，宇宙民文化已经变得相当迷信。"

$HeOrShe渐渐停了下来，呼出一口气，抬头望向看不见的星辰。"前所未有的黑暗，充斥着死亡与神秘。" $heOrShe引用着某句名言。

texts.en:
"Old Mairaath, the center of the old Mayasuran stellar polity, was primed to blossom as a shining beacon of culture and civilization in the Persean Sector, a light to outshine Opis perhaps, once the terraforming came into true fruition."

"Both those lights are extinguished, now," the historian says gloomily. "I suppose they lacked the hard-hearted military-industrial alignment of the Hegemony's Eventide-Chicomoztoc axis, to say nothing of Kazeron and its League. And so on, for the rest of them."

"The worst of us thrive in these violent times, it seems." $HeOrShe seems to realize in the moment who $heOrShe is speaking to and adds, without conviction, "Uh, present company excluded, of course."
texts.zh:
"古老的 Mairaath，古老 Mayasura 政权的中心，本应以文明灯塔的形式在英仙座星域绽放出文化与文明的光辉，假如它的地貌改造工作顺利完成，其光芒将比 Opis 还要耀眼。"

"但现在，这两盏 '明灯' 都已经熄灭了，" 历史学家阴郁地说道，"我想，它们缺乏霸主 Eventide-Chicomoztoc 轴心那种冷酷无情的军事工业联盟，更不用说 Kazeron 及 英仙座联盟 了。其他的政权也大都如此。"

"看来，在这种暴力时代，我们之中最糟糕的那部分反而更能茁壮成长。" $HeOrShe似乎突然意识到自己在和谁说话，于是毫无说服力地补充道，"呃，当然，不包括在场的各位。"

texts.en:
"What precisely the Hegemony does with the 'forbidden' AI confiscated by its technological inspectors, particularly during the post-AI Wars crackdowns, is not - yet - a matter of historical record. And unlikely to ever be, if COMSEC has their way," $heOrShe says bitterly.

"Obviously," $heOrShe continues, "the Hegemony is more conservative in exploitation of AI relative to the Domain at its height. The grumblings of the Luddic population ring loud in any Hegemon's ears, and Baikal Daud knows better than to spark unrest under the present peace-of-compromise."

"Now that said," the historian leans closer, lowering $hisOrHer voice, "The paranoid provide entertaining speculations. One theory tells of secret overminds hidden in far-off planetoids simulating worlds which hold in thrall the minds of billions of bio-suspended human slaves; cruel scenarios playing out in the sick imagination of uncaring AI-gods. Nonsense, of course," $heOrShe smiles reassuringly. "What purpose would such mistreatment serve?"
texts.zh:
"霸主 的技术检查员没收的 '违禁' AI，特别是 AI 战争后各类镇压行动中没收的 AI，到底被用来做了什么，目前没有 —— 还没有 —— 准确的记录。如果 COMSEC 能如愿以偿的话，可能永远也不会有历史记录。" $heOrShe苦涩地说道。

"显而易见，" $heOrShe继续说道，"与鼎盛时期的 人之领 相比，霸主 在利用 AI 方面更为保守。卢德派民众的抱怨声在每一任至高霸主的耳边都响个不停，而 Baikal Daud 深知在当前的妥协和平之下，最好不要激起任何动荡。"

"话虽如此，" 历史学家身体前倾，压低了$hisOrHer的声音，"妄想者们还是提供了有趣的猜测。有一种理论认为，在遥远的行星小天体上隐藏着秘密的超级计算机，它们模拟着世界，并将数十亿进行冷冻休眠的人类思想置于奴役之下；这疯狂的猜测还认为冷漠的 AI 之神会让各类残酷场景在其中上演。当然，这是无稽之谈，" $heOrShe的微笑显得十分宽慰，"这种虐待有什么意义呢？"

texts.en:
"Those who awake from cryosleep who were laid to rest in the time of the Domain are perhaps the most lost of all. Many, though not all, imagined they would populate the far end of a rich frontier; they accepted that they would leave behind all they once knew. Now they all find themselves cut loose from all reference, unmoored in history."

"And who is to care for them? Certainly the Luddics suggest the comfort of their religion. Others take up drink or drugs, or nihilistic detachment which too-often spills outward into destruction. Not a few of the most brutal pirates are former sleepers, you know."

"Where records persist, sleepers who are uniquely skilled are sometimes... recruited, drafted - 'kidnapped' is perhaps the word - by parties seeking insight into some old tech or lost secrets." A troubled look crosses $hisOrHer face. "I admit that if I could, I would arrange for the systematic interview of the sleepers. They would prove an excellent resource to our pre-Collapse histories, provided we keep a realistic understanding of the limitations of first-hand sources."
texts.zh:
"那些在 人之领 时代进入低温休眠，并在如今醒来的人，可能是最迷茫的一群人。他们中的许多人，尽管不是全部，都幻想过自己会成为富饶边疆的开拓者；他们接受了告别过往熟知世界的命运。但现在，他们发现自己甚至被斩断了所有参照系，在历史的长河中漂泊无依。"

"又有谁能来关怀他们呢？卢德教会 当然会建议他们寻求宗教的慰藉。另一些人沉溺于酒精或毒品，亦或者陷入虚无主义的疏离，这种心态往往会外溢为破坏行径。你知道吗，不少最残暴的海盗都曾是低温休眠者。"

"在有档案尚存的区域，拥有独特技能的休眠者有时会被...招募、强征 —— 或许 '绑架' 这个词更准确 —— 被某些渴望破解古代科技或失落机密的势力掳走。" $hisOrHer的脸上掠过一丝忧虑。"我承认，如果我能做到的话，我会系统性地安排对休眠者的采访。只要我们对一手史料的局限性保持清醒认知，他们将成为研究大崩塌前历史的珍贵资源。"

texts.en:
"I find myself with a growing affinity for the developing itinerant spacer culture," $heOrShe gestures to the patrons around you. "They have developed a colorful milieu, worldview, and even a shared mythology."

"Although," $heOrShe leans in, "on a personal level, I cannot but wonder if something of the world itself has changed since the Collapse. Has hyperspace become more chaotic, mysterious; inhabited, almost, by alien phenomena? Or was it simply unobserved, or unreported before? Or were the reports suppressed? Or was there simply not enough intra-spacer contact to reinforce their observations - or shall we put it, for the skeptical -  these shared narrative projections?"

"I am a mere historian and, now," $heOrShe smiles sadly, "I am bereft of the corrective presence of my colleagues in the Academy. I both fear and admit that my documentation efforts might appear to drift toward dilettantism."
texts.zh:
"我发现自己越来越喜欢新兴的流浪太空佬文化了，" $heOrShe向你周围的顾客比划了一下，"他们发展出了丰富多彩的社会环境、世界观，甚至共通的神话体系。"

"不过，" $heOrShe身体前倾，"就我个人而言，我不禁怀疑自从大崩塌以来，是否宇宙本身发生了某种本质变化。超空间是否变得更加混乱、神秘，仿佛被陌生的现象所占据？还是说这些现象本就存在，只是从前未被观测或未被记录？亦或是相关报告以前遭到限制？又或者，当时的流动太空佬之间的接触不够频繁，缺乏足够交流来印证彼此的观察 —— 或者，对于怀疑论者来说 —— 仅仅是虚假故事的集体叙事投射？"

"我只是一名历史学家，而现在，" $heOrShe悲伤地笑了笑，"还失去了学院同事们的纠正。我既担忧也承认，我的记录工作可能会朝着业余爱好者的方向发展。"

texts.en:
"The mind reels at the loss of the Collapse," $heOrShe says. "Set aside even the Domain for a moment, with its population inconceivable to our barely-civilized human brains. Just the fringe world of the Persean Sector witnessed untold death as the thin thread of logistics from the Core, and the Domain itself, was cut. Food, life support, medicines, essential machinery - bled out, spilled into space to become so much debris..."

The historian stares off into a corner, $hisOrHer eyes darkened, $hisOrHer attention become lost in the imagined scene of past horror.
texts.zh:
"大崩塌造成的浩劫令人神智昏聩，" $heOrShe说道。"姑且不提 人之领，我们尚未完全开化的人类大脑无法凭空想象其人口规模。但光是英仙座星域这处边缘世界就见证了难以计数的死亡，当来自核心世界和人之领本身的脆弱物流线路被切断。食物、维生系统、药品、必要的机械 —— 仿佛一切都随着大崩塌化作太空中无数的残骸..."

历史学家凝视着角落，$hisOrHer的眼神变得黯淡，注意力完全沉浸在对过去恐怖场景的想象中。

texts.en:
"Ah, the tragedy of Opis. The sheer scale of loss is incomprehensible to the mind. To this day there are those who fight and kill over the finer points of whose fault it was. I have my position, but that argument over-dominates the story of the Opisean polity itself. Why should those countless dead be defined by their murderer? I find that the beginning of a story is necessary to illuminate the end, don't you agree?"

$HeOrShe doesn't wait for an answer, but begins to lecture. "Opis was a center of population, of art and commerce. Not heavy industry as-such, however - that they exported to Sindria; and agriculture, to Volturn. Out of sight, out of mind. The rulers of the Chartery of Opis grew to see little need in appeasing any but their local patronage networks. Wealth flowed to the center, where influence coagulated; the edges were forgotten."

"Was it once again the sin of the Domain re-enacted on a smaller stage?" $HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer eyebrows.
texts.zh:
"唉，Opis 的悲剧。其损失的规模之大甚至令人费解。直到今天，仍有人为了责任的具体归属的细枝末节厮杀不休。我确实有我的立场，但那场责任的争论已经遮掩了 Opis 政体自己的故事。为什么那些无数的死者应该被他们的凶手所定义？我认为，唯有了解故事的开端，才能看清它的终局，你认可么？"

$HeOrShe没有等待回答，便开始讲解起来。"Opis 曾是人口、艺术和商业的中心。不过，它并不是重工业的中心，他们将重工业转移到了 Sindria；而农业则交给了到了 Volturn。或许是眼不见为净，Opis 宪章联合体的统治者们开始觉得，自己只需要讨好本地的权贵网络即可。财富向权力的中心汇聚，而边缘地区则被彻底遗忘。"

"这是否是 人之领 的罪孽在一处小得多的舞台上重演？" $HeOrShe挑了挑自己的眉毛。

texts.en:
"This?" $HeOrShe pats the paper book $heOrShe keeps close, and consults often. "It is... something of an affectation fitting with my self-image."

"There are independent high-tech manufacturers of such objects which range far from traditional papermaking. The integrated digital interface paper-analogs are impressively functional, but my own notebooks? I purchase them from a Luddic craft guild on Tartessus. Indeed, it is mostly composed of dead cellulose."

"I do produce digital backups," $heOrShe admits. "It is not in keeping with full faith in the spirit of the material, but the archivist and researcher in me cannot abide the risk of losing my notes."
texts.zh:
"这个？" $HeOrShe拍了拍一直放在$heOrShe身边、时常翻阅的纸质书本。"这是... 一种符合我自我形象的装饰。"

"当然有独立的高科技制造商生产着那些早已经脱离传统造纸工艺的物品。那些集成数字界面的 '仿纸载体' 确实功能强大地惊人，但我的笔记本呢？我是从 Tartessus 的一个卢德派手工艺行会购买的。是的，它的主要成分是死去植物的纤维。"

"我确实做了数字备份，" $heOrShe承认，"这并不符合我完全信赖物质本源的精神，但作为档案员和研究者的我，实在无法忍受笔记遗失的风险。"

texts.en:
You pull up the workspace to review the possibilities for decrypting the ANDRADA files.

The inviolate files taunt you. Seven names lead by the surname of the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor.
texts.zh:
你调出工作区，逐一审视破解 ANDRADA 文件的可行路径。

那些尚未被攻破的文件在嘲弄你。七个名字，全冠着辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首的姓氏。

texts.en: Soon their contents will be yours. You have only to carry out your chosen course of action.
texts.zh: 很快，其中的内容就会落到你手里。你只须把选定的那条路走完。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Close the workspace
options.zh: 关闭工作区

texts.en: You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.
texts.zh: 你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

texts.en:
The marines deploy from a cloud of chaff and open-vacuum support shuttles. They're a cluster of glowing points in your tactical display that spreads in a coordinated pattern, almost floral.

Or perhaps it is a web, a net thrown through space, a constellation of chattering nodes allocating firepower, coordinating smart munitions and drone swarms, to envelop and infiltrate the docking bay and its surrounds.
texts.zh:
陆战队员从一片箔条云与真空支援穿梭机中投放出去。战术屏上，他们是一簇发光的点，按协同的队形铺展开来，几近花开。

又或者那是一张网，一张撒向太空的网：一群彼此呼应的节点，分配火力，调度智能弹药与无人机群，只为包围并突入船坞及其周边。

texts.en:
You watch the tactical display as the marines deploy into formation, like the glowing outspread fingers of some fire-god, emerging as squads from a cloud of chaff and open-vacuum support shuttles.

The points on the display spread in seeming chaos, their movements practiced to suggest patternlessness.

Perhaps they are webs, entangling nets thrown through space, a constellation of chattering nodes allocating firepower, coordinating smart munitions and drone swarms to envelop and infiltrate the asteroid base through the docking bay, access ports, and no small number of new breaches created by shaped charge and plasma cutter.
texts.zh:
你盯着战术屏，看陆战队员展开队形——像某位火之神明伸开的发光手指，一个个小队从箔条云与真空支援穿梭机中钻出来。

屏上的光点看似杂乱地散开，那份娴熟却恰恰是为了演出毫无章法。

又或者它们是网，是撒向太空的缠网：一群彼此呼应的节点，分配火力，调度智能弹药与无人机群，从船坞、各个通道口，以及成型装药与等离子切割器新开出的不少破口，包围并突入这座小行星基地。

texts.en: Objective icons flip from urgent ambers to cool greens. It is done, and done quickly. The way is open.
texts.zh: 目标图标从急促的琥珀色翻成沉静的绿色。结束了，而且结束得很快。路已经打开。

texts.en: Objective icons flip from urgent ambers to cool greens all across the facility embedded in the rock of 58966 Elysium. It is done, and done quickly. The way is open.
texts.zh: 嵌在 58966 Elysium 岩体里的整座设施上，目标图标从急促的琥珀色翻成沉静的绿色。结束了，而且结束得很快。路已经打开。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName!"

The mercenary $rank shouts your name like an invective.

"You... WILL... be destroyed."

$HeOrShe turns on $hisOrHer heel, a half-cape fluttering dramatically. One hand is raised, as if waiting to give a fire order.

There is a short pause in which you might insert a word into this drama.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长！"

那名雇佣兵 $rank 把你的名字喊得像一句咒骂。

"你...必将...毁灭。"

$HeOrShe 原地转过身，$hisOrHer 半截披风戏剧性地扬起。一只手举着，像在等着下达开火命令。

短暂的停顿，你或许能在这出戏里插一句话。

texts.en:
"Oh, oh, it IS you, it is."

The mercenary $post is twitchy, eyes darting around, hands in constant motion. You've seen it before; combat stim abuse.

"It is time... to die, $playerSirOrMadam." $HisOrHer eyes manage to focus on you for nearly a second.

"To die, you see. The contract. I will be paid."
texts.zh:
\"哦，哦，真的是你，真的是。\"

那名雇佣兵 $post 神经质地抽动着，眼珠四处乱转，双手一刻不停。这模样你见过；战斗兴奋剂滥用。

\"到时候了...去死吧，$playerSirOrMadam。 $HisOrHer 的目光勉强在你身上聚焦了将近一秒。

"\"去死，你明白的。那份合同。我会拿到钱。\"

texts.en:
The raid hinges on maintaining chaos in the opposition. Feints are initiated along multiple axes, from infiltration squads to seeming external attacks against the Qaras metroplex. All bear different IFF codes or the signs and sigils of local organization's crews in order to maximize confusion.

The EM comms explode with panic and rumor. Your own $shipOrFleet's electronic warfare efforts only add to the operational turmoil.

No one knows if this is an internal coup gone hot, a black-ops strike from an external power, or simply a new pirate warlord attempting to sign their name alongside Leonis and Loke in one bold, swift conquest of the largest 'free' pirate-aligned world.
texts.zh:
这次突袭全看能否让对手一直处在混乱里。佯动沿多条轴线同时展开，从渗透小队到看似针对 Qaras 主城区的外部突袭。所有单位都打着不同的 IFF 识别码，或者本地组织自己船员的标记与徽记，让混乱尽量大。

电磁通讯里炸开一片恐慌与传言。你自己那支 $shipOrFleet 的电子战搅扰，又把局势推得更乱。

没人分得清这到底是一场走火的内部政变、某个外部势力的黑箱打击，还是某个新起的海盗军阀想凭一次大胆而迅疾的征服，把自己的名字与 Leonis、Loke 并列刻在这颗最大的'自由'海盗世界之上。

texts.en:
You watch as the point-squad approaches its ingress through ancient terraforming infrastructure, a trench of roughly fused rock melted from orbit to channel what was once a vast river. The channel was built over and largely forgotten.

The target gang has fortified their compound and deployed unusually heavy anti-armor weapons due to the general alarm. To no avail, however - breaching-charges crumble the floor beneath their weapon-positions and darkly carapaced marines rise from the smoke and darkness below like demons of the underworld.
texts.zh:
你看着尖兵小队向入口靠近——那是穿过古老地球化改造设施的一处缺口，一条从轨道上熔出来的、粗糙熔结的岩沟，当年用来给一条大得惊人的河流改道。后来沟上盖了东西，也就大半被忘了。

目标帮派已经把据点加固，又因全城警戒而搬出了异常沉重的反装甲武器。然而毫无用处——破门炸药炸塌了他们火力点下方的地面，一队身着深色甲壳的陆战队员从下方的烟与暗里升起，像地底的恶魔。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
It is not a real fight.

After a few overwhelming acts of force which lead to minor to moderate injury (and one messy death) on the part of the opposition, the conflict is definitively resolved.

This gang's surviving enforcers have either fled or been subdued by nominally less-than-lethal means.

Their leader is brought before you, a blood-spattered chair set back upright, and he is placed in it by the huge black gauntlets of a power-armored marine.

He's had better days.
texts.zh:
这算不上真正的战斗。

几轮压倒性的武力镇下，对方受了轻度到中度的伤 (还有一人死得很难看)，冲突就此彻底了结。

这个帮派活下来的执法者，要么跑了，要么被一系列名义上算作非致命的手段制服了。

他们的头目被带到你面前。一把溅满血的椅子被扶正，一名身着动力装甲的陆战队员用巨大的黑色护手把他按了进去。

他显然见过好得多的日子。

texts.en:
Inside the compound, the fight is already over.

After a few overwhelming acts of force which lead to minor to moderate injuries (and one messy death), the conflict is definitively resolved.

This minor gang's surviving enforcers have either fled or been subdued by various means generally considered to be less-than-lethal.

Their leader is brought to a blood-spattered chair set back upright, and he is placed in it by the huge black gauntlets of a power-armored marine. A portable comms projector is activated.

He looks like he's not had a worse day.
texts.zh:
院子里面，战斗已经结束。

几轮压倒性的武力镇下，对方受了轻度到中度的伤 (还有一人死得很难看)，冲突就此彻底了结。

这个小帮派活下来的执法者，要么跑了，要么被种种通常算作非致命的手段制服了。

他们的头目被带到一把溅满血的椅子前，椅子被扶正，一名身着动力装甲的陆战队员用巨大的黑色护手把他按了进去。一台便携通讯投影仪随即启动。

瞧他那样，怕是没比今天更倒霉的日子了。

options.en: I was attacked and threatened by your associate.
options.zh: 我遭到了你同伙的袭击和威胁。

options.en: You were so eager to ask me questions I figured I'd drop by.
options.zh: 你这么急着问我问题，我想着不如亲自上门一趟。

options.en: I was assaulted by your associate. Threatened with a deadly weapon.
options.zh: 你的同伙袭击了我。还用致命武器威胁我。

options.en: Why so quiet? You were so eager to ask me questions before.
options.zh: 怎么不吭声了？先前你问问题可问得挺起劲。

texts.en:
He grins desperately.

"You didn't have to go through all the trouble, I- I'm quite satisfied with- And actually I regret- I apologize profusely. I had no idea who you were. Truth!"

He takes a deep breath, assessing if this line of rhetoric is finding traction.

"I was given to think you were a, some kind of... let me make it up to you! The credits I accepted for the job deposit are yours, of course, to cover damages, and to apologize, and..."
texts.zh:
他拼命挤出一个笑。

"你何必闹得这么大，我 —— 我其实很满意 —— 而且我确实后悔 —— 我万分抱歉。我不知道你是谁。真的！"

他深吸一口气，掂量着这套说辞有没有说动你。

"有人让我以为你是、是某种...让我补偿你！我收的那笔活儿定金，当然归你，算作赔偿，也算赔罪，还有..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

Like his underling before him, he spills everything.

He describes his contact, the agent who paid him to try to rough you up, and every detail he can remember.

Askonian by the accent. Military or intelligence by bearing.
Maybe. A professional, anyway.

He volunteers the location of the apartment-safehouse his people tracked this agent to - in case of the need for 'debt collection', of course.

Debts are taken very seriously on Qaras.
texts.zh:
* * *

和他先前那名手下一样，他什么都招了。

他说出了自己的联络人 —— 那个出钱雇他来找你麻烦的代理人，以及他能想起的每一个细节。

口音是 Askonia 人。举止像军人，或者情报人员。
也许吧。不过总归是个行家。

他主动交代了手下摸到的那个代理人落脚公寓安全屋的位置 —— 当然，是备着日后【收债】之需。

在 Qaras，欠债是件极严肃的事。

Askonian by the accent. Military or intelligence by bearing.

和他先前那名打手一样，他什么都招了。

他说出了自己的联络人 —— 那个出钱雇他来找你麻烦的代理人，以及他能想起的每一个细节。

options.zh: 去见那名 Askonia 代理人

texts.en:
* * *

With a gentle 'thump' the breaching charge creates an unexpected ingress through what was once a wall.

Your marines stream through the new gap, the remains of a door, and the (now) empty windowframe of the prefab module. Dust and smoke occlude normal vision, but milliradar and sonics build a more than adequate tactical visualization.

Through the view assembled by helmet-cams and battle-drones - the dust slowly clears as atmo systems detect the unhealthy excess particulate - it looks like this place has been evacuated recently, and quickly. Clothing and food containers are strewn about. A half-empty luggage case idles by the sleep-pod.
texts.zh:
* * *

一声轻轻的'砰'，破门炸药从原本是墙的地方炸开了一个意料之外的入口。

陆战队从新开的缺口、残破的门框和预制舱那扇 (如今已空的) 窗框里涌了进去。尘土与浓烟遮蔽了正常视线，但毫米波雷达和声呐足以拼出一幅相当清晰的战术视图。

从头盔摄像机与战斗无人机拼出的画面里 —— 随着大气系统检测到空气中超标的颗粒物，尘雾正慢慢散去 —— 这里看起来刚被撤离过，而且撤得很急。衣物和食品容器散落一地。一只半空的行李箱静静躺在睡眠舱旁。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The squad engineer's suit mounts a particularly clever electronic warfare module, a sort of up-gunned remote interfacer that trawls every datacache its whisperers can locate within a limited range. Unshielded civilian tech is particularly vulnerable to automated interrogation.

Your technology officer had a team assembled for the operation on your $shipOrFleet and, eager to show their abilities after the slim pickings of the gang compound, they dive into the task of sorting useful intel from the domestic chaff of an entire Qaras apartment agglomeration.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tech officer says, suppressing a triumphant look. "We got a comms record of interest."
texts.zh:
小队工程师的动力装甲上装着一具相当精巧的电子战模块，算是一种火力强化的远程接口器，能在有限范围内把它那些窃听程序所及之处的一切数据缓存都翻个遍。没有防护的民用设备尤其经不起这种自动化审讯。

你的技术官在你的 $shipOrFleet 上为这次行动组建了一支小队；他们在帮派据点里收获寥寥，正急着显显本事，于是一头扎进这活儿，要从整个 Qaras 公寓群的家庭杂讯里筛出有用的情报。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"你的技术官说道，压着一脸得意，\"我们拿到了一段有意思的通讯记录。"

options.en: Start playback
options.zh: 开始播放

texts.en:
* * *

The Askonian is obvious by their demeanor, a face which threatens to break into a look of disgust at any moment. The other is K-O Jove, looking as pleased with himself as ever.
texts.zh:
* * *

那个 Askonia 人一看神态就认得出来，那张脸上随时都像要露出厌恶。另一个是 K-O Jove，还是那副志得意满的老样子。

texts.en: "...am called K-O Jove around here. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business. And you've been asking some interesting questions."
texts.zh: "...am called K-O Jove around here. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business. And you've been asking some interesting questions."

texts.en: "I'm looking for a young man who calls himself Jason Korin. I pay in credits, not favors, and I would appreciate if-"
texts.zh: "I'm looking for a young man who calls himself Jason Korin. I pay in credits, not favors, and I would appreciate if-"

texts.en: Your tech officer chimes in, pausing the playback. "Sorry $playerSirOrMadam, this is the introductions. They do some negotiation. Let me get it to the good part..."
texts.zh: Your tech officer chimes in, pausing the playback. "Sorry $playerSirOrMadam, this is the introductions. They do some negotiation. Let me get it to the good part..."

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Received. A pleasure doing business with a Lion's cub. Now you were with the Ministry of Internal Security, I believe? You're not navy, that I can tell..."\
texts.zh: "Received. A pleasure doing business with a Lion's cub. Now you were with the Ministry of Internal Security, I believe? You're not navy, that I can tell..."\

texts.en: "That's none of your concern Mister Jove. To you I'm an anonymous client who agreed to your absurd price. Now enough stalling, you promised data."\
texts.zh: "That's none of your concern Mister Jove. To you I'm an anonymous client who agreed to your absurd price. Now enough stalling, you promised data."\

texts.en: "You must one day learn to enjoy your work, agent. There must be little enough fun allowed by the philosophies of your grand tiger, or whatever-"\
texts.zh: "You must one day learn to enjoy your work, agent. There must be little enough fun allowed by the philosophies of your grand tiger, or whatever-"\

texts.en: "Don't you dare-"\
texts.zh: "Don't you dare-"\

texts.en: "Calm yourself, agent. I was just pulling it up on - ah, here we are..."\
texts.zh: "Calm yourself, agent. I was just pulling it up on - ah, here we are..."\

Body found, blah blah blah, cremated in a municipal waste furnace. Oh, look at this holo. A nasty wound, isn't it."\

Body found, blah blah blah, cremated in a municipal waste furnace. Oh, look at this holo. A nasty wound, isn't it."\

texts.en:
Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. Shot and killed, if the criminal is to be believed. And not by a Diktat agent. Not this Diktat agent, anyway.

You have no doubt that Macario is capable of arranging countless layers of betrayal and deception.

If you leave now, you might catch the fleeing ship.
texts.zh:
Andrada 的继承人 Jason Korin 死了。照那罪犯的说法，是被人开枪打死的。而且不是辛达强权的代理人干的。至少，不是这个代理人干的。

你毫不怀疑 Macario 有本事布下数不清的背叛与欺骗。

如果你现在就走，也许还能追上那艘正在逃离的船。

texts.en:
This Diktat agent is fleeing with proof - thanks to new discoveries by K-O Jove - that the heir to Andrada is dead.

Was it truly an accident? An agent of the Diktat didn't do it. At least, this agent of the Diktat didn't do it.

If you leave now, you might catch the fleeing ship.
texts.zh:
这名辛达强权代理人正带着证据出逃 —— 那证据来自 K-O Jove 的新发现 —— 表明 Andrada 的继承人已经死了。

真的是意外吗？不是辛达强权的人干的。至少，不是这个辛达强权代理人干的。

如果你现在就走，也许还能追上那艘正在逃离的船。

A look of... understanding, perhaps, grows upon $hisOrHer face.

"I serve the Supreme Executor, Philip Andrada, Lion of Sindria, Conqueror of Askonia! He lives undefeated, his blood immortal!"

A look of triumph crosses $hisOrHer face.

Then a flinch. $HisOrHer eyes go glassy. Blood starts to drip from the side of $hisOrHer mouth as $heOrShe slumps in $hisOrHer restraints.
texts.zh:
一种...了然的神色，也许吧，在$hisOrHer 脸上漫开。

"我效忠于最高元首 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮，Askonia 的征服者！他战无不胜，他的血脉不朽！"

得意之色掠过$hisOrHer 脸。

随即一颤。$HisOrHer 的目光滞了下去。血从$hisOrHer 嘴角淌下，$heOrShe 在$hisOrHer 的束缚带里软了下去。

texts.en:
There's nothing to be done.

The poison was quite potent and immediate. It was held in a small bladder of flesh integrated into the agent's cheek. It would appear on scans as a benign cyst, perhaps, or a small blister.
texts.zh:
已经无能为力了。

那毒药起效极快，且极为猛烈。它被藏在一小囊血肉里，嵌在代理人的脸颊内侧。扫描上大概只会显示为一个良性囊肿，或者一颗小水泡。

texts.en: Your tech officer hovers meekly behind you, TriPad held in both hands.
texts.zh: 你的技术官怯生生地跟在你身后，双手捧着 TriPad。

options.en: What did you find?
options.zh: 你查到了什么？

texts.en: Tech looks almost apologetic.
texts.zh: 技术官的神情近乎歉然。

texts.en: Tech doesn't quite flinch at your voice.
texts.zh: 听到你的声音，技术官几乎没有退缩。

texts.en:
"The Diktat..." a glance in the direction of the medbay. Or its mortuary. "-ran a wipe before they were intercepted."

Tech lifts the TriPad, looks at it, then thinks better of it.

"It was thorough. There's no useful data. Main systems scrubbed, same for personal devices. Can't say whether the data was transmitted or handed off in some form before fleeing Qaras."

They nervously wait a moment, then speak, "Material analysis, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权那边...\"技术官朝医疗舱的方向瞥了一眼。或者说是朝太平间的方向。\"——在被拦截之前就做过清理了。"

技术官举起 TriPad，看了看，又收住了。

"清理得很彻底。没有有用的数据。主系统已被擦净，个人设备也一样。他们在逃离 Qaras 之前究竟是把数据传了出去，还是以某种形式交到了别人手上，不好说。"

技术官紧张地等了一会儿，才开口："不过，物质分析..."

options.en: Material analysis of what?
options.zh: 什么物质分析？

texts.en: "Um. Personal effects. And the ship. It can tell us about where they're from, where they've been, where repairs were made..."
texts.zh: "呃。个人物品。还有那艘船。能看出他们从哪儿来、去过哪儿、在哪儿修过..."

options.en: And does that tell us anything useful?
options.zh: 那能告诉我们什么有用的事吗？

texts.en:
"Crew were a handful of mercs, freelancers, pirates recruited from across the Sector. The ship was refurbished and purchased on Cethlenn."

Nothing useful.

Tech clears their throat, quite aware of this. "What's interesting is the... former prisoner's uniform. It's not custom-fitted."

"For any officer of the Sindrian Diktat, the uniform is extremely important. It's not fake, but it is standard-issue. Unmodified, barely worn. The identity, the name, the rank? I believe they're all false. Clearly this agent was loyal to... the death, but..."
texts.zh:
"船员是几个雇佣兵、自由船员和海盗，从星域各地招来的。船是在 Cethlenn 翻修并购入的。"

没什么有用的。

技术官清了清嗓子，心里很清楚这一点。"有意思的是...那名前囚犯的制服。那身衣服不是定制的。"

"对辛达强权的任何一名军官来说，制服的讲究极重。它不是假的，但只是标准配发品。没有改过，几乎没穿过。身份、姓名、军衔？我认为全是假的。显然，这个代理人忠于...到死为止，可是..."

options.en: So no clear answers.
options.zh: 所以没有明确定论。

options.en: Loyal to who? We have no clear answers.
options.zh: 忠于谁？我们并没有明确定论。

texts.en:
"No," Tech admits. "But it tells you they were trying to hide and had access to official supplies. It could be stolen, but from all indications..."

This time they don't glance down the corridor.

"It was an inside job. From inside the Sindrian Diktat."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tech officer concludes, then scurries off clutching their TriPad.
texts.zh:
"没有，\"技术官承认，\"但它说明，他们一边想藏起来，一边又能拿到官方物资。也可能是偷来的，但从种种迹象看..."

这一次，技术官没朝走廊那头瞥。

"这是内鬼干的。出自辛达强权内部。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"你的技术官说完，抱着 TriPad 匆匆退了下去。

得意之色掠过$hisOrHer 脸。

随即一颤。$HisOrHer 的目光滞了下去。血从$hisOrHer 嘴角淌下，$heOrShe 在$hisOrHer 的束缚带里软了下去。

texts.en:
"I imagine your self-interest will provide sufficient motivation. As you well know, we pay in credits. The prospect of the continuity of technological civilization is an added benefit, is it not?"

"Unless," she pauses, then looks at you over her AR-spex, speaking evenly, "I've gravely misjudged you, and your heart is set on liquidating your fleet, donating the proceeds to charity, and taking up with a flagellant order on Hesperus... no, I've got it- you've been doing a lot of reading; well, watching dark-channel holovids mostly- and have half a mind to enlist as a political enforcer smashing teeth in for the next 1000-cycle reign of some new 'Lion of Sindria'. Did I get it right?"

Your shields hold firm under the broadside of sarcasm deployed by the Provost.
texts.zh:
我觉得你的自身利益就是你最好的动力。你明明很懂，我们以信用点支付。反正对你来说，技术文明的传承和延续只是顺便，不是吗？

“除非...” 她顿了一下，一边隔着 AR 眼镜仔细打量着你，一边不紧不慢地说到，“除非我完全看错你了。搞不好其实你心意已决，打算彻底变卖你的舰队，把全部收益捐给施善会，然后去 Hesperus 加入某个自笞者修会...不，我懂了。你看了很多宣传，大部分都是什么地下频道里的全息视频之类的。你现在完全按耐不住自己想要加入政法部队的冲动，要为维护 “辛达瑞亚之狮” 的千年统治而大杀四方。我猜对了么？”

犹如用护盾牢牢地挡下了激烈的侧舷排炮火力一般，你面不改色地接下了院长的一连串冷嘲热讽。

options.en: I guess we'll just have to see.
