texts.en:
"Your tasks will not be so simple from here on out. I expect you to self-adapt to circumstances in pursuit of the objectives I lay out. And."

She pauses for a moment, considering, before continuing in a tone colder than before, "No matter what you have to do, as long as you pursue the mission goal, I will see that you are rewarded. Securing the future is worth... everything."
texts.zh:
"从此以后，你的任务就不会这么简单了。我期望你能够紧跟我设定的每一个目标，自己主动地去随机应变。还有..."

她停顿了一会儿，思索些许，然后换上了更为冷厉的语气继续说道："不管你采取了什么你认为必要的措施，只要你贯彻了任务的最终目标，我就会确保你得到报酬。为了确保未来... 一切都值得。"

options.en: What do you need done?
options.zh: 你需要我做什么？

options.en: I'm not willing to sacrifice all sense of morality for your 'future'.
options.zh: 我不愿意为了你的 '未来' 牺牲我所有的道德底线。

options.en: I'm willing to do whatever it takes to safeguard the future.
options.zh: 为了守住未来，我愿意不惜一切代价。

options.en: And what if I don't want to help you?
options.zh: 那如果我不想帮你呢？

texts.en:
"My predecessor, Provost Tomas Kallichore, led a series of misguided hyperspace manipulation experiments. Ah, how to put it in layman's terms?"

Baird looks troubled to have to do this, sighs, then speaks: "Captain. Your ships fly through hyperspace with special engines. The Gate network of the Domain was similar, but also very different. Kallichore thought there might be a way to use starship hyperdrives to re-open the Gates."

"Obviously it went terribly wrong, and the Galatia system was cut off from hyperspace when the jump-points were disrupted beyond usability. Though we hear some yahoo found a way to cross unstable jump-points; an act well beyond irresponsible considering the chance of a cascading resonance event- ah, I apologize. That is irrelevant."
texts.zh:
"我的前任，Tomas Kallichore 院长，领导了一系列错误的超空间操纵实验。呃，怎么说得通俗一点呢？"

看起来这确实让 Baird 很伤脑筋，她叹了口气，然后开口："舰长，你的舰船全都利用着特殊的引擎以在超空间航行，这和 人之领 的星门网络有点类似，但也非常不同。而 Kallichore 当时认为可能有办法利用星舰的超空间引擎来 重新打开星门。"

"显然这些实验出了大问题，当跳跃点被扰乱到无法使用时，Galatia 星系也与超空间隔绝了。虽然我们听说一些疯子找到了穿越不稳定跳跃点的方法，但考虑到可能引发级联共振事件的风险，这种行为已经不能只用不负责任来形容了 —— 啊，抱歉，这与当前的话题没什么关系。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What matters is that once the mess was finally cleared up, the Hegemony descended on the Galatia Academy with a technological inspection fleet. They tore the place apart, arrested the heads of the hyperphysics department and several labs, and of course took Provost Kallichore in for questioning."

She turns away. "And, with little delay, sentencing."

"He was a fool, and too trusting," Baird says with contempt. "We lost good people and good research. Scientific breakthroughs are built on the development of theory and, yes, even negative results."
texts.zh:
"重要的是，当这个烂摊子最终收拾干净的时候，霸主就派遣了科技审查舰队来到 Galatia 学院。他们把这个地方拆得七零八落，逮捕了超空间物理学部门和几个实验室的负责人，当然还有 Kallichore 院长，一并抓去审问。"

她面向一旁。"然后，几乎马上就判刑了。"

"他是个傻瓜，而且太信任别人了，" Baird 轻蔑地说。"我们失去了优秀的人和优秀的研究资料。科学突破建立在理论发展上以及，没错，甚至是负面的成果。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I need you to recover Kallichore's secret archive. We need his data from that experiment, and all the others that led up to it. The Hegemony will have kept it. They keep everything. Evidence, you see."

"We shall also need Academician Scylla Coureuse. She was a hyperspace physics researcher, the keystone of the theory team behind the jump-point experiments. The Hegemony, small-minded as they are, only arrested team leaders in the first sweep. They didn't understand that the underlying theory being tested was largely written by one particular academician who was... not suitable for leadership."

"I need you to find her."
texts.zh:
"我需要你找回 Kallichore 的秘密档案。我们需要他那次实验的数据，以及所有导致那次实验的其他前置数据。霸主肯定会把这些资料留在手上。他们保存一切。作为证据，你懂的。"

"此外我们还需要 Scylla Coureuse 院士。她是一位超空间物理学研究员，跳跃点实验背后理论小组的基石。霸主向来目光短浅，在一开始只逮捕了项目负责人。他们想不到，当时测试的基础理论主要是由一位... 不适合担任领导的院士撰写的"

"我需要你找到她。"

options.en: How can I get the Kallichore Archive from the Hegemony?
options.zh: 我怎样才能从 霸主 手上拿到 Kallichore 的档案？

options.en: Do you have any leads on this Scylla Coureuse?
options.zh: 关于这个 Scylla Coureuse，你有什么线索吗？

texts.en:
"Following the aftermath of the Galatia Experiment, the Hegemony technological inspectors seized everything, all of our records and data."

"The most direct approach would involve accessing the data vaults of the Ministry of Technology Standards. They're who you might call the 'AI Inspectors', and they serve that role, among others, for the Hegemony. It would not be trivial." An amused look crosses her face. "But their security has been breached before..."

"I have an old... acquaintance who has been climbing the Tri-Tachyon executive ladder. His name is Rayan Arroyo, and he is based out of Eochu Bres. He may be compelled to assist us with a human asset on this front. I'll forward you the contact information." She taps for a moment on her desk-interface.
texts.zh:
"Galatia 实验之后。霸主 的科技审查员查封了一切，包括我们所有的数据与记录。"

"最直接的方法是进入科技标准部的数据库。他们是你可能称之为 'AI 稽查员' 的人，并同时在其他职位服役。这可不是小事，" 她看起来有些想笑，"但曾经也有人办到过。"

"我的确有个...老熟人，他在 速子科技 的行政梯队中上升很快。他的名字叫 Rayan Arroyo，在 Eochu Bres 办公。或许我们能说服他在这一目标上提供人力支援。我会把联络信息转发给你。" 她在她的桌面终端上敲了一会儿。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Let us say that Arroyo's future career opportunities are on the line," she says.

"Mention me to him," she says. "If you are firm but discreet, I believe you will find him more than willing to assist."
texts.zh:
"这么说吧，这事关乎他未来的职业生涯。" 她说道。

"向他报我的名字，" 她接着说，"如果你的态度足够强硬而谨慎，我相信你会发现他非常乐意提供帮助。"

options.en: Rayan Arroyo. Got it.
options.zh: Rayan Arroyo，明白了。

options.en: You want me to blackmail a Tri-Tachyon executive?
options.zh: 你想让我去勒索一位 速子科技 的高管？

texts.en:
"He compromised corporate security to advance his career over a rival. He understands the value of the deal he made with me."

She almost smiles.

"You will find him quite cooperative once you get past his inflated sense of self-importance."
texts.zh:
"他为了在竞争中胜出，不惜损害公司安全来推动自己的职业生涯。他很清楚与我达成的这笔交易的价值。"

她几乎要露出笑容。

"一旦你忽略他那膨胀的自我感，就会发现他其实相当配合。"

options.en: Do you have any leads on this Scylla Coureuse?
options.zh: 你有关于 Scylla Coureuse 的任何线索么？

options.en: How can I get the Kallichore Archive from the Hegemony?
options.zh: 我该如何从 霸主 手上拿到 Kallichore 的档案？

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"As for the prodigy of Galatia..." Baird trails off.

Is that regret? The look quickly disappears.
texts.zh:
"至于 Galatia 的那位奇才..." Baird 欲言又止。

她脸上的是遗憾吗？这个表情很快就消失了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Coureuse was always an odd fit. Brilliant, yes, but she had a way of being distracted with involvement in, hmm, antagonistic subcultures." Baird waves a hand, dismissing the matter as sociological fluff. "Perhaps the Hegemony crackdown cured her of that childish affectation."

"Her family and, presumably, friends," you wonder for a moment if Baird has any of those, "-are from Fikenhild, in the Westernesse system. You could start there."
texts.zh:
"Coureuse 一直都是个异类。她确实才华横溢，但她总是会分心于参与...嗯...制造对立的亚文化中。" Baird 挥了挥手，仿佛这些不过是社会学上的细枝末节。"或许 霸主 的镇压使她摆脱了那种幼稚的影响。"

"她的家人，以及想必还有朋友，" 听到这里，你忽然好奇 Baird 自己是否也有这类关系，"都来自 Westernesse 星系的 Fikenhild，你可以从那里开始找。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Baird thinks for a moment. "If you are observed looking for Coureuse, you may be contacted by others who are looking for her. That could be useful. You could cut a deal, get some leads."

"Alternatively, her department was operating experimental packages in the $gaFC_starName system. We have detected some ongoing telemetry that suggests these instruments are still in use, though it isn't clear by whom." She taps her desk interface, "I've sent you the coordinates."

The provost looks at you over her spectacles. "How do you want to handle this, captain? Are you a diplomat or an explorer? Do you want to find the probes in the $gaFC_starName system or talk your way through this on Fikenhild?"
texts.zh:
Baird 沉思了片刻，"如果有人发现你在寻找 Coureuse，其他也在找她的人可能会联系你。这可能会对你有所帮助。你可以试着做笔交易，换点线索。"

"此外，她所在的部门曾在 $gaFC_starName 星系部署实验组件。我们侦测到某些仍在传回的遥测数据，表明这些仪器仍在使用中，尽管使用者身份不明。" 她轻点桌面界面，"坐标已经发送给你了。"

院长透过眼镜审视着你。"你打算如何处理此事，舰长？是当外交官还是探险家？你是想去 $gaFC_starName 星系搜寻探测器，还是想在 Fikenhild 靠口才解决这件事？"

texts.en:
"Your status in the Persean League could be useful. Officials might be willing to assist you. The League intelligence apparatus might even provide assistance." She gives you a knowing look. "If they think they're working for the benefit of the League, that is."

"Alternatively, her department was operating experimental packages in the $gaFC_starName system. We have detected some ongoing telemetry that suggests these instruments are still in use, though it isn't clear by whom." She taps her desk interface, "I've sent you the coordinates."

The provost looks at you over her spectacles. "How do you want to handle this, captain? Are you a diplomat or an explorer? Do you want to find the probes in the $gaFC_starName system or talk your way through this on Fikenhild?"
texts.zh:
"你在 英仙座联盟 的地位或许能派上用场。官员们可能会愿意协助你。联盟情报机构甚至可能会提供支持。" 她投来心照不宣的目光，"前提是他们认为这是在为联盟的利益服务。"

"此外，她所在的部门曾在 $gaFC_starName 星系部署实验组件。我们侦测到某些仍在传回的遥测数据，表明这些仪器仍在使用中，尽管使用者身份不明。" 她轻点桌面界面，"坐标已经发送给你了。"

院长透过眼镜审视着你。"你打算如何处理此事，舰长？是当外交官还是探险家？你是想去 $gaFC_starName 星系搜寻探测器，还是想在 Fikenhild 靠口才解决这件事？"

options.en: Take the diplomatic path
options.zh: 选择外交路线

options.en: Take the exploration path
options.zh: 选择探险路线

options.en: Take the diplomatic path
options.zh: 选择外交路线

options.zh: 选择探险路线

texts.en:
Baird nods, "I thought so. There's no problem you don't believe you can talk your way through, is there."

"If you want to change your approach, you must let me know so that I can ensure you have all the information you require."
texts.zh:
Baird 点点头，"我想也是。在你看来，这世上没有不能用你口才解决的问题，对吧。"

"如果你想换一个方法，你必须让我知道，这样我才能确保你掌握所有必要的信息。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"When you do find Scylla Coureuse, I expect her to be unwilling to cooperate. I have provided you with an encrypted message. It is an, ah, a personal appeal from myself to her," she says.

"It should prove persuasive."
texts.zh:
"当你真的找到 Scylla Coureuse 时，我预计她不会很配合。我已经向你提供了一份加密信息。这是一个，啊，我以个人名义对她发出的呼吁。" 她说道。

"这应该有些说服力。"

options.en: I'm sure it will.
options.zh: 我相信这会起到作用的。

options.en: Will I be blackmailing Coureuse for you?
options.zh: 需要我帮你去威逼利诱 Coureuse 吗？

texts.en:
"Indeed," says Baird, looking at you closely. "Her trepidation is a rational response to previous events; the investigations, arrests, the show-trial of Kallichore. But conditions have changed, and she is needed if we are to escape from stagnant local maxima."

Baird turns to the window. "I will call, Scylla will answer," she says. A proclamation?
texts.zh:
"确实，" Baird 说道，一边仔细看着你。"她的惶恐不安是对之前情况的合理反应，Kallichore 被调查、逮捕、公开审判。但现在情况变了，如果我们要突破停滞不前的上限，就必须要找到她。"

Baird 转向窗户。"我将呼吁，而 Scylla 将会响应，" 她说道。这是一句宣告吗？

texts.en:
"You need not be so conspiratorial, captain," Baird admonishes, "Not everything is cloak and dagger, blackmail and bribes."

"Our wayward academician has avoided all contact with the Galatia Academy since the Hegemony arrested her colleagues. I appreciate the rational response to a campaign of scientific suppression, but now she is needed for the role she was always meant to play."
texts.zh:
"你大可不必这么热衷于阴谋论，舰长。" Baird 告诫道，"世上并不只有敲诈勒索和阴谋诡计。"

"自从 霸主 逮捕了她的同事后，我们的这位倔强的学者就避免了与 Galatia 学院的所有接触。我欣赏她对那场压迫科学的运动的理性反应，但现在需要她发挥她应有的作用，一如既往。"

texts.en:
Baird nods, "Of course. You are, at heart, a... an adventurer, shall we say, aren't you."

"If you want to change your approach, you must let me know so that I can ensure you have all the information you require."
texts.zh:
Baird 点点头，"当然。你本质上是一个...一个冒险家，不是么。"

"如果你想换一个方法，你必须让我知道，这样我才能确保你掌握所有必要的信息。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Find the Kallichore Archive. Find Scylla Coureuse. Once you have accomplished both of these missions, the project can proceed to the next phase."

Baird smiles, "And that's when things get exciting."
texts.zh:
"找到 Kallichore 的档案以及 Scylla Coureuse 本人。一旦你完成了这两项任务，项目就可以进入下一阶段。"

Baird 微笑着，继续道，"到那时，事情就会变得有趣了。"

options.en: So that's all?
options.zh: 所以就这样了？

options.en: So what is 'the project'?
options.zh: 所以这项目到底是什么？

texts.en:
She turns to her desk display and starts inputting a command sequence, done with you for now.

"Good day, captain," she says without looking up, "You may check in with me via comms for additional analysis as the operation develops, though I expect you to use your initiative."

"Oh, and I've re-authorized Academician Sebestyen with mission assignment access for your file. Carrying out his little jobs might be a good cover for your real work, and allows us to funnel additional credits to you."

You feel the subtle movement of air as the doors open silently behind you. Mirror-masked guards flank a junior agent who waits to escort you back to your shuttle.
texts.zh:
她转向她办公桌上的显示器，开始输入某个命令序列，看来她和你的谈话暂时结束了。

"祝你好运，舰长，" 她头也不抬地说，"行动开展的同时，你随时可以通过通讯器与我联系，以获得其他建议，尽管我希望你能更多地发挥你的主观能动性。"

"哦，还有，我已经重新授权 Sebestyen 院士向你发布任务。处理他的琐事应该能很好地掩盖你的真实任务，同时也能让我们有渠道向你输送额外的星币。"

你察觉到一丝动静，门在你身后无声地打开。一位初级代理站在戴着镜面面罩的警卫身边，等待着送你回到穿梭机上。

texts.en: Baird's smile does not reach her eyes. "You'll see."
texts.zh: Baird 笑了，但她的眼睛中却没一丝笑意。"你会知道的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Not at all. I," she says this with emphasis. "I was simply attentive when a certain Tri-Tachyon executive compromised corporate security to advance his career over a rival."

"He understands the value of the deal he made and he has come out ahead compared to the alternative. You will find him quite cooperative."
texts.zh:
"不完全是。我，" 她说这句话时加重了语气，"我只是单纯地注意到一位 速子科技 的高管为了在事业上超过竞争对手而损害了公司安全。"

"他明白这个交易的价值，何况比起其他选择，他已经算是赚的盆满钵满了。你会发现他相当愿意合作。"

texts.en:
"Of course not."

She puts on a smile that isn't entirely friendly.

"And I would never ask it of you. This is exactly why I want to give you so much leeway- so you can do this your way. The right way. You've shown that it works; I cannot deny the evidence in front of my eyes."
texts.zh:
"当然不了。"

她摆出一个并不完全友好的笑容。

"我也不会要求你这样做。这正是我想给你这么多周旋余地的原因 —— 让你能用你的方法来办事。正确的方法。你已经证明了你方法的可行性；我不能否认放在我眼前的证据。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Of course you are."

She smiles, and you almost believe it.

"That's why I asked you to help: the ability to set your feelings aside and view the situation objectively. You know what it takes to lead and to prevail. I've seen it."
texts.zh:
"当然了。"

她微笑着，你差点就相信她的说辞。

"这就是为什么我请你帮忙：你拥有将个人情感放在一旁，客观看待事态的能力。怎么带队，怎么取胜，你心里有数。我很清楚。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Ah, the skeptic; of course. As an intellectual, I respect that you don't simply accept my demands due to my authority. I wouldn't have called you here if I wanted an obsequious minion to leap at my every request. I already have those."

"To your question: you would miss out on the opportunity of your life."

She speaks almost casually, like it doesn't matter what you think. But there's an edge to her voice that suggests she does care, very much. "Whatever your feelings, first hear what I have to say and then consider - rationally - what is best. I am confident that you will discover that our interests align."

"So. Hear me out."
texts.zh:
"啊，怀疑主义者；当然。作为一个知识分子，我尊重你不因为我有权力就接受我的要求。如果我想要一个言听计从的谄媚奴才，我也不会叫你来。何况我不缺那种人。"

"现在来回答你的问题：你会错过一生仅有一次的机遇。"

她说得很随意，就像你怎么想并不重要。但她的声音里有一丝紧张，表明她确实在乎，非常在乎。"不管你怎么想，先听听我要说的，然后 —— 理性地 —— 考虑一下何为最佳。我相信你会发现我们的利益是一致的。"

"那么。请听我说完。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You have proven yourself to be... capable," she says.

"These people," she waves a hand to indicate the Galatia Academy, "are very good at very specific things over which they have obsessed all their lives. But they've kept themselves too long in the ivory tower. They're soft. The world is out there," her voice rises, "And we must change it."

She lowers her voice again, speaking directly to you, "And that is why I need you."
texts.zh:
"你已经证明自己...能力卓越。" 她开口说道。

"这些人，" 她单手一挥，暗指整个 Galatia 学院，"他们心无旁骛，在自己的专业领域有很高的造诣。然而，他们呆在象牙塔里闭门不出，久而久之就变得畏手畏脚，明明大千世界近在眼前。" 她的声音越发高亢，"因而，我们必须做出改变。"

她接着又把声音放低，直接对着你说道："那，就是我需要你的原因。"

texts.en:
"I imagine your self-interest would provide sufficient motivation. As you well know, we pay in credits. The prospect of the continuity of technological civilization is an added benefit, is it not?"

"Unless," she pauses, then looks at you over her AR-spex, speaking evenly, "I've gravely misjudged you, and your heart is set on liquidating your fleet, donating the proceeds to charity, and taking up with a flagellant order on Hesperus... no, I've got it- you've been doing a lot of reading; well, watching dark-channel holovids mostly- and have half a mind to enlist as a political enforcer smashing teeth in for the 1000-cycle reign of the 'Lion of Sindria'. Did I get it right?"

Your shields hold firm under the broadside of sarcasm deployed by the Provost.
texts.zh:
我觉得你的自身利益就是你最好的动力。你明明很懂，我们以信用点支付。反正对你来说，技术文明的传承和延续只是顺便，不是吗？

“除非...” 她顿了一下，一边隔着 AR 眼镜仔细打量着你，一边不紧不慢地说到，“除非我完全看错你了。搞不好其实你心意已决，打算彻底变卖你的舰队，把全部收益捐给施善会，然后去 Hesperus 加入某个自笞者修会...不，我懂了。你看了很多宣传，大部分都是什么地下频道里的全息视频之类的。你现在完全按耐不住自己想要加入政法部队的冲动，要为维护 “辛达瑞亚之狮” 的千年统治而大杀四方。我猜对了么？”

犹如用护盾牢牢地挡下了激烈的侧舷排炮火力一般，你面不改色地接下了院长的一连串冷嘲热讽。

texts.en: "Indeed." She leans back, interpreting your response as a stand-down.
texts.zh: "确实如此。" 她向后靠去，将你的回答视为一种退让。

texts.en: He is quiet for a moment, eyes on you. "A thought occurs..."
texts.zh: 他沉默片刻，目光注视着你。"突然想起一件事..."

texts.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.
texts.zh: "哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音刚起，人已经出现在画面里。

texts.en:
Fortuna appears.

"$TitlePL $PlayerName. I expect to see you soon at Yesod."

"Perhaps we will speak further after your conversation with Achilles," she says.
texts.zh:
Fortuna 出现在画面里。

"$TitlePL $PlayerName，盼着早日在 Yesod 见到你。"

"等你和 Achilles 谈完，或许我们再细聊，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Horus Yaribay is well?"
texts.zh:
"哎呀，$PlayerName 舰长，稀客，" 你刚听见 Fortuna 的声音，她人已经现身。

"想来 Horus Yaribay 近来安好吧？"

texts.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. "I trust you are attending to your own business, as I am to mine."
texts.zh: "哟，$PlayerName 舰长，\" Fortuna 说道，听见声音的同时人已出现在画面里，\"想必您忙着自己的事，我也忙我的。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is well?"

It does not sound like an earnest inquiry, somehow.
texts.zh:
"这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音未落，人已经出现在画面里。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 近来安好吧？"

可不知怎么，听着不像真心在问。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough how well you deserve one another."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，想来一切安好吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就知道，你们俩有多般配了。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is paying you well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough just how you deserve one another."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，给的价码还满意吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就明白，你们俩是怎么凑到一块的了。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——这和你在 Yesod 同我谈定的约定，可是正面相左。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod, however purely mercenary it was."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——也和你在 Yesod 同我谈妥的那份约定正面相左，纵然那约定从头到尾不过是桩买卖。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. Her tone contains more than a touch of acid.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is more than pleased with your conspiracy of self-serving fools."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" 话音刚起 Fortuna 便已现身，语气里的酸味可不止一点。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 对你们这伙只顾自己的蠢货攒的局，满意得不能再满意了吧。"

texts.en:
He nods.

"You are most patriotic, $titlePL, I am sure. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work. We shall have much to discuss upon its completion, no doubt."
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 这番爱国心，我信。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。等事情办妥，咱们少不了一大堆要谈的。"

options.en: You should back the Prime Demarchon against Fortuna Kato's scheme for Achilles.
options.zh: 您该站在大统领这边，别由着 Fortuna Kato 替 Achilles 张罗那套。

options.en: I can see why he's the man who leads the Persean League.
options.zh: 我明白为什么他能领导 英仙座联盟 了。

options.en: He's an insufferable egotist.
options.zh: 他是个令人难以忍受的自大狂。

options.en: What do you think of Reynard Hannan?
options.zh: 你怎么评价 Reynard Hannan？

options.en: How can you let that man run the League like it's his own fiefdom?
options.zh: 你怎么能让那个男人把联盟当成他自己的领地来管理呢？

options.en: You mentioned Reynard is backing the Sindrian Diktat. And you're opposed.
options.zh: 您说过 Reynard 在给辛达强权撑腰，而您不赞成。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧。

texts.en:
"You truly believe I should?"

He looks strained.

"I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. To be second is no shameful thing. And I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay... our future which is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always future opportunities."
texts.zh:
"您当真觉得我该这么做？"

他神色有些发紧。

"Fortuna 那套要是黄了，我这一族确有不少好处可捞。屈居第二也不算丢人。我总得先顾着 Yaribay 氏族的周全... 我们往后的路，早和 Hannan 氏族绑死在一处了。"

他顿了顿，慢悠悠地念了句："往后总还有机会。"

options.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
options.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

texts.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主的联络，我很领情，"他说，"更不必说你在 Menes 那件事上的...谨慎。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
texts.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

texts.en:
"His ability, and the success that follows from great ability, are not difficult to perceive," he says.

"Gens Hannan PR sees to that, of course," Horus adds with an ironic smile. "Every victory of the League is Reynard's; every setback, another's mistake... which he is gracious enough to forgive, of course, in public."
texts.zh:
"他的能力，以及由此带来的成功，都是显而易见的。" 他说道。

"当然，Hannan 氏族的公关会确保这一点。" Horus 带着讽刺的微笑补充道，"联盟的每一次胜利都属于 Reynard，而每一次挫折，都是别人的错误...当然，他会在公开场合慷慨地原谅这些错误。"

texts.en: "True though that may be, his accomplishments are notable and do much to justify much," he pauses on the word, "of his presumption."
texts.zh: "尽管这可能是真的，" Horus 平静地说道，"但他的成就斐然，足以撑起他大部分的..."他刻意停顿片刻，再吐出那个词，"...'自负'。"

texts.en:
"Gens Hannan is powerful," he says, "and Reynard a man who knows well how to wield power."

"I respect his station and ability, though he and I agree on few matters of politics."
texts.zh:
"Hannan 氏族势力庞大，" 他说，"而 Reynard 是一个深知如何运用权力的人。"

"虽然我们在政治上鲜有共识，但我尊重他的地位和能力。"

texts.en:
"It is not as if he must ask my permission," Horus says.

He smiles quickly, as if to disarm what might be perceived as the slip of a politic facade.
texts.zh:
"他好像没必要征求我的同意。" Horus 说。

他迅速一笑，仿佛要化解可能被视作礼貌外表下的小失误。

texts.en:
"The Persean League has a rather permissive official relationship with the Sindrian Diktat, yes," he says. "At Reynard's command as Prime Demarchon."

"It is purely cynical. And that I might at least respect if it truly did forward League interests! But to make such allowance for brutish Andradaism demonstrates a cruel hypocrisy on behalf of the ideals the Persean League and its Prime Demarchon are supposed to embody."

He shakes his head, irritated.
texts.zh:
"英仙座联盟对辛达强权，官方上确实宽容得过分，是，\" 他说道，\"Reynard 以大统领的身份一句话定的调。"

"纯粹是拿利害算计。若真能替联盟挣来好处，我倒还敬他几分！可这般迁就野蛮的 Andrada 主义，对着英仙座联盟与它那位大统治理该守住的那些理念，简直是狠狠一记虚伪的耳光。"

他恼火地摇了摇头。

options.en: But... with Reynard, the gens. Isn't this what the League is?
options.zh: 可... 有 Reynard，有这些氏族，联盟不就是这么回事吗？

options.en: And I don't imagine the Hegemony approves.
options.zh: 想来霸主那边也不会点头吧。

options.en: I understand your position. (back)
options.zh: 您的意思我明白了。 (返回)

texts.en:
"No- yes, but."

Horus catches himself and gives you a consternated look.

"Do we simply give in to base motives or do we aim to uphold an ideal? That is the question. The former bears profit and power for some, but it is a... a disease, a parasite, that will eventually kill the host. Without the League, without some common cause, what are we but pirates?"
texts.zh:
"不——是，可是..."

Horus 自知失言，窘迫地看了你一眼。

"是索性向那些上不得台面的私欲低头，还是撑起一桩理想？问题就在这儿。前者能给某些人带来好处和权势，可那是... 是场病，是条寄生虫，早晚要把宿主拖死。没了联盟，没了点共同的念想，我们跟海盗还有什么两样？"

texts.en:
"No, of course not."

Horus crosses his arms.

"And I well understand the point you are getting at. I am no hypocrite for believing that support for the Diktat is foolish for its own sake as well as a barrier to my desire to approach a reconciliation with the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
"不，当然不会。"

Horus 抱起双臂。

"您想说什么，我明白。我一面觉得支持强权本身就蠢，一面又嫌它挡了我同霸主修好的路——这两样摆在一块，我可不觉得自己是伪君子。"

texts.en: Horus nods, his hands held relaxed together in front of him.
texts.zh: Horus 点点头，双手放松地交握在身前。

texts.en:
"You're proving useful to Provost Baird - an admirable figure generally - yet one who stubbornly ties herself to the Hegemony bureaucracy."

"If it weren't for Kallichore's blundering..." Her eyes grow distant - more distant - for a moment, then return to their usual unblinking detachment.

"Here at Tri-Tachyon, we put the highest value in unrestrained R&D. Especially its dividends." She smiles coyly. "So, I think, do you."
texts.zh:
"你对 Baird 院长 —— 一位总体而言值得敬佩的人物 —— 很有助益，可惜她固执地将自己捆绑在霸主的官僚体系上。"

"若非 Kallichore 的愚蠢行径..." 她的目光变得遥远 —— 更加遥远 —— 片刻后又恢复惯常的漠然。

"在 速子科技，我们最看重的就是不受束缚的研发。特别是其红利。" 她狡黠一笑，"我想，你也这么认为。"

texts.en:
"You've proven useful to Provost Baird. And your accomplishment with the Gates..."

She puts her hands together, not quite a single clap for all you've done. Her politely mechanical smile contains some bitterness, you sense.

"I admire Baird, truly I do. Her ability to overcome Hegemony stone-walling, and herding those academics with their notions... sadly, though, it appears as though her grip was too tight. Pity to lose top talent."

The bitterness, you see, has left Glamor-Rotanev's smile to be replaced with something more carnivorous.

"Our R&D is cutting-edge, eminently practical, and there's very little risk of runaways. Our results might match your ambitions, I think."
texts.zh:
"你已向 Baird 院长证明了自己。而你在星门方面的成就..."

她双手合十，却未能为你所做的一切拍响掌声。你察觉到她那礼貌机械的微笑中带着一丝苦涩。

"我敬佩 Baird，真心实意。她突破 霸主 阻挠的能力，以及她驾驭那些学者们的理念...可惜，似乎她抓得太紧了。损失顶尖人才总是遗憾。"

你看见那抹苦涩已从 Glamor-Rotanev 的微笑中褪去，取而代之的是某种更食肉性的神色。

"我们的研发是最前沿的，极为务实，且失控风险极低。我想，我们的成果或许能匹配你的抱负。"

texts.en:
"We see you've taken up an interest with the Luddi- pardon me, with the Church of Galactic Redemption. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so otherwise practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到你开始关注卢德 —— 抱歉，是 银河救赎教会 的事务。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more and better than that. I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Do you?"
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。"

她精准地扬起眉毛，"你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more than that. Better than that. And I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors. That silly little battleship he gave you? A child's toy compared to what I offer."

She brushes one hand off with the other.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。至于给你的那艘愚蠢的小战舰？与我提供的相比，那不过是孩童的玩具。"

她用一只手拂开另一只手。

texts.en:
"Old reports noted your service to Mr. Macario - sorry, 'The Chief High Inspector' - and took has taken you for one of his pawns. But you've managed both to unseat him and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Nonetheless, you and I both know you're more and better than service to that blinkered tin-pot dictatorship. I believe your potential could be worth more than those little bribes and medals they distribute."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Don't you agree?"
texts.zh:
"旧档案里记着你替 Macario 先生办过事——抱歉，是'最高检察长'先生——便把你当他的一枚棋子。可你不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话虽如此，你我心里都清楚，替那个目光短浅的小独裁政权当差，未免埋没了你。我看你的本事，值的可不止他们发的那点贿赂和勋章。"

她精确地挑了挑眉。"你说是不是？"

texts.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Achilles, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. It soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."
texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Achilles——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话哄得住贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Hector, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"Still. Hector? Really? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and barely-concealed murders."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Hector, I believe it's name is - you've managed both to unseat him from his position and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Still. Hector? Really? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and barely-concealed murders."

texts.en:
"I must applaud your patriotism - the Hegemony, the restoration of the Domain!

She makes as if to clap, daintily, but stops her hands before they meet. Then turns her expression toward something far more cynical.

"You may earn the favor of that stubborn 'Old Man Daud'. But is that enough? Surely you tire of that paltry government stipend, the endless regulation? It must stifle your ambition. You must yearn for a truly dynamic enterprise. One in which someone like yourself can change the Sector..."
texts.zh:
"我必须为你的爱国情怀喝彩 —— 为了 霸主，为了 人之领 的复兴！"

她优雅地摆出鼓掌的架势，却在双手相触前停下。随即换上一副远为讥诮的表情。

"你或许能赢得那位固执的 'Daud 老爷子' 的青睐，但这足够吗？你定然已经厌倦那微薄的政府津贴和无尽的规章吧？那必定扼杀了你的雄心。你必然渴望真正充满活力的事业，一个能让你这样的人改变这片星域的事业..."

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you, but not so much that they've invited you to share power as a member," she says.

"Why play the mercenary for below-market rates? You're better than that, I think."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，但并未邀请你作为成员共享权力，" 她说道。

"为何要以低于市场的价格扮演雇佣兵？我想，你值得更好的待遇。"

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you," she looks down, and aside, placing a hand on the empty expanse of her enormous desk.

"But not enough to invite you to become a full member of the League, despite your colonial enterprise." She makes a small sound, halfways between pity and disappointment.

"Consider what you will gain from being a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，" 她垂目侧视，将手放在自己那空阔的巨大桌面上。

"但尽管你有殖民事业，但他们仍未邀请你成为联盟的正式成员。" 她发出轻微的声响，介于怜悯与失望之间。

"不妨想想成为合作伙伴而非从属者后，你将获得什么。"

texts.en:
"You're a member of the League. A junior member, however. Perhaps not in name, but... tell me, do the gens respect you as a peer?"

"Or are you just another vassal to their little empire? Consider your future, captain, and how you might truly achieve greatness."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你是联盟的一员，尽管只是下级成员。或许名义上不是，但...告诉我，氏族势力可曾将你视为平辈？"

"抑或你只是他们那小小帝国的又一个附庸？考量你的未来吧，舰长，思考你该如何真正地成就伟业。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me the truth, are you content to be a mere lackey of our mutual friend Reynard Hannan? He drains you like a leech from atop his so-called League. Let me give you a taste of real business, of real credits."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"说实话，你甘于当我们共同朋友 Reynard Hannan 的区区仆从吗？他高踞在所谓的联盟顶端，如蚂蟥般榨取你的价值。不妨让我带你体验真正的生意，真正的星币。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me, how is Rayan Arroyo? I've always admired his entrepreneurial spirit, but." She forms a little smile that might have been apologetic if it weren't so condescending.

"He doesn't have the killer instinct required for senior leadership. Isn't that funny? But we do need people like him."

"And we need people like you. Go-getters, achievers; builders and destroyers. And what we need, we at Tri-Tachyon pay for. Only the best."
texts.zh:
"告诉我，Rayan Arroyo 近况如何？我一直欣赏他的企业家精神，但是..." 她露出一个本该是歉意的微笑，却透着居高临下的意味。

"他缺乏高层领导所需的杀手本能。这很有趣，不是吗？但我们的确需要像他这样的人。"

"我们也需要你这样的人。行动派，实干家；建设者与毁灭者。而我们 速子科技 对于需要的事物，向来只聘用最顶尖的人才。"

texts.en:
"You cut a deal with the Company after some... assertive negotiations. To our mutual benefit. I applaud your audacity."

Her teeth glisten.

"Such fierce initiative is exactly what Tri-Tachyon needs."
texts.zh:
"经过一番...强势谈判后，你与公司达成了协议。这对我们双方都有利，我赞赏你的胆识。"

她的牙齿闪闪发光。

"如此凌厉的进取心正是 速子科技 所需要的。"

texts.en:
"You've had a taste of working for the Company. A mundane commission, mercenary fare. Boilerplate. Busywork. We'd have automated all that sort of thing long ago, of course, if not for-"

She pulls her gaze back down. "I digress. You're capable of much more. Think of this as the next step."
texts.zh:
"你已浅尝过为公司效力的滋味。无聊的差事，雇佣兵的薪酬。千篇一律。无谓的忙碌。若非某些原因，我们早该将这类工作全面自动化了 ——"

她将视线收回，"好吧，我有些离题了。我相信你有能力成就更多，远不止于此。请将此视为迈向更高层级的阶梯。"

texts.en:
"You're not only an explorer, you're a builder - founding a new colony!"

"It is bold of you to strike out despite the anti-innovation measures sure to fall upon you from the major factions," she says. "I suspect you'll benefit from an injection of capital. For the builder must also ensure that their prosperity cannot be simply seized by the small-minded takers."
texts.zh:
"你不仅是探索者，更是建设者 —— 你正在建立新的殖民地！"

"在各大势力必将施加反创新措施的背景下，你的开拓之举堪称勇毅，" 她说道，"我认为资本的注入将助你一臂之力。因为建设者必须确保自己的繁荣果实不会被眼界狭隘的掠夺者轻易夺取。"

texts.en: "I believe that's enough of that, captain," she says stonily.
texts.zh: "我想这个话题可以到此为止了，舰长，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en:
Her expression is blank for a moment.

"On second thought, I feel no need to justify myself," she says stonily.
texts.zh:
她的表情凝固了片刻。

"转念一想，我觉得我无需自证，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
texts.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
texts.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"

texts.en:
"There are unimaginable possibilities out there." She raises an arm, hand extended, fingers like rays into the far, dark corners of the cavernous office.

You sense the lights dim slightly - a dramatic effect triggered by her cybernetic implants, no doubt.
texts.zh:
"那里蕴藏着无法想象的可能性。" 她抬起手臂，伸出手掌，手指如光芒般射向这间巨型办公室深处幽暗的角落。

你察觉到灯光变得略微黯淡 —— 无疑是她的赛博植入体触发的浮夸效果。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I take the very long shots. There are things," she stresses the word oddly, "Such things out there, captain. Technologies and phenomena the Human Domain hid away, and from. They locked such wonders and treasures up in red-tape concocted by fearful, jealous little minds. They suffocated these opportunities, blinded themselves to unimaginable possibilities."

"The returns from exploitation would be... astronomical. Or perhaps," her eyes glint in the filtered starlight, "They may prove to be of value well beyond that of mere stars."
texts.zh:
"我专攻那些极低概率的机会。那里存在着，" 她异常地重读这个词，"那样的事物，舰长。人之领 曾隐藏 —— 并逃避 —— 的技术与现象。他们用怯懦而狭隘的头脑炮制的官僚程序，将这些奇迹与珍宝禁锢起来。他们扼杀了这些机遇，对无法想象的可能性视而不见。"

"开发这些事物带来的回报将是...天文数字。或者，" 她的眼眸在过滤的星光下闪烁着，"它们可能被证明拥有远超星辰的价值。"

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology are of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

options.en: I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you.
options.zh: 我在深渊里遇到了一些佣兵，他们似乎对和你的交易颇为后悔。

texts.en: "The Perseus-Orion Abyss is a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, present company excepted. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "英仙座-猎户座深渊 是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en: "You know of the Perseus-Orion Abyss; a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, excepting present company. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "你听说过 英仙座-猎户座深渊 吗？真是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You went there, and there you found the Onslaught Mk.I... and the 'Threat'."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"I very much desire to have a look at the Mk.I."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你去过那里，并在那里发现了 攻势 Mk.I...以及 '威胁'。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"我非常希望能亲自看看 Mk.I。"

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You know of the 'Threat'." She looks away. "A typically non-descriptive name passed to us from some primitive government committee, I'm sure."

"You found Academician Cornelius Elek's enigma, the Onslaught Mk.I... among other things."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"This is what I want."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你也知道 '威胁'。" 她移开视线，"我敢肯定，这又是某个简陋的政府委员会所传达给我们的一个毫无描述性的名字。"

"你找到了 Cornelius Elek 院士的谜题，攻势 Mk.I...以及其他东西。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"这正是我想要的。"

options.en: You know a lot about what I've been doing.
options.zh: 你很了解我做过的事情。

options.en: You've been prompting Elek. How'd you know where to make him look?
options.zh: 你一直在诱导 Elek，你怎么知道该让他往哪里探索？

options.en: ...You want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
options.zh: ...你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I？

options.en: But what IS it?
options.zh: 但它究竟是什么？

options.en: How will I know when I find it?
options.zh: 我怎么知道自己找到了它？

options.en: I've seen them. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss.
options.zh: 我见过它们。那潜伏在深渊深处的，古老的自动化作战舰队。

options.en: I've encountered... entities in the Abyss. Non-material, high energy. Hostile.
options.zh: 我在深渊中遭遇过...一些实体，它们没有物质形态，能量极高，且敌对。

options.en: I've seen ancient warfleets deep in the abyss. And... non-material hostile entities.
options.zh: 我见过深渊深处古老的作战舰队。还有... 非物质态的敌对实体。

options.en: I've never encountered such a thing. (lie)
options.zh: 我从未遭遇过这种东西。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"Crews talk, TriPads listen. There is little I cannot know if I so wish," she says, injecting a tone of boredom into her words.

"Accept it. Now let's speak of business."
texts.zh:
"船员会闲聊，TriPad 会监听。只要我意愿，便鲜有不能知晓之事，" 她的话语中掺入一丝厌倦的腔调。

"接受现实吧。现在让我们谈谈正事。"

texts.en:
"Old records," she says curtly.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. Their lack of self-motivation is self-evident."
texts.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

texts.en:
She laughs with a buzz like a malfunctioning agrav plate.

"Oh, no. That'd be far too provocative to..." She gives a little flick of the hand, indicating enemies too irrelevant to bother acknowledging in speech.

The Hegemony, maybe.

"However," she fixes upon you. "I would gladly pay for the opportunity to have my people take a close look at it. And take a few samples, very small, nothing damaging."
texts.zh:
她的笑声像故障的反重力板般震颤作响。

"哦，不。那未免过于挑衅..." 她轻轻摆手，示意某些敌人不值一提，甚至不配被言语提及。

那或许是指 霸主。

"不过，" 她的目光锁定于你，"我很乐意为我的团队争取近距离研究的机会，并提取少量样本 —— 极其微小，绝无损害。"

options.en: You can't detect them, can you. That's what you want.
options.zh: 你无法探测到它们，对吧。这就是你想要的。

texts.en:
She blinks. "Detect them?"

Her voice is emotionless.
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼。"探测它们？"

她的声音没有任何情绪。

options.en: The Threat. They're all but invisible to you.
options.zh: '威胁'，它们对你而言几乎不可见。

texts.en:
Her face arranges itself into a shape suggesting dismissive amusement.

"What an interesting theory, captain. Whatever my motives, will you agree to my proposal? A simple look, a few scans. A few samples."
texts.zh:
她的脸上显露出一种轻蔑的趣味。

"多么有趣的理论，舰长。无论我的动机如何，你是否同意我的提议？只需要简单的观察，几次扫描，以及少许样本。"

options.en: One million credits.
options.zh: 一百万星币。

options.en: Let's discuss this later.
options.zh: 之后再谈吧。

texts.en:
A long pause. Her eyes flicker, accessing. Calculating.

"This is possible." She speaks with an emotion suddenly present - quiet displeasure, presumably at your maneuvering.

"You ask for much, captain."
texts.zh:
通讯陷入了漫长的沉默。她眼眸闪烁，表明她正在访问数据，计算权衡。

"这是可行的。" 她的语气突然有了一些情绪 —— 一种平静的不悦，大概由于你的迂回策略。

"你要价不菲，舰长。"

options.en: Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions can afford a mere million credits. I accept.
options.zh: 速子科技 的特殊采购部总监还是出得起一百万星币的。我接受。

options.en: Let's discuss this later.
options.zh: 等会再说。

texts.en:
"Done," she says, her voice as empty as the Abyss.

Almost instantly, your TriPad pings with several alerts - credits transfer, but also notification from your tactical officer concerning an approaching Tri-Tachyon portside-tender, swarming with engineering drones, and your comms, forwarding certain docking requests directly to the Onslaught Mk.I.

"Take a moment to ensure your affairs are in order, captain," Glamor-Rotanev says.

You'd think she enjoys overwhelming your officers with the speed of her response.
texts.zh:
"成交，" 她的声音像深渊一样空洞。

几乎同时，你的 TriPad 接连弹出数条通知 —— 星币到账，而你的战术军官也发来警示：一艘 满载工程无人机的 速子科技 泊位服务艇正逐步靠近，同时通讯系统也开始将某些对接请求直接转发至 攻势 Mk.I。

"请花些时间确认事务已安排妥当，舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 说道。

你不禁怀疑她很享受用这种迅捷的回应让你的部下疲于应付的快感。

options.en: Make the arrangements
options.zh: 着手安排

texts.en:
Director Glamor-Rotanev takes a moment to turn and appear to look out over her spectacular view of the Xanadu Geodivision.

You're certain she's watching her teams as they board the Onslaught Mk.I through what are no doubt top-of-the-line cybernetic implants and neural integrations.

And, doubtless, watching your comms. Because just as you are finished, she turns back, resettling her facial muscles with a twitch.
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 总监稍作停顿，随即便转身望向窗外 Xanadu 地质区划那壮丽的景色。

你确信她正通过顶级的赛博植入体与神经集成系统，监控着她的团队登上 攻势 Mk.I 的过程。

并且，毫无疑问，她也正在监视着你的通讯。因为就在你刚刚结束事务时，她便转回身，面部肌肉抽动着重新调整着表情。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I am satisfied, $playerName."

It's not that her tone is warm, more that it lacks a certain otherwise ubiquitous contempt perceivable only now by its absence.

Presumably temporary, of course.
texts.zh:
"我很满意，$playerName。"

并非是她的语气变得温暖，而是缺少了某种无处不在的轻蔑 —— 这种轻蔑此刻因缺席而格外明显。

当然，这大概只是暂时的。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says. Her words come more rapidly. "You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived."

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道，语速明显加快，"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。"

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

texts.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
texts.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

options.en: So you know what it is. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: So you know what it is. Was there another expedition that succeeded?
options.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
"'Was there another...'" she says, repeating your words.

"Dozens! Some returned with nothing, others not at all. I won't conceal the fact from you. Maybe you'll find them, though don't feel compelled to render assistance on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. These were independent contractors who accepted and assumed the risk. Then failed."

"If anything," she says quietly, "we have grounds to sue them if they ever manage to get back to the Core Worlds."
texts.zh:
"'还有另一支...' 她重复你的话。

"还有几十支！他们有的空手而归，有的杳无音信，我不会对你隐瞒事实。或许你会遇到他们，但不必代表 三一速子科技公司 施以援手。这些都是接受并承担了风险的独立承包商，然后失败了。"

"甚至可以说，" 她低声道，"如果他们能侥幸返回核心世界，我们完全有理由起诉他们。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Return with something useful," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"带回有价值的东西，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

texts.en:
"Bring me more... samples. From the Abyss," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"再给我多带些...样本。从深渊里带，" 她说着背过身去，望向窗外——Eochu Bres 的贫民窟里，群峰与闪亮的生态巨城像水晶一样拔地而起。

"我会让你也闪闪发光。"

texts.en:
"Return with more finds," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"带回更多的发现，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

options.en: What are you offering to pay me. Specifically.
options.zh: 你打算给我多少报酬？具体讲讲。

options.en: I could use fuel. Lots of fuel. And tankers to carry it.
options.zh: 我需要燃料。大量的燃料。还有运载燃料的油轮。

options.en: I'm going to need supplies. And a freighter to carry them.
options.zh: 我需要补给，以及一艘运载它们的货舰。

options.en: I believe we've come to an arrangement.
options.zh: 我相信我们已经达成了共识。

options.en: I'll consider your offer.
options.zh: 我会考虑你的提议。

options.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for scan and samples from the Onslaught Mk.I. Agreed?
options.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，用于扫描 攻势 Mk.I 并进行采样。同意吗？

texts.en: "Credits. Next question."
texts.zh: "星币。下一个问题。"

texts.en:
"Done." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
texts.zh:
"成交。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

texts.en:
She looks at you over her shoulder.

"You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I will trust in your boundless initiative," $personLastName says.
texts.zh:
她侧过头看向你。

"你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。我将仰赖你无限的进取心，" $personLastName 说道。

texts.en:
"Can't let you starve on the road to glory, can we." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
texts.zh:
"总不能让你在通往荣耀的路上挨饿吧。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

texts.en: "You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I shall trust your initiative on this matter," $personLastName says, rocking on her heels impatiently.
texts.zh: "你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。在这件事上我将仰赖你的进取心，" $personLastName 说道，一边不耐烦地轻轻摇晃着鞋跟。

texts.en:
* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements while rewarding success.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
texts.zh:
* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

texts.en:
"You'll get no better," she says, her tone a dismissal.

* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for rewarding success and effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
texts.zh:
"你找不到更好的条件，" 她说道，语气已是在下逐客令。

* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她冷冰冰地说道，言下之意是 '或许没有'。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她冷冰冰地说道，言下之意是 '或许没有'。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says, repeating you rather frostily.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring more information about the Threat."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她颇为冷淡地重复着你的话。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对 '威胁' 有关的更多信息的获取意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

texts.en:
"Then this topic serves no more purpose," she says frostily.

"Anything else?"
texts.zh:
"那么这个话题已经没有继续的必要了，" 她冷冰冰地说道。

"还有其他事吗？"

texts.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.
texts.zh:
她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

texts.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

texts.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

texts.en:
"Fine," she says, the spite cold in her voice.

"You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived." She is quite collected, suddenly, as she speaks.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
"很好，" 她说道，声音里的恶意冰冷而刺骨。

"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。" 在陈述时，她突然变得异常冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

texts.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
texts.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

texts.en: She says nothing, her disapproval resounding in the silence.
texts.zh: 她不置一词，异议在沉默中掷地有声。

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

options.en: So there was another expedition before me?
options.zh: 所以在我之前还有另一支科考队？

texts.en: "I am particularly interested in the hull you recovered from the Abyss. The Onslaught Mk.I is... unmistakable."
texts.zh: "我对你从深渊打捞的那艘舰船尤其感兴趣，那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的特征...无可混淆。"

options.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
options.zh: 为什么？难道你要出价买它吗？

options.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for access and scanning of the Mk.I.
options.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，换取接触并扫描 Mk.I 的权利。

options.en: Select specimens to turn in
options.zh: 选择上交的样本

options.en: I have nothing for you right now.
options.zh: 我目前没有能提供给你的东西。

texts.en: Glamor-Rotanev gives you a frosty look.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 向你投来了冰冷的一瞥。

texts.en: "A threat, presumably. The hostile connotation lives in the name." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "一种威胁，大概如此，敌意就蕴含在这个名称里。" 她露出一个迅速而苍白的微笑，"我相信你会做好应对任何情况的准备。"

texts.en: "Something which threatened the Domain, presumably." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "想来是曾危及人之领的什么东西。\" 她飞快地一笑，笑里没有半点温度。\"你必定会做好万全准备，这我信得过。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我坚持要求你不计成本地为科考任务配给物资，携带远超预估需求的燃料与补给，以免像那些 —— 算了，不提他们了。你是赢家，而我们只押注赢家。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."

texts.en:
"We assume it'll engage in some sort of hostile action against you or your $shipOrFleet," she says indifferently. "Only this won't be pirate, Pather, or tariff patrol."

"Nor," she fixes you with a cool look, "Some remnant AI warfleet. Those, those we know about."

"Disappointing conversationalists," she mutters. "Superintelligence with no mind for business. Simply unbelievable..."
texts.zh:
"我们推测它会对你或你的$shipOrFleet采取某种敌对行动，" 她漠然说道，"但这并非是海盗、左径分子，或关税巡逻队。"

"也并非是，" 她投来冷静的目光，"某支残存的 AI 战争舰队。那些东西，那些我们有所了解的东西。"

"令人失望的对话对象，" 她低语道，"具有超常的智能却毫无商业头脑，简直难以置信..."

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"And you lived to tell it," she says, outwardly cool. You suspect, however, that you've impressed the Director because she pauses a moment to consider your words.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"而你活着讲述了它，" 她说道，神色冷酷。然而，你怀疑自己已经给这位总监留下了深刻的印象，因为她停顿了片刻以琢磨你的话语。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"That does not... quite fit with our working knowledge of the issue. Would you part with recordings of your... encounter with these entities? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"这与我们对该问题的现有认知不...甚吻合。你是否愿意出售你与这些实体...遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And she stares for several seconds, motionless.

"You're telling the truth," she says, outwardly cool.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounters with both of these... forces? I offer 150,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。她凝视数秒，纹丝不动。

"你说的是真话，" 她说道，外表依然冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与这两股...势力遭遇的影像记录？我出 150,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en: "You've been most useful," she says, almost actually smiling. It looks uncomfortable.
texts.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她说道，几乎真的露出了微笑，看上去极不自然。

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings.
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响了。

texts.en: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."
texts.zh: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."

texts.en:
She blinks and her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And they narrow slightly.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注，眼睛也微微眯起。

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

texts.en:
"It is true, however, that the Abyss is hostile to our hyperspace technology. That is precisely why the secrets it holds may be all the more profitably disruptive."

She turns to look you full-on, once more. "I want you to go there. I have data... there is something to find. Very old. Very dangerous. Very valuable. Bring me scans, samples. You will be paid handsomely for tangible specimens."
texts.zh:
"但深渊确实对我们的超空间技术充满敌意。而这恰恰意味着其中隐藏的秘密可能带来更具颠覆性的利润。"

她再度转过身来直视着你，"我要你去往那里。我掌握着数据...那里存在值得探查的事物，非常古老，极度危险，也价值连城。为我带回扫描数据，采集样本。对于实体标本，你将获得丰厚的酬劳。"

options.en: You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?
options.zh: 你还没具体说明我要寻找什么。是要打捞物品吗？

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisifed. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

options.en: Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?
options.zh: 这与余辉的 AI 战争舰队有关吗？

options.en: Is it aliens?
options.zh: 这是外星人吗？

options.en: Yes, but you haven't said what.
options.zh: 是的，但你还没具体说明要找什么。

texts.en:
"Those old things?" She gives her head an abbreviated shake.

"No, we have people for that. Although," she fixes you with a look, "they've made quite a mess of it, haven't they? The wasted possibilities... but no, we're looking for something older... different."
texts.zh:
"那些旧东西？" 她简短地摇了摇头。

"不，我们有专人负责那些。不过，" 她凝视着你，"它们确实搞得一团糟，不是吗？那些被浪费的可能性...但我们寻找的是更古老的...不同的东西。"

texts.en: Sensing the insufficiency of her pep-talk, she begins anew: "What it is, is old. Early Domain. Pre-Persean Frontier, but we have reason to believe some part of it is out... here. Whether it followed us or we followed it. Whatever it is, wherever there is."
texts.zh: 察觉到自己的鼓舞之辞不够有力，她重新开口道："重点是，它很古老。早于 人之领 时期，在英仙座边境形成之前，但我们有理由相信它的某些部分就在...这里。不知是它尾随而来，还是我们追寻至此。无论它是什么，无论它在何处。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisfied. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

texts.en:
"No, nothing like that." She emits a joyless laugh, like a machine, then pauses suddenly.

"Although if you did happen to find alien technology... provide me with exclusive access and I would ensure you credits enough to purchase your own solar system. Or," she waves a hand in an unconscious arc, "Build yourself a new one out of dross, if that's what you enjoy."
texts.zh:
"不，不是那种东西。" 她发出机器般毫无欢愉的笑声，随即突然停顿。

"不过，如果你真的偶然发现了外星技术...那就向我提供独家接触权限，我会确保你获得足以买下一整个恒星系的财富。或者，" 她无意识地挥手划了个弧线，"如果你喜欢，用废料给自己造个新的也行。"

texts.en: "There's no need. Our strategic indicators forecast a reasonably likely chance of your survival if your outlook is unbiased by speculation, so take heart." She trails off.
texts.zh: "没必要。我们的战略指标预测，如果你不受主观臆断影响，那么你的存活概率将相当可观，所以振作些。" 她的声音渐渐低了下去。

texts.en: "Then I think we shall work well together," she says.
texts.zh: "那么我想我们会合作得很愉快，" 她说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Yes. Does that frighten you?" she asks.
texts.zh: "是的。这让你感到恐惧吗？" 她问道。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 不。

options.en: No. (lie)
options.zh: 不。 (说谎)

options.en: Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there.
options.zh: 是的。如果不对那里的存在心怀敬畏，那我才真是愚蠢。

options.en: Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation.
options.zh: 是的。正因如此，我需要获得充分的补偿。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your pretense of bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你佯装的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," she says after a moment.

"I trust that you shall ensure your executive judgment is merely tempered, not impaired, by such sentiment."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她停顿片刻后说道。

"我相信你会确保这种情绪仅仅只会调节，而非削弱你的决策判断力。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Of course," she says, allowing a trace of amusement to enter her voice.
texts.zh: "当然，" 她说道，话音里渗入了一丝玩味。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Her head gives a small twitch.

"Regret, you say."
texts.zh:
她的头部微微抽动了一下。

"后悔，你是说。"

options.en: They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment.
options.zh: 他们表达的措辞可激烈得多。

options.en: They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself.
options.zh: 他们的结局很糟，我想让自己避免那种下场。

texts.en:
"I see," she says.

"You found them. In the Abyss. And returned." The Director pauses a moment. "This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她说道。

"你找到了他们，在深渊里，并且回来了。" 总监停顿片刻，"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en: She makes no outward reaction to your implication, simply proceeding as if you'd said nothing at all.
texts.zh: 她对你的暗示毫无表露，只是继续着，仿佛你未曾开口一般。

texts.en:
"Evidently, you already have," she says.

"This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"显然，你已经做到了，" 她说道。

"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, eyes black.

"I shall make my proposal shortly. First, allow me to elaborate on a shape for our partnership."
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，双眼漆黑。

"我将很快提出我的方案。首先，请允许我进一步阐述我们合作关系的框架。"

options.en: I'm listening.
options.zh: 我在听。

options.en: I don't see how that's your business.
options.zh: 我不认为这与你有关。

options.en: I don't think about it. Like you said, I'm practical.
options.zh: 我不会考虑这个。如你所说，我很务实。

options.en: I do. I stand for the Church and the Church with me.
options.zh: 是的。我支持教会，教会也支持我。

options.en: I do believe, but not as does the Church. I follow Ludd's Word.
options.zh: 我确实信仰，但并非依循教会的信条。我追随卢德的圣言。

options.en: Not as such. My interest is humanitarian.
options.zh: 并非如此。我的关注是出于人道主义。

options.en: No, my interest is purely mercenary.
options.zh: 不，我的关注纯粹出于雇佣关系。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better.
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better. (lie)
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。 (说谎)

texts.en:
If her look could become any colder without freezing the local atmo, it would.

"An interest in your business is my business if we are to do business. I shall repeat the point for emphasis: it is important that I know where we stand." Her hands, neatly folded, gently draw apart and close. Not clenched into fists, but...

"Do you believe?"
texts.zh:
她的眼神愈发冰冷，而且只要空气还尚未结冰，她就不介意让自己的目光再冰冷几分。

"如果你我还有所关联，那么和你有关的事情就等同于和我有关。我必须重申要点以进行强调：明确我们的立场是至关重要的。" 她交叠的双手缓缓分开又合拢。并未攥成拳，但...

"你相信那些东西吗？"

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "How admirable," she says with no attempt to inject sincerity into her words. It is a dismissal; she pauses for but a moment then proceeds.
texts.zh: "真令人钦佩，" 她的言语毫无真诚之意。这已经是逐客令；她仅停顿片刻便继续开口。

texts.en:
"How unexpected," she says, curious.

"I suppose one must concede that the Church is not without some wealth and not without need for services unclouded by... fanatic enthusiasm. I suppose you've found something of a niche market for yourself. However limited."
texts.zh:
"真是出人意料，" 她说道，语气好奇。

"看来我必须承认，教会并非没有财力，也并非不需要那些不受...狂热信仰影响的纯粹服务。你似乎为自己找到了某个利基市场，尽管相当有限。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A cool smile. "Of course. I just wanted to hear you say it." She pauses for a moment, then proceeds.
texts.zh: 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"当然。我只是想听你亲口说出来。" 她停顿片刻，而后继续开口。

texts.en:
"Of course." A cool smile. "I wanted to hear you say it."

Her eyes seem suddenly more engaged - focused and examining you intently, distantly. Like you're a lab experiment pinned to a dissection table.
texts.zh:
"当然。" 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"我只是想听你亲口说出来。"

她的目光突然变得锐利 —— 专注而疏离地审视着你，仿佛你是钉在解剖台上的实验样本。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Your interest in matters of the Luddics has been noted. Even working with, perhaps for, an archcurate. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so evidently practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"你对卢德事务的关注已被记录在案，甚至正在与某位大祭司一同工作，或者可能是受雇于他。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

options.en: There is an urgent matter. I must speak with the Chief Inspector.
options.zh: 有紧急情况。我必须和检察长通话。

options.en: I bring a matter of highest importance regarding the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我带来一桩关乎辛达强权的头等要事。

options.en: Tell Dolos I found the sons.
options.zh: 转告 Dolos，我找到那几个儿子了。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Acknowledged," he says impatiently.

"As I explained, all subversion should be reported to an appropriate officer of the Patriotic Citizen-Security Reports section. The Chief High Inspector-General does not answer to," now the sneer, "random spacers."
texts.zh:
"知道了，" 他不耐烦地应道。

"我说过了，一切颠覆行为都该向爱国公民安全举报处的对口军官举报。最高检察长可不对接，\" 这时他撇了撇嘴，\"来路不明的太空流浪汉。"

options.en: I am no random 'spacer'. I've performed work for Macario.
options.zh: 我可不是什么来路不明的'太空流浪汉'。我替 Macario 办过事。

options.en: I am no random 'spacer'. I bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 我可不是什么来路不明的'太空流浪汉'。我持有辛达强权的委任状！

texts.en:
His eyes flicker, indicating something. Likely annoyance.

"Noted. If the Chief High Inspector-General wishes to contact you, you will be contacted." He turns away. "This conversation is concluded."

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他目光一闪，透出点什么，多半是恼火。

"记下了。最高检察长若想联系你，自会有人找你。\" 他转过身去，\"谈话到此为止。"

"荣耀归于辛达强权。"

通讯被切断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Your status has already been noted. This conversation is concluded."

His eyes narrow ever so slightly. As if he might say something more, but he chooses not to. Instead-

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"你的身份已经记录在案。谈话到此为止。"

他眼睛几不可察地一眯，像是要再说点什么，终究没开口。转而——

"荣耀归于辛达强权。"

通讯被切断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
An annoyed look flashes on his face.

"Wasting my time may be seen as hindering official duties of an officer of the Ministry of Internal Security which, in turn, may be treated as an act of terroristic insubordination and-"

He pauses, reaching for his ear. Indignant expression frozen.

"I-" His voice catches, and he clears his throat. The blood has drained from his face.

"Acknowledged. Forwarding comms."
texts.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝不耐。

"浪费我的时间，可视为妨碍内部安全部军官执行公务，而妨碍公务，又可视为恐怖性质的抗命行为，按律可——"

他忽然顿住，抬手摸向耳边，愤愤的表情僵在脸上。

"我——" 他嗓音一卡，清了清嗓子，脸上一下没了血色。

"明白。正在转接通讯。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
A silhouette appears.

Macario moves forward, revealing an amused smirk.

He moves to speak and an odd sound seems to escape from his mouth before he can contain it.

A cough; a pause. He looks up and begins again.

"My, my, we've been busy busy, Captain $playerLastName. I've been watching you, of course."

He inhales sharply. "Closely."
texts.zh:
一道剪影浮现出来。

Macario 向前一步，脸上挂着一抹似笑非笑。

他刚要开口，一声怪响没憋住先从嘴里溜了出来。

一声咳，一顿。他抬起头，重新来过。

"哎呀呀，可真够忙的，$playerLastName 舰长。我自然一直看着你呢。"

他猛地吸了口气。"看得紧紧的。"

options.en: I need to know what you're doing. What's your goal?
options.zh: 我得知道你在搞什么。你到底要什么？

options.en: I want you to leave me alone. I don't care about any of this.
options.zh: 别来烦我。这些事我根本不在乎。

options.en: I want you to pay me to forget about all of this...
options.zh: 想让我把这一切都忘干净，拿钱来...

options.en: Macario. We need to save the Sindrian Diktat - together.
options.zh: Macario。要救辛达强权，你我得联手。

options.en: Have you betrayed Philip Andrada? Are you behind the assassins?
options.zh: 你背叛了 Philip Andrada？那些刺客是你派来的？

options.en: I'm going to stop whatever you're doing, Dolos.
options.zh: 不管你在捣什么鬼，我都会拦下来，Dolos。

texts.en: "Shh, shh." He hushes you, like an infant. "Nothing you say matters. So much rotting air."
texts.zh: "嘘，嘘。\" 他像哄婴儿似的叫你别出声。\"你说什么都没分量。净是些发臭的废气。"

texts.en: "You lied to me, $playerName. Of course I could tell. Every time," his voice is thin, animated by hate. "You fool. You insect. You pathetic, faithless spacer."
texts.zh: "你对我撒了谎，$playerName。我当然看得出来。每一次都看得出来，\" 他的嗓音尖细，字字浸着恨意。\"蠢货。区区虫子。你这可悲又不忠的太空人。"

texts.en:
"You will receive what you deserve..."

He trails off, mouth hanging open. Idly, he wipes a drop of spittle with the sleeve of his uniform.

Then he turns away, as if he's forgotten he was talking to you.
texts.zh:
"你会得到你应得的..."

他的话断了，嘴还张着。他随手用制服袖子抹去嘴角一点唾沫。

随后他转过身去，像是已经忘了还在跟你说话。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The comms go dark.
texts.zh: 通讯画面一黑。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接
