texts.en: "Andrada, of course." Macario simply raises an eyebrow, "I thought that was obvious."
texts.zh: "当然是 Andrada。" Macario 挑了下眉毛，"我以为这很明显。"

texts.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
texts.zh:
"决断的一刻总会来临的，我亲爱的舰长。" 他按了下数据平板。

"我相信你应该能喜欢我...慷慨的领导方式。"

texts.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
texts.zh:
"很快就要到必须做决断的时候了，亲爱的舰长，" 他腾出片刻，在数据板上点了几下。

"想必你已经领教了我这... 宽厚的处事风范。"

options.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
options.zh: 你到底效忠谁，Macario？

options.en: You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
options.zh: 上次谈话时你提到了一个 '实验舰体' ...

options.en: I serve the Sindrian Diktat. Glory to the Supreme Executor!
options.zh: 我为辛达强权效劳。荣耀归于最高元首！

options.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
options.zh: 你到底效忠于什么，Macario？

options.en: You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
options.zh: 你上回聊天时提到过'advanced spacecraft hull'...

texts.en:
"Power, of course. I'm just like you."

 He slowly rubs his hands together, watching.

"Don't bother denying it."
texts.zh:
"权力，还用说吗。你我都是一路人。"

他慢慢地两手交叉，观察着。

"不用浪费时间去否定这一点了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
His eyes open wide, "Don't you see it, captain? I have no need to emblazon my face upon history. Merely... " he grows quiet, "Mm, to direct it. Correct it. Trim the loose ends which hold us back, tie us down."

"That is all captain," he says, re-asserting a mask of calm. "For now. I'm sure we shall speak again soon."

The comms cut to the crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry.
texts.zh:
他双眼睁大。"你还看不出来吗，舰长？我不需要在历史上刻下我这张脸！只要..." 他声音低了下来。"嗯，引导历史，修正历史。除掉拖累，限制我们的累赘。"

"目前就这样吧，舰长。" 他重新带上了冷静的面具。"我相信我们很快会再联络的。"

通讯画面转换为了 辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标。

options.en: Close the comm-link
options.zh: 关闭通讯链接

texts.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
texts.zh:
"我说过吗？\" 他轻笑一声。\"到头来还是个雇佣兵，嗯？我会安排好的。"

"你这么看重我拿得出手的东西，我真是欣慰。这事很快就要派上大用场了。"

texts.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
texts.zh:
"我提过？" 他笑道，"到最后都是个雇佣兵吗？我会做对应的安排。"

"我很高兴你能珍视我所能提供的利益。这点会很重要，很快就会。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Yes, glory to all of that. Of course," he says quickly.

"You are simply... the perfect specimen to serve the Supreme Executor."

A mix of expressions crosses his face as he continues to examine you, like something he found but did not expect. Then, like a phase-shift, he is suddenly calm.
texts.zh:
"是、是啊，荣耀归于那一切，自然，" 他说得很快。

"你简直... 是服侍最高元首的完美样本。"

他仍旧打量着你，脸上神色变换不定，像是捡到了件没料到的东西。紧接着，像切换了相位一般，他忽然平静下来。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "On so few the future hangs, captain," Macario says hollowly, unblinking.
texts.zh: "可叹未来竟要寄托在寥寥数人身上，舰长。" Macario 空洞地说道，眼睛依旧一眨不眨。

options.en: One hundred thousand credits
options.zh: 十万星币。

options.en: One million credits
options.zh: 一百万星币

options.en: The cryosleeping body of Leonidas, clone of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 处于低温休眠中的 Leonidas，Philip Andrada 的克隆体

options.en: A thousand units of Volturnian Lobster
options.zh: 一千单位蓝龙虾。

options.en: A $foundWeaponName, glorious engine of destruction
options.zh: 一件 $foundWeaponName，超凡绝伦的大杀器。

options.en: The ISS Hamatsu, a ship of great sentimental value to Callisto Ibrahim
options.zh: ISS Hamatsu，一艘对 Callisto Ibrahim 有重大纪念意义的舰船。

options.en: A Ziggurat-class starship, the only one of its kind
options.zh: 一艘 通灵塔-级 星舰，世上仅此一艘。

options.en: The $foundShipName, a $foundShipClass
options.zh: $foundShipName，一艘 $foundShipClass

options.en: A Domain-era Combat Drone Replicator
options.zh: 一部 人之领 时代的战斗无人机复制器。

options.en: A Domain-era Dealmaker Holosuite, adaptable for medical experiments
options.zh: 一部 人之领 时代的全息交易撮合套件，也适用于医疗实验用途。

options.en: A corrupted Domain-era Nanoforge
options.zh: 一部受损的 人之领 时代纳米锻炉

options.en: A Domain-era Planetkiller
options.zh: 一台 人之领 时代的行星杀手。

options.en: A pristine Domain-era Nanoforge, a true rarity
options.zh: 一台完好的 人之领 时代纳米锻炉，真正的稀罕之物。

options.en: An Orbital Fusion Lamp
options.zh: 一架轨道聚变射灯。

options.en: $foundShipBPName
options.zh: $foundShipBPName

options.en: Compromising information on $foundContactName, $foundContactFaction $foundContactPost and trusted contact
options.zh: 关于 $foundContactName 的敏感信息。其人乃是一位 $foundContactFaction 的 $foundContactPost 以及信任你的联络人。

options.en: A favor of her choosing, at any time in the future
options.zh: 欠她一个人情，她将来可以随时要求偿还。

options.en: I shall take my leave to consider what sort of gift befits the pirate queen.
options.zh: 我先退下了，我会考虑何种礼物配得上海盗女王。

texts.en:
"Paltry, plebeian, pathetic," Cydonia hisses at you, "A beggar's sum, unworthy of the mighty Kanta!" he shouts, spittle flying.

The court shouts and jeers at your pitiable offer.
texts.zh:
"微不足道，庸俗，可悲。" Cydonia 嘶声道，"这是打发乞丐的金额，配不上伟大的 Kanta！" 他吐沫星子横飞地吼道。

整座王庭开始吼叫着嘲笑你可悲的提议。

texts.en:
"Hm," the doctor ponders, then looks to Kanta, whose obsidian gaze acknowledges him.

"One million credits," says Cydonia with an unusual affect, then adds "Dull, very dull. But a queenly sum nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"嗯。" 医生思考了一下，然后看向 Kanta，后者以黑曜石般深邃的凝视回应了他。

"一百万星币。" Cydonia 口气中难得有些被打动，但随即补充道。"乏味，非常乏味。但好歹是对得起一位女王的金额。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You step back from the center of the court-chamber. Kanta's metal body hisses on her throne, patient as a landmine. Cydonia scuttles to speak with one or another pirate sergeant responsible for prisoners and petitioners awaiting Kanta's judgment.

The pirates shout and cheer, their wild stylings and radical augmentations giving Kanta's Court the aspect of Pandemonium.
texts.zh:
你从王庭大厅的中央后退了一步。Kanta 的金属身体在王座上发出嘶嘶声，她如地雷般耐心。Cydonia 快步走向另一个海盗头目并与之交谈，此人负责看管有待 Kanta 处置的犯人和有求之人。

海盗们欢呼声和吼叫声不断传来，他们纷乱的装扮以及极端的生化改造无一不让 Kanta 的王庭看上去更像是一个混乱的魔窟。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: As you leave, pirates call and grab at your hands and slap your back, winking and greeting you as ersatz-sibling, now. Others glower and grumble, their eyes promising secret blood spilled at some future opportunity.
texts.zh: 你离开时，海盗们一个个过来跟你勾肩搭背，以义兄弟相称。但也有其他人对你虎视眈眈、念念有词，他们的眼神预示着未来某个时机必将在暗地里给你放血。

texts.en:
The doctor's eyebrows raise, his interest obviously piqued. He looks furtively at Kanta, as if any expression by hateful domination could be gleaned from her mask-face.
He licks his lips and-

"The Lion's Blood," Kanta's voice rumbles like a mining drill. "The Lion's heir. One of so few, so few remaining..." Her voice drops several octaves, then continues as pure noise, a rumbling in your chest. Kanta's court shuffles uncomfortably.

If her ceramic-armor mask could show pleasure, that is what you think it would be doing now. And it is answer enough.

As for what nightmares await sleeping Leonidas... you put that question far from your mind.
texts.zh:
医生扬起眉毛，兴致显然被勾了起来。他偷偷瞟向 Kanta，仿佛想从她那张面具似的脸上，辨出哪怕一丝带着恨意的威仪。
他舔了舔嘴唇，正要——

"雄狮之血，" Kanta 的嗓音像矿钻一样隆隆作响。"雄狮的继承人。所剩无几，所剩无几了..." 她的声音陡然沉下几个八度，接着化作纯粹的噪声，在你胸腔里隆隆震颤。Kanta 的王庭里，众人不安地挪动着脚步。

倘若她那张陶瓷装甲面具能露出快意，你想，此刻它多半正是这副模样。而这，已经算是答案了。

至于沉睡中的 Leonidas 会迎来怎样的噩梦...你把这个念头远远抛到了脑后。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A thousand units of Andrada's best, how..." the doctor pauses, quickly glancing to the black eyes of Kanta for confirmation.

"...delightful," Cydonia concludes as if he was going to say it all along. "It will bring pleasure to our warlord-queen to vex Andrada's customs ministry with the mystery of how so many of his cold-blooded spawn slithered from his grasp."

For her part, Kanta nods, apparently satisfied, though it is impossible to know through her mask of a face.
texts.zh:
"一千单位 Andrada 最好的货，这可真是..." 医生停顿了一下，快速地看向 Kanta 那双漆黑的眼睛，寻求确认。

"...令人愉悦。" Cydonia 总结道，仿佛他本就打算这么说一样。"Andrada 的海关会绞尽脑汁试图搞清楚是怎么弄丢了这么多他们主子的冷血后代，而我们的军阀女王大人会很高兴地看着这些。"

至于 Kanta 本人，她点了下头，似乎是满意了，但是没人能从她面具般的脸上确认这一点。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Oh, oh, th-" Cydonia almost bounces with excitement, but his mewling is crushed by Kanta's synthesized voice.

"A weapon of transcendent power," she booms. "A beautiful thing. THIS. Is a gift worthy of Kanta." Her dark eyes scan the crowds accusingly, demanding someone match this prize. None can.
texts.zh:
"哦，哦，这 ——" Cydonia 兴奋地几乎要跳了起来，但他兴奋的声音直接被 Kanta 的合成音压了过去。

"威力超凡的武器。" 她的声音响起，"美丽的物件。'这 个'。是配得上 Kanta 的礼物。" 她漆黑的双眼看向众人，如同问罪一般，审视着是否还有人能拿出与之匹敌的献礼。但看来无人能够做到。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"This, this bucket of bolts is unfit for the lowest scavenger following in a pirate's wake," Cydonia starts working himself into a lather. "-Let alone a Queen!"

Kanta stands with a clank and the doctor drops into a confused silence. Kanta's synthesized voice bursts like a roar: "Your cruelty is subtle, and impressive. It will please us to take Ibrahim's most treasured ship. We shall have it overhauled and used to plunder the weak. Each prize, each victory taken will wound her."

The artificial words drip with pleasure; it is an intimate view into Kanta's psyche, and her court shuffles uncomfortably. Cydonia stutters as he makes arrangements, clearly displeased.
texts.zh:
"这，这堆破铜烂铁连跟在海盗后面捡破烂的拾荒者都看不上。" Cydonia 激动得唾沫横飞，"—— 更别说一位女王了！"

Kanta 咣啷一声站了起来，医生不解地沉默了下来。Kanta 突然以她的合成音吼道："你的残忍很低调，也叫人印象深刻。咱家很乐意接受 Ibrahim 最宝贵的舰船。咱家会将其翻新，用以劫掠弱者。每次劫掠，每次胜利都将为她身上添上一道伤。"

她机械化的声音充满了愉悦；这一幕透露出 Kanta 内心的隐秘角落，而她的王庭也开始不安地骚动。Cydonia 结巴着做好了安排，明显非常不悦。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Ah, ah ah," Cydonia's throat makes an uncomfortable noise. "A truly unique specimen, a fitting trophy from Tri-Tachyon! Beautiful, my queen-"

"NO." Kanta's denial overwhelms Cydonia's mewling praise. "That," she booms, "Is a fool's prize. Desired beyond all reason by the factions, and others; it invites disaster from this world and those unknown."

She sits with finality, and her last words echo in the court-chamber, which has gone oddly quiet but for a wash of fearful susurration. Kanta is not much known for natural philosophy; her courtiers speculate at her implication.
texts.zh:
"啊，啊啊，" Cydonia 喉咙里发出了某种令人不适的声音，"一件真正独特的标本，一份来自 速子科技 的绝佳战利品！太美了，我的女王 ——"

"不。" Kanta 的拒绝盖过了 Cydonia 呜咽的称赞。"那个，" 她说道，"是愚者的宝物。所有势力，还有其他的东西，无一不疯狂地渴求它；留着它，只会为这个世界，还有其他未知的境界，引来灾祸。"

她的坐姿体现她心意已决，她最后的话语还在王庭内回响。王庭里出奇地宁静，能听到的只有恐惧的吸气声。Kanta 可不是什么出名的哲学家；她的手下纷纷猜测着她的意图。

texts.en:
"That? So garish, so useless," Cydonia sputters, "And expensive. It would require an AI-core and special technicians to keep working at all. Think of the expense, and-"

Kanta's voice rolls over Cydonia's whining like thunder: "Glorious!"

"It shall be a monument to Tri-Tachyon's betrayal," she booms, "And to Hegemony weakness. We shall display it proudly, and invite them to remove their shame. They will cringe in fear!"
texts.zh:
"这个？太奢华无用。" Cydonia 啐道，"而且昂贵。这需要一个 AI 核心以及专业的工程师才能运作。想想这开支，还有 ——"

Kanta 如雷霆般的声音轻易盖过了 Cydonia 的抱怨。"好极了！"

"这将作为一座纪念碑，显示出 速子科技 的背叛 ，" 她洪亮地宣告道，"以及 霸主 的软弱，我们将光荣地将其展示出来，并邀请他们来取回自己的耻辱。他们将在恐惧中战栗！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The core of the drone replicator is dragged into the court on an agrav sled and the specs read aloud at Cydonia's instructions by some kind of lead technician.

Certain phrases stand out: "autonomous hunter-killer", "exploding-tip fragmentation", "semi-lethal crowd-control escalation",  "adjustable potency chemical irritant", "30,000 rounds-per-minute", "excruciating burning sensation".

Kanta nods along, seemingly enthralled. Cydonia glances between you and her, ensuring that he is following the lead of his queen.
texts.zh:
无人机复制器的核心被一架反重力拖橇拖入王庭。一个 Cydonia 指挥下的技师头子正在大声读出其数据明细。

其中有些词语颇为让人在意："自动猎杀系统"，"高爆破片弹头"，"可选半致命镇暴"，"每分钟三万发"，"痛苦的灼烧感"。

Kanta 看上去听入神了，边听边点头。Cydonia 的视线在你和 Kanta 之间游移，确保自己紧跟女王的步调。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: As the reading is finished, Cydonia exchanges one last look with Kanta then turns approvingly to the technician. "Take it to The Arena!" he shouts, and Kanta's court erupts with thunderous shouts and stomps.
texts.zh: 技师报告完毕后，Cydonia 和 Kanta 交换了最后一个眼神，然后赞许地转向技师。"把它送到斗技场去！" 他大声说道，Kanta 的王庭随即爆发出热烈的欢呼和顿足声。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Kanta blasts her synthetic approval, "YES. A delightful toy for my Cydonia, for his little experiments, his playthings. Won't they amuse us?" With a creak of metal and clatter of beads and trophies, Kanta turns to look upon Cydonia.

He seems to shrink, "Y- yes, my queen. I'm sure- I suppose it could be... repurposed for my needs. There will be less need for live... subjects, I suppose."

The 'doctor' looks crestfallen at this development. It would seem that Kanta doesn't notice, or care.
texts.zh:
Kanta 的合成音充满了赞许。"好，给咱家 Cydonia 的小实验找了个好玩具。想来它会给咱家找些乐子？" 伴随着金属的吱嘎声以及串珠与战利品的碰撞声，Kanta 转向了 Cydonia。

他似乎快要缩进地里。"是 —— 是的，我的女王，我肯定 —— 我估计它可以按...我的需求进行改装。这样我们需要的活...实验品估计会少一些，我估计。"

'医生' 看上去对这项安排垂头丧气。而 Kanta 要么没有看出来，要么根本不在意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"That?" Cydonia's face contorts into a seemingly impossible sneer. "You can find junk like that in half the ruins in the fringe systems alone! It's a lump of technological excrement passed by the dying idiot-corpse of the Domain!"

He's either ignorant or lying about the rarity and value of even a damaged nanoforge. Many in the crowd of pirates know it, too, by their dark expressions and grumbling - but there is only one who may question Cydonia's judgment.

Kanta looks on, impassive. Bored, almost, if her moods could be divined by the subtle shift and hum of her augments.
texts.zh:
"这个？" Cydonia 的脸不自然地扭曲成了一个鄙视的表情，"你在边缘星区里一半的废墟里都能挖出这种垃圾玩意！这不过是 人之领 政权那愚蠢的尸体后留下来的一坨狗屎技术罢了。"

Kanta 毫无波澜地看着这一切。如果能从她的机械义体中微弱的嗡嗡声和动作中看出些什么，那大概就是无聊吧。

texts.en:
Cydonia looks uncertain, glances at Kanta, then back to you. His mouth opens, and you hear a grinding, throbbing sound. It builds, louder. Laughter.

Kanta stands, laughing. Then stops; black eyes fixed on you. Cydonia and the court are frozen silent, awaiting her mercurial judgment.

"It is a beautiful thing you offer," she booms at you in synth-voice. "But a predator's weapon is not terracide. Keep it. And be pursued by small men dreaming dreams of death to the end of the Arm of Perseus."

Cydonia, and the court, bow at her judgment; murmuring.
texts.zh:
Cydonia 神色不宁，匆匆地瞥了 Kanta 一眼，才把视线重新投回你身上。见他嘴巴微张，你听到的却是有节奏的咯吱声在铿锵作响。异响愈发高亢洪亮。竟是笑声。

Kanta 霍然起身，放声大笑。随即笑声戛然而止，那双漆黑的眼睛死死地盯住了你。Cydonia 与王庭众人瞬间陷入死寂，静候她喜怒无常的裁决落下。

"你献上的东西着实美妙。" 她洪亮的合成音向你袭来，"但掠食者的武器可用不着毁天灭地。留着它。尔后就等着被那些追逐死亡痴梦的卑鄙小人，一路追杀到英仙座旋臂的尽头去吧。"

Cydonia 和王庭众人皆躬身认同她的裁定；但交头接耳之声不绝于耳。

texts.en:
"I... I, yes, yes" Cydonia caresses the specifications you transmitted to his datapad. He capers around the grim totems surrounding Kanta's throne and excitedly shows her the screen. Her attention is, for a moment, laser-focused. Her court of pirates murmur and whisper.

Finally, Kanta's gauntleted hand, strength enhanced by cybernetics, shoves Cydonia away like a dewy-eyed lapdog. He nearly topples from the platform, but manages to recover his balance.

Kanta stands with a clank, the hum of her synthetic voice grows, a raw buzz, in anticipation of her proclamation.
texts.zh:
"我... 我，好，好..." Cydonia 轻轻抚摸着他数据平板上显示的数据。他一路小跑穿过 Kanta 王座周围可怖的图腾，兴奋地向她展示出平板上的数据。有那么一刻，Kanta 全神贯注地审视着屏幕。她的海盗臣下们彼此交头接耳。

终于，Kanta 那只经过生化改装后的铁拳，像推开一只泪汪汪的哈巴狗一样将 Cydonia 一把推开。他几乎跌下了王座平台，但在最后一刻勉强站稳了脚跟。

Kanta 咣啷一声站了起来，她的电子合成音嗡嗡作响，可见其主人将要开始演讲。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A worthy gift," her voice blasts. "The heart of Domain power - torn from the chest of the dead colossus, it will beat now for ME." Her words echo painfully off the metal panels of the chamber.

"Great teeth it shall grow! Again will the Persean Sector learn true fear of the WARLORD."

The court erupts in cheers, and a chaos of stomping boots and pounding longarms resolves into a chant. "KAN-TA, KAN-TA". She revels in their praise, and their bloodlust.
texts.zh:
"一份珍贵的礼物。" 她用洪亮的声音说道，"从那巨兽尸骸的心口掏出的 —— 人之领 力量的核心 。现在，它将再度跳动，为 了 我！" 她的声音在大厅之中金属板间回响，形成令人痛苦的回音。

"它将为我们生出巨大的獠牙！英仙座星域将再一次感受体会到 军 阀 给予它的恐惧。"

整座王庭沸腾起来了，纷乱的顿靴声与枪托砸地声逐渐汇成整齐的呼号。"KAN —— TA！KAN —— TA！" 她沉醉于众人的颂扬，以及那沸腾的嗜血渴望。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What," Cydonia's lip curls into a sneer, "would the mighty warlord do with-"

There's a heavy clank, all turn to find that Kanta is standing, trailing trophies and tubes. "WE ACCEPT," her vocoder blasts, the voice inhuman. "Vacuum AND fire shall greet those prisoners I wish to dispose."

The pirates of the court cheer to this, stomping their feet and slamming weapon-stocks into the deck plates.
texts.zh:
"我们伟大的军阀，" Cydonia 的嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，"要这个东西做 ——"

随着咣啷一声传来，众人转头望去，发现 Kanta 已经站了起来，拉扯着身后一堆管线以及战利品。"咱家接受。" 她的语音器爆发出非人的声音。"真空 与 烈火，将迎接那些咱家想处置的囚犯。"

听到这里，整座王庭的海盗欢呼起来，跺着脚，将武器枪托重重砸在甲板上。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Cydonia inspects the blueprint specifications on his datapad, pallid fingers caressing the display. "Hmm, mmm, yes."

He capers up Kanta's throne, dodging the twisted remains of hand weapons and morbid totems, to show the pirate queen your offering.

Kanta's cybernetic mask of a face does turn to look, and in but a moment her gauntleted arm whirrs and shoves Cydonia away like an annoying pet.
texts.zh:
Cydonia 在他的数据平板上审视着蓝图，他苍白的手指划过显示屏。"嗯，嗯，好。"

他随后小跑到 Kanta 的王座旁，小心避开一路上废弃的武器和各类病态的图腾。他向海盗女王展示了你的贡品。

Kanta 的机械面孔确实转头看了一眼，然而仅仅片刻之后，她那只戴着手甲的胳膊便嗡鸣着将 Cydonia 推开，如同驱赶一只烦人的宠物。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She stands with the thrum of servos, sending Cydonia tumbling off the platform. Miraculously, he is not impaled on any of the jagged prizes which festoon the base of Kanta's throne.

"WE ACCEPT," she booms in a voice like a synthesized orbital strike, and raises a gauntleted fist.

"Install this in our arsenal. A new blade for our hunters, the Sector shall bleed rich and deep!"

The pirate court cheers, pounding the deckplates with boots and weapons.
texts.zh:
伴随着一系列伺服电机工作的声音，Kanta 站了起来，将 Cydonia 震得从平台上翻滚而下。后者则奇迹般地没有被 Kanta 王座下面的若干尖锐战利品捅个对穿。

"咱家接受。" 她抬起一只铁拳，洪亮的声音仿佛电子合成的轨道轰炸。

"装进我们的武库，我们的猎人会有新的利刃。星域将血流成河！"

整座海盗王庭欢呼起来，海盗们纷纷用靴子和武器沉重地敲击着甲板。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Cydonia rolls his eyes theatrically as you declare your willingness to betray a contact at Kanta's will. "A worthless-" he begins.

A rhythmic thudding overpowers him, like the sound of a malfunctioning shield capacitor locked into a destructive charge cycle. You suppress your instinctual reaction to that danger as you realize that Kanta is laughing. Cydonia cringes, holding pallid hands over his ears.

With a dying echo, her laughter stops.
texts.zh:
听到你打算为了 Kanta 背叛一位联络人，Cydonia 装模做样地翻了个白眼道。"毫无价值的 ——"

一阵规律的砰砰声淹没了他的声音，这声音好像护盾发生器被锁进了自毁性的充能循环。你几乎本能地要做出对那种故障的应急反应时方才发现这其实是 Kanta 的笑声。Cydonia 战栗着以苍白的手指捂住他的耳朵。

随着最后一段回响，她的笑声停止了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She speaks with the voice of a mechanical demon, "A willing betrayer; most delectable. You understand that the softest weapon may cause the most pain."

Her cyberauged body draws a deep, ragged breath, and she continues, "The anticipation shall bring us such pleasure."
texts.zh:
她以那机械恶魔般的声音开口道："一位心甘情愿的背叛者；最好的美味。你明白最柔软的兵器往往能造成最大的痛苦。"

她机械强化的身体深深地吸了一口气，继续道。"这份期待将会给咱家带来无上的欢愉。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Cydonia frowns petulantly through your declaration.

"A favor?" he calls out shrilly, "My mighty queen's protection for the feeble promise of a-"

A metallic boom and the electric hum of overcharged amplification drown out Cydonia's mockery. Kanta's voice is like thunder, echoing off the armored wall-panels of the court chamber.

"WE ACCEPT."

With those simple words, she sits. Her face, a dark mask, has no expression you can discern. But she might be smiling to herself, somewhere inside her shell.
texts.zh:
Cydonia 在你宣告时不满地皱起了眉头。

"一个人情？" 他尖声叫道，"让我强大的女王提供保护，你却只愿给一个 ——"

金属音的巨响和过载扩音器的电子音淹没了 Cydonia 的嘲笑。Kanta 如雷般的声音在王庭的装甲墙之间回响。

"咱 家 接 受。"

仅仅说出这几个字后，她再次坐下。她的脸如同一副深色的面具，让你无法辨别出其下潜藏的表情。但军阀可能在暗自微笑着，就在她金属外壳下的某处。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
There is dark murmuring from the crowd of pirates as they jostle, metallic clinks and scrapes coming from their brazenly displayed weapons and combat armor.

Kanta's metal body hisses on her throne, patient as a landmine. Cydonia glares at you then leans over to whisper something to some pirate sergeant. The pirate makes a face as he catches himself pulling away from Cydonia.
texts.zh:
海盗人群相互推挤，压着嗓子的窃窃私语里透出不祥，那些毫不遮掩亮出来的武器与战斗护甲叮当、刮擦作响。

Kanta 的金属身躯在王座上嘶嘶作响，耐心得像一枚地雷。Cydonia 瞪了你一眼，随即侧身对某个海盗军士耳语了几句。那海盗察觉自己下意识往旁边躲了躲，脸上不由得做了个怪相。

texts.en: There is murmuring from the crowd of pirates as they jostle, metallic clinks and scrapes coming from their brazenly displayed weapons and combat armor.
texts.zh: 海盗人群相互推挤，低声议论着，那些毫不遮掩亮出来的武器与战斗护甲叮当、刮擦作响。

texts.en:
You step back from the center of the court-chamber, your time in the garish spotlight now finished.

Kanta's metal body hisses on her throne, patient as a landmine. Cydonia scuttles to speak with one or another pirate sergeant responsible for prisoners and petitioners awaiting Kanta's judgment.
texts.zh:
你从王庭大厅的中央后退了一步，你在聚光灯下的时间已经结束了。

Kanta 的金属身体在王座上发出嘶嘶声，她如地雷般耐心。Cydonia 快步走向另一个海盗头目并与之交谈，此人负责看管有待 Kanta 处置的犯人和有求之人。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
As you leave, the court rumbles, and calls, jeers and admonitions directed at you, and each other.

Pirates in the corridors of Kanta's Den glower and grumble at your passing, their eyes promising secret blood spilled at some future opportunity.
texts.zh:
你离开时，整座王庭处于骚动之中，你身后皆是各类针对你和针对海盗彼此的呼声，嘲笑以及指责。

Kanta 之巢通道里的其他海盗在你路过时无一不对你虎视眈眈、念念有词，他们的眼神预示着未来某个时机必将在暗地里给你放血。

texts.en:
The doctor's eyebrows raise, his interest obviously piqued. He looks furtively at Kanta, as if any expression by hateful domination could be gleaned from her mask-face.
He licks his lips and-

"The Lion's Blood," Kanta's voice rumbles like a mining drill. "The Lion's heir. One of so few, so few remaining..." Her voice drops several octaves, then continues as pure noise, a rumbling in your chest. Kanta's court shuffles uncomfortably.

If her ceramic-armor mask could show pleasure, that is what you think it would be doing now. And it is answer enough.

As for what nightmares await sleeping Leonidas... you put that question far from your mind.
texts.zh:
医生扬起眉毛，兴致显然被勾了起来。他偷偷瞟向 Kanta，仿佛想从她那张面具似的脸上，辨出哪怕一丝带着恨意的威仪。
他舔了舔嘴唇，正要——

"雄狮之血，" Kanta 的嗓音像矿钻一样隆隆作响。"雄狮的继承人。所剩无几，所剩无几了..." 她的声音陡然沉下几个八度，接着化作纯粹的噪声，在你胸腔里隆隆震颤。Kanta 的王庭里，众人不安地挪动着脚步。

倘若她那张陶瓷装甲面具能露出快意，你想，此刻它多半正是这副模样。而这，已经算是答案了。

至于沉睡中的 Leonidas 会迎来怎样的噩梦...你把这个念头远远抛到了脑后。

texts.en:
Although nothing appears to change in the holodisplay, you hear nothing more from the voice.

It feels, somehow, as if an animating presence has departed.

Your comms officer looks wide-eyed at you in amazement. The others' expressions range from world-weary incomprehension to barely-suppressed terror.
texts.zh:
虽然全息投影没有任何变化，你没再听到那个声音再说任何话语了。

看上去，似乎驱动这一切的存在已经离开了。

你的通讯军官惊讶地瞪眼看着你。其他人的表情多是掩饰不住的恐惧和疲惫的不解。

options.en: Reports by end-of-shift! Dismissed.

texts.en:
Their reports don't tell you anything you couldn't already guess.

The techs who were ordered to run a more paranoid than usual sweep found nothing in your $shipOrFleet's computer systems that wasn't supposed to be there - any more than usual, at least. Nothing of the telemetry recorded during your 'chat' provides anything of use.

The navigational coordinates which appeared in the comms buffer appear valid, however.
texts.zh:
他们的报告没有告知任何你预料之外的内容。

技官们被要求对$shipOrFleet的电脑系统进行一个比平常更小心的扫描。扫描结果没发现多出任何本来不该在系统里的东西 —— 至少没有平时多出来的更多。你 '谈话' 中记录的遥测信息也没能提供有用的信息。

但是在你通讯缓存中出现的航行坐标看上去确实是有效的。

options.en: Let's discuss a cryosanctum package.

options.en: We spoke of Doctor Cydonia. I want what he provides.
options.zh: 我们谈过 Cydonia 博士。我想要他提供的东西。

texts.en:
"Certainly."

Blanc's mouth arranges itself into something he was probably told looked pleasant.

He makes a subtle motion, and a form appears in the comms-link. A list of packages. You skim the text - various levels of insurance, guarantees, bodily integrity maintained... regrowth of damaged elements upon thawing, neural integrity treatments...
texts.zh:
"当然。"

Blanc 把嘴摆成一个大概有人告诉过他算是和悦的形状。

他不动声色地做了个手势，通讯画面里浮出一份表格，列着各类套餐。你扫了几眼 —— 各档保险、担保、躯体完整保全... 解冻时受损部位的再生、神经完整性疗程...

texts.en: Budget Package - 25,000 credits
texts.zh: Budget Package - 25,000 credits

texts.en: Midline Package - 300,000 credits
texts.zh: Midline Package - 300,000 credits

texts.en: Deluxe Package - 1,000,000 credits
texts.zh: Deluxe Package - 1,000,000 credits

options.en: Tell me more about the budget package.
options.zh: 说说经济套餐吧。

options.en: I see you have a midline package...
options.zh: 我看你们还有个中档套餐...

options.en: I'm interested in the deluxe package.
options.zh: 我对豪华套餐感兴趣。

options.en: These feel limiting. Do you have something truly exceptional to offer?
options.zh: 这些看着都束手束脚，你们有没有真正不同凡响的东西？

options.en: Perhaps another time. (back)
options.zh: 改日再谈吧。 (返回)

texts.en:
"I'm not sure this is the right choice for you, captain. But," he lays a patient expression over his disapproval, "perhaps we may establish a... baseline."

"The budget option discards most of the unnecessary appendages, and indeed most of the corpus itself. These components help offset the expense of offering such a... reasonable option, you see."
texts.zh:
"我拿不准这是否适合您，舰长。不过，\" 他把一层耐心盖在不以为然上，\"或许我们可以先立个... 基准。"

"经济套餐会去掉大部分用不上的四肢，其实连躯干本身也去掉大半。这些部件正好拿来抵扣推出这般... 实惠价格的开销，您懂的。"

options.en: So you'd chop off my head?
options.zh: 所以你们要把我的脑袋切下来？

texts.en:
"Not exactly," he says, blandly correcting you. "The procedure is quite controlled, and retains a reasonable portion of the spinal cord to ease reconstruction."

A pause.

"It was also found that the standard cryocephalic unit permits the storage of certain... additional small organs considered by some to have sentimental value, as well. A popular option."
texts.zh:
"倒也不是，\" 他不动声色地纠正。\"流程控制得很严，还会保留相当一段脊髓，方便日后复原。"

他顿了顿。

"另外我们发现，标准的头部低温舱里还容得下某些... 额外的小器官 —— 有人觉得它们别有纪念意义。选这项的人不少。"

options.zh: 确认这一选择

options.en: Let's review your other offerings... (back)

texts.en: "Very well, Captain $playerName. We shall make the arrangements..."
texts.zh: "很好，$playerName 舰长，我们这就去安排..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Of course," he says with the mildest disapproval. "A common option for... those of limited means."

"Much of the body is preserved, though to fit the smaller, and more efficient, long-term cryo units, certain reversible procedures are undergone to remove as much unnecessary volume and mass as possible."
texts.zh:
"自然，\" 他微微露出点不以为然。\"这是... 手头不宽裕的人常选的。"

"身体大部分都留着，只不过为了塞进更小、更省地方的长期低温舱，得先做些可逆处理，把不必要的体积和分量尽量去掉。"

options.en: Tell me more of this... reversible procedure.
options.zh: 详细说说这个... 可逆处理。

texts.en:
He smiles icily.

"The commonplace organs are removed - to bring down the cost of cryosanctum, you see. And then, much of the fat, muscle, and bones are..."

Blanc licks his lips. You'd swear his tongue makes a rasping sound, but that may simply have been signal interference.

"Think of it as... folding. Folding was an ancient art on Old Earth, I am told," he muses. "The resulting package is quite compact, retaining all the distinctive elements of mind and body, to be... reconstructed at a future date."
texts.zh:
他冷冰冰地一笑。

"寻常那些器官会取出来 —— 您也知道，好把低温圣所的价钱压下来。然后，大部分脂肪、肌肉、骨头就..."

Blanc 舔了舔嘴唇。你几乎敢担保他的舌头发出干涩的摩擦声，不过也可能只是信号干扰。

"不妨想成... 折叠。听说折叠是古地球的一门古老技艺，\" 他悠悠地说。\"折好之后十分紧凑，心智与身体所有要紧的特征都留着，等将来某个日子再... 重新拼回去。"

texts.en:
"Ah, the deluxe." An attempt at a pleasant expression creaks into being on his face.

"This is the full-body option. We provide a custom-tuned cryosarcophagus which, I must note, is a far more sophisticated piece of equipment than the standard emergency survival tube spacefarers are familiar with. And it is not quite infinitely more reliable than the crude, mass-fabricated things many of our own ancestors were lucky enough to survive on their journey to the Persean Sector."

You'd swear Blanc is nearly enthusiastic about the subject.

"We guarantee a slot in our top-of-the-line cryorevival facilities and provide enhanced recuperation procedures. As we like to say, 'Your future self will feel younger than you do today'."

He smiles, teeth like dead ivory.
texts.zh:
"啊，豪华款。" 他脸上一点点挤出个讨喜的表情，僵硬得像生了锈。

"这是全身方案。我们提供一具按您量身调校的低温棺 —— 我得说，比起寻常跑船人熟悉的那种标准应急求生舱，可要精密得多。不过，比起当年我们不少祖先靠着侥幸活下来、一路驶到英仙座星域的那些粗制滥造的量产货，它的可靠性倒也算不上高出无穷倍。"

你简直要以为 Blanc 对这个话题生出了几分热忱。

"我们保证在顶尖的低温复苏设施里为您留一个位置，另附强化康复疗程。用我们的话说：'未来的您，会比今天的您更觉年轻'。"

他笑了，一口牙白得像死象牙。

texts.en:
"You have exceptional taste, I can tell, captain," Blanc says, eyes widening slightly.

"If you provide us with a budget of, perhaps, five million credits, you will be treated as though you were one of the legendary immortal monarchs of Old Earth."

"The custom-tuned cryosarcophagus and top-of-the-line cryomedical monitoring team - rotated and replaced throughout your stay - come without question. Your awakening, a kind of second birth, would be attended by the finest care that the investments Mbaye-Gogol has made into the future of human health can provide."

"Many of our Directors have themselves made a... similar decision."
texts.zh:
"舰长，看得出您品味不凡，" Blanc 说着，眼睛微微睁大。

"只要您拿出个，比方说，五百万信用点的预算，我们便能当您是古地球传说里那些长生不老的君王来伺候。"

"量身调校的低温棺、顶尖的低温医疗监护团队自不待言 —— 您住多久，团队便轮替更换多久。您醒来时，如同再世为人，会有 Mbaye-Gogol 为人类健康未来投下的心血所能换来的最周全照护。"

"我们不少董事自己也做过... 类似的选择。"

texts.en: He nods slowly, unblinking.
texts.zh: 他缓缓点头，眼睛一眨不眨。

texts.en:
You explain your requirements in somewhat elliptical terms. It is a politically and ethically sensitive proposal, after all.

As Blanc picks up on your intimations, he almost looks amused. "Hardly a unique case, $playerSirOrMadam."

"We welcome many guests with... unique medical situations to the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum."

"May we suggest a secure, mid-term care package for 100,000 credits? It has a 50-cycle guarantee of integrity with very reasonable rewewal options."
texts.zh:
你把要求说得颇为含混。毕竟这提议在政治和伦理上都烫手。

Blanc 听懂了言外之意，几乎显出点觉得有趣的样子。"这算不上什么特例，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所接待过许多... 医疗状况颇为特殊的客人。"

"可否向您推荐一份稳妥的中期托管方案，十万信用点？含五十周期的完好担保，续期条件也相当公道。"

texts.en:
"I believe I recall the details of the situation," Blanc says, stone-faced.

"May we suggest a secure, mid-term care package for 100,000 credits? It has a 50-cycle guarantee of integrity with very reasonable renewal options."
texts.zh:
"这桩情形的细节，我应当还记得，" Blanc 面无表情地说。

"可否向您推荐一份稳妥的中期托管方案，十万信用点？含五十周期的完好担保，续期条件也相当公道。"

options.en: Accept his terms
options.zh: 接受他的条件

options.en: Perhaps another time. (back)
options.zh: 改日再谈吧。 (返回)

texts.en:
The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit into the bowels of Nomios. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off as soon as it is wheeled through the first set of doors.

Leonidas will be safe, here. And the Sector safe from Leonidas.

For now.

手续办妥了。

一艘查不出来历的穿梭机把一具没有任何标记的低温休眠舱送进 Nomios 深处。你悄悄装在舱上的追踪器，在它被推过第一道门的一瞬间便断了信号。

Leonidas 在这里会平安无事，星域也终于不必再提防 Leonidas。

暂时如此。

texts.en:
Your eyes wander to meet the hard gaze of The Lion of Sindria glowering darkly from a suspiciously upscaled full-body holo-portrait projected to overlook the trader's concourse.

You think to yourself...
texts.zh:
你的目光游移过去，正撞上辛达瑞亚之狮那沉郁而锐利的凝视——那幅全身全息肖像大得有些可疑，投映在交易广场上方，俯视着来往的人群。

你暗自思忖...

texts.en:
Your eyes wander over a crudely disfigured image of the Lion of Sindria glowering darkly from a peeling agit-print, mass-fabricated and postered to keep the ARC's hate pure.

His portrait is inverted, his face X'd out with jagged red lightning bolts, the skulls of his victims piled around his head.

You think to yourself...
texts.zh:
你的目光扫过一幅粗糙毁损的画像：辛达瑞亚之狮从那剥落的宣传画里阴沉地瞪视着。画是批量印制的，贴满街巷，只为让 Askonia 革命者委员会心里的仇恨保持纯粹。

画像被倒挂着，脸上打了个红叉，四周钉着锯齿状的红色闪电；他那些"受害者"的骷髅堆在他脑袋周围。

你暗自思忖...

texts.en:
Your eyes wander to a flickering holoprojector casting a news channel over the trader's concourse. The latest crimes of the Sindrian regime are being iterated over an image of The Lion of Sindria caught glowering darkly during some military inspection.

You think to yourself...
texts.zh:
你的目光被一台闪烁的全息投影仪吸引，它正把新闻频道投到交易广场上方。辛达政权的最新罪行被逐条念出，配图是辛达瑞亚之狮在某次军事视察中阴沉着脸的样子。

你暗自思忖...

texts.en:
And why not?

Andrada carved a stellar empire from the heart of the Persean Sector, then was foolish enough to let it and himself fall to ruin.

You are no fool. You won't repeat his mistakes. You need to know what you're working with - and exactly what Macario is up to.
texts.zh:
有何不可？

Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国，随后又蠢到让自己和它一同坠入废墟。

你不是蠢人，不会重蹈他的覆辙。你得弄清楚自己手里握着什么——以及 Macario 到底在做什么。

texts.en:
And why not?

Philip Andrada carved a stellar empire out of the heart of the Persean Sector and then, it seems, when his body - though not his immortal will - faltered, it allowed parasites and traitors to bring corruption and ruin to his vision.

You are no fool. You know who your enemies are, and you know that victory is simply a matter of transcendent will. You need to know what you're working with - and exactly what Macario is up to.

Then you shall strike.
texts.zh:
有何不可？

Philip Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国；而后，当他的身体——而非他不朽的意志——开始衰败，寄生虫与叛徒便得以把他的愿景拖进腐败与毁灭。

你不是蠢人。你知道自己的敌人是谁，也知道胜利不过是超凡意志的产物。你得弄清楚自己手里握着什么——以及 Macario 到底在做什么。

那就动手。

texts.en:
The hacker is mercurial, but Gargoyle's curiosity can be counted on, to say nothing of the opportunity to disgrace and annoy one or more powerful factions by revealing secrets.

It is clear, then, that you must take the ANDRADA files to Gargoyle at the Galatia Academy.

(DEV or maybe Tse Franchise Station)
texts.zh:
这名骇客性情多变，但 Gargoyle 的好奇心可以指望，更别提揭露秘密好让一个甚至多个强大势力颜面尽失、恼羞成怒的机会了。

所以很清楚，你必须把 ANDRADA 的文件交给加拉提亚学院（Galatia Academy）的 Gargoyle。

（DEV 或 Tse Franchise Station）

The have waves a dismissal.

"And I, captain, serve glorious battle. The credits of my patron merely pave the path toward the glory of the warrior."

$HeOrShe looks over one shoulder, almost coy.

"I have heard much spoken of those loyal to the Lion of Sindria. Perhaps your reputed fervor will enhance the honor of my victory."

那只手一挥，示意不必再说。

"而我，舰长，效忠于光荣的战斗。雇主的星币，不过是替我铺出一条通往战士荣光的路。"

texts.zh:
那只手迟疑了。$HisOrHer 的头转向一侧，也许是在看 $hisOrHer 的战术官。

对面的舰桥上传来喊叫，被通讯隐私算法搅得失真。$PersonLastName 猛地扭头，$hisOrHer 那副不可撼动的神情有一瞬动摇。随即转为怒意。

"把你的借口扔进太空去，懦夫！叛徒！"$HisOrHer 的咒骂全冲着 $hisOrHer 自己舰桥上的某名军官。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The mercenary $post struggles with $hisOrHer belt for a moment then draws a pistol which snaps to a threatening position somewhere off-link. More shouting.

The link snaps off. It's unclear if the flash was a weapons discharge or just noise at the end of an interrupted comms buffer.

Regardless, chaos on the mercenary's bridge may provide you with an opportunity for easy disengagement.
texts.zh:
雇佣兵 $post 在 $hisOrHer 腰带上摸索了一下，随即拔出手枪，枪口一下抬向画面外某个威胁性的方位。喊声更响了。

通讯骤然中断。那一闪究竟是武器击发，还是通讯缓冲被截断时的杂讯，说不清楚。

无论如何，那名雇佣兵舰桥上的混乱，也许正好给了你轻松脱身的机会。

"Space your excuses, coward! Traitor!" $HisOrHer invectives are directed at an officer on $hisOrHer own bridge.

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks back over a shoulder. The hand waves a dismissal.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I serve only the splendor of battle. The credits of my patron merely pave a path toward the glory of war.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 回头望了一眼。那只手一挥，示意不必再说。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我只效忠于战斗的壮美。雇主的星币，不过是替我铺出一条通往战争荣光的路。

texts.en:
The have waves a dismissal.

"And I, captain, serve glorious battle. The credits of my patron merely pave the path toward the glory of the warrior."

$HeOrShe looks over one shoulder, almost coy.

"I have heard much spoken of those loyal to the Lion of Sindria. Perhaps your reputed fervor will enhance the honor of my victory."
texts.zh:
那只手一挥，示意不必再说。

"而我，舰长，效忠于光荣的战斗。雇主的星币，不过是替我铺出一条通往战士荣光的路。"

$HeOrShe 回头望过一侧肩膀，带着几分刻意的含情。

"关于忠于辛达瑞亚之狮的那些人，我听过不少说法。也许你传闻中的那股狂热，能让我的胜利更有光彩。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.zh: 那只手迟疑着。这一刻被拉得很长。

texts.en:
As the transfer pings, the hand waves a dismissal.

"I, $playerSirOrMadam, serve glorious battle. Credits merely pave a path toward the glory of war, whether they come from my patron or from my..." $HeOrShe considers $hisOrHer words for a moment, then looks over one shoulder, almost coy. "My supplicant."

$HeOrShe spins once more to face you, half-cape fluttering in a practiced motion.

"Until we meet again - in battle, no doubt."
texts.zh:
转账到账的提示音响过，那只手一挥，示意作罢。

"我，$playerSirOrMadam，只侍奉光荣的战斗。星币不过是铺就通往战争荣光之路的石子，无论它来自我的雇主，还是来自我的...\"$HeOrShe 略微斟酌了$hisOrHer措辞，随后侧过一边肩膀，几乎带着几分娇态，\"还是来自我的祈求者。"

$HeOrShe 再次旋身面对你，半披风随着这练熟的动作翻飞。

"后会有期——当然，是在战场上。"

texts.en: "A coward's ruse!" shouts $personName. "I smelled it from the start. This is no true warrior we face in battle, but a cashier, a mere credit-pinching accountant."
texts.zh: "懦夫的把戏！\"$personName吼道，\"我一开始就闻出来了。我们在战场上撞见的不是什么真正的战士，是个收银员，一个只会数着星币过日子的账房。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe spins once more to face you, half-cape fluttering in a practiced motion.

"Fly, fly now my hunters! My beautiful knights of the vacuum! Fight gloriously!"

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 再次旋身面对你，半披风随着这练熟的动作翻飞。

"去吧，去吧，我的猎手们！我美丽的真空骑士！光荣地战斗吧！"

通讯中断。

texts.en:
* * *

Your tech officer makes arrangements so that it appears as if the AIs freed themselves using pre-existing security holes in the maintenance subsystems.

Meanwhile, Crasis takes it upon themself to author a colorful parting message for whoever arrives to 'clean up' the failed Irkalla project.
texts.zh:
* * *

你的技术官做了安排，让这一切看起来像是 AI 们利用维护子系统里原有的安全漏洞自行脱身。

与此同时，Crasis 自告奋勇，为那些上门来'收拾'Irkalla 这个失败项目的人写了一封花样十足的告别信。

options.en: Stand down - I hold a Tri-Tachyon commission. We're on the same team.
options.zh: \"退下——我持有速子科技的委任状。我们是自己人。\

texts.en:
"I... no-no, that's not going- no problem at all." $HeOrShe speaks rapidly, stumbling over $hisOrHer own thoughts. "We, I don't have a Tachy commission, so it's OK, you see?"

"I see," $heOrShe says, nodding.
texts.zh:
"我...不、不，这不成——一点问题都没有。\" $HeOrShe 说得飞快，被 $hisOrHer 自己的想法绊得直打结。\"我们，我没有速子科技的委任状，所以没关系，你明白吧？"

"我明白了。" $heOrShe 点头道。

options.en: Are you feeling okay?
options.zh: 你还好吗？

texts.en:
"Yes! Of-course yes."

The answer comes too quick, thoughtlessly, as $hisOrHer wandering eyes snap intently on yours through the link.

It takes a moment for the meaning of the question to parse.

"You waste my time! We shall engage."
texts.zh:
"是！当然，是。"

回答来得太快，不加思索；$hisOrHer 游移的目光透过链接骤然钉在你身上。

过了一会儿，才咂摸出这个问题是什么意思。

"你在浪费我的时间！开战吧。"

options.en: What if I paid you to not kill me?
options.zh: 如果付钱让你别杀我呢？

texts.en:
"No, no. That would break the contract."

$HisOrHer hands look like a pair of fighting eels, the pale kind grown as tank-protein.

"You can't break the contract. Bad business. Contract penalty, pay 50k. I should review..." One hand attaches itself to a datapad, trembling. "-Later. Not now. Irrelevant. Delivering..."

The merc looks back at you.

"You violated client property. Consequences, consequences."
texts.zh:
"不，不。那会毁了合约。"

$HisOrHer 的双手像两条互相绞缠的鳗，培育槽里养出来的那种惨白色。

"合约不能毁。坏买卖。违约金，50,000。我该查一下...\"一只手探向数据板，抖着。\"...回头。不是现在。不相干。送货..."

那名雇佣兵重新看向你。

"你侵犯了雇主的财产。后果，后果。"

options.en: A bit of professional advice - you've misjudged the strength of my $shipOrFleet.
options.zh: 给你一句专业建议——你错判了我手头 $shipOrFleet 的战力。

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes twitch alarmingly.

"Impossible! Sensors, tactical, recalc! Another scan! Now!"

Fingers drum on the console as the merc's bulging eyes do their best to stare you down.
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer 的眼皮抽搐起来，抽得人心里发慌。

"不可能！传感、战术，重算！再扫一遍！马上！"

手指在控制台上敲个不停；雇佣兵凸出的双眼竭力想把你盯穿。

options.en: Take this opportunity to cut comms and disengage
options.zh: 趁此机会切断通讯，脱离接触

options.en: Do you know K-O Jove?
options.zh: 你知道 K-O Jove 吗？

texts.en:
$HeOrShe pauses deliberately before answering.

"Might know one by that name. might not. Why?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 刻意停顿了一下，才开口。

"也许认识一个叫这名字的。也许不认识。问这个做什么？"

options.en: Can he be trusted? Is his information good?
options.zh: 他靠得住吗？他的消息准吗？

options.en: Why's he called 'K-O?' It's a strange name.
options.zh: 为什么叫他 K-O？这名字挺怪。

options.en: That's all, thanks.
options.zh: 就这些，谢谢。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you for a long moment.

"Those are very different questions when it comes to Jove." $HeOrShe looks down. "That's all I'll say about that."
OR
"I suppose as much as anyone around here," $heOrShe says with a grin. "Do you trust me?"

"Don't answer that. Don't care to know."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 久久地看着你。

"问到 Jove 头上，这两个问题可就差得太远了。\" $HeOrShe 垂下目光。\"这件事我只说这么多。"
OR
"大概跟这一带任何人一样靠得住。\" $heOrShe 咧嘴一笑。\"你信我吗？"

"别回答。我也不想知道。"

texts.en:
"K-O." $HeOrShe repeats the name. "I always assumed it meant 'knockout'. From a bar fight, you know?"
OR
"Is it?" $HeOrShe looks genuinely confused. "People go by initials from time to time."

"It's a strange question, don't you think?" $HeOrShe looks satisfied to have turned this around on you.
OR
"Never asked." $HeOrShe shrugs. "Seemed like it'd be rude. People call themselves all sorts of things."
OR
"This is Qaras," $heOrShe says, matter-of-fact. "People come here all the time and find a new name, new face. New all sorts of things. I don't make it my business to find out if they're not volunteering why. We all got a past."

"Some more than others," $heOrShe says, giving you a significant look.
texts.zh:
"K-O。\" $HeOrShe 把这个名字重复了一遍。\"我一直以为那是【击倒】的意思。酒吧斗殴里那种，你懂吧？"
OR
"是吗？\" $HeOrShe 看上去真的糊涂了。\"用缩写当名字的人时不时也有。"

"这问题挺怪，你不觉得吗？" $HeOrShe 把话头反推回你身上，显得颇为得意。
OR
"没问过。\" $HeOrShe 耸肩。\"问了显得没礼貌。人给自己起的名字五花八门。"
OR
"这里是 Qaras。\" $heOrShe 说得平平淡淡。\"总有人来这儿，换一个新名字、一张新面孔。新的什么都有。人家不主动说，我就不去打听。谁都有过去。"

"有些人的过去比别人的多。" $heOrShe 意味深长地看了你一眼。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives an unenthusiastic nod of acknowledgement.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 提不起兴致地点了下头，算是知道了。

texts.en: You have a meeting scheduled with a Mammonite to talk with a third party who might know something about Jethro Bornanew, but it is not yet the agreed upon time.
texts.zh: 你有一个日程安排，准备同一个玛门之仆一起，和某位可能了解 Jethro Bornanew 的人会面。但现在还没到约定的时间。

texts.en:
You ask around about someone named 'Jason Korin', lubricating the conversation freely with purchased drinks. Most are pleased to accept your generosity - such token gifts in exchange for a bit of goodwill and a rumor are a fixture of spaceport bars

No one has heard of a 'Jason Korin', however, nor seen the young man whose image you extracted from the intel file.

Alternatives are suggested for whatever presumed service you are seeking or offering but, with clarification, you receive nothing more than an apologetic shrug or a raised glass and the expressed hope that you'll find yourself under a luckier star soon enough.
texts.zh:
你四处打听一个叫 Jason Korin 的人，用买来的酒水把话头润得顺滑。多数人乐意接受你的慷慨——用这点小恩小惠换几分好感和一则传闻，本是太空港酒吧的常态。

然而没人听过 Jason Korin 这个名字，也没人见过你从情报文件里截出的那个年轻人的模样。

人们纷纷替你猜你想找或想卖的是哪一门路，可等你解释清楚，换来的只有一句抱歉的耸肩，或者举起酒杯，说希望你早点走到一颗运气更好的星下去。

options.en: Consider your options
options.zh: 考虑你的选择

options.en: I was assaulted on Qaras; I wish to... investigate.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 上遭了袭击；我希望能...调查一下。

options.en: I was assaulted on Qaras; I require revenge.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 上遭了袭击；我要报仇。

texts.en: "Investigate?" $HeOrShe gives you a skeptical look. "You won a fight or you lost. What's to investigate?"
texts.zh: "调查？\"$HeOrShe 怀疑地看着你。\"打一场，要么赢要么输。有什么好调查的？"

texts.en:
"Anyway, I'm just the $post. If this was a matter of a bad batch of chem, maybe I could help you out. We produce a good, clean supply here on Qaras," $heOrShe says proudly. "Got a reputation to maintain."

Sensing your lack of immediate interest in the finer points of the recreational drug industry, $heOrShe adds, "Might try with one of the big bosses. Should have open comms IDs. Good luck with your problem, captain."
texts.zh:
"再说，我不过是个 $post。如果这是哪批化学药剂出了问题，我或许还能帮你一把。Qaras 这边出的货干净、品质好，\"$heOrShe 语气里带点自豪，\"名声是要护着的。"

察觉你对娱乐性药物生意的门道没什么即时兴趣，$heOrShe 又补了一句："不妨去找哪位大老板试试。他们的通讯识别码应该是公开的。舰长，愿你的事顺利。"

texts.en:
Sensing you won't give up so easily, $heOrShe sighs, then speaks.

"So what would this entail? We have a system here on Qaras that keeps things so that we may conduct our business... freely. Why should I stick my neck out for you?"
texts.zh:
看出你不会这么轻易罢手，$heOrShe 叹了口气，才开口。

"那这要牵扯到什么？Qaras 这里有自己的一套规矩，好让我们能把生意...自由地做下去。我凭什么要为你冒险出头？"

options.en: You must recall that I have an... arrangement with Warlord Kanta.
options.zh: 你应当记得，我与军阀 Kanta 之间有一份...安排。

options.en: You must recall that I have an... arrangement with Warlord Kanta.
options.zh: 你应当记得，我与军阀 Kanta 之间有一份...安排。

options.en: Have you appreciated my $shipOrFleet?
options.zh: 你可有好好端详过我这支 $shipOrFleet？

options.en: Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
options.zh: 10,000 星币，能买你的支持吗？

options.en: Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
options.zh: 10,000 星币，能买你的支持吗？

options.en: You must recall that I have... an arrangement with Warlord Kanta. (lie)
options.zh: 你应当记得，我与军阀 Kanta 之间...有一份安排。 (说谎)

options.en: Let me ask about something else... (back)
options.zh: 我换个问题问问... (返回)

texts.en:
The pirate squints, then picks up a datapad, taps it, and sets it down.

"Ah, so you're that $playerName."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat. "It would be my honor to sponsor your imposition of, ah, justice upon your attacker."
texts.zh:
那海盗眯起眼，随后拿起数据板，点了几下，又放下。

"啊，原来你就是那位 $playerName。"

$HeOrShe 清了清 $hisOrHer 嗓子。"能为你对你那位袭击者施加的、呃，正义做个保人，是我的荣幸。"

texts.en:
"I assume you'll be 'taking out' the party and-or individual who wronged you. Worth making a little example to uphold our policy of armed politeness, isn't it? Poor bastard."

"I'll make sure no one interferes." $HeOrShe gives a little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"我猜你会把那伙人、或者那个害了你的家伙'清掉'。正好拿来做个小样板，维系我们这套'武装礼貌'的规矩，不是吗？可怜的东西。"

"我会保证没人来插手。"$HeOrShe 抬手行了个小礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en:
The pirate picks up a datapad and taps at it. $HisOrHer eyebrows raise appreciatively.

"I see... yes. That'll do." $HeOrShe smiles. "You see, with a $shipOrFleet like that, no one can call me a coward for, ah, offering my full assistance with your pursuit of justice."
texts.zh:
那海盗拿起数据板点了几下。$HisOrHer 眉毛赞许地扬了起来。

"我明白了...对。这就够了。\"$HeOrShe 笑了。\"你看，有那样一支 $shipOrFleet 在手，谁还敢说我懦弱——毕竟我只是，呃，全力协助你追讨公道而已。"

texts.en:
The pirate places a finger on $hisOrHer chin, taking a fraction of a second to consider your offer.

"Yes. Yes it would."
texts.zh:
那海盗一根手指抵在 $hisOrHer 下巴上，用了不到一瞬考虑你的提议。

"能。确实能。"

options.en: Transfer 10,000 credits
options.zh: 转出 10,000 星币

options.en: Let's discuss alternatives.
options.zh: 我们谈谈别的方案。

texts.en:
"Received," $heOrShe says, pleased. "I would honored to assist you in pursuing justice for this... this outrageous assault upon an upstanding merchant-captain of good reputation!"

$HeOrShe winks.
texts.zh:
"收到了。\"$heOrShe 语气满意。\"能协助你为这次...这次对一位声誉良好的正直商船船长的骇人袭击追讨公道，是我的荣幸！"

$HeOrShe 冲你眨了下眼。

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks disappointed, but nods.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 显得失望，但还是点了点头。

texts.en:
"You? An arrangement? I haven't heard of any such..."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad and starts to taps at it.
texts.zh:
"你？安排？我可没听说过有什么这样的..."

$HeOrShe 拿起数据板，开始在上面点划。

options.en: I suppose you weren't told. That's not a good sign, is it.
options.zh: 看来没人告诉过你。这可不是什么好兆头，对吧。

texts.en:
"What do you mean?"

There it is. A worried look.

"Maybe it's news to you," $PersonName sits up a little straighter, "but I'm pretty important here on Qaras. I have contacts in Kanta's court. Anyone who matters does. Nothing happens without my knowing it!"
texts.zh:
"你什么意思？"

就是这一下。一丝忧虑浮上他的脸。

"这对你也许算新鲜，\"$PersonName 把身子坐直了些，\"可我在 Qaras 这地方是相当有分量的。我在 Kanta 的宫廷里有关系。但凡有点地位的人都有。这一片没有哪件事能瞒过我！"

options.en: But if someone wanted to empty your seat, how would they do it?
options.zh: 可要是有人想把你从这个位子上弄下去，他们会怎么动手？

texts.en:
You explain where they'd attack first if they were too weak for a frontal assault: $hisOrHer sources of information.

This malefactor would cut key pieces of intel out of the loop, bribe or threaten or simply deceive certain low-level informants, and in doing so contrive a misunderstanding between $personName, the $Post of Qaras, and the mighty Warlord Kanta.

A misunderstanding which can easily turn into a conflict.

And a conflict with Kanta? That's a very dangerous place to find oneself. Especially if one doesn't even know it.

The pirate looks at you, ashen. Datapad forgotten. "Who would do this? I've treated my people well. I've rewarded success."
texts.zh:
你解释说，若对方弱到打不了正面强攻，会先攻哪里：$hisOrHer 的情报来源。

这恶徒会把关键的情报从环路里切走，收买、威胁，或者干脆欺骗几个低层线人，就此在 $personName——Qaras 的 $Post——与强大的军阀 Kanta 之间做出一场误会。

而误会，很容易变成冲突。

与 Kanta 起冲突？那可是个极其危险的位置。尤其是在你自己都还没察觉的时候。

那海盗脸色发灰地看着你，数据板早忘了。"谁会这么做？我待我的人不薄。有功的我都赏过。"

options.en: ...It's often said that the warmest smile conceals the coldest betrayal.
options.zh: ...常有人说，最暖的笑掩着最冷的背叛。

texts.en:
$HisOrHer brow furrows. "I haven't heard that one before."

"But it's not wrong." $HeOrShe looks away, silently assessing contacts and allies.

"Rads and blood," $heOrShe whispers to $himOrHerself. "Could it be..."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer 眉头皱起。"这话我倒是头一回听说。"

"但没说错。"$HeOrShe 移开目光，在心里默默盘点手下的人与盟友。

"辐射与血啊，"$heOrShe 低声对 $himOrHerself 说，"难道真会..."

options.en: Don't act too quickly; first, cover for yourself. I could put in a good word...
options.zh: 别急着动手；先把自己护住。我可以替你去说句话...

texts.en:
"...at Kanta's court," $heOrShe finishes for you.

"If not directly to Herself. Yes," $heOrShe nods. "I'll need to play this smart to draw them out. Counter every the move - first, ensure that Kanta knows I'm loyal."
texts.zh:
"...在 Kanta 的宫廷里。"$heOrShe 替你把话说完。

"若不是直接说给她本人听。对，\"$heOrShe 点头，\"我要把这事做得聪明些，才能把他们引出来。每一步都要反着走——首先，得让 Kanta 知道我忠心。"

options.en: You know, you're quite the tactician.
options.zh: 说起来，你还真是个出色的战术家。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods, accepting the compliment graciously.

"With Kanta's blessing - and my support - go to Qaras and investigate... take out, whatever is necessary, whoever wronged you. I'll ensure no one interferes."

"I appreciate your insights, captain. I guess it's true what they say about you." $HeOrShe gives a small salute. "Good hunting."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 点了点头，体面地收下这句称赞。

"有 Kanta 的许可——加上我的支持——你就去 Qaras 查吧...该清掉谁就清掉谁，谁害了你，就找谁。我会保证没人来插手。"

"舰长，你这番见地我很受用。看来外头传你的那些话是真的。"$HeOrShe 抬手行了个小礼。"猎运亨通。"

options.en: You as well. (cut comms)
options.zh: 你也一样。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: "Alright," $heOrShe says, giving you a funny look.
texts.zh: "也罢。"$heOrShe 说着，怪怪地看了你一眼。

texts.zh: "那就这样吧。"$heOrShe 说着，怪怪地看了你一眼。

texts.zh: "知道了。"$heOrShe 说着，怪怪地看了你一眼。

texts.en: "Again with this?" $HeOrshe frowns. "Qaras deals with its own problems and it's worked out so far. Why should I back outsider meddling?"
texts.zh: "又提这个？\"$HeOrshe 皱起眉。\"Qaras 自己的麻烦自己了，至今也都这么过来了。我凭什么要替外人的插手撑腰？"

那海盗拿起数据板点了几下。$HisOrHer 眉毛赞许地扬了起来。

"我明白了...对。这就够了。\"$HeOrShe 笑了。\"你看，有那样一支 $shipOrFleet 在手，谁还敢说我懦弱——毕竟我只是，呃，全力协助你追讨公道而已。"

texts.en:
The pirate places a finger on $hisOrHer chin, taking a fraction of a second to consider your offer.

"Yes. Yes it would."
texts.zh:
那海盗一根手指抵在 $hisOrHer 下巴上，用了不到一瞬考虑你的提议。

"能。确实能。"

options.en: Transfer 10,000 credits
options.zh: 转出 10,000 星币

options.en: Let's discuss alternatives.
options.zh: 我们谈谈别的方案。

texts.en:
"Received," $heOrShe says, pleased. "I would honored to assist you in pursuing justice for this... this outrageous assault upon an upstanding merchant-captain of good reputation!"

$HeOrShe winks.
texts.zh:
"收到了。\"$heOrShe 语气满意。\"能协助你为这次...这次对一位声誉良好的正直商船船长的骇人袭击追讨公道，是我的荣幸！"

$HeOrShe 冲你眨了下眼。

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks disappointed, but nods.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 显得失望，但还是点了点头。

texts.en:
"You? An arrangement? I haven't heard of any such..."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad and starts to taps at it.
texts.zh:
"你？安排？我可没听说过有什么这样的..."

$HeOrShe 拿起数据板，开始在上面点划。

options.en: I suppose you weren't told. That's not a good sign, is it.
options.zh: 看来没人告诉过你。这可不是什么好兆头，对吧。

texts.en:
"What do you mean?"

There it is. A worried look.

"Maybe it's news to you," $PersonName sits up a little straighter, "but I'm pretty important here on Qaras. I have contacts in Kanta's court. Anyone who matters does. Nothing happens without my knowing it!"
texts.zh:
"你什么意思？"

就是这一下。一丝忧虑浮上他的脸。

"这对你也许算新鲜，\"$PersonName 把身子坐直了些，\"可我在 Qaras 这地方是相当有分量的。我在 Kanta 的宫廷里有关系。但凡有点地位的人都有。这一片没有哪件事能瞒过我！"

options.en: But if someone wanted to empty your seat, how would they do it?
options.zh: 可要是有人想把你从这个位子上弄下去，他们会怎么动手？

texts.en:
You explain where they'd attack first if they were too weak for a frontal assault: $hisOrHer sources of information.

This malefactor would cut key pieces of intel out of the loop, bribe or threaten or simply deceive certain low-level informants, and in doing so contrive a misunderstanding between $personName, the $Post of Qaras, and the mighty Warlord Kanta.

A misunderstanding which can easily turn into a conflict.

And a conflict with Kanta? That's a very dangerous place to find oneself. Especially if one doesn't even know it.

The pirate looks at you, ashen. Datapad forgotten. "Who would do this? I've treated my people well. I've rewarded success."
texts.zh:
你解释说，若对方弱到打不了正面强攻，会先攻哪里：$hisOrHer 的情报来源。

这恶徒会把关键的情报从环路里切走，收买、威胁，或者干脆欺骗几个低层线人，就此在 $personName——Qaras 的 $Post——与强大的军阀 Kanta 之间做出一场误会。

而误会，很容易变成冲突。

与 Kanta 起冲突？那可是个极其危险的位置。尤其是在你自己都还没察觉的时候。

那海盗脸色发灰地看着你，数据板早忘了。"谁会这么做？我待我的人不薄。有功的我都赏过。"

options.en: ...It's often said that the warmest smile conceals the coldest betrayal.
options.zh: ...常有人说，最暖的笑掩着最冷的背叛。

texts.en:
$HisOrHer brow furrows. "I haven't heard that one before."

"But it's not wrong." $HeOrShe looks away, silently assessing contacts and allies.

"Rads and blood," $heOrShe whispers to $himOrHerself. "Could it be..."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer 眉头皱起。"这话我倒是头一回听说。"

"但没说错。"$HeOrShe 移开目光，在心里默默盘点手下的人与盟友。

"辐射与血啊，"$heOrShe 低声对 $himOrHerself 说，"难道真会..."

options.en: Don't act too quickly; first, cover for yourself. I could put in a good word...
options.zh: 别急着动手；先把自己护住。我可以替你去说句话...

texts.en:
"...at Kanta's court," $heOrShe finishes for you.

"If not directly to Herself. Yes," $heOrShe nods. "I'll need to play this smart to draw them out. Counter every the move - first, ensure that Kanta knows I'm loyal."
texts.zh:
"...在 Kanta 的宫廷里。"$heOrShe 替你把话说完。

"若不是直接说给她本人听。对，\"$heOrShe 点头，\"我要把这事做得聪明些，才能把他们引出来。每一步都要反着走——首先，得让 Kanta 知道我忠心。"

options.en: You know, you're quite the tactician.
options.zh: 说起来，你还真是个出色的战术家。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods, accepting the compliment graciously.

"With Kanta's blessing - and my support - go to Qaras and investigate... take out, whatever is necessary, whoever wronged you. I'll ensure no one interferes."

"I appreciate your insights, captain. I guess it's true what they say about you." $HeOrShe gives a small salute. "Good hunting."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 点了点头，体面地收下这句称赞。

"有 Kanta 的许可——加上我的支持——你就去 Qaras 查吧...该清掉谁就清掉谁，谁害了你，就找谁。我会保证没人来插手。"

"舰长，你这番见地我很受用。看来外头传你的那些话是真的。"$HeOrShe 抬手行了个小礼。"猎运亨通。"

options.en: You as well. (cut comms)
options.zh: 你也一样。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
"I assume you'll be 'taking out' the party and-or individual who wronged you. Worth making a little example to uphold our policy of armed politeness, isn't it? Poor bastard."

"I'll make sure no one interferes." $HeOrShe gives a little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"我猜你会把那伙人、或者那个害了你的家伙'清掉'。正好拿来做个小样板，维系我们这套'武装礼貌'的规矩，不是吗？可怜的东西。"

"我会保证没人来插手。"$HeOrShe 抬手行了个小礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en:
You convene your officers to discuss how to breach the defenses of Qaras in order to obtain intel from a minor gang leader.

The target gang is lightly armed and you have reasonable intel about their defenses and capabilities. The problem is the loose alliance of heavily armed groups pledged to defend Qaras from unauthorized incursions by outsiders - like yourself. Even the civilian population is notoriously well-armed, with more than its fair share of pirates, criminals, and deserters.

The decentralized nature of the opposition is a weakness and a strength. While they will have difficulty coordinating their efforts, there is no central command to target, no one tactical mode to anticipate and counter. The key will be not to defeat the enemy - that would require nightmarish protracted subsurface urban combat - but to sow confusion between various armed bodies so that the objective may be achieved by rapid, targeted infiltration.
texts.zh:
你召集军官们，商议如何破开 Qaras 的防线，好从一个小帮派头目嘴里挖出情报。

目标帮派装备轻，你对他们的防御与战力也有相当可靠的了解。问题在于那批重武装团伙结成的松散同盟，他们发誓要把任何未经许可的外来入侵挡在 Qaras 外面——而你正是那种外来者。连平民的武装程度都出了名的扎实，其中海盗、罪犯、逃兵的比例远高于常理。

对手分散，这既是弱点也是长处。他们各干各的，难以协同；可也没有中枢可以一击，没有一套统一的战术模式可供预判和反制。关键在于不要以击溃敌军为目标——那意味着要在深层城区里打一场噩梦般的持久巷战——而是在各支武装之间散播混乱，好让目标靠一次快速、精准的渗透达成。
effects: AddRaidObjective genericIcon "Raid the gang compound on Qaras" MEDIUM 3000 SD7SqarasRaidFinishedA true

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Prepare a 'visit' to the gang leader who ordered a goon to attack you
options.zh: 筹备一次对那个下令让打手袭击你的帮派头目的'拜访'

texts.en:
Although your bodyguards are capable, they're not trained or equipped to assault semi-fortified urban strongholds.

You need at least 12 marines to ensure your 'visit' is both safe (for you) and sufficiently persuasive.
texts.zh:
你的卫队虽个个能干，却没有攻打半设防城区据点的训练与装备。

你至少需要 12 名陆战队员，才能保证这次'拜访'既 (对你来说) 安全，也足够有说服力。

texts.en:
Your armorer meets you along with a dozen marines equipped for urban infiltration.

They're more lightly armed and armored than they would be for a full assault, but they have more than enough firepower to take on any minor gang of Qaras.
texts.zh:
你的军械官带着十来个为城区渗透装备好的陆战队员来见你。

他们的武装与装甲都比全面强攻时轻，但火力拿来对付 Qaras 上任何一个小帮派都绰绰有余。

texts.en:
You have not received permission from any figure of local influence on Qaras to perform an operation. As an outsider imposing on their home turf, however chaotic, you are likely to set off the defensive alliance of the various gangs, crews, corps, and mercs that protect Qaras from outsiders.

Only a full military raid can overcome them.
texts.zh:
你没有从 Qaras 任何有影响力的角色那里取得行动许可。作为一个闯进他们地盘的外人，无论这地方多乱，你都很可能触发那套防御同盟——各个帮派、船员、公司和雇佣兵组成的、把 Qaras 挡在外人之外的网。

只有一次全面的军事突袭才能压过他们。

texts.en: With the blessing of a local leader of influence, the 'official' enforcers of what passes for order around here should not give you any trouble.
texts.zh: 有了本地一位有影响力的头面人物点头，这地方勉强算作秩序的那批'官方'执法者，应该不会给你添麻烦。

options.en: Give the order to proceed
options.zh: 下令开始

options.en: Stand down, for now
options.zh: 暂且作罢

options.en: Prepare a full raid against the gang that attacked you
options.zh: 筹备一次对袭击你的帮派的全面突袭

texts.en:
Each party of local enforcers, variously affiliated, stationed at strategic points of the main metroplex of Qaras makes no acknowledgement that a squad of power-armored space marines is marching through their territory.

Some bystanders stare. The wiser flee.

Shopkeepers shut their storefronts with practiced efficiency. They know what to do when a turf war breaks out, and this looks like a serious one.
texts.zh:
驻扎在 Qaras 主城区各个要点上的本地执法者分属各不相同的势力，对一队身着动力装甲的太空陆战队正从自己地盘上走过这件事，全都装作没看见。

有几个旁观者直盯着看。聪明些的已经跑了。

店主们以熟练的效率关上店门。地盘火并起来该怎么办，他们心里清楚；而这一场看着不像闹着玩的。

texts.en:
Groups of local enforcers, variously affiliated, are stationed at strategic points throughout the main metroplex of Qaras. Those you can avoid, you avoid. Those who force a confrontation in the name of this-or-that local gang boss are forced to stand aside by the threat of military-grade firepower.

As a rule, bystanders flee on sight.

Shopkeepers shut their storefronts with practiced speed; they know what to do when a turf war breaks out, and this looks like a serious one.

It doesn't take long for word to spread. The corridors are cleared of civilians well before you arrive at your target.
texts.zh:
本地执法者分属各不相同的势力，成群驻扎在 Qaras 主城区各处要点。能绕开的，你就绕开。那些打着这个或那个本地帮派头目的名号非要拦你的，在军用级火力的威胁下也只能让到一边。

照例，旁观者一看见你们就跑。

店主们以熟练的速度关上店门；地盘火并起来该怎么办，他们清楚，而这一场看着不像闹着玩的。

消息传开得很快。你还没到目标，走廊里的平民早就清空了。

options.en: Storm the gang's compound
options.zh: 强攻帮派据点

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
No serious firefights broke out during your intrusion through the territory of a dozen minor gangs - you're an unknown bearing heavy firepower, so they satisfy themselves with threats, taunts, and displays of bravado. It would be expensive to force a conflict with uncertain goals and definite losses; evolutionary pressure has compelled a reasonably practical level of strategic thought among the gangs of Qaras.

You've made no friends here, of course.
texts.zh:
在你穿过十几个小帮派地盘的整个过程中，没有爆发一场像样的枪战 —— 你是个来历不明、火力凶猛的访客，所以他们只要威胁、嘲讽、摆摆架子就满足了。为了一场目标不明、损失却必然惨重的冲突硬碰一次，代价太高；生存的压力，早已在 Qaras 的帮派之间逼出一种相当务实的战略思维。

当然，你在这儿一个朋友都没交到。

options.en: Storm the gang's compound
options.zh: 强攻帮派据点

texts.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. No change in the situation. Operation is ongoing."
texts.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。情况没有变化。行动仍在进行。"

texts.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Successful contact was initiated by the subject and pick-up arrangements were made." A nervous look. "It was a short timescale, very recent... we had to act before we could confirm with you."

"But he didn't show. No further contact attempt was made. And no hard confirmation on who contacted us - they just... claimed to be Hercules. Text only. We have no additional information on the situation."
texts.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。目标主动发起了通讯，联系成功，接应安排也已定下。\"对方不安地瞥了一眼。\"时间非常紧，就在不久前...我们来不及先向你确认就动手了。"

"可他没有出现。之后也没再尝试联系。而且我们无法确认对方是谁——那人只是...自称 Hercules。只有文字。关于目前的情况，我们没有更多情报。"

texts.en:
"There has been no further contact with the subject. We've received nothing, we've found nothing."

Hesitation.
texts.zh:
"与目标再没有任何联系。我们什么都没收到，也什么都没查到。"

一阵迟疑。

options.en: Then take the initiative. Make contact with Hercules.
options.zh: 那就主动出手。想办法联系上 Hercules。

options.en: Acknowledged. Keep it quiet, but keep the line open.
options.zh: 收到。别声张，但线要保持通着。

options.en: Good. Keep it up and tell me if you find anything.
options.zh: 很好。继续，有发现就报我。

options.zh: 我要你们静下来，别引人注意。但他要是来通讯，线得通着。

texts.en:
"It's... almost speculation, almost. But our agents have found... patterns which suggest that other operatives have been looking for Hercules."

"Surveillance anomalies, reactive software inquiries set off by our own search - very discreet, we were never tracked," they add rapidly. "Suspect the others are private agents, but some very likely backed by major factions. Very sophisticated, very subtle. High access."
texts.zh:
"这...几乎只能算推测，几乎。但我们的人手发现了一些...迹象，表明还有别的特工在找 Hercules。"

"监视上的异常、由我们自己的搜索引发的反制性软件探询——做得极隐蔽，我们从未被追踪到，\"对方说得很快。\"怀疑其他几路是私人特工，但也有些很可能有大型势力撑腰。手段极老练，极隐蔽。权限很高。"

options.en: But no sign of Hercules.
options.zh: 可还是没有 Hercules 的踪迹。

texts.en:
"Correct, $playerSirOrMadam. It's possible someone else got to him first."

Their expression is closed.

"We'll send a priority message to you, directly, if the situation changes."
texts.zh:
"正是，$playerSirOrMadam。有可能别人先一步找到了他。"

对方神色一收。

"情况若有变化，我们会直接给你发最优先级的消息。"

texts.en:
Found Achilles, options:
- stays with PL, hand over to Finlay Siyavong in Fleet Intelligence
- take him to Hyder to push his claim
- try to convince him to go to Orcus Rao "for his protection" (He'll agree, but actually duck out to go with PL intelligence)

BTW an assassin tried to take him out already and failed - thats what really happened in the bar, the random fight story is a coverup
texts.zh:
找到了 Achilles，选项：

- 留在英仙座联盟，移交给舰队情报局的 Finlay Siyavong

- 带他去找 Hyder，帮他推进自己那份主张

- 试着劝他去 Orcus Rao 那里，名义上说是"为他提供庇护"（他会答应，实际上不过是借机躲开，转投联盟情报机构）

顺带一提，已经有个刺客想取他性命却没得逞 - 酒吧里真正发生的就是这回事，那场"偶遇斗殴"的说法是遮掩。

texts.en:
The link snaps into an active connection. The young man looks impatient.

"Yes, what do you want?"

His face is familiar from the intel reports. And historical holos.

Once you know what, who, you're looking at, it's impossible to unsee. But, strikingly, in a Persean League Fleet uniform rather than that of a Hegemony officer. It feels quite wrong.
texts.zh:
通讯链接啪地接通。对面的年轻人一脸不耐烦。

"说吧，什么事？"

那张脸你在情报报告里见过。也在历史全息影像里见过。

一旦你认出眼前这个人是谁，这相似就再也躲不开。可最扎眼的是那一身英仙座联盟舰队制服，而不是霸主的军官装。看着实在不对劲。

options.en: I'm asking about Lieutenant Kallian as a Demarchon of the Persean League.
options.zh: 我是以英仙座联盟统领的身份，在打听 Kalian 中尉。

texts.en:
$personName sits up straight. "My apologies, Demarchon. I didn't recognize you in this context - my comms suite should have..."

$HeOrShe gives an annoyed glance to the side, perhaps directed at the comms technician.

"Nonetheless, I'm not familiar with... Kalian, you said? An officer in Fleet? Hm." $HeOrShe taps at $hisOrHer datapad.
texts.zh:
$personName 坐直了身子。"恕我失礼，统领。这种场合我没认出你来——我的通讯系统本该..."

$HeOrShe 不快地朝旁边瞥了一眼，大概是在看通讯技师。

"不过，我对... 你说的是 Kalian？舰队里的一名军官？嗯。"$HeOrShe 在$hisOrHer的数据板上敲了几下。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Yes, it looks like we did have a transfer recently. Lieutenant... Kalian. Yes."

$HisOrHer eyes scan the datapad. "Wow."
texts.zh:
"对，看来我们最近确实接收过一名调动人员。中尉... Kalian。对。"

$HisOrHer 的目光扫过数据板。"哇哦。"

options.en: 'Wow'?
options.zh: '哇哦'？

texts.en:
"They usually send us... well, between you and me, demarchon, Yesod isn't exactly Fleet's top priority."

"We get the dregs. Drunks, fools, and the most disgraced of the gens-babies to lead them. Your Kalian? His record says he was flagged for an early command. Someone thought he'd have a serious career. Then it looks like that got squashed by..." $HeOrShe taps for a moment the interface. "Some major gens or other. Shame."

"Not that Kalian is totally clean... Looks like he got into a fight in a spacer bar not long after transfer. Public record suppressed. Someone up high felt bad for him, I'd guess."
texts.zh:
"他们派给我们的通常都是... 这么说吧，统领，你我之间的话，Yesod 可不算舰队的头等要地。"

"分到这儿来的都是些剩货。醉鬼、蠢货，还有最丢人的那批氏族子弟来带队。你那位 Kalian？档案上说他曾被标为可提前授衔指挥。有人觉得他会有番正经前程。可后来似乎被... 压下去了。\"$HeOrShe 在界面上敲了一阵。\"某个大氏族之类。可惜。"

"倒不是说 Kalian 一点污点都没有... 看来他调来没多久，就在一家太空佬酒吧里打了架。公开记录被压了下去。我猜是上头有人替他难过。"

options.en: An officer should know to control himself regardless of the circumstances.
options.zh: 不管什么处境，军官都该懂得克制自己。

options.en: He lost a prime opportunity to corruption. It's natural to take out that anger.
options.zh: 他丢掉的那个绝好机会，毁在了腐败上。把火气撒出来，也是人之常情。

options.en: Do you have a comms ID? I'd like to speak with him.
options.zh: 你有他的通讯识别码吗？我想跟他谈谈。

texts.en: "I suppose. The young..." $HeOrShe looks up. "They have much to learn. I hope Fleet knows what it's doing here."
texts.zh: "也许吧。年轻人...\"$HeOrShe 抬起头。\"他们要学的还多。但愿舰队知道自己在做什么。"

texts.en: "I suppose." A look of concern crosses $hisOrHer face. "But he should have the sense to direct it where it belongs."
texts.zh: "也许吧。\"$hisOrHer 脸上掠过一丝担忧。\"可他该有分寸，把火气发在该发的地方。"

texts.en:
"I do, in fact." $HeOrShe taps the datapad. "You should have it now."

"Good luck with... with whatever you're up to, demarchon. Maybe give Lieutenant Kallian a bit of advice on how to deal with the gens?"

$name smirks, then shakes $hisOrHer head.

"Anything else today?"
texts.zh:
"我确实有。\"$HeOrShe 在数据板上敲了一下。\"你现在应该收到了。"

"祝你好运... 不管你打算做什么，统领。也许可以给 Kalian 中尉提点建议，教他怎么应付那些氏族？"

$name 咧嘴一笑，随即摇起 $hisOrHer 的头。

"今天还有别的事吗？"

options.en: I bear a commission of the Persean League. I ask again, do you know of a Lieutenant Kallian?
options.zh: 我持有英仙座联盟的委任状。我再问一次，你认得一位 Kalian 中尉吗？

texts.en:
"I see. However, $playerSirOrMadam, I remain a civilian administrator."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad. "Out of respect for your dedication to the defense of the League, I'll do what I can. Which isn't much. I assume this is somehow pursuant to factional defense interests?"

$HeOrShe looks up at you, but doesn't wait for a reply, then executes a series of taps on datapad.

"I've sent a request with your comms ID to my Fleet liaison. Maybe they'll help, maybe not. You'll know if you get a comms request."

$HeOrShe leans back. "That help?"
texts.zh:
"我明白。不过，$playerSirOrMadam，我终究只是个民政行政官。"

$HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板。"念在你为联盟防务尽心尽力的份上，我尽力而为。不过也做不了多少。我猜这事多少与联盟的防务利益有关？"

$HeOrShe 抬眼看向你，却没等你回答，随即在数据板上敲了一连串指令。

"我已经把你的通讯识别码附在一份请求里，发给了我的舰队联络官。他们帮不帮，不好说。要是收到通讯请求，那就是有回音了。"

$HeOrShe 靠回椅背。"这样有帮助吗？"

options.en: Yes, thank you.
options.zh: 是的，谢谢你。

options.en: It's the least you could do.
options.zh: 这不过是你最起码该做的。

texts.en: "You're welcome," $heOrShe says. "Is there anything else I can help with?"
texts.zh: "不客气，\"$heOrShe 说道，\"还有别的我能帮上的吗？"

texts.en:
An annoyed look.

"You're so very welcome, captain. Now I have an important meeting."

$HeOrShe hits the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
一脸不快。

"不必客气，舰长。现在我有个重要的会。"

$HeOrShe 按下了通讯切断键。

texts.en:
$personName sits up straight. "My apologies, Demarchon. I didn't recognize you in this context - my comms suite should have..."

$HeOrShe gives an annoyed glance to the side, perhaps directed at the comms technician.

"Nonetheless, I'm not familiar with... Kalian, you said? An officer in Fleet? Hm." $HeOrShe taps at $hisOrHer datapad.
texts.zh:
$personName 坐直了身子。"恕我失礼，统领。这种场合我没认出你来——我的通讯系统本该..."

$HeOrShe 不快地朝旁边瞥了一眼，大概是在看通讯技师。

"不过，我对... 你说的是 Kalian？舰队里的一名军官？嗯。"$HeOrShe 在$hisOrHer的数据板上敲了几下。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Yes, it looks like we did have a transfer recently. Lieutenant... Kalian. Yes."

$HisOrHer eyes scan the datapad. "Wow."
texts.zh:
"对，看来我们最近确实接收过一名调动人员。中尉... Kalian。对。"

$HisOrHer 的目光扫过数据板。"哇哦。"

options.en: 'Wow'?
options.zh: '哇哦'？

texts.en:
"They usually send us... well, between you and me, demarchon, Yesod isn't exactly Fleet's top priority."

"We get the dregs. Drunks, fools, and the most disgraced of the gens-babies to lead them. Your Kalian? His record says he was flagged for an early command. Someone thought he'd have a serious career. Then it looks like that got squashed by..." $HeOrShe taps for a moment the interface. "Some major gens or other. Shame."

"Not that Kalian is totally clean... Looks like he got into a fight in a spacer bar not long after transfer. Public record suppressed. Someone up high felt bad for him, I'd guess."

texts.en:
"Achilles Kalian? Of course we know him! He's the one who wiped the floor with some spacer trash last week, ha-ha!"

A couple other young officers start chanting "Kalian! Kalian!"

After this fails to inspire the rest of the bar to take up the chant, they conclude with a cheer nonetheless and down their drinks.
texts.zh:
"Achilles Kalian？我们当然认得他！上周把某个太空佬渣滓揍得满地找牙的就是他，哈哈！"

旁边几个年轻军官开始齐声喊："Kalian！Kalian！"

这喊声没能带动酒吧里其余的人，他们还是自己欢呼了一声作结，然后把杯中酒一饮而尽。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The officers' pointman slams a drinking vessel down and wipes his mouth on his sleeve.
texts.zh: 军官们当中领头的那个把酒杯往桌上一顿，用袖子抹了抹嘴。

texts.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking between you and their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're a... you have a commish... mission."

After a moment of confusion, the message gets across - you bear a League commission and therefore are one of the "good ones" - the exact words used.

This results in a cheer to your integrity and honorable bearing followed by enthusiastic back-slapping and drink-spilling.
texts.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官的目光在你和他们的数据板之间来回，人有些站不稳，\"你是... 你有委任... 委任状。"

困惑了片刻，意思总算传达到了——你持有联盟的委任状，因此属于他们口中的"自己人"——用的正是这几个字。

于是有人为你的正直与体面欢呼起来，接着是一通热情的拍背和泼洒的酒水。

texts.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking between you and their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're a, uh... a democh... demarchon!"

Everyone stands up a bit straighter, adopting a somewhat more respectable, though still wobbly, composure.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," their apparent leader declares. "It would be an honor to share a drink with you."

A chorus of "ayes" follow this proclamation.
texts.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官的目光在你和他们的数据板之间来回，人有些站不稳，\"你是，呃... 统... 统领！"

所有人都坐直了些，摆出一副稍微像样些、多少也还算端正的仪态，尽管有几位仍在晃。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"他们当中显然是头儿的那位宣布道，\"能与您共饮一杯，是我们的荣幸。"

话音刚落，一片"是！"的应和声响起。

texts.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking at their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're not with us."

Low muttering; the officers seem to withdraw their drinks as if you might snatch them away, or seed them with some spacer-poison.
texts.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官看着自己的数据板，人有些站不稳，\"你不是我们的人。"

低低的嘀咕声；军官们似乎把酒杯往回收，像是怕你一把抢走，或者往里下了什么太空佬的毒药。

options.en: I feel like you good folks could use another round - on me.
options.zh: 我看诸位该再来一轮——我请。

options.en: Alright, let's settle down.
options.zh: 好了，都安静些。

options.en: Uh, I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
options.zh: 呃，我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

options.zh: 我看诸位该让我请一轮。

options.zh: 好了，都安静些。

options.en: Well, it's not like you have much choice
options.zh: 反正你也没什么别的选择

texts.en:
You couldn't have delivered a more fitting line to a more receptive audience.

The cheers and stomping earn a worried look from the barkeeper, but they know where the credits come from and who it's profitable to keep happy.
texts.zh:
这句话说得再合适不过，听的人也再捧场不过。

欢呼与跺脚招来酒保担忧的一瞥，可他们清楚星币是从谁手里来的，也清楚哄谁开心才有赚头。

texts.en:
Their 'leader' seems unsure, and looks back at the gang to gauge their mood. By their state of inebriation, their mood seems to be a matter of pure chance.

A shaking head, a displeased noise. It spreads into frowns and glares and more muttering.

"I don't think so, cap," the 'leader' says dismissively. "We don't rec with your kind. Kalian knew what to do with your type."

The implied threat earns some hoots and encouragement.
texts.zh:
他们的'头儿'看着有些迟疑，回头望向那帮人，想摸清他们的情绪。不过就他们醉成那样，情绪如何恐怕全凭运气。

一个摇头，一声不满的哼声。随即蔓延成皱眉、瞪眼和更多的嘀咕。

"我看不必了，舰长，\"他们的'头儿'不以为然地摆了摆手，\"我们可不跟你们这种人喝酒。Kalian 知道该拿你们这种人怎么办。"

这暗含的威胁招来几声哄笑和叫好。

texts.en:
Their 'leader' seems unsure, and looks back at the gang to gauge their mood. By their state of inebriation, their mood seems to be a matter of pure chance.

A shrug, a sheepish grin. This spreads into approving sounds, then cheers. The 'leader' nods at you.

"A drinks a drink, isn't it? Come on, then."

You're pulled to their table and hailed as someone landing halfway between a worthy competitor and a fellow-warrior.
texts.zh:
他们的'头儿'看着有些迟疑，回头望向那帮人，想摸清他们的情绪。不过就他们醉成那样，情绪如何恐怕全凭运气。

一个耸肩，一个不好意思的笑。这笑传染开来，变成认可的嘀咕，接着是欢呼。'头儿'朝你点了点头。

"酒就是酒，还能有什么两样？那就来吧。"

你被拽到他们桌边，被当成一个既算得上像样的对手、又够得上同袍的人来欢迎。

texts.en:
"I don't think so, cap," their 'leader' says dismissively.

Some derisive hoots are emitted from the pack of officers. "We don't rec with your kind. Achilles knew what to do with you."

The implied threat earns some jeers and encouragement.
texts.zh:
"我看不必了，舰长，"他们的'头儿'不以为然地摆了摆手。

军官堆里爆出几声嘲弄的嘘声。"我们可不跟你们这种人打交道。Achilles 知道该拿你们怎么办。"

这暗含的威胁招来几声哄笑和叫好。

options.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

options.en: Wipe the smirk off his face... with your fist.
options.zh: 用拳头抹掉他脸上那副得意的笑...

options.en: Bartender, a round for my new friends!
options.zh: 酒保，给我的新朋友们来一轮！

options.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
options.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

options.en: Wipe the smirk off his face - with your fist
options.zh: 用拳头抹掉他脸上那副得意的笑

texts.en: You make a quick exit before things get out of control.
texts.zh: 在场面失控之前，你迅速离场。

texts.en: It doesn't take a tactician to read the room. You make a quick exit before things get ugly.
texts.zh: 读懂这屋里的气氛用不着战术家。在事情变难看之前，你迅速抽身。

texts.en:
* * *

You got a good first hit in.

But there were a lot of them, and they're Fleet officers in a Persean League polity. This doesn't make them tougher than the usual crowd, but they enjoy certain exceptional legal protections.

Your bodyguards could only do so much to pull you from the chaos - your honor, perhaps, intact. Bodily you are battered and bruised, uniform torn, and your local reputation besmirched.

The MuniSec officer who 'interviews' you makes it clear that someone higher up gave an order to sweep this incident away. They just want you gone, and quietly.
texts.zh:
* * *

你第一拳打得漂亮。

可他们人太多，而且这里是英仙座联盟的政体，他们是舰队军官。这并不让他们比寻常的混混更抗揍，但他们享有某些格外好用的法律保护。

你的保镖能把你从乱局里拖出来，能做的也就那么多——名誉也许还算完好。身上青一块紫一块，制服扯破了，你在此地的名声也毁了。

"约谈"你的那名 MuniSec 军官把话说得很明白：上头有人下令，把这事抹平。他们只想让你走，而且是悄无声息地走。

texts.en: One round turns into two, and a good impression is solidified.
texts.zh: 一轮变成两轮，好印象也就此坐实。

texts.en: More than one of the officers is forced to retreat from the field to 'vent flux', as they put it, before the ruckus quiets enough that you can find an opportunity to turn the conversation toward your inquiry.
texts.zh: 不止一名军官不得不离席，用他们的话说，去"排幅能"；等喧闹平息到你能找到机会把话头引向你的问题，已经过了一会儿。

options.en: I hear Kalian was unassigned. Shame. But I might have an opportunity...
options.zh: 我听说 Kalian 没有任职。可惜。不过我这儿也许有个机会...

texts.en:
You're treated to an enthusiastic retelling of the injustice faced by Kalian - a brilliant officer, the academy's finest - who received a choice assignment then had it withdrawn at the last moment. And then, again, about his confrontation with a barbaric spacer who dared malign the good name of the League (generally) and (in particular) Fleet.

Sour talk about Gens-babies taking the choice missions is much quieter. You steer the conversation back toward what could be done for Kalian - perhaps a private request for increased fleet patrols to quell piracy, even mercenary work...

The drunk League officers are more than happy to help their comrade make a useful contact.
texts.zh:
你被热情地灌了一通 Kalian 所受的不公：一个出色的军官，学院里最拔尖的人，本已拿到一份好差事，却在最后一刻被撤了。接着又是一遍，讲他怎么跟一个野蛮的太空佬对上——那人竟敢玷污联盟 (泛泛而言) 和舰队 (尤其) 的好名声。

至于说氏族崽子抢走好任务的酸话，就压得低多了。你把话头引回能为 Kalian 做点什么——也许私下请求增派舰队巡逻、清剿海盗，甚至雇佣兵的活儿...

这些醉醺醺的联盟军官乐得帮自家兄弟搭上一条有用的线。

options.en: Say your polite good-byes and leave
options.zh: 礼貌道别，然后离开

texts.en: You deftly extract yourself before the officers can ply you with ill-advised quantities of drink.
texts.zh: 趁军官们还没灌你喝下那些不明智的酒量，你利落地脱了身。

texts.en:
The junior officers sheepishly give in to your authority, shushing their drunker comrades and arranging themselves respectfully at the table. It isn't a passable parade formation, but it's a good sight more civilized than the state you found them in.

The bartender gives you a grateful look as they find this opportunity to finally clear some of the empties.
texts.zh:
那些下级军官讪讪地服了你的管束，嘘住醉得更厉害的同伴，规规矩矩地在桌边坐好。这队形算不上能上阅兵场的行列，但比起你刚进来时的样子，已经文明太多了。

酒保趁这机会终于能收走几个空杯，感激地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
Boos and jeers erupt. You're obviously no fun at all.

The officers do settle into a relatively sullen din after a minute, but they seem unlikely to engage in a conversation.
texts.zh:
嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你显然是个扫兴的家伙。

过了一分钟，军官们到底还是压成了一片闷闷的低声嘈杂，但看样子是不打算跟你搭话了。

texts.en: Boos and jeers erupt. It's become clear that you're no fun at all, and the mood is taking a turn for the ugly.
texts.zh: 嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你是个扫兴的家伙，这已经很明显了，而气氛正往难看的方向滑。

texts.en:
Boos and jeers erupt. You're no fun at all.

One larger, drunker junior officer steps to your face, flashes a grin to his comrades, then delivers his line.

"Achilles knew what to do with your kind."
texts.zh:
嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你一点都不好玩。

一个块头更大、醉得更狠的下级军官凑到你脸前，朝同伴们咧嘴一笑，然后撂下他那句话。

"Achilles 知道该怎么收拾你们这种人。"

texts.en:
You share a round with the junior officers. Learning that they are drinking with a demarchon of the League has put them into a somewhat stunned state.

They do their best to maintain their composure - sitting up straight, albeit unsteadily in a few cases, and sipping their drinks rather than downing them all at once.

A few polite questions are managed - where is your planet, what are its notable qualities - before you can firmly turn the conversation to your own purposes.
texts.zh:
你和这些下级军官共饮了一轮。得知自己是在跟联盟的一位统领喝酒，他们有些发懵。

他们竭力维持仪态——坐得笔直，有几位却坐得不太稳，喝酒也改成小口啜，不再一口闷。

他们总算问出几个客套的问题——你的星球在哪儿，有什么出众之处——你这才得以把话头稳稳引到自己的目的上。

options.en: I hear Lieutenant Kalian is unassigned. I'd like to speak with him...
options.zh: 我听说 Kalian 中尉目前没有任职。我想跟他谈谈...

texts.en: You hear the words "heggie" and "Mairaath" along with the broadside of dark looks.
texts.zh: 你听见"霸主佬"和"Mairaath"这两个词，还迎着迎面而来的一片阴沉目光。

texts.en: You hear the words "sindie" and "Cruor" alongside some skeptical looks.
texts.zh: 你听见"辛达佬"和"Cruor"这两个词，还伴着几道怀疑的目光。

texts.en: You hear the words "luddie" and "mazzie" alongside with some skeptical looks.

texts.en: You hear the words "tachy" along with some skeptical looks.
texts.zh: 你听见"速子佬"这个词，还伴着几道怀疑的目光。

texts.en: Having run an ID, it appears they've discovered that while you bear a commission, it is not with the Persean League, which appears to put your character into question.
texts.zh: 他们查过身份之后似乎发现：你确实持有委任状，但并不属于英仙座联盟——这让你的品性成了问题。

texts.en: Having run an ID, it appears they've discovered that you don't bear a faction commission at all - you're just some random spacer out for their own self.
texts.zh: 他们查过身份之后似乎发现：你根本没有任何势力的委任状——不过是个为自己奔忙的太空佬。

texts.zh: 军官们当中领头的那个把酒杯往桌上一顿，用袖子抹了抹嘴。

options.en: I feel like you good folks could use another round - on me.
options.zh: 我看诸位该再来一轮——我请。
