options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"It is strange, $playerName, to taunt me to my face after so much effort. It is a waste. And for what?"

He, for one, sounds unamused. His expression clears and is replaced by something stoic, hardened over many cycles.

"You are no use to me. Do not interfere."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，费了这么多功夫之后当面嘲弄我，真是奇怪。这是浪费。究竟图什么？"

至少他听起来毫无笑意。他脸上的神情一扫而空，换成了某种坚忍的东西——历经许多星历年磨出来的硬。

"你对我没有用处。别来碍事。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Then we have nothing more to talk about," he says conclusively, then reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: "那我们就没有什么可谈的了，"他以定论的口吻说，随后伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"An understandable position," he says calmly. "Your choice must be your own."

"I must ask the question, $titlePL: do I have your support?"
texts.zh:
"可以理解，\"他平静地说。\"你的选择必须由你自己作。"

"我必须问一句，$titlePL：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没有。

texts.en: "Yes, we've had unusually sophisticated materiel coming in. Good Tri-Tachyon tech. Unlocked, it seems, by an insider. The kind of kit that usually comes from lucky convoy-raiding."
texts.zh: "是的，最近进来的物资精密得反常。上好的速子科技货。看来是有内鬼解锁的。这种装备，通常只有运气极好地劫下一支运输队才弄得到。"

texts.en:
"It is useful to diversify sources of material support. I expect you appreciate the implications, captain."

He nods toward you. "I do."
texts.zh:
"物资来源多样化，总是有用的。我想你明白这意味着什么，舰长。"

他朝你点了点头。"我明白。"

texts.en:
He nods, satisfied and even amused.

"It is welcome," he says. "I admit, my staff - yes, I have a staff now - was a little surprised when your partner first made contact."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，颇为满意，甚至有些觉得好笑。

"这很受欢迎，\"他说。\"我承认，我的幕僚——没错，我现在也有幕僚了——在你那位伙伴初次接触时，还有点吃惊。"

texts.en:
"Of course." He doesn't quite smile.

"My logistics team noted that the black market prices were unusually generous. My new shadowy 'benefactor' might make enemies of the usual con-artists if they aren't careful."
texts.zh:
"当然。"他算不上笑了。

"我的后勤组注意到，黑市上的价格优惠得反常。我那位新来的、神出鬼没的'恩主'，要是不小心，恐怕会把那些惯常坑蒙拐骗的家伙都得罪光。"

texts.en:
He blinks, expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally. "You did not come here to whine, I hope."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，\"他终于开口。\"我希望你不是来这儿诉苦的。"

texts.en:
"Unthinkable," he snaps.

"Those Pather terrorists have been carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? One would hope that they recognize that I am not my father - or my brother - and am not to fault for the excesses of either."

Achilles takes a deep breath. "I've already shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."

His tone makes his feelings about further discussion of the topic quite clear.
texts.zh:
"想都别想，"他厉声道。

"那些左径恐怖分子一直在搞破坏、搞暗杀，就是要直接毁掉我的事业。可这又是图什么？我倒希望他们能明白：我不是我父亲——也不是我兄长——他们两人做过的那些过头事，怪不到我头上。"

Achilles 深吸了一口气。"我已经克制得够多了，舰长。相当多。"

他的语气已经把他的态度说得很清楚：这个话题不必再谈。

texts.en:
"Strategy?" He laughs, wildly.

"All these fleets, mercs, navies - they open comms and then officers squawk about 'tactics' and 'strategy', but are they the screams of Dolos Macario?"

He shakes his head.

"Until that I hear, I hear nothing. The wolves are hungry, captain." Moroz looks distant, now. "I must go to battle."

The comms cut, leaving you with his fading image.
texts.zh:
"战略？"他放声大笑，笑得有点疯。

"这么多舰队、雇佣兵、海军——他们打开通讯，军官们就嚷嚷什么'战术'、什么'战略'，可那里面有 Dolos Macario 的惨叫吗？"

他摇了摇头。

"在我听见那声音之前，我什么也听不见。狼群饿了，舰长。\"Moroz 此刻目光飘远。\"我得去打仗了。"

通讯切断，只留给你他那道渐渐消散的影像。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
A cynical smile appears for a moment.

"Of course. That is our arrangement."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
texts.zh:
一丝讥讽的笑在她脸上一闪而过。

"当然。我们就是这么约定的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

texts.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"A rather directly mercenary request, but I ought to have anticipated it."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
texts.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"这要求直白得像雇佣兵，不过我早该料到的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

texts.en:
He smiles, smug and powerful.

"You did well to push him over the edge. Horus was always easily manipulated. He is more like his cousin Menes than he'd ever admit, but..."

Reynard smirks, then waves the thought away.
texts.zh:
他笑了，自得而强势。

"你把他推过了那道坎，干得不错。Horus 一向容易被人摆布。他比他自己肯承认的更像他表亲 Menes，不过..."

Reynard 扯了扯嘴角，把那点念头挥手拂开。

texts.en:
If no spymaster of a major faction can or will help, there is someone you know illegitimate enough to accept credits to solve a mystery.

An information broker on Qaras. Self important, shady, and even annoying. You rejected his offer of assistance outright, and for good reason.

But maybe...
texts.zh:
要是哪个大势力的间谍头子都不能、或不肯帮忙，你还认识一个人，底细够不干净，愿意收星币去解开一桩谜案。

Qaras 上的一个情报贩子。自命不凡、来路不正，甚至还很烦人。你当时断然拒绝了他的协助提议，理由充分。

不过也许...

options.en: K-O Jove.
options.zh: K-O Jove.

options.en: No. Not K-O Jove.
options.zh: 不。不是 K-O Jove。

texts.en: Your bridge crew perks up as you speak but quickly realize none of them was addressed, so return their attention to the report being 'cast to their respective stations.
texts.zh: 你一开口，舰桥上的船员都竖起了耳朵，但很快意识到你不是在对他们说话，于是又把注意力转回各自岗位上播放的报告。

texts.en: Your bridge crew perks up as you speak but quickly realize none of them was addressed, so return their attention to the report being 'cast to their respective stations.
texts.zh: 你一开口，舰桥上的船员都竖起了耳朵，但很快意识到你不是在对他们说话，于是又把注意力转回各自岗位上播放的报告。

texts.en:
You tap your control surface and the feed dies to black. Everyone, your bridge officers and crew, is silent and frozen for a moment - processing.

They begin to move, returning attention to system status.

Nav bravely breaks the silence and speaks up.

"Course, $PlayerSirOrMadam?"
texts.zh:
你点了点控制面板，转播熄灭成一片黑。舰桥上的军官与船员全都沉默地僵了一瞬——在消化。

他们开始动起来，把注意力转回系统状态。

导航官壮着胆子打破沉默开口。

"航向，$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

texts.en:
You tap your control surface and the feed dies to black. Everyone, your bridge officers and crew, is silent and frozen for a moment - processing.

They begin to move, returning attention to system status.

Nav bravely breaks the silence and speaks up.

"Orders, $PlayerSirOrMadam?"
texts.zh:
你点了点控制面板，转播熄灭成一片黑。舰桥上的军官与船员全都沉默地僵了一瞬——在消化。

他们开始动起来，把注意力转回系统状态。

导航官壮着胆子打破沉默开口。

"请下命令，$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

options.en: Proceed on current heading.
options.zh: 保持当前航向前进。

options.en: Maintain orbit.
options.zh: 维持轨道。

texts.en:
You do your best to put him from your mind.

Perhaps you'll find another way. Somehow.
texts.zh:
你尽力把他从脑子里赶开。

也许你能找到别的办法。总有办法。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Running with the transponder off in $faction space is against the law. You're hereby ordered to turn your transponder on, identify yourself immediately, and submit to a cargo scan for contraband."
texts.zh: "Running with the transponder off in $faction space is against the law. You're hereby ordered to turn your transponder on, identify yourself immediately, and submit to a cargo scan for contraband."

options.en: I'm working for Admiral Rao, $rank.
options.zh: 我在为 Rao 上将效力，$rank。

options.en: Turn the transponder on and comply
options.zh: 打开应答器，照办

options.en: Talk your way out of it
options.zh: 靠嘴皮子脱身

options.en: Refuse and cut the comm link
options.zh: 拒绝并切断通讯

texts.en:
An annoyed look crosses $post's face.

"Hold a moment for confirmation," $heOrShe says, tapping at an interface.

It appears to come through green because $heOrShe sighs, and says, "$PlayerSirOrMadam. You are clear to proceed, just... try to keep a low profile from now on, alright?"

Then, curtly, "$PersonRank $PersonLastName out."
texts.zh:
$post 脸上闪过一丝不快。

"稍等，我需要核实一下，"$heOrShe 说着，在界面上敲了几下。

看来核验通过了，因为$heOrShe 叹了口气，说道："$PlayerSirOrMadam。你可以通行了，只是...往后尽量低调些，行吗？"

随后简短地说："$PersonRank $PersonLastName 通话结束。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: You issue an order to activate the transponder and wait for the cargo scan to finish.
texts.zh: 你下令启动了应答器，并等待货物扫描完成。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: After a brief wait, the $faction $otherFleetName transmits the scan results.
texts.zh: After a brief wait, the $faction $otherFleetName transmits the scan results.

texts.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
texts.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

texts.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
texts.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

texts.en:
The $faction $personRank pauses and looks off-screen.

"But what about these cargo pods, which, let me check - why, they do contain illegal cargo. Not yours, are they? No? Excellent. We'll be confiscating the contents, then."
texts.zh:
$faction $personRank 停了下来，并把视线从屏幕上移开了。

"请你解释下这些货舱是怎么回事，为什么它们装的是违禁品？这不是你的，对吧？不是？很好，我们之后会没收这些玩意。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personName looks vaguely displeased.

"If I catch you running with the transponder off again, you won't get off so easily."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
texts.zh:
$personName $PersonRank 看上去很失望。

"如果再让我抓到你关着{应答器}晃悠，事情就不会这么简单了。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

texts.en:
The scan finds no overt contraband, but there is enough suspicion of your involvement in black market activities that the patrol commander is not appeased by this.

"Prepare to receive a boarding party. We'll be conducting a very thorough, hands-on inspection."

You consider it very likely the inspectors will do some small - but just borderline excusable - damage to the combat worthiness of your ships during the course of this "thorough" inspection.
texts.zh:
扫描没有发现公开的违禁品，但对由于你参与黑市活动的嫌疑充分，巡逻队指挥官对此并未善罢甘休。

"准备好迎接一个登船小组。我们要亲自动手进行一次非常彻底的检查。"

你认为在这次 "彻底" 的检查过程中，检查人员很可能会对你的舰船的战备造成一些还算勉强可以接受的少量损害。

texts.en:
"Well, well. Just as I suspected, we've got a smuggler here. Per standard $faction procedure, you're required to eject the contraband into space, for pickup or incineration at the discretion of the patrol commander."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks rather pleased, and you suspect that "pickup" rather than "incineration" might be the order of the day.
texts.zh:
"好啊。正如我所料，我们这还真逮到了个走私犯。遵照 $faction 的标准流程，你必须将违禁品抛弃到太空中，由巡逻队指挥官全权决定是拾取还是焚毁。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 看上去相当高兴，你猜今天的命令应该是 "拾取" 而不是 "焚毁"。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.zh: 允许并准备接受检查

texts.en: As you'd half-expected, several of your ships report minor but painful losses of operational capability. Fortunately, the inspectors seemed to be more interested in causing "accidental" damage than looking for actual contraband, so no objectionable cargo was found.
texts.zh: 情况和你预计得差不多，你的几艘船报告说在作战能力上受到了轻微但令人不快的损失。幸运的是，检查人员似乎更热衷于制造 "意外" 损害，而不是去实际寻找违禁品，因此他们没有发现问题货物。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You manage to convince the patrol commander that $heOrShe would get in trouble with $hisOrHer superiors if $heOrShe pressed the issue.
OR
The patrol commander appears to have a venal streak a mile wide, and some vague promises of favors owed and eventual compensation convince $himOrHer to look the other way.
texts.zh:
你设法让巡逻队指挥官相信，如果$heOrShe坚持要惹事的话，$hisOrHer的上司就会让$heOrShe吃不了兜着走。
OR
看来巡逻队的指挥官早就贪腐成性，在一些诸如欠个人情以后必有重谢之类的含糊承诺之下，$himOrHer睁一只眼闭一只眼放了你一马。
